# Offline widget construction evidence for later skill integration

This is the requested evidence deliverable. It captures literal report-option graphs, inherited contracts, filter payload implementations, widget construction rules and page-context facts. It does not change the skill. Application source was parsed and read only; no application callback, SQL, database connection or deployment was run.

Scope: `ListView`, `ChartView`, `SummaryView`, `DynamicListView`. Cards remain excluded. The shared widget serializer contains incidental branches for other types; these are retained only inside complete source evidence and do not extend scope. Detail-page evidence is supplied for a later scope decision.

Source root: the `businessman-web` application repository. Source citations throughout are provenance. The literal definitions needed for this handover are embedded in this document. There is no release/version check or inference.

## What was captured and what remains a target fact

- Every distinct callback named by the supplied manifest and supplemental InspectionReport record has a returned graph, expanded group paths, constructor declarations, complete callback body, and relation metadata below. The inventory has 184 distinct callback files, reconciled against every manifest pair, including the unusual projectInternalRole.ts directory.
- Shared class and filter definitions are embedded in full. A filter map points to a specific class and source, avoiding ambiguity between unrelated classes named `StatusFilter` or `ContainsFilter`.
- Source-backed widget defaults, source selectors, field selectors, group restrictions, contextual query behaviour, palette values and host calls are supplied below.
- User IDs, enabled modules, permissions, custom-field definitions/maximum, current configuration rows and active relations remain target facts. Preferred dictionary terms are also target facts: four callback labels depend on `_()` and cannot be made target-exact from static source alone. The exact expressions and default wording are captured.

The previous suggestion that a machine-readable format was itself missing product knowledge was too strong. It is a representation choice. This document supplies both a normalized path catalogue and literal source contracts so integration can choose its format without another source retrieval pass. Likewise a complete icon catalogue is useful for arbitrary customization, but a valid default icon and palette suffice for a basic new widget. Both are captured.

### Source ambiguities that an offline generator must preserve

Some returned arrays repeat the same option, and some distinct options share a label. Report path lookup uses the first matching label; do not silently rename or pretend that a later colliding option has a separately addressable path. The ledger preserves every returned entry for provenance, so its entry count is not a count of unique usable paths.

## Reading the normalized records

Each path is relative to the named registered source. A relation row is an edge: concatenate its path with a valid target-source path. Group rows are containers, never terminal selections. Every DateGroup/AggregateGroup child is listed explicitly. Arbitrarily flattening recursive relations would create an unbounded catalogue; the finite graphs plus literal selection/traversal rules define admissible paths. Source callback order is preserved; the picker itself alphabetically sorts labels.

`L`/`C` = class allows list/chart context; `S` = sortable flag; `G` = groupable flag; `A` = AggregateData terminal; `V` = visible flag. These flags are combined with selector rules, permissions and the actual applyGroup/applySort implementations. They are not independent claims that every combination produces a meaningful query. Filter-map IDs refer to the exact map table in this document. Presentation overrides, calculated projections and dependent options also remain in each complete callback body. `[undefined: omit from serialized JSON]` is documentation notation, never a value to persist.

## JobTimeSheet acceptance fixture

Captured 25 returned top-level entries, 5 relations and 105 local data terminals after DateGroup expansion. This count excludes target-dependent custom fields and any fields reached through relations. `Start date / Week of the year` is a real DateData path using WEEKOFYEAR(startDate), not an invented ORM field. A weekly report also needs an explicit year-boundary policy; calendar Year + Week of the year must not be assumed to be ISO week-year.

All five relations (`Job`, `Support ticket`, `Employee`, `Master job`, `Parent job`) are to-one. `Time used` and `Time chargeable` read seconds and render one-decimal hours. `Total time booked` and `Total time charged` sum seconds and render hours, blank at zero. `Total hourly cost` and `Total charge out value` are NumberData fields, not sum aggregates. `Status` is DotData with no filters. Its colour/tooltip derives from whether hourlyRate and chargeOutRate are above zero.

The exact UserData filter is `logged on user` with `{}`; employee identification requires a valid Employee-to-User relation path, not merely selecting the root Employee relation. Root support-ticket label is `Support ticket`; a column may be titled `Ticket` while storing a different path.

````typescript
import { Absence, AbsenceType, CompanyHolidayYear, Employee } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus } from '../../configuration'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Absence>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Absence, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Absence, 'Edited by', 'editor')

    const absenceEnd = new DateGroup(Absence, 'Date to', 'absenceEnd')
    const absenceStart = new DateGroup(Absence, 'Date from', 'absenceStart')
    const created = new DateGroup(Absence, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Absence, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const count = new AggregateData(Absence, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const id = new LinkData(Absence, 'ID', ['id'])

    const absenceType = new RelationOption(Absence, 'Type', 'absenceType', AbsenceType)
    const employee = new RelationOption(Absence, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)

    const additionalInformation = new TypographyData(Absence, 'Additional information', ['additionalInformation'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Absence, 'Status', ['draft', 'pending', 'approved', 'declined'])

    const isPaidAbsence = new BooleanData(Absence, 'Is paid absence', 'isPaid')
    const isPartOfEntitlement = new BooleanData(Absence, 'Is part of entitlement', 'isEntitlement')
    const doctorNoteRequired = new BooleanData(Absence, 'Is doctor note required', 'doctorNoteRequired')
    const doctorNoteUploaded = new BooleanData(Absence, 'Is doctor note uploaded', 'doctorNote')
    const dateDoctorNoteReceived = new TypographyData(Absence, 'Date doctor note received', ['doctorNoteReceived'])

    const workingDays = new NumberData(Absence, 'Working days', 'workingDays')
    const workingHours = new NumberData(Absence, 'Working hours', 'workingHours')
    const holidayYear = new RelationOption(Absence, 'Holiday year', 'holidayYear', CompanyHolidayYear)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(absence => getStatus(absence))

    id.addDependentOption(employee)
    id.setRenderLink(absence => `/company/employees/${absence.employee.id}/absences/${absence.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(absence => `Absence ${absence.id}`)

    return [
        absenceEnd, absenceStart, absenceType, additionalInformation, count, created, creator, edited, editor, employee,
        holidayYear, id, status, workingDays, workingHours, isPaidAbsence, isPartOfEntitlement, doctorNoteRequired, doctorNoteUploaded,
        dateDoctorNoteReceived
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { ArrayFilter } from '../../reports/data/link/filters/arrayFilter'
import { AccountingPeriod, AccountingYear } from '../../models'
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<AccountingPeriod>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(AccountingPeriod, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(AccountingPeriod, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(AccountingPeriod, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(AccountingPeriod, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new LinkData(AccountingPeriod, 'ID', ['id'])
    id.addFilterType('in', ArrayFilter)

    const periodNumber = new TypographyData(AccountingPeriod, 'Number', ['periodNumber'])
    const yearOfPeriod = new RelationOption(AccountingPeriod, 'Year', 'accountingYear', AccountingYear)

    // Default quick filter is 'contains' which doesn't work well for periods - typing 1 would return 1, 10, 11, 12 etc.
    periodNumber.setQuickFilter('equals')

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, periodNumber, yearOfPeriod, id
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { Address } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BooleanData, DateGroup, GroupOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CountryFilter } from './filters/country'
import { countries } from 'typed-countries'

export function getReportOptions(): (UserData<Address> | GroupOption<Address> | TypographyData<Address> | AggregateData<Address> | BooleanData<Address>)[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Address, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Address, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Address, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Address, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const streetAddress1 = new TypographyData(Address, 'Street Address 1', ['streetAddress1'])
    const streetAddress2 = new TypographyData(Address, 'Street Address 2', ['streetAddress2'])
    const streetAddress3 = new TypographyData(Address, 'Street Address 3', ['streetAddress3'])
    const city = new TypographyData(Address, 'City', ['city'])
    const administrativeArea = new TypographyData(Address, 'Administrative area', ['administrativeArea'])
    const postalCode = new TypographyData(Address, 'Postal code', ['postalCode'])
    const country = new GroupOption(Address, 'Country')

    const countryCode = new TypographyData(Address, 'Code', ['country'])
    const countryName = new TypographyData(Address, 'Name', ['country'])
    const countryRegion = new TypographyData(Address, 'Region', ['country'])
    const count = new AggregateData(Address, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const isAddressValidated = new BooleanData(Address, 'Address validated', 'isAddressValidated')

    country.addChild(countryCode, countryName, countryRegion)

    countryCode.clearFilterTypes()
    countryCode.addFilterType('equals', CountryFilter)
    countryCode.setQuickFilter('equals')

    countryName.clearFilterTypes()
    countryName.addFilterType('equals', CountryFilter)
    countryName.setQuickFilter('equals')

    countryRegion.clearFilterTypes()
    countryRegion.addFilterType('equals', CountryFilter)
    countryRegion.setQuickFilter('equals')
    countryRegion.setGroupable(false)
    countryRegion.setSortable(false)

    countryName.setRenderLabel(address => {
        const country = countries.find(country => country.iso === address.country)

        return country === undefined ? '' : country.name
    })

    countryRegion.setRenderLabel(address => {
        const country = countries.find(country => country.iso === address.country)

        return country === undefined ? '' : country.region
    })

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, streetAddress1, streetAddress2, streetAddress3,
        administrativeArea, city, postalCode, count, country, isAddressValidated
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { AiKey, AiProvider, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<AiKey>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(AiKey, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(AiKey, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const count = new AggregateData(AiKey, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const editor = new UserData(AiKey, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(AiKey, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(AiKey, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const aiProvider = new RelationOption(AiKey, 'AI Provider', 'aiProvider', AiProvider)
    const name = new TypographyData(AiKey, 'Name', ['name'])
    const isActive = new BooleanData(AiKey, 'Is active', 'isActive')
    const isDefault = new BooleanData(AiKey, 'Is default', 'isDefault')
    const lastUsedAt = new DateGroup(AiKey, 'Last used at', 'lastUsedAt')
    const baseUrl = new TypographyData(AiKey, 'Base URL', ['baseUrl'])
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(AiKey, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const hiddenAiKey = new TypographyData(AiKey, 'Api key', ['apiKey'])
    hiddenAiKey.renderContent = () => new Typography('*********')

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, count, aiProvider, name, isActive, isDefault, lastUsedAt, baseUrl, tradingCompany, hiddenAiKey
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { AiKey, AiModel, AiProvider, AiUsageLog, TradingCompany } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<AiUsageLog>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(AiUsageLog, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(AiUsageLog, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const user = new UserData(AiUsageLog, 'User', 'user')
    const aiRequestId = new TypographyData(AiUsageLog, 'AI Request ID', ['aiRequestId'])
    const aiProvider = new RelationOption(AiUsageLog, 'AI Provider', 'aiProvider', AiProvider)
    const aiModel = new RelationOption(AiUsageLog, 'AI Model', 'aiModel', AiModel)
    const aiKey = new RelationOption(AiUsageLog, 'AI Key', 'aiKey', AiKey)
    const promptTokensUncached = new NumberData(AiUsageLog, 'Tokens - input uncached prompt', 'promptTokensUncached')
    const cacheReadTokens = new NumberData(AiUsageLog, 'Tokens - input cache read', 'cacheReadTokens')
    const cacheWriteTokens = new NumberData(AiUsageLog, 'Tokens - input cache write', 'cacheWriteTokens')
    const totalInputTokens = new NumberData(AiUsageLog, 'Tokens - input total', 'totalInputTokens')
    const outputTokens = new NumberData(AiUsageLog, 'Tokens - output total', 'outputTokens')
    const totalTokens = new NumberData(AiUsageLog, 'Tokens - grand total', 'totalTokens')
    const calculatedCost = new NumberData(AiUsageLog, 'Calculated Cost', 'calculatedCost')
    const created = new DateGroup(AiUsageLog, 'Created on', 'created')
    const actionType = new TypographyData(AiUsageLog, 'Action type', ['actionType'])
    const additionalDescription = new TypographyData(AiUsageLog, 'Additional description', ['additionalDescription'])
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(AiUsageLog, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    return [
        id, user, count, aiRequestId, aiProvider, aiModel, aiKey, promptTokensUncached, cacheReadTokens, cacheWriteTokens, totalInputTokens,
        outputTokens, totalTokens, calculatedCost, created, actionType, additionalDescription, tradingCompany
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { AllJobCost, Job } from '../../models'
import { CostTypeFilter } from './filters/costType'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions/formatInternationalNumber'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<AllJobCost>[] {
    const job = new RelationOption(AllJobCost, 'Job', 'job', Job)

    const costType = new TypographyData(AllJobCost, 'type', ['type'])
    const cost = new TypographyData(AllJobCost, 'cost', ['cost'])
    const invoiceCost = new TypographyData(AllJobCost, 'Invoice cost', ['invoiceCost'])
    const forInvoice = new BooleanData(AllJobCost, 'For invoice', 'forInvoice')
    const description = new TypographyData(AllJobCost, 'Description', ['description'])

    const createdOn = new DateGroup(AllJobCost, 'Created on', 'createdOn')

    const totalCost = new AggregateData(AllJobCost, 'Costs', 'cost', 'sum')
    const totalInvoiceCost = new AggregateData(AllJobCost, 'Invoice values', 'invoiceCost', 'sum')
    const count = new AggregateData(AllJobCost, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    totalCost.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatInternationalNumber(Number(totalCost.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2)
    totalCost.setPrecision(2)
    totalCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalCost.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    totalInvoiceCost.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatInternationalNumber(Number(totalInvoiceCost.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2)
    totalInvoiceCost.setPrecision(2)
    totalInvoiceCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalInvoiceCost.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    costType.setSortable(false)
    costType.clearFilterTypes()
    costType.addFilterType('equals', CostTypeFilter)
    costType.setQuickFilter('equals')

    return [
        job, costType, cost, forInvoice, description, createdOn, invoiceCost, totalCost, count, totalInvoiceCost
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { AllSoCosts, Job, PurchaseOrder, SalesOrder } from '../../models'
import { CostTypeFilter } from './filters/costsType'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions/formatInternationalNumber'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<AllSoCosts>[] {
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(AllSoCosts, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)

    const costType = new TypographyData(AllSoCosts, 'type', ['type'])
    const cost = new NumberData(AllSoCosts, 'cost', 'cost')
    const description = new TypographyData(AllSoCosts, 'Description', ['description'])
    const includeCost = new BooleanData(AllSoCosts, 'Include cost', 'includeCost')
    const includeCosts = new TypographyData(AllSoCosts, 'Include costs', ['includeCost'])

    const createdOn = new DateGroup(AllSoCosts, 'Created on', 'createdOn')

    const totalCost = new AggregateData(AllSoCosts, 'Costs', 'cost', 'sum')
    const count = new AggregateData(AllSoCosts, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(AllSoCosts, 'Purchase order', 'purchaseOrder', PurchaseOrder)
    const job = new RelationOption(AllSoCosts, 'Job', 'job', Job)

    totalCost.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatInternationalNumber(Number(totalCost.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2)
    totalCost.setPrecision(2)
    totalCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(totalCost.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    costType.setSortable(false)
    costType.clearFilterTypes()
    costType.addFilterType('equals', CostTypeFilter)
    costType.setQuickFilter('equals')

    cost.setRenderLabel(entity => Number(entity.cost).toFixed(2))

    return [
        salesOrder, costType, cost, description, createdOn, totalCost, count, includeCost, includeCosts,
        purchaseOrder, job
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, Filter, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Asset, Employee, Job, MaintenanceSchedule, NoteRelation, Product, ProductLocation, PurchaseOrder, Quote, SalesOrder, ServiceContract, Site } from '../../models'
import { FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class SlaFilter extends Filter<{}, TypographyData<Asset>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
            const subQuery = query.subQuery()
                .select('a.id')
                .from(Asset, 'a')
                .andWhere('a.serviceLevel IS NOT NULL')

            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${subQuery.getQuery()}`)

            return true
    }

    public render() {
        return new FragmentContainer()
    }
}

export function getReportOptions(): (AggregateData<Asset> | DateGroup<Asset> | LinkData<Asset> | RelationOption<Asset> | TypographyData<Asset> | UserData<Asset>)[] {
    const id = new LinkData(Asset, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(Asset, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Asset, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Asset, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Asset, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const contract = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Contract', 'contract', ServiceContract)
    const contract2 = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Contract', 'contract', ServiceContract)

    // Temporary double relation as workaround for bug when add the same relation twice on the same ListView
    const site = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Site', 'site', Site)
    const site2 = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Site', 'site', Site)

    const parent = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Parent', 'parent', Asset)
    const children = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Children', 'children', Asset)
    const primaryEngineer = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Primary engineer', 'primaryEngineer', Employee)
    const product = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const jobs = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const supportTicket = new RelationOption(Asset, 'SupportTickets', 'notes', NoteRelation)
    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(Asset, 'PurchaseOrder', 'purchaseOrders', PurchaseOrder)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(Asset, 'SalesOrder', 'salesOrders', SalesOrder)
    const quote = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Quote', 'quotes', Quote)
    const serialNumberLocation = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Product location', 'productLocation', ProductLocation)
    const maintenanceSchedules = new RelationOption(Asset, 'Maintenance schedules', 'maintenanceSchedules', MaintenanceSchedule)

    const description = new LinkData(Asset, 'Description', ['id', 'description'])
    const stockCode = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Stock code', ['stockCode'])
    const model = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Model', ['model'])
    const manufacturer = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Manufacturer', ['manufacturer'])
    const manufacturerPartNumber = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Manufacturer part number', ['manufacturerPartNumber'])
    const serviceLevel = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Service level', ['serviceLevel']).addFilterType('notNull', SlaFilter)
    const responseTime = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Response time', ['responseTime'])
    const resolutionTime = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Resolution time', ['resolutionTime'])
    const repairOrReplace = new TypographyData(Asset, 'Repair / Replace', ['repairOrReplace'])

    const count = new AggregateData(Asset, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    id.addDependentOption(contract, site)
    id.setRenderLink(asset => `/work/contracts/${asset.contract.id}/sites/${asset.site.id}/assets/${asset.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(asset => `Asset ${asset.id}`)

    description.addDependentOption(contract2, site2)
    description.setRenderLink(asset => `/work/contracts/${asset.contract.id}/sites/${asset.site.id}/assets/${asset.id}`)

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, contract, site, parent,
        children, primaryEngineer, product, description, model,
        stockCode, jobs, supportTicket, purchaseOrder, salesOrder,
        serialNumberLocation, manufacturer, manufacturerPartNumber, serviceLevel,
        quote, count, maintenanceSchedules, responseTime, resolutionTime, repairOrReplace
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import * as models from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { EntityFilter } from './filters/entity'
import { TypeFilter } from './filters/type'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<models.AuditEvent> {
    const creator = new UserData(models.AuditEvent, 'User', 'user')
    const created = new DateGroup(models.AuditEvent, 'Date', 'created')
    const type = new TypographyData(models.AuditEvent, 'Type', ['type'])
    const entity = new TypographyData(models.AuditEvent, 'Entity', ['entity'])
    const record = new LinkData(models.AuditEvent, 'Record', ['entity', 'entityId'])
    const description = new TypographyData(models.AuditEvent, 'Description', ['description'])
    const count = new AggregateData(models.AuditEvent, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const auditId = new TypographyData(models.AuditEvent, 'Audit ID', ['id'])

    type.setRenderLabel(entity => entity.type.replace(/^\w/, character => character.toUpperCase()))

    const renderRecordContent = record.renderContent.bind(record)
    record.renderContent = (auditEvent, raw) => {
        const recordModel = auditEvent === null
            ? undefined
            : models[auditEvent.entity as keyof typeof models]

        if (auditEvent === null || !auditEvent.entityId || typeof recordModel !== 'function') {
            return new Typography('')
        }

        return renderRecordContent(auditEvent, raw)
    }

    record.setRenderLink(entity => {
        const instance = new models[entity.entity as keyof typeof models]()
        instance.id = entity.entityId

        const url = getViewUrl(instance)

        return url || '/'
    })

    record.setRenderLabel(entity => `#${entity.entityId}`)

    entity.setRenderLabel(entity => `${entity.entity.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^./, match => match.toUpperCase())}`)

    entity.clearFilterTypes()
    entity.addFilterType('equals', EntityFilter)
    entity.setQuickFilter('equals')

    type.clearFilterTypes()
    type.addFilterType('equals', TypeFilter)
    type.setQuickFilter('equals')

    return [creator, created, type, entity, record, description, count, auditId]
}

````

````typescript
        creditNote, division, tradingCompany, returnsAuthorisation
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AdvancedLinkData } from './advancedLink'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, EnumOption, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Backorder, Job, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, SalesOrder } from '../../models'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { countDecimalPlaces, formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Backorder>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(Backorder, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(Backorder, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Backorder, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Backorder, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Backorder, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(Backorder, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const product = new RelationOption(Backorder, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const job = new RelationOption(Backorder, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(Backorder, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const scheduledBackorder = new BooleanData(Backorder, 'Scheduled', 'scheduledBackorder')
    const priority = new EnumOption(Backorder, 'Priority', 'priority')
    const resolutionMethod = new EnumOption(Backorder, 'Resolution method', 'resolutionMethod')
    const requiredByDate = new DateGroup(Backorder, 'Required by date', 'requiredByDate')
    const backorderSourceEntity = new AdvancedLinkData(Backorder, 'Source ID', ['salesOrder', 'job'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Backorder, 'Status', ['pending', 'complete', 'active'])

    const quantity = new NumberData(Backorder, 'Quantity', 'quantity')
    const quantityBase = new NumberData(Backorder, 'Quantity base', 'quantityBase')
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(Backorder, 'Unit Of Measure', 'productUnitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)

    const quantityWithUnit = new NumberData(Backorder, 'Quantity with unit', 'quantity')

    quantityWithUnit.setPrecision(0)
    quantityWithUnit.addDependentOption(unitOfMeasure)
    quantityWithUnit.setRenderLabel(item => `${formatInternationalNumber(item.quantity, undefined, undefined, 0)} ${item.productUnitOfMeasure ? item.productUnitOfMeasure.name : ''}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(backorder => getStatus(backorder))

    quantity.setRenderLabel(({ quantity }) => formatInternationalNumber(quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(quantity))))

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, count, product, quantity, quantityBase, priority, unitOfMeasure, quantityWithUnit,
        requiredByDate, resolutionMethod, scheduledBackorder, backorderSourceEntity, status, salesOrder, job
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Bank, BankStatement, BankStatementTransaction, Currency, CustomerRemittance, GeneralLedger, GeneralLedgerCode, SupplierRemittance } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Bank>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Bank, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Bank, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Bank, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Bank, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const currency = new RelationOption(Bank, 'Currency', 'currency', Currency)
    const glCode = new RelationOption(Bank, 'General ledger code', 'glCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const glTransactions = new RelationOption(Bank, 'General ledger', 'glTransactions', GeneralLedger)
    const statementTransactions = new RelationOption(Bank, 'Statement transactions', 'bankStatementTransactions', BankStatementTransaction)
    const statements = new RelationOption(Bank, 'Statements', 'bankStatements', BankStatement)
    const supplierRemittances = new RelationOption(Bank, 'Supplier remittances', 'supplierRemittances', SupplierRemittance)
    const customerRemittances = new RelationOption(Bank, 'Customer remittances', 'customerRemittances', CustomerRemittance)
    const name = new TypographyData(Bank, 'Name', ['internalAccountRef'])
    const accountNumber = new TypographyData(Bank, 'Account number', ['accountNumber'])
    const sortCode = new TypographyData(Bank, 'Sort code', ['sortCode'])
    const count = new AggregateData(Bank, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const id = new LinkData(Bank, 'Bank account ID', ['id'])

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, currency, name, accountNumber, sortCode, glCode, count, id, glTransactions,
        statementTransactions, statements, supplierRemittances, customerRemittances
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Bank, BankReconciliationRule, CostCode, GeneralLedgerCode } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<BankReconciliationRule>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(BankReconciliationRule, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(BankReconciliationRule, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const id = new LinkData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Bank account ID', ['id'])

    const global = new BooleanData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Global', 'global')
    const name = new TypographyData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Name', ['name'])
    const bankAccount = new RelationOption(BankReconciliationRule, 'BankAccount', 'bankAccount', Bank)
    const type = new TypographyData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Rule type', ['ruleType'])
    const matchType = new TypographyData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Match type', ['matchType'])
    const text = new TypographyData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Match text', ['matchText'])
    const field = new TypographyData(BankReconciliationRule, 'Applicable field', ['applicableField'])
    const glCode = new RelationOption(BankReconciliationRule, 'General ledger code', 'generalLedgerCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const costCode = new RelationOption(BankReconciliationRule, 'Cost Code', 'costCode', CostCode)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, count, id, global, name, bankAccount, type, matchType, text, field, glCode, costCode
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Bank, BankStatement, BankStatementTransaction } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<BankStatement>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(BankStatement, 'Bank statement ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(BankStatement, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const creator = new UserData(BankStatement, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(BankStatement, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(BankStatement, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(BankStatement, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const bankAccount = new RelationOption(BankStatement, 'Bank account', 'bankAccount', Bank)
    const importedDate = new DateGroup(BankStatement, 'Imported date', 'importedDate')
    const startDate = new DateGroup(BankStatement, 'Start date', 'startDate')
    const endDate = new DateGroup(BankStatement, 'End date', 'endDate')
    const source = new TypographyData(BankStatement, 'Source', ['source'])
    const reconciled = new BooleanData(BankStatement, 'Reconciled', 'reconciled')
    const statementTransactions = new RelationOption(BankStatement, 'Statement transactions', 'bankStatementTransactions', BankStatementTransaction)

    return [
        id, count, creator, editor, created, edited, bankAccount, importedDate, startDate, endDate,
        source, reconciled, statementTransactions
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, Bank, BankStatement, BankStatementTransaction } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<BankStatementTransaction>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Bank statement transaction ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const creator = new UserData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(BankStatementTransaction, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(BankStatementTransaction, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const transactionDate = new DateGroup(BankStatementTransaction, 'Transaction date', 'transactionDate')
    const bankAccount = new RelationOption(BankStatementTransaction, 'Bank account', 'bankAccount', Bank)
    const paymentReference = new TypographyData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Payment reference', ['paymentReference'])
    const reference = new TypographyData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Reference', ['reference'])
    const description = new TypographyData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Description', ['description'])
    const value = new NumberData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Value', 'value')
    const source = new TypographyData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Source', ['source'])
    const reconciled = new BooleanData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Reconciled', 'reconciled')
    const reconciledDate = new DateGroup(BankStatementTransaction, 'Reconciled date', 'reconciledDate')
    const reconciledPeriod = new RelationOption(BankStatementTransaction, 'Reconciled period', 'reconciledPeriod', AccountingPeriod)
    const statement = new RelationOption(BankStatementTransaction, 'Statements', 'bankStatement', BankStatement)
    const balancePerBank = new NumberData(BankStatementTransaction, 'Balance', 'balance')

    value.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(value.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    balancePerBank.renderContent = (entity, data) => {
        const value = balancePerBank.getFormattedValue(entity, data)

        return new Typography(value === 'NaN' ? null : value)
    }

    return [
        id, count, creator, editor, created, edited, transactionDate, bankAccount, paymentReference, reference, description, value,
        source, reconciled, statement, reconciledDate, reconciledPeriod, balancePerBank
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { BaseOption, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { BillOfMaterials, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { countDecimalPlaces, formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<BillOfMaterials>[] {
    const product = new RelationOption(BillOfMaterials, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const item = new RelationOption(BillOfMaterials, 'Item', 'item', Product)
    const productUnitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(BillOfMaterials, 'Product unit of measure', 'productUnitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)

    const quantity = new TypographyData(BillOfMaterials, 'Qty', ['quantity'])

    quantity.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatInternationalNumber(Number(quantity.getValue(entity, data)), undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(quantity.getValue(entity, data))))
    quantity.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(quantity.getValue(entity, data)), undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(quantity.getValue(entity, data)))))

    return [
        product, item, quantity, productUnitOfMeasure
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { Address, Branch, Company, Contact, TeamMember } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { BranchDeliveryAddress } from './reports/branchDeliveryAddress'
import { BranchDeliveryAddressAdministrativeArea } from './reports/branchDeliveryAddressAdministrativeArea'
import { BranchDeliveryAddressCity } from './reports/branchDeliveryAddressCity'
import { BranchDeliveryAddressCountry } from './reports/branchDeliveryAddressCountry'
import { BranchDeliveryAddressPostalCode } from './reports/branchDeliveryPostalCode'
import { BranchInvoiceAddress } from './reports/branchInvoiceAddress'
import { BranchInvoiceAddressAdministrativeArea } from './reports/branchInvoiceAddressAdministrativeArea'
import { BranchInvoiceAddressCity } from './reports/branchInvoiceAddressCity'
import { BranchInvoiceAddressCountry } from './reports/branchInvoiceAddressCountry'
import { BranchInvoiceAddressPostalCode } from './reports/branchInvoicePostalCode'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Branch>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Branch, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Branch, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Branch, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Branch, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const address = new RelationOption(Branch, 'Address', 'address', Address)
    const company = new RelationOption(Branch, 'Company', 'company', Company)
    const invoiceBranch = new RelationOption(Branch, 'Invoice branch', 'invoiceBranch', Branch)
    const contacts = new RelationOption(Branch, 'Contacts', 'contacts', Contact)
    const teamMembers = new RelationOption(Branch, 'Team members', 'teamMembers', TeamMember)
    const branchName = new TypographyData(Branch, 'Branch name', ['name'])
    const telephoneNumber = new TypographyData(Branch, 'Telephone number', ['telephoneNumber'])
    const url = new LinkData(Branch, 'URL', ['url']).setRenderLink(branch => branch.url)
    const count = new AggregateData(Branch, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const id = new LinkData(Branch, 'ID', ['id'])
    const locationId = new TypographyData(Branch, 'Location ID', ['locationID'])
    const branchInvoiceAddress = new BranchInvoiceAddress()
    const branchDeliveryAddress = new BranchDeliveryAddress()
    const branchInvoiceAddressCity = new BranchInvoiceAddressCity()
    const branchDeliveryAddressCity = new BranchDeliveryAddressCity()
    const branchInvoicePostalCode = new BranchInvoiceAddressPostalCode()
    const branchDeliveryPostalCode = new BranchDeliveryAddressPostalCode()
    const branchInvoiceAddressAdministrativeArea = new BranchInvoiceAddressAdministrativeArea()
    const branchDeliveryAddressAdministrativeArea = new BranchDeliveryAddressAdministrativeArea()
    const branchInvoiceAddressCountry = new BranchInvoiceAddressCountry()
    const branchDeliveryAddressCountry = new BranchDeliveryAddressCountry()

    const branchStatus = new TypographyData(Branch, 'Branch status', ['status'])

    //const name = new LinkData(Branch, 'Name', ['name', 'id'])
    // 'Branch name' - customer 3 has been hardcoded...this is wrong and cannot work. 'customer' cannot be got from here.
    // name.setRenderLink(branch => `/sales/customers/3/branches/${branch.id}`)
    //name.setRenderLabel(branch => branch.name)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, address, company, invoiceBranch, branchName,
        contacts, teamMembers, telephoneNumber, url, count, id, locationId, branchInvoiceAddress, branchDeliveryAddress,
        branchInvoiceAddressCity, branchDeliveryAddressCity, branchInvoiceAddressAdministrativeArea,
        branchDeliveryAddressAdministrativeArea, branchInvoicePostalCode, branchDeliveryPostalCode, branchInvoiceAddressCountry,
        branchDeliveryAddressCountry, branchStatus
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CallLog, CallLogOutcome, Contact, Customer, Employee, Job, Prospect, Supplier, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { MentionProjectionData } from './reports/mentionProjectionData'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): (BaseOption<CallLog>)[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CallLog, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CallLog, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CallLog, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CallLog, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const dueDate = new DateGroup(CallLog, 'Due date', 'dueDate')
    const id = new TypographyData(CallLog, 'ID', ['id'])
    const loggedOn = new DateGroup(CallLog, 'Logged on', 'loggedOn')
    const outcome = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'Follow up', 'outcome', CallLogOutcome)
    const outcomeId = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'OutcomeId', 'outcome', CallLogOutcome)
    const jobs = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const actionedBy = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'Actioned by', 'actionedBy', Employee)
    const contact = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const customer = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const supplier = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const prospect = new RelationOption(CallLog, 'Prospect', 'prospect', Prospect)
    const description = new TypographyData(CallLog, 'Description', ['description'])

    const mentionCompany = new MentionProjectionData(
        'Mention company',
        (subQuery, parentAlias, selectAlias) => {
            const projectionAlias = id.getRandomAlias()
            const companyAlias = id.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${companyAlias}\`.company_name`, selectAlias)
                .from('call_log_mention_projection', projectionAlias)
                .leftJoin('company', companyAlias, `\`${companyAlias}\`.id = \`${projectionAlias}\`.mention_company_id`)
                .where(`\`${projectionAlias}\`.call_log_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .limit(1)
        }
    )

    const mentionContact = new MentionProjectionData(
        'Mention contact',
        (subQuery, parentAlias, selectAlias) => {
            const projectionAlias = id.getRandomAlias()
            const contactAlias = id.getRandomAlias()
            const personAlias = id.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(
                    `TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(\`${personAlias}\`.forename, ''), ' ', COALESCE(\`${personAlias}\`.surname, '')))`,
                    selectAlias
                )
                .from('call_log_mention_projection', projectionAlias)
                .leftJoin('contact', contactAlias, `\`${contactAlias}\`.id = \`${projectionAlias}\`.mention_contact_id`)
                .leftJoin('person', personAlias, `\`${personAlias}\`.id = \`${contactAlias}\`.person_id`)
                .where(`\`${projectionAlias}\`.call_log_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .limit(1)
        }
    )

    const mentionPhone = new MentionProjectionData(
        'Mention phone',
        (subQuery, parentAlias, selectAlias) => {
            const projectionAlias = id.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${projectionAlias}\`.mention_phone`, selectAlias)
                .from('call_log_mention_projection', projectionAlias)
                .where(`\`${projectionAlias}\`.call_log_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .limit(1)
        }
    )

    const callLogNumber = new LinkData(CallLog, 'Call log number', ['id'])
    const status = new TypographyData(CallLog, 'Status', ['open', 'complete'])

    const count = new AggregateData(CallLog, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(CallLog, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    callLogNumber.setRenderLink(call => `/sales/calls/${call.id}`)
    callLogNumber.setRenderLabel(call => `Call log ${call.id}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(callLog => getStatus(callLog))

    return [
        id, callLogNumber, creator, editor, created, edited, loggedOn, contact, customer, supplier, prospect,
        outcome, outcomeId, status, jobs, count, actionedBy, dueDate, description,
        mentionCompany, mentionContact, mentionPhone, tradingCompany
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { CallLogOutcome } from '../../models'
import { DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(CallLogOutcome, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CallLogOutcome, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const id = new TypographyData(CallLogOutcome, 'ID', ['id'])
    const created = new DateGroup(CallLogOutcome, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CallLogOutcome, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const label = new TypographyData(CallLogOutcome, 'Label', ['label'])

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, label, id
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CargoItem, Delivery, Shipment } from '../../models'
import { ExternalLink } from '../../component'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CargoItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CargoItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CargoItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CargoItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CargoItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'ID', ['id'])

    const delivery = new RelationOption(CargoItem, 'Delivery', 'delivery', Delivery)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(CargoItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)

    const easyPostOrderId = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'EasyPost order ID', ['easyPostOrderId'])
    const easyPostShipmentId = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'EasyPost shipment ID', ['easyPostShipmentId'])
    const reference = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Reference', ['reference'])
    const carrierName = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Carrier name', ['carrierName'])
    const carrierService = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Carrier service', ['carrierService'])
    const carrierAccountId = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Carrier account ID', ['carrierAccountId'])
    const specialInstructions = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Special instructions', ['specialInstructions'])

    const trackingCode = new LinkData(CargoItem, 'Tracking code', ['trackingCode'])
    const trackingUrl = new LinkData(CargoItem, 'Tracking URL', ['trackingUrl'])
    const labelUrl = new LinkData(CargoItem, 'Label URL', ['labelUrl'])
    const labelLink = new LinkData(CargoItem, 'Label ID', ['labelUrl'])

    trackingCode.setRenderLink(cargoItem => new ExternalLink(`${cargoItem.trackingUrl}`))
    trackingUrl.setRenderLink(cargoItem => new ExternalLink(`${cargoItem.trackingUrl}`))
    labelUrl.setRenderLink(cargoItem => new ExternalLink(`${cargoItem.labelUrl}`))

    labelLink.setRenderLink(cargoItem => new ExternalLink(`${cargoItem.labelUrl}`))
    labelLink.setRenderLabel(cargoItem => `Label ${cargoItem.id}`)

    const sizeUnitOfMeasure = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Size UOM', ['sizeUnitOfMeasure'])
    const weightUnitOfMeasure = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Weight UOM', ['weightUnitOfMeasure'])
    const height = new NumberData(CargoItem, 'Height', 'height')
    const width = new NumberData(CargoItem, 'Width', 'width')
    const length = new NumberData(CargoItem, 'Length', 'length')
    const weight = new NumberData(CargoItem, 'Weight', 'weight')

    const price = new NumberData(CargoItem, 'Price', 'price')
    const currencyCode = new TypographyData(CargoItem, 'Currency code', ['currencyCode'])

    const deliveryDays = new NumberData(CargoItem, 'Delivery days', 'deliveryDays')

    const deliveryDate = new DateGroup(CargoItem, 'Delivery Date', 'deliveryDate')

    const isDeliveryDateGuaranteed = new BooleanData(CargoItem, 'Is delivery date guaranteed', 'isDeliveryDateGuaranteed')
    const isSignatureRequired = new BooleanData(CargoItem, 'Is signature required', 'isSignatureRequired')
    const isTest = new BooleanData(CargoItem, 'Is test', 'isTest')
    const isCancelled = new BooleanData(CargoItem, 'Is cancelled', 'isCancelled')

    const count = new AggregateData(CargoItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, delivery, shipment, easyPostOrderId, easyPostShipmentId, reference, carrierName,
        carrierService, carrierAccountId, trackingCode, trackingUrl, labelUrl, specialInstructions, sizeUnitOfMeasure, weightUnitOfMeasure,
        height, width, length, weight, price, currencyCode, deliveryDays, deliveryDate, isDeliveryDateGuaranteed, isSignatureRequired,
        isTest, isCancelled, count, labelLink
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, Bank, CashJournal, CashJournalItem, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { getViewUrl } from '..'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CashJournal>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CashJournal, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CashJournal, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CashJournal, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CashJournal, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new LinkData(CashJournal, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(CashJournal, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const includedInVatReturn = new TypographyData(CashJournal, 'Included in VAT return', ['includedInVatReturn'])

    const period = new RelationOption(CashJournal, 'Period', 'accountingPeriod', AccountingPeriod)

    const transactionDate = new DateGroup(CashJournal, 'Transaction date', 'transactionDate')
    const internalReference = new TypographyData(CashJournal, 'Internal reference', ['internalReference'])
    const paymentReference = new TypographyData(CashJournal, 'Payment reference', ['paymentReference'])
    const description = new TypographyData(CashJournal, 'Description', ['description'])
    const totalCash = new NumberData(CashJournal, 'Total cash', 'totalCash')

    const bankAccount = new RelationOption(CashJournal, 'Bank account', 'bankAccount', Bank)
    const lineItems = new RelationOption(CashJournal, 'Items', 'lineItems', CashJournalItem)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(CashJournal, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    id.setRenderLink(cashJournal => getViewUrl(cashJournal))
    id.setRenderLabel(cashJournal => `Cash journal ${cashJournal.id}`)

    totalCash.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalCash.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, count, transactionDate, internalReference, bankAccount, paymentReference, description,
        lineItems, totalCash, period, includedInVatReturn, tradingCompany
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CashJournal, CashJournalItem, Company, CostCode, GeneralLedgerCode, TaxCode } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CashJournalItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CashJournalItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CashJournalItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CashJournalItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CashJournalItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(CashJournalItem, 'ID', ['id'])

    const description = new TypographyData(CashJournalItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const cashJournal = new RelationOption(CashJournalItem, 'Cash Journal', 'cashJournal', CashJournal)
    const costCode = new RelationOption(CashJournalItem, 'Cost code', 'costCode', CostCode)
    const glCode = new RelationOption(CashJournalItem, 'GL code', 'glCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const debit = new NumberData(CashJournalItem, 'Debit', 'debit')
    const credit = new NumberData(CashJournalItem, 'Credit', 'credit')
    const taxGlCode = new RelationOption(CashJournalItem, 'Tax GL code', 'taxGlCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const tax = new NumberData(CashJournalItem, 'Tax', 'taxAmount')
    const taxCode = new RelationOption(CashJournalItem, 'Tax code', 'taxCode', TaxCode)
    const taxInputOutput = new TypographyData(CashJournalItem, 'InputOutput', ['inputOrOutputVAT'])

    const companyType = new TypographyData(CashJournalItem, 'Company type', ['companyType'])
    const companyAccountNumber = new TypographyData(CashJournalItem, 'Account number', ['companyAccountNumber'])
    const company = new RelationOption(CashJournalItem, 'Company', 'company', Company)

    const totalDebit = new AggregateData(CashJournalItem, 'Total debit', 'debit', 'sum')
    const totalCredit = new AggregateData(CashJournalItem, 'Total credit', 'credit', 'sum')
    const totalTax = new AggregateData(CashJournalItem, 'Total tax', 'taxAmount', 'sum')

    totalDebit.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    totalDebit.setPrecision(2)
    totalDebit.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalDebit.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    totalCredit.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    totalCredit.setPrecision(2)
    totalCredit.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalCredit.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    totalTax.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    totalTax.setPrecision(2)
    totalTax.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalTax.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, totalDebit, totalCredit, totalTax, cashJournal,
        description, costCode, glCode, debit, credit, taxGlCode, tax, taxCode, taxInputOutput, companyType, companyAccountNumber, company
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CompanyDropdownData } from '../../configuration/company/reports/companyDropdownData'
import { Branch, Company, Currency, Customer, Supplier } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Company>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Company, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Company, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Company, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Company, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const branches = new RelationOption(Company, 'Branches', 'branches', Branch)
    const defaultBranch = new RelationOption(Company, 'Default branch', 'defaultBranch', Branch)
    const defaultInvoicBranch = new RelationOption(Company, 'Default invoice branch', 'defaultInvoiceBranch', Branch)
    const defaultDeliveryBranch = new RelationOption(Company, 'Default shipping branch', 'defaultDeliveryBranch', Branch)
    const defaultCurrency = new RelationOption(Company, 'Default currency', 'defaultCurrency', Currency)
    const suppliers = new RelationOption(Company, 'Suppliers', 'suppliers', Supplier)
    const customers = new RelationOption(Company, 'Customers', 'customers', Customer)
    const name = new TypographyData(Company, 'Name', ['name']).setRenderLabel(company => company.name).setMinimumWidth(200)
    const alias = new TypographyData(Company, 'Alias', ['alias']).setRenderLabel(company => company.name).setMinimumWidth(200)

    const nameDropdown = new CompanyDropdownData()
    const count = new AggregateData(Company, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const enterpriseType = new TypographyData(Company, 'Enterprise type', ['enterpriseType'])
    const parentCompany = new TypographyData(Company, 'Parent company', ['parentCompany'])

    const id = new TypographyData(Company, 'ID', ['id'])

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, branches, defaultBranch, defaultCurrency, name, count, id, nameDropdown, suppliers,
        customers, enterpriseType, parentCompany, alias, defaultInvoicBranch, defaultDeliveryBranch
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CompanyHolidayYear, TradingCompany } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CompanyHolidayYear>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Trading Company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const holidayYearName = new TypographyData(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Holiday Year Name', ['holidayYearName'])
    const holidayStartDate = new DateGroup(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Holiday Start Date', 'holidayStartDate')
    const holidayEndDate = new DateGroup(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Holiday End Date', 'holidayEndDate')
    const isCurrentHolidayYear = new BooleanData(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Is Current Holiday Year', 'isCurrentHolidayYear')

    const id = new TypographyData(CompanyHolidayYear, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(CompanyHolidayYear, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        count, created, creator, edited, editor, id, isCurrentHolidayYear,
        holidayEndDate, holidayStartDate, holidayYearName, tradingCompany
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Branch, Contact, Employee, Invoice, Job, Opportunity, Person, Project, PurchaseOrder, Quote, SalesOrder, ServiceContract } from '../../models'
import { ContactNameLinkData } from './reports/contactNameLinkData'
import { TagData } from './reports/tagData'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Contact>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Contact, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Contact, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Contact, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Contact, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const id = new LinkData(Contact, 'ID', ['id']).setRenderLink(contact => `/sales/contacts/${contact.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(contact => `Contact ${contact.id}`)

    const branch = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Branch', 'branch', Branch)
    const person = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Person', 'person', Person)
    const invoices = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Invoices', 'invoices', Invoice)
    const opportunities = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Opportunities', 'opportunities', Opportunity)
    const quotes = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Quotes', 'quotes', Quote)
    const salesOrders = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Sales orders', 'salesOrders', SalesOrder)
    const jobs = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const projects = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Projects', 'projects', Project)
    const contracts = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Contracts', 'contracts', ServiceContract)
    const purchaseOrders = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Purchase orders', 'purchaseOrders', PurchaseOrder)

    const role = new TypographyData(Contact, 'Role', ['role'])

    const isActive = new BooleanData(Contact, 'Status', 'isActive')

    const count = new AggregateData(Contact, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const contactName = new ContactNameLinkData()

    contactName.addDependentOption(person)

    const includeInCallList = new BooleanData(Contact, 'Include in call list', 'includeInCallList')

    const preferredTime = new TypographyData(Contact, 'Preferred time', ['preferredTime'])

    const decisionMaker = new BooleanData(Contact, 'Decision maker', 'decisionMaker')

    const dateOfBirth = new DateGroup(Contact, 'Date of birth', 'dateOfBirth')

    const preferredDay = new TypographyData(Contact, 'Preferred day', ['preferredDay'])

    const contactActive = new BooleanData(Contact, 'Contact active', 'contactActive')

    const accountDevelopedBy = new RelationOption(Contact, 'Account developed by', 'accountDevelopedBy', Employee)

    const marketingTags = new TagData()

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, branch, person, role, isActive, contracts,
        opportunities, invoices, quotes, salesOrders, count, contactName, projects, jobs,
        purchaseOrders, includeInCallList, preferredTime, preferredDay, decisionMaker, dateOfBirth, contactActive, accountDevelopedBy, marketingTags
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { ArrayFilter } from '../../reports/data/link/filters/arrayFilter'
import { ArrayFilterIncludingNulls } from '../../reports/data/link/filters/arrayFilterIncludingNulls'
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CostCode, GeneralLedger } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CostCode>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CostCode, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CostCode, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CostCode, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CostCode, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const id = new LinkData(CostCode, 'ID', ['id']).setRenderLink(contact => `/sales/contacts/${contact.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(contact => `Contact ${contact.id}`)

    // Required for GL code interrogation
    id.addFilterType('in', ArrayFilter)
    id.addFilterType('inIncNulls', ArrayFilterIncludingNulls)

    const elementOneCode = new TypographyData(CostCode, 'Element One Code', ['elementOneCode'])
    const elementTwoCode = new TypographyData(CostCode, 'Element Two Code', ['elementTwoCode'])
    const elementOneName = new TypographyData(CostCode, 'Element One Name', ['elementOneName'])
    const elementTwoName = new TypographyData(CostCode, 'Element Two Name', ['elementTwoName'])

    const fullCode = new TypographyData(CostCode, 'Full code', ['elementOneCode'])

    fullCode.addDependentOption(elementTwoCode)
    fullCode.setRenderLabel(code => `${code.elementOneCode} ${code.elementTwoCode ? code.elementTwoCode : ''}`)

    const glTransactions = new RelationOption(CostCode, 'GL transactions', 'glTransactions', GeneralLedger)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, elementOneCode, elementTwoCode, elementOneName, elementTwoName, fullCode, glTransactions
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Address, ConsignmentCategory, CourierTrackingInformation, FreightType, Job, Supplier, UnitOfMeasure } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CourierTrackingInformation>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'ID', ['id'])

    const length = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Length', ['palletLength'])
    const width = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Width', ['palletWidth'])
    const height = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Height', ['palletHeight'])
    const weight = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Weight', ['palletWeight'])
    const quantity = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const description = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Description', ['description'])
    const trackingNumber = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Tracking number', ['trackingNumber'])
    const specialInstructions = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Special Instructions', ['specialInstructions'])

    const job = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const supplier = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const unitOfMeasurePalletWidth = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Unit of measure pallet width', 'unitOfMeasurePalletWidth', UnitOfMeasure)
    const unitOfMeasurePalletHeight = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Unit of measure pallet height', 'unitOfMeasurePalletHeight', UnitOfMeasure)
    const unitOfMeasurePalletLength = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Unit of measure pallet length', 'unitOfMeasurePalletLength', UnitOfMeasure)
    const unitOfMeasurePalletWeight = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Unit of measure pallet weight', 'unitOfMeasurePalletWeight', UnitOfMeasure)
    const address = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Address', 'Address', Address)
    const consignmentCategory = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Consignment category', 'consignmentCategory', ConsignmentCategory)
    const freightType = new RelationOption(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Freight type', 'freightType', FreightType)

    const totalWeight = new NumberData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Total weight', 'palletWeight')

    const volumetricWeight = new TypographyData(CourierTrackingInformation, 'Volumetric weight', ['volumetricWeight'])

    return [
        address, consignmentCategory, created, creator, description, edited, editor, freightType, height, id, job, length, quantity,
        specialInstructions, supplier, totalWeight, trackingNumber, unitOfMeasurePalletHeight, unitOfMeasurePalletLength,
        unitOfMeasurePalletWeight, unitOfMeasurePalletWidth, volumetricWeight, weight, width
    ]
}
````
