Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, Contact, CreditNote, CreditNoteItem, Currency, Customer, Invoice, Job, SalesOrder, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ArrayFilter } from '../../reports/data/typography/filters'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { PaymentStatusFilter } from '../invoice/filters/paymentStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'
import { getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CreditNote>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CreditNote, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CreditNote, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CreditNote, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CreditNote, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(CreditNote, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')
    const includedInVatReturn = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Included in VAT return', ['includedInVatReturn'])
    const salesTaxNumber = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Sales tax number', ['salesTaxNumber'])

    const creditNoteDate = new DateGroup(CreditNote, 'Credit note date', 'creditNoteDate')

    const creditNoteNumber = new UniqueNumberData(CreditNote, 'Credit note number', 'creditNoteNumber')

    const periodPosted = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Period posted', 'periodPosted', AccountingPeriod)
    const periodFullyPaid = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Period fully paid', 'periodFullyPaid', AccountingPeriod) // deducted
    const dateFullyPaid = new DateGroup(CreditNote, 'Date fully paid', 'dateFullyPaid') // deducted

    const baseCurrency = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Base currency', 'baseCurrency', Currency)
    const saleCurrency = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Sale currency', 'saleCurrency', Currency)
    const customer = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const parentCustomer = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Customer on sales order', 'parentCustomer', Customer)
    const contact = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const items = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Items', 'lineItems', CreditNoteItem)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const job = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const invoice = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Invoice', 'invoice', Invoice)

    const id = new LinkData(CreditNote, 'Credit note ID', ['id'])
    const tableId = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'ID', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Description', ['description'])
    const status = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Status', ['draft', 'assigned', 'posted'])
    const posted = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Posted', ['posted'])

    const isPaid = new BooleanData(CreditNote, 'Is paid', 'paid')
    const amountPaid = new NumberData(CreditNote, 'Amount paid', 'totalAmountPaid')
    const amountOutstanding = new NumberData(CreditNote, 'Amount outstanding', 'amountOutstanding')
    const creditNoteTotal = new NumberData(CreditNote, 'Credit note total (base currency)', 'creditNoteTotal')

    const creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency = new NumberData(CreditNote, 'Credit note total (sale currency)', 'creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency')
    const creditNoteAmountPaidSaleCurrency = new NumberData(CreditNote, 'Amount paid (sale currency)', 'totalAmountPaidSaleCurrency')
    const creditNoteAmountOSSaleCurrency = new NumberData(CreditNote, 'Amount o/s (sale currency)', 'amountOutstandingSaleCurrency')

    const paymentRequiredBy = new ListStatus(CreditNote, 'Payment required by', ['paymentRequiredBy'])
    const count = new AggregateData(CreditNote, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(CreditNote, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const billingAddressLine1 = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Billing address line 1', ['customerStreetAddress1'])
    const billingAddressLine2 = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Billing address line 2', ['customerStreetAddress1'])
    const billingAddressLine3 = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Billing address line 3', ['customerStreetAddress1'])
    const billingAddressCity = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Billing address city', ['customerCity'])
    const billingAddressAdministrativeArea = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Billing address administrative area', ['customerAdministrativeArea'])
    const billingAddressPostCode = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Billing address postal code', ['customerPostalCode'])
    const billingAddressCountry = new TypographyData(CreditNote, 'Billing address country', ['customerCountry'])

    id.setRenderLink(creditNote => getViewUrl(creditNote))
    id.setRenderLabel(creditNote => `Credit note ${creditNote.id}`)

    tableId.addFilterType('in', ArrayFilter)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(creditNote => getStatus(creditNote))

    creditNoteNumber.setRenderLink(creditNote => getViewUrl(creditNote))
    creditNoteNumber.setRenderLabel(creditNote => creditNote.getCreditNoteNumber())

    const today = new Date()
    paymentRequiredBy.setRenderLabel(creditNote => creditNote.paymentRequiredBy.toDateString())
    paymentRequiredBy.setRenderLink(invoice => getViewUrl(invoice))
    paymentRequiredBy.addFilterType('equals', PaymentStatusFilter)
    paymentRequiredBy.setQuickFilter('equals')
    paymentRequiredBy.setSortable(true)
    paymentRequiredBy.setColor(creditNote => {
        if (creditNote.paid) {
            paymentRequiredBy.setTooltip('Credit note paid (deducted)')
            return colors.green
        } else if (creditNote.paymentRequiredBy.valueOf() > today.valueOf()) {
            paymentRequiredBy.setTooltip(`Payment required in ${Math.ceil((creditNote.paymentRequiredBy.valueOf() - today.valueOf()) / (60 * 60 * 24 * 1000))} days`)
            return colors.amber
        } else if (creditNote.paymentRequiredBy.valueOf() < today.valueOf()) {
            paymentRequiredBy.setTooltip('Payment overdue')
            return colors.red
        }
    })

    return [
        tableId, creator, editor, created, edited, description, baseCurrency, saleCurrency, customer, parentCustomer, contact,
        salesOrder, job, paymentRequiredBy, id, invoice, status, creditNoteNumber, count, includedInVatReturn, salesTaxNumber,
        posted, items, creditNoteDate, amountPaid, amountOutstanding, creditNoteTotal, periodPosted, periodFullyPaid, dateFullyPaid,
        creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency, creditNoteAmountPaidSaleCurrency, creditNoteAmountOSSaleCurrency, tradingCompany, isTakeOn, isPaid,
        billingAddressLine1, billingAddressLine2, billingAddressLine3, billingAddressCity, billingAddressAdministrativeArea,
        billingAddressPostCode, billingAddressCountry
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CreditNote, CreditNoteItem, GeneralLedgerCode, Product, Shipment, TaxCode, UnitOfMeasure } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CreditNoteItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CreditNoteItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CreditNoteItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CreditNoteItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CreditNoteItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'ID', ['id'])

    const creditNote = new RelationOption(CreditNoteItem, 'Credit note', 'creditNote', CreditNote)
    const product = new RelationOption(CreditNoteItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(CreditNoteItem, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', UnitOfMeasure)
    const taxCode = new RelationOption(CreditNoteItem, 'Tax code', 'taxCode', TaxCode)
    const generalLedgerCode = new RelationOption(CreditNoteItem, 'General ledger code', 'glCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const avalaraTaxCode = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Avalara tax code', ['avalaraTaxCode'])
    const shipment = new RelationOption(CreditNoteItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)

    const description = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const price = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Price', ['price'])
    const priceInCurrency = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Price in sale currency', ['priceInCurrency'])
    const discount = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Discount', ['discount'])
    const discountInCurrency = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Discount in sale currency', ['discountInCurrency'])
    const quantity = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const taxPercent = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Tax percent', ['taxPercent'])
    const taxTotal = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Tax total', ['taxValue'])
    const grossTotal = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Gross total', 'grossTotal', 'sum')
    const grossTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Gross total in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency', 'sum')

    const count = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const netTotal = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Credit note total', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const netTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Credit note total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const quantities = new AggregateGroup(CreditNoteItem, 'Quantities', 'quantity')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(CreditNoteItem, 'Prices', 'price')
    const discounts = new AggregateGroup(CreditNoteItem, 'Discounts', 'discount')
    const total = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Total price', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const totalInCurrency = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Total price in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')

    const discountPercent = new NumberData(CreditNoteItem, 'Discount %', 'price')

    const netPrice = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Net UP/RSP', ['price'])
    const netPriceInCurrency = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Net UP/RSP in sale currency', ['priceInCurrency'])
    const net = new TypographyData(CreditNoteItem, 'Net total', ['netTotal'])
    const netInCurrency = new NumberData(CreditNoteItem, 'Net total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency')
    const grossInCurrency = new NumberData(CreditNoteItem, 'Gross in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency')

    const taxValue = new NumberData(CreditNoteItem, 'Tax value', 'taxValue')
    const taxValueInCurrency = new NumberData(CreditNoteItem, 'Tax value in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency')
    const taxValueTotal = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Tax value total', 'taxValue', 'sum')
    const taxValueTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(CreditNoteItem, 'Tax value total in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency', 'sum')

    discountPercent.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const discountPercent = (1 - (Number(entity.price - Number(entity.discount))) / (Number(entity.price))) * 100
        return `${discountPercent.toFixed(2)}`
    })

    netTotal.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(netTotal.getValue(entity, data))
    netTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(netTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data))

    netPrice.setRenderLabel(entity => `${(Number(entity.price) - Number(entity.discount) / entity.quantity).toFixed(2)}`)
    netPriceInCurrency.setRenderLabel(entity => `${(Number(entity.priceInCurrency) - Number(entity.discountInCurrency) / entity.quantity).toFixed(2)}`)

    total.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(total.getValue(entity, data)))
    total.setPrecision(2)

    totalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(totalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)))
    totalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)

    taxTotal.setRenderLabel(entity => entity.taxValue ? Number(entity.taxValue).toFixed(2) : '0.00')

    grossTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(grossTotal.getValue(entity, data)))
    grossTotal.setPrecision(2)

    grossTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(grossTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)))
    grossTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, creditNote, product, description, price, avalaraTaxCode,
        unitOfMeasure, discount, quantity, count, quantities, prices, discounts,
        discountPercent, netPrice, net, total, netTotal, taxCode, generalLedgerCode,
        taxPercent, taxTotal, grossTotal, priceInCurrency, discountInCurrency, netInCurrency, grossInCurrency, taxValue, taxValueInCurrency,
        taxValueTotal, taxValueTotalInCurrency, grossTotalInCurrency, netTotalInCurrency, totalInCurrency, netPriceInCurrency, shipment, id
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Currency } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(Currency, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Currency, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Currency, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Currency, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const name = new TypographyData(Currency, 'Name', ['name'])
    const code = new TypographyData(Currency, 'Code', ['code'])
    const symbol = new TypographyData(Currency, 'Symbol', ['symbol'])
    const count = new AggregateData(Currency, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, name, code, symbol, count]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Bank, CallLog, Company, CreditNote, CustomProductPrice, Customer, CustomerDiscount, CustomerGroup, CustomerRemittance, CustomerSubGroup, Department, Division, Employee, Invoice, Job, NetTotalDiscount, NonComplianceReport, Opportunity, Payment, Product, Project, Quote, SalesOrder, SalesTerritory, ServiceContract, Task, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Customer>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Customer, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Customer, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Customer, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Customer, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new LinkData(Customer, 'ID', ['id'])

    const projects = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Projects', 'projects', Project)
    const calllogs = new RelationOption(Customer, 'CallLog', 'calllogs', CallLog)
    const tasks = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Task', 'tasks', Task)
    const productsOwnedByCustomer = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Products', 'products', Product)
    const bank = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Bank', 'bank', Bank)
    const company = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Company', 'company', Company)
    const manager = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Manager', 'manager', Employee)
    const contracts = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Contracts', 'serviceContracts', ServiceContract)
    const invoices = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Invoices', 'invoices', Invoice)
    const payments = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Payments', 'payments', Payment)
    const customerRemittances = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Remittances', 'customerRemittances', CustomerRemittance)
    const opportunities = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Opportunities', 'opportunities', Opportunity)
    const orders = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Orders', 'orders', SalesOrder)
    const quotes = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Quotes', 'quotes', Quote)
    const jobs = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const customPrice = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Custom prices', 'customProductPrices', CustomProductPrice)
    const discount = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Discounts', 'customerDiscounts', CustomerDiscount)
    const netTotalDiscount = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Net total discounts', 'netTotalDiscounts', NetTotalDiscount)
    const nonComplianceReport = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Non compliance reports', 'nonComplianceReports', NonComplianceReport)
    const salesTerritory = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Territory', 'salesTerritory', SalesTerritory)
    const creditNote = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Credit notes', 'creditNotes', CreditNote)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Customer, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const division = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Division', 'division', Division)
    const department = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Department', 'department', Department)

    const accountNumber = new LinkData(Customer, 'Account number', ['accountNumber', 'id'])
    const type = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Type', ['company', 'id'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Status', ['closed', 'hold', 'approved'])
    const supplierAccountNumber = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Supplier account number', ['supplierAccountNumber'])
    const creditTermDays = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Credit Term Days', ['creditTermDays'])
    const creditLimit = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Credit limit', ['creditLimit'])
    const balanceOwedBase = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Balance owed', ['balanceOwed'])
    const estimatedAnnualSalesValue = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Estimated annual sales value', ['estimatedAnnualSalesValue'])
    const VATRegistrationNumber = new TypographyData(Customer, 'VAT Registration Number', ['taxRegistrationNumber'])

    const exemptionNumber = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Exemption number', ['exemptionNumber'])
    const entityUseCode = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Entity use code', ['entityUseCode'])

    const allowBackorder = new BooleanData(Customer, 'Allow backorder', 'allowBackorder')

    const count = new AggregateData(Customer, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const dotLink = new ListStatus(Customer, 'Status dot', ['company'])

    id.setRenderLink(customer => `/sales/customers/${customer.id}`)

    dotLink.addDependentOption(company)
    dotLink.setRenderLink(customer => `/sales/customers/${customer.id}`)
    dotLink.setRenderLabel(customer => customer.company ? customer.company.alias : null) // make this the same as setRelatedPropertyToFilter
    dotLink.setRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort('alias') // make this the same as setRenderLabel
    dotLink.setSortable(true)

    const alias = new LinkData(Customer, 'Alias', ['company'])

    alias.setRenderLabel(customer => customer.company ? customer.company.alias : '')
    alias.setRenderLink(customer => `/sales/customers/${customer.id}`)
    alias.addDependentOption(company)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(customer => getStatus(customer))

    accountNumber.setRenderLink(customer => `/sales/customers/${customer.id}`)
    accountNumber.setRenderLabel(customer => `${customer.accountNumber}`)

    dotLink.setColor(entity => {
        if (!entity.closed && !entity.hold) {
            dotLink.setTooltip('Customer active')
            return colors.green
        } else if (entity.hold) {
            dotLink.setTooltip('Customer on hold')
            return colors.amber
        } else if (entity.closed) {
            dotLink.setTooltip('Customer closed')
            return colors.red
        }
    })

    const customerGroup = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Customer group', 'customerGroup', CustomerGroup)
    const customerSubGroup = new RelationOption(Customer, 'Customer sub group', 'customerSubGroup', CustomerSubGroup)

    const website = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Website', ['website'])

    const employeeCount = new NumberData(Customer, 'Employee count', 'employeeCount')

    const isParentCompany = new BooleanData(Customer, 'Is parent company', 'isParentCompany')

    const isDealer = new BooleanData(Customer, 'Is dealer', 'isDealer')

    const naicsCode = new NumberData(Customer, 'Naics code', 'naicsCode')

    const customerSource = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Customer source', ['customerSource'])

    const revenueRange = new TypographyData(Customer, 'Revenue range', ['revenueRange'])

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, accountNumber, status, creator, bank, company, quotes, jobs, manager,
        contracts, invoices, opportunities, orders, supplierAccountNumber, creditLimit, count, customPrice, discount, netTotalDiscount,
        salesTerritory, dotLink, creditNote, division, nonComplianceReport, tradingCompany, department, alias, type, payments,
        allowBackorder, projects, productsOwnedByCustomer, balanceOwedBase, customerRemittances, calllogs, tasks,
        exemptionNumber, entityUseCode, estimatedAnnualSalesValue, creditTermDays, VATRegistrationNumber, customerGroup, customerSubGroup, website, employeeCount, isParentCompany, isDealer, naicsCode, customerSource, revenueRange
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CustomerDiscount } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CustomerDiscount>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CustomerDiscount, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CustomerDiscount, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CustomerDiscount, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CustomerDiscount, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const name = new TypographyData(CustomerDiscount, 'Name', ['name'])
    const discount = new TypographyData(CustomerDiscount, 'Discount %', ['discountPercentage'])
    const enabled = new BooleanData(CustomerDiscount, 'Enabled', 'enabled')
    const startDate = new DateGroup(CustomerDiscount, 'Start date', 'startDate')
    const endDate = new DateGroup(CustomerDiscount, 'End date', 'endDate')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, name, discount, enabled, startDate, endDate]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CustomerGroup, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CustomerGroup>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CustomerGroup, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const created = new DateGroup(CustomerGroup, 'Created on', 'created')
    const editor = new UserData(CustomerGroup, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CustomerGroup, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const groupName = new TypographyData(CustomerGroup, 'Group name', ['groupName'])
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(CustomerGroup, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const id = new TypographyData(CustomerGroup, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(CustomerGroup, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        created, creator, count, edited, editor, groupName, id, tradingCompany
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { NetTotalDiscount } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<NetTotalDiscount>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(NetTotalDiscount, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(NetTotalDiscount, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(NetTotalDiscount, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(NetTotalDiscount, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const breakpoint = new NumberData(NetTotalDiscount, 'Breakpoint', 'breakpoint')
    const discount = new TypographyData(NetTotalDiscount, 'Discount %', ['discountPercentage'])

    breakpoint.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(breakpoint.getValue(entity, data))))

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, breakpoint, discount]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Bank, Currency, Customer, CustomerRemittance, PaymentMethod } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<CustomerRemittance>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(CustomerRemittance, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CustomerRemittance, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CustomerRemittance, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CustomerRemittance, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(CustomerRemittance, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')

    // Label is so it is easier for user to understand if they see it
    const isCopyOnAccountReceiptAllocated = new BooleanData(CustomerRemittance, 'Is on a/c payment void', 'isCopyOnAccountReceiptAllocated')

    const id = new TypographyData(CustomerRemittance, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(CustomerRemittance, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const customer = new RelationOption(CustomerRemittance, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const bank = new RelationOption(CustomerRemittance, 'Bank', 'bank', Bank)
    const paymentMethod = new RelationOption(CustomerRemittance, 'Payment method', 'paymentMethod', PaymentMethod)
    const remittanceBankCurrency = new RelationOption(CustomerRemittance, 'Bank currency', 'currency', Currency)
    const documentsInRemittanceCurrency = new RelationOption(CustomerRemittance, 'Document currency', 'documentCurrency', Currency)

    const paymentReference = new TypographyData(CustomerRemittance, 'Payment reference', ['paymentReference'])
    const chequeNumber = new TypographyData(CustomerRemittance, 'Cheque number', ['chequeNumber'])
    const remittanceAmount = new TypographyData(CustomerRemittance, 'Remittance amount', ['amountPaid'])
    const remittanceAmountTotal = new AggregateData(CustomerRemittance, 'Remittance amount total', 'amountPaid', 'sum')
    const remittanceAmountInCurrency = new TypographyData(CustomerRemittance, 'Remittance amount currency', ['amountPaidInCurrency'])
    const notes = new TypographyData(CustomerRemittance, 'Notes', ['notes'])

    const remittanceDate = new DateGroup(CustomerRemittance, 'Remittance date', 'paymentMadeOn')

    remittanceAmountTotal.setPrecision(2)
    remittanceAmountTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(remittanceAmountTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    id.setRenderLabel(remittance => `Remittance ${remittance.id}`)

    remittanceAmount.setRenderLabel(remittance => formatInternationalNumber(Number(remittance.amountPaid), undefined, undefined, 2))
    remittanceAmountInCurrency.setRenderLabel(remittance => formatInternationalNumber(Number(remittance.amountPaidInCurrency), undefined, undefined, 2))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, paymentReference, chequeNumber, notes, id, remittanceDate, paymentMethod, bank, count, customer,
        remittanceBankCurrency, documentsInRemittanceCurrency, remittanceAmount, remittanceAmountInCurrency, remittanceAmountTotal, isTakeOn,
        isCopyOnAccountReceiptAllocated
    ]
}

````

````typescript
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, LinkData,  RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Customer, CustomProductPrice, Product } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(CustomProductPrice, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(CustomProductPrice, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(CustomProductPrice, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(CustomProductPrice, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const product = new RelationOption(CustomProductPrice, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const customer = new RelationOption(CustomProductPrice, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)

    const price = new TypographyData(CustomProductPrice, 'Price', ['customPrice'])

    const count = new AggregateData(CustomProductPrice, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        count, creator, editor, created, edited, price, product, customer
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Delivery, DeliveryNoteNumber, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, Shipment } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Delivery>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Delivery, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Delivery, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Delivery, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Delivery, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const id = new TypographyData(Delivery, 'ID', ['id'])
    const order = new RelationOption(Delivery, 'Order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const deliveryNoteNumber = new RelationOption(Delivery, 'Delivery note number', 'deliveryNoteNumber', DeliveryNoteNumber)
    const orderItem = new RelationOption(Delivery, 'Order item', 'salesOrderItem', SalesOrderItem)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(Delivery, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)
    const count = new AggregateData(Delivery, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const quantity = new TypographyData(Delivery, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const packingNoteNumber = new TypographyData(Delivery, 'Packing note number', ['id'])
    const shippingDate = new DateGroup(Delivery, 'Shipping date', 'shippingDate')

    packingNoteNumber.addDependentOption(shipment, deliveryNoteNumber)
    packingNoteNumber.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(`${entity.shipment.id}-${entity.deliveryNoteNumber.uniqueNumber}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, order, orderItem, id, quantity, deliveryNoteNumber, count, shipment, packingNoteNumber, shippingDate
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { Address, Department, DepartmentMember, DepartmentResource, Division, TradingCompany, WarehouseDepartment } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Department>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Department, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Department, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Department, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Department, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(Department, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const address = new RelationOption(Department, 'Address', 'addresses', Address)
    const departmentName = new LinkData(Department, 'Department name', ['departmentName'])
    const id = new LinkData(Department, 'ID', ['id'])
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Department, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const division = new RelationOption(Department, 'Division', 'division', Division)
    const members = new RelationOption(Department, 'Members', 'members', DepartmentMember)
    const resources = new RelationOption(Department, 'Resources', 'resources', DepartmentResource)
    const warehouseDepartment = new RelationOption(Department, 'Warehouse department', 'warehouseDepartment', WarehouseDepartment)
    const description = new TypographyData(Department, 'Description', ['description'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Department, 'Status', ['closed'])
        .setSortable(false)
        .clearFilterTypes()
        .addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
        .setQuickFilter('equals')
        .setRenderLabel(department => getStatus(department))

    departmentName.addDependentOption(division)
    departmentName.setRenderLink(department => `/company/departments/${department.id}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, departmentName, id, status, division, description,
        tradingCompany, count, members, warehouseDepartment, resources, address
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Department, DepartmentMember, Employee } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(DepartmentMember, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(DepartmentMember, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    
    const created = new DateGroup(DepartmentMember, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(DepartmentMember, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const department = new RelationOption(DepartmentMember, 'Department', 'department', Department)
    const employee = new RelationOption(DepartmentMember, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)

    const count = new AggregateData(DepartmentMember, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, count, department, employee]
}
````

````typescript
import { DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Employee,  Note, StaffDisciplinary } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(StaffDisciplinary, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(StaffDisciplinary, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(StaffDisciplinary, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(StaffDisciplinary, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const employee = new RelationOption(StaffDisciplinary, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)
    const authorized = new TypographyData(StaffDisciplinary, 'Authorized', ['authorized'])
    const authorizedBy = new RelationOption(StaffDisciplinary, 'Authorized by', 'authorizedBy', Employee)
    const date = new DateGroup(StaffDisciplinary, 'Date', 'date')
    const otherNote = new RelationOption(StaffDisciplinary, 'Notes', 'otherNote', Note )
    const reason = new RelationOption(StaffDisciplinary, 'Reason', 'reason' , Note )
    const type = new TypographyData(StaffDisciplinary, 'Type', ['type'])

    return [
        authorized, authorizedBy, creator, created, date, editor, edited, otherNote, reason, type, employee
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Division, DivisionResource, Resource } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(DivisionResource, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(DivisionResource, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(DivisionResource, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(DivisionResource, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(DivisionResource, 'ID', ['id'])

    const count = new AggregateData(DivisionResource, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const division = new RelationOption(DivisionResource, 'Division', 'division', Division)
    const resource = new RelationOption(DivisionResource, 'Resource', 'resource', Resource)

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, id, count, division, resource]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { Address, Department, Division, TradingCompany, WarehouseDivision } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Division>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Division, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const count = new AggregateData(Division, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const editor = new UserData(Division, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Division, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Division, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const divisionName = new LinkData(Division, 'Division name', ['name'])
    const id = new LinkData(Division, 'ID', ['id'])

    const departments = new RelationOption(Division, 'Departments', 'departments', Department)
    const address = new RelationOption(Division, 'Address', 'addresses', Address)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Division, 'Company', 'parentCompany', TradingCompany)
    const warehouseDivision = new RelationOption(Division, 'Warehouse division', 'warehouseDivision', WarehouseDivision)

    divisionName.setRenderLink(division => `/company/divisions/${division.id}`)
    divisionName.setRenderLabel(division => `${division.name}`)

    return [
        count, creator, editor, created, edited, divisionName, id, departments, address,
        tradingCompany, warehouseDivision
    ]
}


````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Document, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { humanFileSize } from '../../application/document/explorerUtility'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Document>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Document, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Document, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Document, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Document, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const name = new TypographyData(Document, 'Name', ['name'])
    const description = new TypographyData(Document, 'Description', ['description'])
    const version = new TypographyData(Document, 'Version', ['version'])
    const size = new TypographyData(Document, 'Size', ['size'])
    const uuid = new TypographyData(Document, 'Unique ID', ['uuid'])
    const id = new TypographyData(Document, 'ID', ['id'])
    const location = new RelationOption(Document, 'Folder', 'location', Document)
    const cardOnly = new TypographyData(Document, 'Card only', ['cardOnly'])
    const tradingCompanyTC = new RelationOption(Document, 'Trading Company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const count = new AggregateData(Document, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    size.setRenderLabel(document => humanFileSize(Number(document.size)))

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, name, description, version, size, uuid, count, location, id, cardOnly, tradingCompanyTC]
}

````

````typescript
import { Asset, Bank, CallLog, CashJournal, Company, Contact, CreditNote, Customer, Document, DocumentRelation, Employee, EmployeeQualification, Invoice, Job, NominalJournal, NonComplianceReport, Note, Operation, Opportunity, Product, ProductBatch, ProductUnit, Project, Prospect, PurchaseOrder, Quote, SalesOrder, ServiceContract, Supplier, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierInvoice, SupportTicket, TradingCompany, User } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): (RelationOption<DocumentRelation> | AggregateData<DocumentRelation> | TypographyData<DocumentRelation>)[] {
    const id = new TypographyData(DocumentRelation, 'ID', ['id'])

    const invoice = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Invoice', 'invoice', Invoice)
    const job = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const note = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Note', 'note', Note)
    const opportunity = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Opportunity', 'opportunity', Opportunity)
    const product = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const project = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Project', 'project', Project)
    const quote = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Quote', 'quote', Quote)
    const prospect = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Prospect', 'prospect', Prospect)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Sales Order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const serviceContract = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Contract', 'serviceContract', ServiceContract)
    const supplier = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const supplierInvoice = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Supplier Invoice', 'supplierInvoice', SupplierInvoice)
    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Purchase Order', 'purchaseOrder', PurchaseOrder)
    const supportTicket = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Support Ticket', 'supportTicket', SupportTicket)
    const user = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'User', 'user', User)
    const operation = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Operation', 'operation', Operation)
    const mainDocumentArea = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Trading Company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const cashJournal = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Cash Journal', 'cashJournal', CashJournal)
    const nominalJournal = new RelationOption(DocumentRelation, 'Nominal Journal', 'nominalJournal', NominalJournal)
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { EmailAddress } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<EmailAddress>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(EmailAddress, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(EmailAddress, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(EmailAddress, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(EmailAddress, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const emailAddress = new TypographyData(EmailAddress, 'Email address', ['emailAddress'])

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, emailAddress]
}
````

````typescript
import { Absence, Department, Division, Employee, EmployeeNextOfKin, JobTitles, Person, SalesTerritory, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { EmployeeNameLinkData } from './reports/employeeNameLinkData'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { getViewUrl } from '..'

export function getReportOptions(): (AggregateData<Employee> | BooleanData<Employee> | DateGroup<Employee> | LinkData<Employee> | RelationOption<Employee> | UserData<Employee>)[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Employee, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Employee, 'Edited by', 'editor')

    const created = new DateGroup(Employee, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Employee, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const dateJoined = new DateGroup(Employee, 'Date joined', 'dateJoined')

    const person = new RelationOption(Employee, 'Person', 'person', Person)
    const jobTitle = new RelationOption(Employee, 'Job title', 'jobTitle', JobTitles)
    const salesTerritory = new RelationOption(Employee, 'Sales territory', 'salesTerritory', SalesTerritory)
    const employeeNextOfKin = new RelationOption(Employee, 'Next of kin', 'employeeNextOfKin', EmployeeNextOfKin)
    const absence = new RelationOption(Employee, 'Absences', 'absences', Absence)

    const count = new AggregateData(Employee, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const id = new LinkData(Employee, 'ID', ['id'])
    const employeeName = new EmployeeNameLinkData()
    const isManager = new BooleanData(Employee, 'Is manager', 'isManager')
    const isActive = new BooleanData(Employee, 'Is Active', 'active')

    const department = new RelationOption(Employee, 'Department', 'department', Department)
    const division = new RelationOption(Employee, 'Division', 'division', Division)

    id.setRenderLabel(employee => `Employee ${employee.id}`)
    id.setRenderLink(employee => getViewUrl(employee))

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Employee, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, person, count, id, isActive, isManager, jobTitle, salesTerritory, dateJoined, employeeName, employeeNextOfKin, absence, tradingCompany, department, division]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Employee, EmployeeHoliday } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<EmployeeHoliday>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(EmployeeHoliday, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(EmployeeHoliday, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const employee = new RelationOption(EmployeeHoliday, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)
    const currentHolidayYear = new TypographyData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Current Holiday Year', ['currentHolidayYear'])
    const currentHolidayYearStartDate = new DateGroup(EmployeeHoliday, 'Current Holiday Year Start Date', 'currentHolidayYearStartDate')
    const currentHolidayYearEndDate = new DateGroup(EmployeeHoliday, 'Current Holiday Year End Date', 'currentHolidayYearEndDate')
    const hours = new NumberData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Entitled hours', 'entitledHours')
    const additionalHoursAwarded = new NumberData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Additional Hours Awarded', 'additionalHoursAwarded')
    const carriedForwardHours = new NumberData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Carried Forward Hours', 'carriedForwardHours')
    const totalAllocatedHours = new NumberData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Total Allocated Hours', 'totalAllocatedHours')
    const remainingHours = new NumberData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Remaining Hours', 'remainingHours')
    const id = new TypographyData(EmployeeHoliday, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(EmployeeHoliday, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, employee,
        currentHolidayYear, currentHolidayYearStartDate, currentHolidayYearEndDate, hours,
        additionalHoursAwarded, carriedForwardHours, totalAllocatedHours, remainingHours, id, count
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Employee, EmployeeQualification, Note } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<EmployeeQualification>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(EmployeeQualification, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(EmployeeQualification, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(EmployeeQualification, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(EmployeeQualification, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const employee = new RelationOption(EmployeeQualification, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)
    const dateAchieved = new DateGroup(EmployeeQualification, 'Date achieved', 'dateAchieved')
    const isExpired = new BooleanData(EmployeeQualification, 'Is expired', 'isExpired')
    const expiryDate = new DateGroup(EmployeeQualification, 'Expiry date', 'expiryDate')
    const qualificationType = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Qualification type', ['qualificationType'])
    const qualificationName = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Qualification name', ['qualificationName'])
    const grade = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Grade', ['grade'])
    const certificateNumber = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Certificate number', ['certificateNumber'])
    const awardingBody = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Awarding body', ['awardingBody'])
    const establishment = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Establishment', ['establishment'])
    const notes = new RelationOption(EmployeeQualification, 'Notes', 'notes', Note)
    const qualificationVerified = new BooleanData(EmployeeQualification, 'Qualification verified', 'qualificationVerified')
    const verifiedBy = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Verified by', ['verifiedBy'])
    const verifiedDate = new DateGroup(EmployeeQualification, 'Verified date', 'verifiedDate')
    const followUpRequired = new BooleanData(EmployeeQualification, 'Follow up required', 'followUpRequired')
    const followUpDate = new DateGroup(EmployeeQualification, 'Follow up date', 'followUpDate')
    const originalResult = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Original result', ['originalResult'])
    const retestResult = new TypographyData(EmployeeQualification, 'Retest result', ['retestResult'])

    const id = new LinkData(EmployeeQualification, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(EmployeeQualification, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    id.addDependentOption(employee)
    id.setRenderLink(qualification => `/company/employees/${qualification.employee.id}/qualifications/${qualification.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(qualification => `Qualification ${qualification.id}`)

    return [
        creator, created, editor, edited, employee, dateAchieved, isExpired, expiryDate,
        qualificationType, qualificationName, grade, certificateNumber, awardingBody, establishment, notes,
        qualificationVerified, verifiedBy, verifiedDate, followUpRequired, followUpDate, originalResult, retestResult, id, count
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<FinanceReportHeading>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(FinanceReportHeading, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(FinanceReportHeading, 'Edited by', 'editor')

}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { FreightType } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<FreightType>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(FreightType, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(FreightType, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(FreightType, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(FreightType, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(FreightType, 'ID', ['id'])

    const name = new TypographyData(FreightType, 'Name', ['name'])
    const value = new TypographyData(FreightType, 'Value', ['value'])
    const isDefault = new BooleanData(FreightType, 'Default', 'isDefault')
    const count = new AggregateData(FreightType, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        count, created, creator, edited, editor, id, isDefault, name, value
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, CashJournal, CostCode, CreditNote, Currency, CustomerRemittance, GeneralLedger, Invoice, NominalJournal, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierInvoice, SupplierRemittance, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ArrayFilter } from '../../reports/data/typography/filters'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { getViewUrl as getUrlForCreditNote } from '../supplierCreditNote/getViewUrl'
import { getViewUrl as getUrlForInvoice } from '../supplierInvoice/getViewUrl'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<GeneralLedger>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(GeneralLedger, 'created', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(GeneralLedger, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(GeneralLedger, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(GeneralLedger, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'ID', ['id'])
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(GeneralLedger, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')

    const accountingPeriod = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Period', 'accountingPeriod', AccountingPeriod)

    const invoice = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Invoice', 'invoice', Invoice)
    const creditNote = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Credit note', 'creditNote', CreditNote)
    const supplierInvoice = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Supplier invoice', 'supplierInvoice', SupplierInvoice)
    const supplierCreditNote = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Supplier credit note', 'supplierCreditNote', SupplierCreditNote)
    const costCode = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Cost Code', 'costCode', CostCode)

    const ledgerCode = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Code', ['ledgerCode'])
    const ledgerDescription = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Description', ['ledgerDescription'])
    const ledgerCategory = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Category', ['ledgerCategory'])
    const ledgerHeading = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Heading', ['ledgerHeading'])
    const ledgerSubHeading = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Sub Heading', ['ledgerSubHeading'])
    const currencyCode = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Currency code', ['currencyCode'])
    const debitTotal = new NumberData(GeneralLedger, 'Debit total', 'debit')
    const creditTotal = new NumberData(GeneralLedger, 'Credit total', 'credit')

    const supplierRemittance = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Supplier remittance', 'supplierRemittance', SupplierRemittance)
    const customerRemittance = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Customer remittance', 'customerRemittance', CustomerRemittance)
    const nominalJournal = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Nominal journal', 'nominalJournal', NominalJournal)
    const cashJournal = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Cash journal', 'cashJournal', CashJournal)
    const nonBaseCurrency = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Non base currency', 'currency', Currency)
    const debitInCurrencyTotal = new NumberData(GeneralLedger, 'Debit in currency total', 'debitInCurrency')
    const creditInCurrencyTotal = new NumberData(GeneralLedger, 'Credit in currency total', 'creditInCurrency')

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const company = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Company', ['company'])
    const sku = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Sku', ['sku'])
    const productName = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Product name', ['productName'])
    const invoiceNumber = new LinkData(GeneralLedger, 'Invoice number', ['invoiceNumber'])
    const creditNoteNumber = new LinkData(GeneralLedger, 'Credit note number', ['creditNoteNumber'])
    const supplierInvoiceNumber = new LinkData(GeneralLedger, 'Supplier invoice number', ['supplierInvoice'])
    const supplierCreditNoteNumber = new LinkData(GeneralLedger, 'Supplier credit note number', ['supplierCreditNote'])
    const taxCode = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Tax code', ['taxCode'])
    const taxDescription = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Tax description', ['taxDescription'])
    const taxPercent = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Tax percent', ['taxPercent'])
    const taxAmount = new NumberData(GeneralLedger, 'Tax amount', 'taxAmount')
    const tradingCompanyGlCodePrefix = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Trading company gl code prefix', ['tradingCompanyGlCodePrefix'])
    const divisionGlCodePrefix = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Division gl code prefix', ['divisionGlCodePrefix'])
    const departmentGlCodePrefix = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Department gl code prefix', ['departmentGlCodePrefix'])
    const count = new AggregateData(GeneralLedger, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const transactionDate = new DateGroup(GeneralLedger, 'Transaction date', 'transactionDate')
    const lineDescription = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Line description', ['lineDescription'])
    const paymentReference = new TypographyData(GeneralLedger, 'Payment reference', ['paymentReference'])
    const reconciled = new BooleanData(GeneralLedger, 'Reconciled', 'reconciled')
    const reconciledDate = new DateGroup(GeneralLedger, 'Reconciled date', 'reconciledDate')
    const reconciledPeriod = new RelationOption(GeneralLedger, 'Reconciled period', 'reconciledPeriod', AccountingPeriod)

    // Required for GL code interrogation
    ledgerCode.addFilterType('in', ArrayFilter)

    supplierInvoiceNumber
        .addDependentOption(supplierInvoice)
        .setRenderLabel(generalLedger => generalLedger.supplierInvoice ? `${generalLedger.supplierInvoice.invoiceNumber}` : '')
        .setRenderLink(generalLedger => generalLedger.supplierInvoice ? `${getUrlForInvoice(generalLedger.supplierInvoice)}` : '')

    supplierCreditNoteNumber
        .addDependentOption(supplierCreditNote)
        .setRenderLabel(generalLedger => generalLedger.supplierCreditNote ? `${generalLedger.supplierCreditNote.creditNoteNumber}` : '')
        .setRenderLink(generalLedger => generalLedger.supplierCreditNote ? `${getUrlForCreditNote(generalLedger.supplierCreditNote)}` : '')

    taxAmount.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(taxAmount.getFormattedValue(entity, data))
    debitTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(debitTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))
    creditTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(creditTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))
    debitInCurrencyTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(debitInCurrencyTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))
    creditInCurrencyTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(creditInCurrencyTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        count, company, created, creator, currencyCode, edited, accountingPeriod, tradingCompany, id,
        editor, invoiceNumber, ledgerCategory, ledgerHeading, ledgerSubHeading, costCode, ledgerCode, ledgerDescription,
        supplierInvoiceNumber, supplierCreditNoteNumber, productName, sku, taxAmount, taxCode, taxDescription, taxPercent, transactionDate,
        tradingCompanyGlCodePrefix, divisionGlCodePrefix, departmentGlCodePrefix, supplierInvoice, supplierCreditNote, lineDescription,
        creditNote, creditNoteNumber, invoice, paymentReference, debitTotal, creditTotal, supplierRemittance, customerRemittance,
        debitInCurrencyTotal, creditInCurrencyTotal, nonBaseCurrency, nominalJournal, cashJournal,
        reconciled, reconciledDate, reconciledPeriod, isTakeOn
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Currency, GeneralLedgerCode, GeneralLedgerCodeCategory, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { getViewUrl } from '..'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<GeneralLedgerCode>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new LinkData(GeneralLedgerCode, 'ID', ['id'])

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(GeneralLedgerCode, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const category = new RelationOption(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Category', 'category', GeneralLedgerCodeCategory)
    const accountCurrency = new RelationOption(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Currency', 'accountCurrency', Currency)

    const code = new TypographyData(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Code', ['code'])
    const description = new TypographyData(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Description', ['description'])
    const isBankAccount = new BooleanData(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Used as bank account', 'isBankAccount')
    const isProfitAndLossAccount = new BooleanData(GeneralLedgerCode, 'Profit and loss account', 'isProfitAndLossAccount')

    id.setRenderLink(code => getViewUrl(code))
    id.setRenderLabel(code => code.id)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, code, description, category, id,
        accountCurrency, isProfitAndLossAccount, tradingCompany, isBankAccount
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { GoodsReceived, ProductLocation, PurchaseOrderItem, WarehouseLocation } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<GoodsReceived>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(GoodsReceived, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(GoodsReceived, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(GoodsReceived, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(GoodsReceived, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const purchaseOrderItem = new RelationOption(GoodsReceived, 'Line item', 'purchaseOrderItem', PurchaseOrderItem)
    const quantity = new TypographyData(GoodsReceived, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const count = new AggregateData(GoodsReceived, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const deliveryNoteNumber = new TypographyData(GoodsReceived, 'Delivery note number', ['deliveryNoteNumber'])
    const location = new RelationOption(GoodsReceived, 'Location', 'location', WarehouseLocation)
    const productLocation = new RelationOption(GoodsReceived, 'Product location', 'productLocation', ProductLocation)

    quantity.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(String(Number(quantity.getFormattedValue(entity, data))))

    const totalDelivered = new AggregateData(GoodsReceived, 'Total delivered', 'quantity', 'sum')

    totalDelivered.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(String(Number(totalDelivered.getValue(entity, data))))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, count, quantity, purchaseOrderItem, deliveryNoteNumber, location, totalDelivered,
        productLocation
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Employee, InspectionReport, Job, ProductBatch, ProductUnit } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<InspectionReport>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(InspectionReport, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(InspectionReport, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(InspectionReport, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(InspectionReport, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const job = new RelationOption(InspectionReport, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const inspector = new RelationOption(InspectionReport, 'Inspector', 'inspector', Employee)
    const productUnit = new RelationOption(InspectionReport, 'Unit', 'productUnit', ProductUnit)
    const productBatch = new RelationOption(InspectionReport, 'Batch', 'productBatch', ProductBatch)

    const inspectionDate = new DateGroup(InspectionReport, 'Inspection date', 'inspectionDate')
    const manufacturingDate = new DateGroup(InspectionReport, 'Manufacturing date', 'manufacturingDate')

    const inspectedQuantity = new TypographyData(InspectionReport, 'Inspected quantity', ['inspectedQuantity'])
    const rejectedQuantity = new TypographyData(InspectionReport, 'Rejected quantity', ['rejectedQuantity'])
    const reworkedQuantity = new TypographyData(InspectionReport, 'Reworked quantity', ['reworkedQuantity'])

    const passedQuantity = new TypographyData(InspectionReport, 'Passed quantity', ['inspectedQuantity'])
    const passedPercentage = new TypographyData(InspectionReport, 'Passed %', ['inspectedQuantity'])

    passedQuantity.setRenderLabel(report => `${report.inspectedQuantity - report.rejectedQuantity - report.reworkedQuantity}`)

    passedPercentage.setRenderLabel(report => {
        const passed = report.inspectedQuantity - report.rejectedQuantity - report.reworkedQuantity
        const percentage = passed / report.inspectedQuantity * 100

        return `${percentage}`
    })

    return [
        creator, created, editor, edited, job, inspector, productUnit, productBatch, inspectionDate,
        manufacturingDate, inspectedQuantity, rejectedQuantity, reworkedQuantity, passedQuantity, passedPercentage
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { InventoryCost, Job, Product } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<InventoryCost> {
    const product = new RelationOption(InventoryCost, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const job = new RelationOption(InventoryCost, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const quantity = new TypographyData(InventoryCost, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const count = new AggregateData(InventoryCost, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const invoiceValue = new TypographyData(InventoryCost, 'Invoice value', ['invoiceCost'])
    const invoiceValues = new AggregateData(InventoryCost, 'Invoice values', 'invoiceCost', 'sum')

    invoiceValues.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatter.format(Number(invoiceValues.getValue(entity, data)))
    invoiceValues.setPrecision(2)
    invoiceValues.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(invoiceValues.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    const costPrice = new TypographyData(InventoryCost, 'Cost price', ['costPrice'])

    const costTotal = new AggregateData(InventoryCost, 'Total cost', 'totalCost', 'sum')

    costTotal.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatter.format(Number(costTotal.getValue(entity, data)))
    costTotal.setPrecision(2)
    costTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(costTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        product, job, quantity, count, invoiceValue, invoiceValues, costPrice, costTotal
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, Contact, CreditNote, Currency, Customer, Invoice, InvoiceItem, SalesOrder, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ArrayFilter } from '../../reports/data/typography/filters'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { PaymentStatusFilter } from './filters/paymentStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus, getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Invoice>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Invoice, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Invoice, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Invoice, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Invoice, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(Invoice, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')
    const includedInVatReturn = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Included in VAT return', ['includedInVatReturn'])

    const invoiceDate = new DateGroup(Invoice, 'Invoice date', 'invoiceDate')
    const taxPointDate = new DateGroup(Invoice, 'Tax point date', 'taxPointDate')
    const salesTaxNumber = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Sales tax number', ['salesTaxNumber'])
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Invoice, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const periodPosted = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Period posted', 'periodPosted', AccountingPeriod)
    const periodFullyPaid = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Period fully paid', 'periodFullyPaid', AccountingPeriod)
    const dateFullyPaid = new DateGroup(Invoice, 'Date fully paid', 'dateFullyPaid')

    const baseCurrency = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Base currency', 'baseCurrency', Currency)
    const saleCurrency = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Sale currency', 'saleCurrency', Currency)
    const customer = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const parentCustomer = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Customer on sales order', 'parentCustomer', Customer)
    const contact = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const items = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Items', 'lineItems', InvoiceItem)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const creditNotes = new RelationOption(Invoice, 'Credit note', 'creditNotes', CreditNote)

    const invoiceNumber = new UniqueNumberData(Invoice, 'Invoice number', 'invoiceNumber')

    const id = new LinkData(Invoice, 'Invoice ID', ['id'])
    const tableId = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'ID', ['id'])

    const description = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Description', ['description'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Status', ['draft', 'assigned', 'posted', 'paid'])
    const posted = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Posted', ['posted'])
    const invoiceTotal = new NumberData(Invoice, 'Invoice total (base currency)', 'invoiceTotal')
    const isPaid = new BooleanData(Invoice, 'Is paid', 'paid')
    const amountPaid = new NumberData(Invoice, 'Amount paid', 'totalAmountPaid')
    const amountOutstanding = new NumberData(Invoice, 'Amount outstanding', 'amountOutstanding')

    const paymentRequiredBy = new ListStatus(Invoice, 'Payment required by', ['paymentRequiredBy'])
    const count = new AggregateData(Invoice, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const multiOrderInvoice = new BooleanData(Invoice, 'Multi-order', 'isMultipleOrderBulkInvoice')

    const invoiceTotalSaleCurrency = new NumberData(Invoice, 'Invoice total (sale currency)', 'invoiceTotalSaleCurrency')
    const invoiceAmountPaidSaleCurrency = new NumberData(Invoice, 'Amount paid (sale currency)', 'totalAmountPaidSaleCurrency')
    const invoiceAmountOSSaleCurrency = new NumberData(Invoice, 'Amount o/s (sale currency)', 'amountOutstandingSaleCurrency')

    const notesForCustomerView = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Notes For Customer View', ['notesForCustomerView'])
    const projectOVP = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Customer Project Reference', ['projectOVP'])
    const quoteReference = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Quote Reference', ['quoteReference'])
    const billingAddressLine1 = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Billing address line 1', ['customerStreetAddress1'])
    const billingAddressLine2 = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Billing address line 2', ['customerStreetAddress1'])
    const billingAddressLine3 = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Billing address line 3', ['customerStreetAddress1'])
    const billingAddressCity = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Billing address city', ['customerCity'])
    const billingAddressAdministrativeArea = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Billing address administrative area', ['customerAdministrativeArea'])
    const billingAddressPostCode = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Billing address postal code', ['customerPostalCode'])
    const billingAddressCountry = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Billing address country', ['customerCountry'])

    const invoicingType = new TypographyData(Invoice, 'Invoicing type', ['invoicingType'])
    const isDepositInvoiceRefundable = new BooleanData(Invoice, 'Is deposit refundable', 'isRefundableDeposit')

    invoicingType.setRenderLabel(
        invoice => invoice.invoicingType === 0 || invoice.invoicingType === null ? 'Standard' : invoice.invoicingType
    )

    id.setRenderLink(invoice => getViewUrl(invoice))
    id.setRenderLabel(invoice => `${invoice.id}`)

    tableId.addFilterType('in', ArrayFilter)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(invoice => getStatus(invoice))

    const today = new Date()
    paymentRequiredBy.setRenderLabel(invoice => invoice.paymentRequiredBy.toDateString())
    paymentRequiredBy.setRenderLink(invoice => getViewUrl(invoice))
    paymentRequiredBy.addFilterType('equals', PaymentStatusFilter)
    paymentRequiredBy.setQuickFilter('equals')
    paymentRequiredBy.setSortable(true)
    paymentRequiredBy.setColor(invoice => {
        if (invoice.paid) {
            paymentRequiredBy.setTooltip('Invoice paid')
            return colors.green
        } else if (invoice.paymentRequiredBy.valueOf() > today.valueOf()) {
            paymentRequiredBy.setTooltip(`Payment required in ${Math.ceil((invoice.paymentRequiredBy.valueOf() - today.valueOf()) / (60 * 60 * 24 * 1000))} days`)
            return colors.amber
        } else if (invoice.paymentRequiredBy.valueOf() < today.valueOf()) {
            paymentRequiredBy.setTooltip('Payment overdue')
            return colors.red
        }
    })

    amountOutstanding.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(amountOutstanding.getValue(entity, data))))
    invoiceNumber.setRenderLink(invoice => getViewUrl(invoice))
    invoiceNumber.setRenderLabel(invoice => invoice.getInvoiceNumber())

    return [
        tableId, creator, editor, created, edited, id, invoiceNumber, multiOrderInvoice, periodPosted, periodFullyPaid, dateFullyPaid,
        baseCurrency, saleCurrency, customer, parentCustomer, contact, items, description, count, invoicingType, isDepositInvoiceRefundable,
        status, salesOrder, posted, paymentRequiredBy, amountPaid, amountOutstanding, invoiceTotal, creditNotes,
        invoiceDate, invoiceTotalSaleCurrency, invoiceAmountPaidSaleCurrency, invoiceAmountOSSaleCurrency, tradingCompany,
        notesForCustomerView, projectOVP, quoteReference, taxPointDate, isTakeOn, isPaid, includedInVatReturn, salesTaxNumber,
        billingAddressLine1, billingAddressLine2, billingAddressLine3, billingAddressCity, billingAddressAdministrativeArea,
        billingAddressPostCode, billingAddressCountry
    ]
}

````
