Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { GeneralLedgerCode, Invoice, InvoiceItem, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, Shipment, TaxCode } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { countDecimalPlaces, formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<InvoiceItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(InvoiceItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(InvoiceItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(InvoiceItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(InvoiceItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'ID', ['id'])

    const invoice = new RelationOption(InvoiceItem, 'Invoice', 'invoice', Invoice)
    const product = new RelationOption(InvoiceItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(InvoiceItem, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const taxCode = new RelationOption(InvoiceItem, 'Tax code', 'taxCode', TaxCode)
    const generalLedgerCode = new RelationOption(InvoiceItem, 'General ledger code', 'glCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const avalaraTaxCode = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Avalara tax code', ['avalaraTaxCode'])
    const shipment = new RelationOption(InvoiceItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)

    const description = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const price = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Price', ['price'])
    const priceInCurrency = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Price in sale currency', ['priceInCurrency'])
    const discount = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Discount', ['discount'])
    const discountInCurrency = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Discount in sale currency', ['discountInCurrency'])
    const quantity = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const quantityAndUnit = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Quantity and unit', ['quantity'])
    const taxPercent = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Tax percent', ['taxPercent'])
    const taxTotal = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Tax total', ['taxValue'])

    const count = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const netTotal = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Invoice total', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const grossTotal = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Invoice gross total', 'grossTotal', 'sum')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(InvoiceItem, 'Prices', 'price')
    const netTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Invoice total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const grossTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Invoice gross total in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const pricesInCurrency = new AggregateGroup(InvoiceItem, 'Prices in sale currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const quantities = new AggregateGroup(InvoiceItem, 'Quantities', 'quantity')
    const discounts = new AggregateGroup(InvoiceItem, 'Discounts', 'discount')
    const total = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Total price', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const totalInCurrency = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Total price in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const totalQuantity = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Total quantity', 'quantity', 'sum')

    const discountPercent = new NumberData(InvoiceItem, 'Discount %', 'price')

    const netPrice = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Net UP/RSP', ['price'])
    const netPriceInCurrency = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Net UP/RSP in sale currency', ['priceInCurrency'])
    const net = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Net total', ['netTotal'])
    const netInCurrency = new NumberData(InvoiceItem, 'Net total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency')
    const gross = new TypographyData(InvoiceItem, 'Gross total', ['grossTotal'])
    const grossInCurrency = new NumberData(InvoiceItem, 'Gross in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency')

    const taxValue = new NumberData(InvoiceItem, 'Tax value', 'taxValue')
    const taxValueInCurrency = new NumberData(InvoiceItem, 'Tax value in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency')
    const taxValueTotal = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Tax value total', 'taxValue', 'sum')
    const taxValueTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(InvoiceItem, 'Tax value total in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency', 'sum')

    discountPercent.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const discountPercent = (1 - (Number(entity.price) - Number(entity.discount)) / (Number(entity.price))) * 100
        return `${discountPercent.toFixed(2)}`
    })

    netTotal.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(netTotal.getValue(entity, data))
    netTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(netTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data))

    netPrice.setRenderLabel(entity => `${(Number(entity.price) - Number(entity.discount)).toFixed(2)}`)
    netPriceInCurrency.setRenderLabel(entity => `${(Number(entity.priceInCurrency) - Number(entity.discountInCurrency)).toFixed(2)}`)

    total.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(total.getValue(entity, data)))
    total.setPrecision(2)

    totalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(totalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)))
    totalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)

    taxTotal.setRenderLabel(entity => entity.taxValue ? Number(entity.taxValue).toFixed(2) : '0.00')

    grossTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(grossTotal.getValue(entity, data)))
    grossTotal.setPrecision(2)

    grossTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(grossTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)))
    grossTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)

    quantity.setRenderLabel(invoiceItem => formatInternationalNumber(invoiceItem.quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(invoiceItem.quantity))))

    quantityAndUnit.addDependentOption(unitOfMeasure)
    quantityAndUnit.setRenderLabel(invoiceItem => `${formatInternationalNumber(invoiceItem.quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(invoiceItem.quantity)))} ${invoiceItem.unitOfMeasure ? invoiceItem.unitOfMeasure.name : ''}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, invoice, product, description, price, avalaraTaxCode,
        unitOfMeasure, discount, quantity, count, quantities, prices, discounts,
        discountPercent, netPrice, net, total, netTotal, taxCode, generalLedgerCode,
        taxPercent, taxTotal, grossTotal, totalQuantity, gross, grossTotal, quantityAndUnit,
        priceInCurrency, discountInCurrency, netInCurrency, grossInCurrency, taxValue, taxValueInCurrency,
        taxValueTotal, taxValueTotalInCurrency, netTotalInCurrency, grossTotalInCurrency, pricesInCurrency, shipment, id
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { InvoiceNumber } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(InvoiceNumber, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const created = new DateGroup(InvoiceNumber, 'Created on', 'created')

    const uniqueInvoiceNumber = new TypographyData(InvoiceNumber, 'Invoice number', ['uniqueNumber'])

    uniqueInvoiceNumber.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        if (entity.uniqueNumber === null) {
            return 'Not assigned'
        } else {
            return entity.uniqueNumber.toString()
        }
    })

    return [
        creator, created, uniqueInvoiceNumber
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, FormattedNumberData, LinkData, NumberData, ProgressData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { AllJobCost, Asset, Branch, Contact, Currency, Customer, Employee, InventoryCost, Job, JobCost, JobStage, JobTimeSheet, JobType, LabourCost, Manifest, Product, Project, PurchaseOrder, RunList, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, ScheduleEvent, TradingCompany, WarehouseLocation } from '../../models'
import { IdArrayFilter } from './filters/idArray'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'
import { getViewUrl } from './getViewUrl'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Job>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Job, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Job, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Job, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Job, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(Job, 'ID', ['id'])

    const customer = new RelationOption(Job, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const contact = new RelationOption(Job, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const manager = new RelationOption(Job, 'Manager', 'jobManager', Employee)
    const stage = new RelationOption(Job, 'Stage', 'stage', JobStage)
    const type = new RelationOption(Job, 'Type', 'type', JobType)
    const parent = new RelationOption(Job, 'Parent', 'parent', Job)

    const masterJob = new RelationOption(Job, 'Master job', 'masterJob', Job)
    const children = new RelationOption(Job, 'Children', 'children', Job)
    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(Job, 'Orders', 'purchaseOrders', PurchaseOrder)
    const currency = new RelationOption(Job, 'Currency', 'currency', Currency)
    const asset = new RelationOption(Job, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const timeSheet = new RelationOption(Job, 'Time sheets', 'timeSheets', JobTimeSheet)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(Job, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const salesOrderItem = new RelationOption(Job, 'Sales order item', 'salesOrderItem', SalesOrderItem)
    const project = new RelationOption(Job, 'Project', 'project', Project)
    const product = new RelationOption(Job, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const scheduleEvents = new RelationOption(Job, 'Schedule events', 'scheduleEvents', ScheduleEvent)
    const labour = new RelationOption(Job, 'Labour', 'labourCost', LabourCost) // - use the total on the job to improve load speed
    const inventory = new RelationOption(Job, 'Inventory', 'inventoryCosts', InventoryCost) // - use the total on the job to improve load speed
    const adhocCosts = new RelationOption(Job, 'Adhoc costs', 'costs', JobCost) // This is adhoc job costs - use the total on the job to improve load speed
    const allCosts = new RelationOption(Job, 'All costs', 'allJobCost', AllJobCost) // This is all the jobs costs - use the total on the job to improve load speed
    const assemblyLocation = new RelationOption(Job, 'Assembly location', 'assemblyLocation', WarehouseLocation)
    const requiredDeliveryDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Required delivery date', 'requiredDeliveryDate')
    const consignmentDeliveryDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Delivery date (consignment)', 'deliveryDate')
    const jobStartDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Start date', 'dateStarted')
    const jobDeliveryDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Delivery date (job)', 'dateJobDelivered')
    const completionDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Completion date', 'dateCompleted')
    const processedDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Processed date', 'dateProcessed')
    const overdueDeliveryDays = new FormattedNumberData(Job, 'Overdue Delivery Days', 'requiredDeliveryDate')

    // If there is an actual delivery date use it else use "now" to show how overday it was or is now.
    // "dateJobDelivered" and "deliveryDate" are mutually exculive
    overdueDeliveryDays.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const requiredDate = moment(entity.requiredDeliveryDate)

        const comparisonDate = entity.dateJobDelivered
            ? moment(entity.dateJobDelivered)
            : entity.deliveryDate
                ? moment(entity.deliveryDate)
                : moment()

        const timeDiffDays = comparisonDate.diff(requiredDate, 'days')
        return timeDiffDays ? `${timeDiffDays} day${timeDiffDays === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''
    })

    const jobNumber = new LinkData(Job, 'Job number', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(Job, 'Description', ['description'])
    const jobTypeName = new TypographyData(Job, 'Job type', ['jobTypeName'])
    const stagingAreaName = new TypographyData(Job, 'Staging area name', ['stagingAreaName'])
    const stagingAreaCode = new TypographyData(Job, 'Staging area code', ['stagingAreacode'])
    const stagingAreaDescription = new TypographyData(Job, 'Staging area description', ['stagingAreaDescription'])
    const progress = new ProgressData(Job, 'Progress', 'progress')
    const count = new AggregateData(Job, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const status = new TypographyData(Job, 'Status', ['draft', 'hold', 'cancelled', 'escalated', 'complete'])

    const timeManaged = new BooleanData(Job, 'Time managed', 'timeManaged')
    const allocatedTime = new NumberData(Job, 'Allocated time', 'allocatedTime')
    const lowHourThreshold = new NumberData(Job, 'Low hour threshold', 'lowHourThreshold')
    const remainingTime = new NumberData(Job, 'Remaining time', 'remainingTime')

    const isTemplate = new BooleanData(Job, 'Is template', 'isTemplate')
    const isConsignment = new BooleanData(Job, 'Is consignment', 'isConsignment')

    const isTopLevel = new BooleanData(Job, 'IsTopLevel', 'isTopLevel')
    const templateName = new LinkData(Job, 'Template name', ['templateName'])
    const templateDescription = new TypographyData(Job, 'Template description', ['templateDescription'])
    const uniqueJobTemplateNumber = new UniqueNumberData(Job, 'Unique job template number', 'jobTemplateNumber')

    const uniqueJobNumber = new UniqueNumberData(Job, 'Unique job number', 'jobNumber')
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Job, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const referenceBranch = new RelationOption(Job, 'Reference branch', 'referenceBranch', Branch)

    const runList = new RelationOption(Job, 'RunList', 'runList', RunList)
    const manifest = new RelationOption(Job, 'Manifest', 'manifest', Manifest)

    const productQuantity = new NumberData(Job, 'Product quantity', 'productQuantity')
    const productQuantityAssembled = new NumberData(Job, 'Product quantity assembled', 'productQuantityAssembled')
    const productQuantityFailed = new NumberData(Job, 'Product quantity failed', 'productQuantityFailed')

    const bomOutputQuantity = new NumberData(Job, 'Bom output quantity', 'bomOutputQuantity')

    const totalTimesheetLabourCost = new NumberData(Job, 'Total labour cost (timesheets)', 'totalTimesheetLabourCost')
    const totalOtherLabourCost = new NumberData(Job, 'Total labour cost (other)', 'totalOtherLabourCost')
    const totalInventoryCost = new NumberData(Job, 'Total inventory cost', 'totalInventoryCost')
    const totalAdhocCost = new NumberData(Job, 'Total Adhoc cost', 'totalAdhocCost')
    const totalPurchaseOrderCost = new NumberData(Job, 'Total purchase order cost', 'totalPurchaseOrderCost')
    const totalItemCost = new NumberData(Job, 'Total Item cost', 'totalItemCost')
    const totalAllJobCosts = new NumberData(Job, 'Total all job cost', 'totalAllJobCosts')
    const totalAllJobCostsIncChildren = new NumberData(Job, 'Total cost (inc children)', 'totalAllJobCostsIncChildren')

    allocatedTime.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        if (entity.allocatedTime === null) {
            return entity.timeManaged ? 'Unlimited' : ''
        }
        return `${(entity.allocatedTime / 3600).toFixed(1)} Hours`
    })

    lowHourThreshold.setRenderLabel(entity => entity.lowHourThreshold ? `${(entity.lowHourThreshold / 3600).toFixed(1)} Hours` : '')

    remainingTime.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        if (entity.remainingTime === null) {
            return entity.timeManaged ? 'Unlimited' : ''
        }
        return `${(entity.remainingTime / 3600).toFixed(1)} Hours`
    })

    jobNumber.addDependentOption(type)
    jobNumber.setRenderLink(job => `/work/jobs/${job.id}`)
    jobNumber.setRenderLabel(job => `${_('Job')} ${job.id}`)
    jobNumber.addFilterType('in', IdArrayFilter)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(job => getStatus(job))

    templateName.setRenderLink(job => getViewUrl(job))

    uniqueJobNumber.setRenderLink(job => getViewUrl(job))
    uniqueJobNumber.setRenderLabel(job => `${job.jobNumber.uniqueNumber}`)

    templateName.addDependentOption(parent)
    templateName.setRenderLabel(job => job.templateName ? job.templateName : job.parent.templateName)

    uniqueJobTemplateNumber.setRenderLink(job => getViewUrl(job))
    uniqueJobTemplateNumber.setRenderLabel(job => `${job.jobTemplateNumber.uniqueNumber}`)

    bomOutputQuantity.setRenderLabel(job => String(Number(job.bomOutputQuantity)))

    const criticalDataRequired = new BooleanData(Job, 'Critical data required', 'criticalDataRequired')

    const contractedStartDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Contracted start date', 'contractedStartDate')
    const estimatedContractedEndDate = new DateGroup(Job, 'Estimated end date', 'estimatedEndDate')
    const estimatedOverdueDays = new NumberData(Job, 'Estimated overdue days', 'estimatedOverdueDays')
    const actualOverdueDays = new NumberData(Job, 'Actual overdue days', 'actualOverdueDays')
    const reasonForlastChange = new TypographyData(Job, 'Reason for last change', ['reasonForLastChange'])

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, jobNumber, customer, stage, status, jobDeliveryDate, completionDate, processedDate,
        type, manager, description, progress, count, parent, children, adhocCosts, purchaseOrder, consignmentDeliveryDate, jobStartDate,
        asset, timeManaged, allocatedTime, product, scheduleEvents, inventory, allCosts, timeSheet, overdueDeliveryDays,
        labour, uniqueJobNumber, contact, salesOrder, isTemplate, templateName, templateDescription, tradingCompany,
        uniqueJobTemplateNumber, project, lowHourThreshold, masterJob, isTopLevel, remainingTime, requiredDeliveryDate, jobTypeName,
        stagingAreaName, stagingAreaCode, stagingAreaDescription, referenceBranch, salesOrderItem, isConsignment, assemblyLocation, runList, manifest,
        productQuantity, productQuantityAssembled, productQuantityFailed, bomOutputQuantity, currency, totalAllJobCostsIncChildren,
        totalTimesheetLabourCost, totalOtherLabourCost, totalInventoryCost, totalAdhocCost, totalPurchaseOrderCost, totalItemCost, totalAllJobCosts, criticalDataRequired,
        contractedStartDate, estimatedContractedEndDate, estimatedOverdueDays, actualOverdueDays, reasonForlastChange
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DataOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Component, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Job, JobCost } from '../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

class TotalCostData extends DataOption<JobCost> {
    protected preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(JobCost, 'Total cost')
    }

    public getValue(entity: JobCost | null, raw: any): boolean {
        return raw[this.preferredAlias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: JobCost | null, raw: any, container: Component<any, any, any>): Component<any, any, any> {
        const totalCost = raw[this.preferredAlias]

        return new Typography(totalCost)
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`SUM(\`${alias}\`.cost)`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(JobCost, alias)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.job_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}

const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<JobCost> {
    const creator = new UserData(JobCost, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(JobCost, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(JobCost, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(JobCost, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const job = new RelationOption(JobCost, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const description = new TypographyData(JobCost, 'Description', ['description'])

    const cost = new TypographyData(JobCost, 'Cost', ['cost'])
    const invoiceValue = new TypographyData(JobCost, 'Invoice value', ['invoiceCost'])
    const costs = new AggregateData(JobCost, 'Costs', 'cost', 'sum')
    const invoiceValues = new AggregateData(JobCost, 'Invoice values', 'invoiceCost', 'sum')
    // const totalCost = new TotalCostData() // This does not appear to work but is it needed? Commented out for now to avoid user confusion.

    const count = new AggregateData(JobCost, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    costs.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatter.format(Number(costs.getValue(entity, data)))
    costs.setPrecision(2)
    costs.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(costs.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    invoiceValues.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatter.format(Number(invoiceValue.getValue(entity, data)))
    invoiceValues.setPrecision(2)
    invoiceValues.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(invoiceValue.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, description, cost, count, costs,
        invoiceValue, invoiceValues, job
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Job, JobItem, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure } from '../../models'
import { countDecimalPlaces, formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<JobItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(JobItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(JobItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(JobItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(JobItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const job = new RelationOption(JobItem, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const product = new RelationOption(JobItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const includeCost = new BooleanData(JobItem, 'Include cost', 'includeCost')
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(JobItem, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const costPrice = new TypographyData(JobItem, 'Cost price', ['costPrice']) // Each in base. To get total it would be costPrice * quantity * UOM.modifier

    const quantity = new TypographyData(JobItem, 'Required Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const backorderQuantity = new TypographyData(JobItem, 'Backorder Quantity', ['backorderQuantity'])
    const allocatedQuantity = new TypographyData(JobItem, 'Allocated Quantity', ['allocatedQuantity'])
    const consumedQuantity = new TypographyData(JobItem, 'Consumed Quantity', ['consumedQuantity'])

    quantity.setRenderLabel(jobItem => formatInternationalNumber(jobItem.quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(jobItem.quantity))))
    backorderQuantity.setRenderLabel(jobItem => formatInternationalNumber(jobItem.backorderQuantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(jobItem.backorderQuantity))))
    allocatedQuantity.setRenderLabel(jobItem => formatInternationalNumber(jobItem.allocatedQuantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(jobItem.allocatedQuantity))))
    consumedQuantity.setRenderLabel(jobItem => formatInternationalNumber(jobItem.consumedQuantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(jobItem.consumedQuantity))))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, product, quantity, allocatedQuantity, job, consumedQuantity, backorderQuantity,
        unitOfMeasure, costPrice, includeCost
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, DotData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Employee, Job, JobTimeSheet, SupportTicket } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<JobTimeSheet>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(JobTimeSheet, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(JobTimeSheet, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(JobTimeSheet, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(JobTimeSheet, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(JobTimeSheet, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const job = new RelationOption(JobTimeSheet, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const masterJob = new RelationOption(JobTimeSheet, 'Master job', 'masterJob', Job)
    const parentJob = new RelationOption(JobTimeSheet, 'Parent job', 'parentJob', Job)
    const supportTicket = new RelationOption(JobTimeSheet, 'Support ticket', 'supportTicket', SupportTicket)
    const employee = new RelationOption(JobTimeSheet, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)

    const startDate = new DateGroup(JobTimeSheet, 'Start date', 'startDate')
    const startTime = new DateGroup(JobTimeSheet, 'Start time', 'startTime', undefined, true) // set as time only (local)
    const finishTime = new DateGroup(JobTimeSheet, 'Finish time', 'finishTime', undefined, true) // set as time only (local)
    const isChargeable = new BooleanData(JobTimeSheet, 'Chargeable', 'isChargeable')
    const timeUsed = new TypographyData(JobTimeSheet, 'Time used', ['timeUsed'])
    const timeChargeable = new TypographyData(JobTimeSheet, 'Time chargeable', ['timeChargeable'])
    const description = new TypographyData(JobTimeSheet, 'Description', ['description'])
    const details = new TypographyData(JobTimeSheet, 'Details', ['details'])
    const hourlyRate = new NumberData(JobTimeSheet, 'Hourly rate', 'hourlyRate')
    const chargeOutRate = new NumberData(JobTimeSheet, 'Charge out rate', 'chargeOutRate')
    const totalHourlyCost = new NumberData(JobTimeSheet, 'Total hourly cost', 'totalHourlyCost')
    const totalChargeOutValue = new NumberData(JobTimeSheet, 'Total charge out value', 'totalChargeOutValue')

    totalHourlyCost.setPrecision(2)
    totalHourlyCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => {
        let value = totalHourlyCost.getValue(entity, data)

        if (value === 'null') {
            value = '0.00'
        }

        return new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(value), null, null, 2))
    }

    totalChargeOutValue.setPrecision(2)
    totalChargeOutValue.renderContent = (entity, data) => {
        let value = totalChargeOutValue.getValue(entity, data)

        if (value === 'null') {
            value = '0.00'
        }

        return new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(value), null, null, 2))
    }

    timeUsed.setRenderLabel(entity => (Number(entity.timeUsed) / 3600).toFixed(1))
    timeChargeable.setRenderLabel(entity => (Number(entity.timeChargeable) / 3600).toFixed(1))

    const totalTimeBooked = new AggregateData(JobTimeSheet, 'Total time booked', 'timeUsed', 'sum')
    const totalTimeCharged = new AggregateData(JobTimeSheet, 'Total time charged', 'timeChargeable', 'sum')

    totalTimeBooked.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(Number(totalTimeBooked.getValue(entity, data)) === 0
        ? ''
        : `${(Number(totalTimeBooked.getValue(entity, data) / 3600).toFixed(1))} Hours`)

    totalTimeCharged.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(Number(totalTimeCharged.getValue(entity, data)) === 0
        ? ''
        : `${(Number(totalTimeCharged.getValue(entity, data) / 3600).toFixed(1))} Hours`)

    const dot = new DotData(JobTimeSheet, 'Status', 'employee')

    dot.setColor(timeSheetData => {
        const { hourlyRate, chargeOutRate } = timeSheetData

        if (Number(hourlyRate) > 0 && Number(chargeOutRate) > 0) {
            dot.setTooltip('hourly rate and charge out rate are fixed')
            return colors.green
        } else if (Number(hourlyRate) <= 0 && Number(chargeOutRate) <= 0) {
            dot.setTooltip(`hourly rate and charge out rate are missing`)
            return colors.red
        } else if (Number(hourlyRate) <= 0) {
            dot.setTooltip(`hourly rate is missing`)
            return colors.red
        } else if (Number(chargeOutRate) <= 0) {
            dot.setTooltip(`charge out rate is missing`)
            return colors.red
        }
    })

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, job, supportTicket, startDate, startTime, finishTime,
        isChargeable, employee, timeUsed, description, timeChargeable, details, masterJob,
        totalTimeCharged, totalTimeBooked, parentJob, count, dot, hourlyRate, chargeOutRate,
        totalHourlyCost, totalChargeOutValue
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { Employee, Job, LabourCost } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<LabourCost> {
    const employee = new RelationOption(LabourCost, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)
    const job = new RelationOption(LabourCost, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const duration = new TypographyData(LabourCost, 'Duration', ['duration'])
    const startTime = new DateGroup(LabourCost, 'Start time', 'startTime')
    const finishTime = new DateGroup(LabourCost, 'Finish time', 'finishTime')

    const cost = new TypographyData(LabourCost, 'Cost', ['cost'])
    const invoiceValue = new TypographyData(LabourCost, 'Invoice value', ['invoiceCost'])
    const costs = new AggregateData(LabourCost, 'Costs', 'cost', 'sum')
    const invoiceValues = new AggregateData(LabourCost, 'Invoice values', 'invoiceCost', 'sum')

    const count = new AggregateData(LabourCost, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    duration.setRenderLabel(entity => (entity.duration / 3600).toFixed(1))

    costs.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatter.format(Number(costs.getValue(entity, data)))
    costs.setPrecision(2)
    costs.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(costs.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    invoiceValues.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatter.format(Number(invoiceValues.getValue(entity, data)))
    invoiceValues.setPrecision(2)
    invoiceValues.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(invoiceValues.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        employee, job, duration, startTime, finishTime, costs, count, invoiceValues, cost, invoiceValue
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Address, LatLong, Location } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): (DateGroup<Location> | RelationOption<Location> | TypographyData<Location> | UserData<Location>)[] {
    const id = new TypographyData(Location, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(Location, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Location, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Location, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Location, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const address = new RelationOption(Location, 'Address', 'address', Address)
    const latLong = new RelationOption(Location, 'Latitude and longitude', 'latLong', LatLong)

    const description = new TypographyData(Location, 'Description', ['description'])

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, address, latLong, description
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
import { Application } from '../../application'
import { Asset, MaintenanceSchedule, MaintenanceScheduleResourceTag, ServiceContract } from '../../models'
import { Chip } from '../../component'
import { Component, Dialog, FlexContainer, Icon, IconButton } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { BaseOption, DataOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class ManyData extends DataOption<MaintenanceSchedule> {
    protected preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Resource roles')
    }

    public getValue(entity: MaintenanceSchedule | null, raw: any): boolean {
        return raw[this.preferredAlias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: MaintenanceSchedule | null, raw: any, container: Component<any, any, any>): Component<any, any, any> {
        const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
        const content: { name: string, quantity: number }[] = []
        const contentContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setAlignItems('center')
        const showMoreButton = new IconButton(new Icon('MoreHoriz'))

        if (raw[this.preferredAlias]) {
            let stop = false
            for (const [id, quantity, name] of JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])) {
                content.push({ name, quantity })
                if (!stop) {
                    const nameAndQuantity = new Chip().setLabel(name).setIncludeAvatar(true).setAvatarText(`${quantity}`)
                    contentContainer.addChild(nameAndQuantity)

                    if (contentContainer.getChildren().length > 2) {
                        stop = true
                        contentContainer.removeChild(nameAndQuantity)
                        contentContainer.addChild(showMoreButton)
                    }
                }
            }

            showMoreButton.on('click', () => {
                const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Resource roles')
                const dialogContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)

                for (const data of content) {
                    dialogContainer.setJustifyContent('space-evenly').addChild(
                        new Chip()
                            .setLabel(data.name)
                            .setIncludeAvatar(true)
                            .setAvatarText(`${data.quantity}`)
                            .setSize('medium')
                    )
                }

                dialog.addChild(dialogContainer)
                application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)
            })
        }

        return contentContainer
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( '[', \`${alias}\`.id, ',', \`${alias}\`.quantity, ',"', r.name, '"]' ) ), ']')`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(MaintenanceScheduleResourceTag, alias)
                .leftJoin(`resource_tag_name`, 'r', `\`${alias}\`.\`resource_tag_name_id\` = r.id`)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.schedule_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .groupBy(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<MaintenanceSchedule>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const contract = new RelationOption(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Contract', 'contract', ServiceContract)
    const asset = new RelationOption(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const displayLabel = new TypographyData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Display label', ['displayLabel'])
    const priority = new TypographyData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Priority', ['priority'])
    const frequency = new TypographyData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Frequency', ['frequency'])
    const preferredStartDate = new DateGroup(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Preferred start date', 'preferredStartDate')
    const jobRequired = new TypographyData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Job required?', ['jobRequired'])
    const scheduleJob = new TypographyData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Schedule job?', ['scheduleJob'])
    const includedInPlanning = new TypographyData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Include in planning?', ['includedInPlanning'])
    const duration = new TypographyData(MaintenanceSchedule, 'Duration', ['duration'])

    const resourceTags = new ManyData()

    duration.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const humanizedDuration = moment.duration(Number(entity.duration), 'seconds').humanize()

        return humanizedDuration
    })

    return [
        creator, created, editor, edited, contract, displayLabel, priority, frequency,
        preferredStartDate, jobRequired, scheduleJob, includedInPlanning, resourceTags, duration, asset
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Hub, Manifest } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Manifest>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Manifest, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Manifest, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Manifest, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Manifest, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const sourceHub = new RelationOption(Manifest, 'Source Hub', 'sourceHub', Hub)
    const destinationHub = new RelationOption(Manifest, 'Destination Hub', 'destinationHub', Hub)
    const departureDate = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Departure Date', ['departureDate'])
    const departureHour = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Departure Hour', ['departureHour'])
    const departureMinute = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Departure Minute', ['departureMinute'])
    const departureInfo = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Departure Info', ['departureInfo'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Status', ['active', 'draft', 'complete'])
    const trailerNumber = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Trailer Number', ['trailerNumber'])
    const notes = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Notes', ['notes'])
    const itemCount = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Item Count', ['itemCount'])
    const totalWeight = new TypographyData(Manifest, 'Total Weight', ['totalWeight'])
    const count = new AggregateData(Manifest, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(manifest => getStatus(manifest))

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, sourceHub, destinationHub, departureDate,
        departureHour, departureMinute, departureInfo, status, count, trailerNumber, notes, itemCount, totalWeight]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Employee, EmployeeNextOfKin, Person } from '../../models'
import { formatPersonName } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<EmployeeNextOfKin>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const person = new RelationOption(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Person', 'nextOfKin', Person)
    const employee = new RelationOption(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)

    const id = new LinkData(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'ID', ['id'])
    const isPrimary = new BooleanData(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Primary', 'isPrimaryNextOfKin')
    const nextOfKinName = new LinkData(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Full name', ['id', 'nextOfKin'])
    const relationship = new TypographyData(EmployeeNextOfKin, 'Relationship', ['nextOfKinRelationship'])

    nextOfKinName.addDependentOption(person)
    nextOfKinName.setRenderLink(employeeNextOfKin => `/company/employees/${employeeNextOfKin.employee.id}/kin/${employeeNextOfKin.id}`)
    nextOfKinName.setRenderLabel(employeeNextOfKin => formatPersonName(employeeNextOfKin.nextOfKin))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, person, id, isPrimary, nextOfKinName, relationship, employee
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, NominalJournal, NominalJournalItem, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { getViewUrl } from '..'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<NominalJournal>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(NominalJournal, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(NominalJournal, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(NominalJournal, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(NominalJournal, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new LinkData(NominalJournal, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(NominalJournal, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const includedInVatReturn = new TypographyData(NominalJournal, 'Included in VAT return', ['includedInVatReturn'])

    const period = new RelationOption(NominalJournal, 'Period', 'accountingPeriod', AccountingPeriod)

    const transactionDate = new DateGroup(NominalJournal, 'Transaction date', 'transactionDate')
    const internalReference = new TypographyData(NominalJournal, 'Internal reference', ['internalReference'])
    const description = new TypographyData(NominalJournal, 'Description', ['description'])
    const type = new TypographyData(NominalJournal, 'Type', ['type'])
    const specialYEAdjustment = new BooleanData(NominalJournal, 'Special Y/E adjustment', 'specialYEAdjustment')

    const lineItems = new RelationOption(NominalJournal, 'Items', 'lineItems', NominalJournalItem)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(NominalJournal, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    id.setRenderLink(nominalJournal => getViewUrl(nominalJournal))
    id.setRenderLabel(nominalJournal => `Nominal journal ${nominalJournal.id}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, count, transactionDate, internalReference, description, lineItems, period, type,
        specialYEAdjustment, includedInVatReturn, tradingCompany
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Company, CostCode, GeneralLedgerCode, NominalJournal, NominalJournalItem, TaxCode } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<NominalJournalItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(NominalJournalItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(NominalJournalItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(NominalJournalItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(NominalJournalItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(NominalJournalItem, 'ID', ['id'])

    const description = new TypographyData(NominalJournalItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const nominalJournal = new RelationOption(NominalJournalItem, 'Nominal Journal', 'nominalJournal', NominalJournal)
    const costCode = new RelationOption(NominalJournalItem, 'Cost code', 'costCode', CostCode)
    const glCode = new RelationOption(NominalJournalItem, 'GL code', 'glCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const debit = new NumberData(NominalJournalItem, 'Debit', 'debit')
    const credit = new NumberData(NominalJournalItem, 'Credit', 'credit')
    const taxGlCode = new RelationOption(NominalJournalItem, 'Tax GL code', 'taxGlCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const tax = new NumberData(NominalJournalItem, 'Tax', 'taxAmount')
    const taxCode = new RelationOption(NominalJournalItem, 'Tax code', 'taxCode', TaxCode)
    const taxInputOutput = new TypographyData(NominalJournalItem, 'InputOutput', ['inputOrOutputVAT'])

    const companyType = new TypographyData(NominalJournalItem, 'Company type', ['companyType'])
    const companyAccountNumber = new TypographyData(NominalJournalItem, 'Account number', ['companyAccountNumber'])
    const company = new RelationOption(NominalJournalItem, 'Company', 'company', Company)

    const totalDebit = new AggregateData(NominalJournalItem, 'Total debit', 'debit', 'sum')
    const totalCredit = new AggregateData(NominalJournalItem, 'Total credit', 'credit', 'sum')
    const totalTax = new AggregateData(NominalJournalItem, 'Total tax', 'taxAmount', 'sum')

    totalDebit.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    totalDebit.setPrecision(2)
    totalDebit.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalDebit.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    totalCredit.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    totalCredit.setPrecision(2)
    totalCredit.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalCredit.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    totalTax.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    totalTax.setPrecision(2)
    totalTax.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalTax.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, totalDebit, totalCredit, totalTax, nominalJournal,
        description, costCode, glCode, debit, credit, taxGlCode, tax, taxCode, taxInputOutput, companyType, companyAccountNumber, company
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Customer, NonComplianceReport, Product, Supplier } from '../../models'
import { PriorityFilter } from './filters/priority'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<NonComplianceReport>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(NonComplianceReport, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(NonComplianceReport, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(NonComplianceReport, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(NonComplianceReport, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(NonComplianceReport, 'ID', ['id'])

    const count = new AggregateData(NonComplianceReport, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const description = new TypographyData(NonComplianceReport, 'Description', ['description'])
    const status = new TypographyData(NonComplianceReport, 'Status', ['draft', 'active', 'cancelled', 'completed'])
    const priority = new TypographyData(NonComplianceReport, 'Priority', ['priority'])

    const supplier = new RelationOption(NonComplianceReport, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const customer = new RelationOption(NonComplianceReport, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const product = new RelationOption(NonComplianceReport, 'Product', 'product', Product)

    const nonComplianceReportNumber = new LinkData(NonComplianceReport, 'NCR Number', ['id'])

    nonComplianceReportNumber.setRenderLink(nonComplianceReport => `/company/qualityassurance/${nonComplianceReport.id}`)
    nonComplianceReportNumber.setRenderLabel(nonComplianceReport => `NCR ${nonComplianceReport.id}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(NonComplianceReport => getStatus(NonComplianceReport))

    priority.setSortable(false)
    priority.clearFilterTypes()
    priority.addFilterType('equals', PriorityFilter)
    priority.setQuickFilter('equals')

    return [creator, editor, created, description, edited, id, nonComplianceReportNumber, priority, status, supplier, customer, product, count]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Note } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(Note, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Note, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Note, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Note, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const note = new TypographyData(Note, 'Note', ['text'])
    const count = new AggregateData(Note, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, note, count]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Job, Operation, OperationDependency, Product, ResourceTagName } from '../../models'
import { OperationTagData } from './reports/operationTags'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Operation>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Operation, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Operation, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Operation, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Operation, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const completedDate = new DateGroup(Operation, 'Completed date', 'completedDate')
    const completedBy = new UserData(Operation, 'Completed by', 'completedBy')

    const product = new RelationOption(Operation, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const job = new RelationOption(Operation, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const dependencies = new RelationOption(Operation, 'Dependencies', 'dependencies', OperationDependency)
    const resourceTag = new RelationOption(Operation, 'Resource tag', 'resourceTag', ResourceTagName)

    const operationNumber = new LinkData(Operation, 'ID', ['id'])
    const operationNumberNoLink = new TypographyData(Operation, 'IDNoLink', ['id'])
    const name = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Name', ['name'])
    const description = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Description', ['description'])
    const duration = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Duration', ['duration'])
    const resourceTagQuantity = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Resource tag quantity', ['resourceTagQuantity'])

    const requiresDuration = new BooleanData(Operation, 'Requires duration', 'requiresDuration')
    const stagingAreaName = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Staging area name', ['stagingAreaName'])
    const stagingAreaCode = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Staging area code', ['stagingAreacode'])
    const stagingAreaDescription = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Staging area description', ['stagingAreaDescription'])

    const count = new AggregateData(Operation, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const setUpDuration = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Setup duration', ['setUpDuration'])
    const runDuration = new TypographyData(Operation, 'Run duration', ['runDuration'])

    operationNumber.addDependentOption(product, job)
    operationNumber.setRenderLink(operation => {
        if (operation.product) {
            return `/purchasing/products/${operation.product.id}/operations/${operation.id}`
        }

        return `/work/jobs/${operation.job.id}/operations/${operation.id}`
    })
    operationNumber.setRenderLabel(operation => `Operation ${operation.id}`)

    description.setMinimumWidth(300)
    duration.setRenderLabel(operation => operation.duration > 0 ? moment.duration(operation.duration * 1000).humanize() : '')
    setUpDuration.setRenderLabel(operation => operation.setUpDuration > 0 ? moment.duration(operation.setUpDuration * 1000).humanize() : '')
    runDuration.setRenderLabel(operation => operation.runDuration > 0 ? moment.duration(operation.runDuration * 1000).humanize() : '')

    operationNumberNoLink.setRenderLabel(operation => `Operation ${operation.id}`)

    const resourceTagAndQuantity = new OperationTagData()

    const operationHaveAssociatedDataBoolean = new TypographyData(
        Operation, 'Has associated data', ['operationAssociatedDataDocumentRelations']
    )

    operationHaveAssociatedDataBoolean.setRenderLabel(
        operation => operation.operationAssociatedDataDocumentRelations &&
         operation.operationAssociatedDataDocumentRelations.length > 0
            ? 'Yes'
            : 'No'
    )

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, operationNumber, product,
        description, duration, dependencies, count, operationNumberNoLink,
        job, name, completedDate, completedBy, resourceTag, resourceTagQuantity,
        resourceTagAndQuantity, requiresDuration, setUpDuration, runDuration,
        stagingAreaName, stagingAreaCode, stagingAreaDescription, operationHaveAssociatedDataBoolean
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Operation, OperationResourceTag, ResourceTagName } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<OperationResourceTag>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(OperationResourceTag, 'Created by', 'creator')

    const created = new DateGroup(OperationResourceTag, 'Created on', 'created')

    const count = new AggregateData(OperationResourceTag, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, operation, resourceTagName,

    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, ProgressData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Contact, Customer, Employee, Opportunity, OpportunityAdditionalCost, Prospect, Quote, SalesPipeline, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Opportunity>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Opportunity, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Opportunity, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Opportunity, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Opportunity, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const customer = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const pipelineStage = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Sales pipeline', 'salesPipeline', SalesPipeline)
    const contact = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const manager = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Manager', 'manager', Employee)
    const quotes = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Quotes', 'quotes', Quote)
    const additionalCosts = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Additional costs', 'additionalCosts', OpportunityAdditionalCost)
    const prospect = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Prospect', 'prospect', Prospect)

    const opportunityNumber = new LinkData(Opportunity, 'ID', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(Opportunity, 'Description', ['description'])
    const costs = new TypographyData(Opportunity, 'Costs', ['costs'])
    const value = new NumberData(Opportunity, 'Value', 'value')
    const percentage = new ProgressData(Opportunity, 'Percentage', 'percentage')
    const status = new TypographyData(Opportunity, 'Status', ['won', 'closed'])

    const count = new AggregateData(Opportunity, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const values = new AggregateGroup(Opportunity, 'Values', 'value')

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Opportunity, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    opportunityNumber.setRenderLink(opportunity => `/sales/opportunities/${opportunity.id}`)
    opportunityNumber.setRenderLabel(opportunity => `Opportunity ${opportunity.id}`)
    description.setMinimumWidth(300)

    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(opportunity => getStatus(opportunity))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, opportunityNumber, customer, pipelineStage, contact,
        manager, quotes, costs, description, value, percentage, status, count, values,
        additionalCosts, tradingCompany, prospect
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Opportunity, OpportunityAdditionalCost } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<OpportunityAdditionalCost>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const opportunity = new RelationOption(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Opportunity', 'opportunity', Opportunity)
    const description = new TypographyData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Description', ['description'])
    const includeCost = new BooleanData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Include in cost', 'includeCost')
    const cost = new NumberData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Cost', 'cost')
    const quantity = new NumberData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Quantity', 'quantity')
    const totalCost = new NumberData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Total cost', 'totalCost')

    const count = new AggregateData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const sumTotalCost = new AggregateData(OpportunityAdditionalCost, 'Total', 'totalCost', 'sum')

    sumTotalCost.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(sumTotalCost.getValue(entity, data))
    sumTotalCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalCost.getFormattedValue(entity, data))
    sumTotalCost.setPrecision(2)

    cost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(cost.getValue(entity, data))))
    totalCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(totalCost.getValue(entity, data))))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, description, cost, count, totalCost, quantity, sumTotalCost, includeCost, opportunity
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, Bank, CreditNote, Currency, Customer, Invoice, Payment, PaymentMethod, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierInvoice, SupplierRemittance } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Payment>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Payment, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Payment, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Payment, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Payment, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(Payment, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')

    const id = new TypographyData(Payment, 'ID', ['id'])

    const periodPosted = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Period posted', 'periodPosted', AccountingPeriod)

    const invoice = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Invoice', 'invoice', Invoice)
    const creditNote = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Credit Note', 'creditNote', CreditNote)
    const supplierInvoice = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Supplier Invoice', 'supplierInvoice', SupplierInvoice)
    const supplierCreditNote = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Supplier Credit Note', 'supplierCreditNote', SupplierCreditNote)
    const customer = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const bank = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Bank', 'bank', Bank)
    const paymentMethod = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Payment method', 'paymentMethod', PaymentMethod)
    const paymentCurrency = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Payment currency', 'currency', Currency)
    const supplierRemittance = new RelationOption(Payment, 'Supplier remittance', 'supplierRemittance', SupplierRemittance)

    const paymentReferenceNumber = new TypographyData(Payment, 'Payment reference number', ['paymentReference'])
    const chequeNumber = new TypographyData(Payment, 'Cheque number', ['chequeNumber'])
    const notes = new TypographyData(Payment, 'Notes', ['notes'])

    const paymentAmount = new TypographyData(Payment, 'Payment amount', ['amountPaid'])
    const paymentAmountTotal = new AggregateData(Payment, 'Payment amount total', 'amountPaid', 'sum')
    const paymentAmountCurrency = new TypographyData(Payment, 'Payment amount currency', ['amountPaidInCurrency'])

    const paymentAmountUnmatched = new NumberData(Payment, 'Payment amount unmatched', 'amountUnmatched')
    const paymentAmountUnmatchedTotal = new AggregateData(Payment, 'Payment amount unmatched total', 'amountUnmatched', 'sum')
    const paymentAmountUnmatchedCurrency = new TypographyData(Payment, 'Payment amount unmatched currency', ['amountUnmatchedInCurrency'])

    const matched = new BooleanData(Payment, 'Matched', 'matched')

    const paymentMadeOn = new DateGroup(Payment, 'Payment made on', 'paymentMadeOn')

    paymentAmountTotal.setPrecision(2)
    paymentAmountTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(paymentAmountTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    paymentAmountUnmatchedTotal.setPrecision(2)
    paymentAmountUnmatchedTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(paymentAmountUnmatchedTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    id.setRenderLabel(payment => `Payment ${payment.id}`)

    paymentAmount.setRenderLabel(payment => {
        const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2
        })

        return formatter.format(Number((Number(payment.amountPaid))))
    })

    paymentAmountCurrency.setRenderLabel(payment => {
        const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2
        })

        return formatter.format(Number((Number(payment.amountPaidInCurrency))))
    })

    paymentAmountUnmatched.setRenderLabel(payment => {
        const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2
        })

        return formatter.format(Number((Number(payment.amountUnmatchedInCurrency))))
    })

    paymentAmountUnmatchedCurrency.setRenderLabel(payment => {
        const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2
        })

        return formatter.format(Number((Number(payment.amountUnmatchedInCurrency))))
    })

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, invoice, creditNote, customer, paymentReferenceNumber, paymentCurrency, paymentAmountCurrency,
        chequeNumber, paymentAmount, notes, id, paymentMadeOn, paymentMethod, bank, paymentAmountTotal, supplierRemittance, periodPosted,
        supplierInvoice, supplierCreditNote, paymentAmountUnmatched, paymentAmountUnmatchedTotal, paymentAmountUnmatchedCurrency, matched,
        isTakeOn
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { PaymentMethod } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<PaymentMethod>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(PaymentMethod, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(PaymentMethod, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(PaymentMethod, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(PaymentMethod, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const name = new TypographyData(PaymentMethod, 'Name', ['name'])

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, name]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
/* eslint-disable max-classes-per-file */
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, MultiPropertyDataOption, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Component, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Contact, Employee, Person, PersonAddress, PersonEmailAddress, PersonTelephoneNumber, Title } from '../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

class PrimaryEmailData extends MultiPropertyDataOption<Person> {
    protected preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(Person, 'Primary email address')
    }

    public getValue(entity: Person | null, raw: any): string {
        return raw[this.preferredAlias] || ''
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof Person)[] {
        return []
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Person | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const email = raw[this.preferredAlias]

        return new Typography(email)
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select('em.email_address', this.preferredAlias)
                .from(PersonEmailAddress, alias)
                .leftJoin('email_address', 'em', `\`${alias}\`.email_address_id = em.id`)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.person_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .andWhere(`\`${alias}\`.is_primary = 1`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}

class PrimaryPhoneData extends MultiPropertyDataOption<Person> {
    protected preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(Person, 'Primary phone number')
    }

    public getValue(entity: Person | null, raw: any): string {
        return raw[this.preferredAlias] || ''
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof Person)[] {
        return []
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Person | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const phone = raw[this.preferredAlias]

        return new Typography(phone)
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${alias}\`.telephone_number`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(PersonTelephoneNumber, alias)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.person_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .andWhere(`\`${alias}\`.is_primary = 1`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}

class UserType extends MultiPropertyDataOption<Person> {
    protected employeeAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
    protected contactAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(Person, 'Type')
    }

    public getValue(entity: Person | null, raw: any): string {
        if (!raw) {
            return undefined
        }

        const employeeType = raw[this.employeeAlias]
        const contactType = raw[this.contactAlias]

        if (contactType) {
            return 'Contact'
        } else if (employeeType) {
            return 'Employee'
        }

        return ''
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof Person)[] {
        return []
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Person | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const employeeType = raw[this.employeeAlias]
        const contactType = raw[this.contactAlias]

        if (contactType) {
            return new Typography('Contact')
        } else if (employeeType) {
            return new Typography('Employee')
        }
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${alias}\`.id`, this.contactAlias)
                .from(Contact, alias)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.person_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.contactAlias)

        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${alias}\`.id`, this.employeeAlias)
                .from(Employee, alias)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.person_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.employeeAlias)
    }
}

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Person>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Person, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Person, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Person, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Person, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const addresses = new RelationOption(Person, 'Addresses', 'addresses', PersonAddress)
    const emailAddresses = new RelationOption(Person, 'Email addresses', 'emailAddresses', PersonEmailAddress)
    const telephoneNumbers = new RelationOption(Person, 'Telephone numbers', 'telephoneNumbers', PersonTelephoneNumber)
    const title = new RelationOption(Person, 'Title', 'title', Title)
    const user = new UserData(Person, 'User', 'user')

    const forename = new TypographyData(Person, 'Forename', ['forename'])
    const surname = new TypographyData(Person, 'Surname', ['surname'])
    const fullName = new TypographyData(Person, 'Full name', ['surname', 'forename'])
    const primaryEmail = new PrimaryEmailData()
    const primaryPhone = new PrimaryPhoneData()

    const count = new AggregateData(Person, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const id = new TypographyData(Person, 'ID', ['id'])
    const type = new UserType()

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, addresses, emailAddresses,
        telephoneNumbers, title, forename, surname, fullName, count,
        primaryEmail, primaryPhone, id, user, type
    ]
}

````

````typescript
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { EmailAddress, Person, PersonEmailAddress } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<PersonEmailAddress>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(PersonEmailAddress, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(PersonEmailAddress, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(PersonEmailAddress, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(PersonEmailAddress, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const person = new RelationOption(PersonEmailAddress, 'Person', 'person', Person)
    const emailAddress = new RelationOption(PersonEmailAddress, 'Email address', 'emailAddress', EmailAddress)
    const type = new TypographyData(PersonEmailAddress, 'Type', ['type'])
    const isPrimary = new BooleanData(PersonEmailAddress, 'Primary', 'isPrimary')
    const count = new AggregateData(PersonEmailAddress, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, person, emailAddress, count, type, isPrimary]
}

````
