Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AlternativeSku, Backorder, BillOfMaterials, Customer, DiscountGroup, GeneralLedgerCode, InvoiceItem, Job, NonComplianceReport, Operation, PackagingType, PermittedWarehouseLocation, Product, ProductBatch, ProductLocation, ProductQuantityDiscount, ProductSupplier, ProductUnit, ProductUnitOfMeasure, PurchaseOrderItem, QuoteItem, RecipientProduct, SalesOrderItem, StockCategory, StockValues, TaxCode, WarehouseLocation } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ArrayFilter } from '../../reports/data/typography/filters'
import { CheckboxData } from './reports/checkboxData'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { StockValueProperty } from './reports/stockValueProperty'
import { TagData } from './reports/tagData'
import { getStatus } from '../../configuration'
import { round } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Product>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Product, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Product, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Product, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Product, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const quantityDiscounts = new RelationOption(Product, 'Quantity discounts', 'quantityDiscounts', ProductQuantityDiscount)
    const operations = new RelationOption(Product, 'Operations', 'operations', Operation)
    const productSupplier = new RelationOption(Product, 'Product Supplier', 'productSuppliers', ProductSupplier)
    const preferredSupplier = new RelationOption(Product, 'Preferred supplier', 'preferredSupplier', ProductSupplier)
    const job = new RelationOption(Product, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const billOfMaterials = new RelationOption(Product, 'Bill of materials', 'billOfMaterials', BillOfMaterials)
    const batches = new RelationOption(Product, 'Batches', 'batches', ProductBatch)
    const locations = new RelationOption(Product, 'Locations', 'locations', ProductLocation)
    const units = new RelationOption(Product, 'Units', 'units', ProductUnit)
    const taxCode = new RelationOption(Product, 'Tax code', 'taxCode', TaxCode)
    const stockValues = new RelationOption(Product, 'Stock values', 'stockValues', StockValues)
    const nonComplianceReport = new RelationOption(Product, 'Non compliance reports', 'nonComplianceReports', NonComplianceReport)
    const permittedLocations = new RelationOption(Product, 'Permitted locations', 'permittedLocations', PermittedWarehouseLocation)
    const invoiceItems = new RelationOption(Product, 'Invoice items', 'invoiceItems', InvoiceItem)
    const quoteItems = new RelationOption(Product, 'Quote items', 'quoteItems', QuoteItem)
    const backorders = new RelationOption(Product, 'Back orders', 'backorders', Backorder)
    const salesOrderItems = new RelationOption(Product, 'Sales order items', 'salesOrderItems', SalesOrderItem)
    const purchaseOrderItems = new RelationOption(Product, 'Purchase order items', 'purchaseOrderItems', PurchaseOrderItem)
    const recipientProducts = new RelationOption(Product, 'Recipient products', 'recipientProducts', RecipientProduct)
    const alternativeSkus = new RelationOption(Product, 'Alternative skus', 'alternativeSkus', AlternativeSku)
    const parentSkus = new RelationOption(Product, 'Parent skus', 'parentSkus', AlternativeSku)
    const bomOutputUnitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(Product, 'Bom output unit of measure', 'bomOutputUnitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const stockCategory = new RelationOption(Product, 'Stock category', 'stockCategory', StockCategory)
    const assemblyLocation = new RelationOption(Product, 'Assembly location', 'assemblyLocation', WarehouseLocation)

    const id = new TypographyData(Product, 'ID', ['id'])
    id.addFilterType('arrayFilter', ArrayFilter)
    const sku = new LinkData(Product, 'SKU', ['sku', 'id'])
    const name = new TypographyData(Product, 'Name', ['name'])
    const description = new TypographyData(Product, 'Description', ['description'])
    const price = new TypographyData(Product, 'Normal selling price', ['normalSellPrice'])
    const displayPrice = new TypographyData(Product, 'Normal selling price Display', ['normalSellPriceDisplay'])
    const displaySellPriceUOM = new RelationOption(Product, 'Display selling price UOM', 'sellPriceDisplayUnitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const status = new TypographyData(Product, 'Status', ['draft', 'active'])

    const count = new AggregateData(Product, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(Product, 'Prices', 'normalSellPrice')

    const isAssembly = new BooleanData(Product, 'Assembly', 'isAssembly')
    const unitTracked = new BooleanData(Product, 'Unit tracked', 'unitTracked')
    const isAvailableForShippingCheckbox = new CheckboxData()
    const stockLevelStatusDot = new StockValueProperty().addDependentOption(stockValues)

    const tags = new TagData()
    const topLevelSku = new RelationOption(Product, 'Top level sku', 'topLevelSku', Product)

    const allocationMethod = new TypographyData(Product, 'Allocation method', ['allocationMethod'])
    const manufacturer = new TypographyData(Product, 'Manufacturer', ['manufacturer'])
    const manufacturerPartNumber = new TypographyData(Product, 'Manufacturer part number', ['manufacturerPartNumber'])
    const model = new TypographyData(Product, 'Model', ['model'])
    const reorderLevel = new TypographyData(Product, 'Reorder level', ['reorderLevel'])
    const minimumStock = new TypographyData(Product, 'Minimum stock', ['minimumStock'])
    const maximumStock = new TypographyData(Product, 'Maximum stock', ['maximumStock'])
    const minimumShippingQuantity = new TypographyData(Product, 'Minimum shipping quantity', ['minimumShippingQuantity'])
    const bomOutputQuantity = new NumberData(Product, 'Bom output quantity', 'bomOutputQuantity')
    const baseUnitOfMeasure = new TypographyData(Product, 'Base UOM', ['baseUnitOfMeasure'])

    const costPrice = new TypographyData(Product, 'Cost price', ['costPrice'])
    const displayCostPrice = new TypographyData(Product, 'Cost price Display', ['costPriceDisplay'])
    const displayCostPriceUOM = new RelationOption(Product, 'Display cost price UOM', 'costPriceDisplayUnitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const minimumSellPrice = new TypographyData(Product, 'Minimum selling price', ['minimumSellPrice'])
    const maximumSellPrice = new TypographyData(Product, 'Maximum selling price', ['maximumSellPrice'])
    const avalaraTaxCode = new TypographyData(Product, 'Avalara tax code', ['avalaraTaxCode'])
    const hsCommodityCode = new TypographyData(Product, 'HS commodity code', ['hsCommodityCode'])

    const autoOrder = new BooleanData(Product, 'Auto order', 'autoOrder')
    const isTaxable = new BooleanData(Product, 'Taxable', 'isTaxable')
    const batchTracked = new BooleanData(Product, 'Batch tracked', 'batchTracked')
    const vendorRestricted = new BooleanData(Product, 'Vendor restricted', 'vendorRestricted')
    const managed = new BooleanData(Product, 'Managed', 'managed')
    const allowDiscounts = new BooleanData(Product, 'Allow discounts', 'allowDiscounts')
    const isTopLevel = new BooleanData(Product, 'Top level', 'isTopLevel')
    const isContract = new BooleanData(Product, 'Contract', 'isContract')
    const availableForJob = new BooleanData(Product, 'Available for job', 'availableForJob')
    const availableForPointOfSale = new BooleanData(Product, 'Available for point of sale', 'availableForPointOfSale')
    const availableForQuote = new BooleanData(Product, 'Available for quote', 'availableForQuote')
    const availableForSalesOrder = new BooleanData(Product, 'Available for sales order', 'availableForSalesOrder')
    const availableForPurchaseOrder = new BooleanData(Product, 'Available for purchase order', 'availableForPurchaseOrder')
    const deliverable = new BooleanData(Product, 'Deliverable', 'deliverable')
    const consumable = new BooleanData(Product, 'Consumable', 'consumable')
    const bulk = new BooleanData(Product, 'Bulk', 'isBulk')

    const buildToOrder = new BooleanData(Product, 'Build to order', 'buildToOrder')
    const isDropShippable = new BooleanData(Product, 'Drop Shippable', 'isDropShippable')
    const isCustomerOwned = new BooleanData(Product, 'Is customer owned', 'isCustomerOwned')
    const allowAdditionOfManagedProductToPOofSalesOrder = new BooleanData(Product, 'Allow addition of managed product to PO of sales order', 'allowAdditionOfManagedProductToPOofSalesOrder')
    const allowAdditionOfManagedProductToPOofJob = new BooleanData(Product, 'Allow addition of managed product to PO of job', 'allowAdditionOfManagedProductToPOofJob')
    const customer = new RelationOption(Product, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)

    const generalLedgerCodePurchases = new RelationOption(Product, 'GL code - Purchases', 'generalLedgerCodePurchases', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const generalLedgerCodeRawMaterials = new RelationOption(Product, 'GL code - Raw material', 'generalLedgerCodeRawMaterials', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const generalLedgerCodeWorkInProgress = new RelationOption(Product, 'GL code - WIP', 'generalLedgerCodeWorkInProgress', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const generalLedgerCodeFinishedGoods = new RelationOption(Product, 'GL code - Finished goods', 'generalLedgerCodeFinishedGoods', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const generalLedgerCodeSales = new RelationOption(Product, 'GL code - Sales', 'generalLedgerCodeSales', GeneralLedgerCode)

    const packagingType = new RelationOption(Product, 'Packaging type', 'packagingType', PackagingType)
    const discountGroup = new RelationOption(Product, 'Discount group', 'discountGroup', DiscountGroup)

    const widthExcludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Width excluding packaging', ['widthExcludingPackaging'])
    const heightExcludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Height excluding packaging', ['heightExcludingPackaging'])
    const depthExcludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Depth excluding packaging', ['depthExcludingPackaging'])
    const weightExcludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Weight excluding packaging', ['weightExcludingPackaging'])
    const volumeExcludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Volume excluding packaging', ['volumeExcludingPackaging'])

    const widthIncludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Width including packaging', ['widthIncludingPackaging'])
    const heightIncludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Height including packaging', ['heightIncludingPackaging'])
    const depthIncludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Depth including packaging', ['depthIncludingPackaging'])
    const weightIncludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Weight including packaging', ['weightIncludingPackaging'])
    const volumeIncludingPackaging = new TypographyData(Product, 'Volume including packaging', ['volumeIncludingPackaging'])

    sku.setRenderLink(product => `/purchasing/products/${product.id}`)
    sku.setRenderLabel(product => product.sku)

    price.setRenderLabel(entity => String(round(Number(entity.normalSellPrice), 5)))
    costPrice.setRenderLabel(entity => String(round(Number(entity.costPrice), 5)))

    bomOutputQuantity.setRenderLabel(product => String(Number(product.bomOutputQuantity)))

    stockLevelStatusDot.setRenderLink(product => `/purchasing/products/${product.id}/${product.unitTracked ? 'units' : product.batchTracked ? 'batches' : 'stock'}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(product => getStatus(product))

    const isInternallyReplenished = new BooleanData(Product, 'Internally Replenished', 'isInternallyReplenished')

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, sku, name, description, price, isDropShippable,
        count, prices, quantityDiscounts, operations, productSupplier, batches, locations, units,
        preferredSupplier, isAssembly, job, tags, billOfMaterials, topLevelSku, id, isAvailableForShippingCheckbox,
        unitTracked, taxCode, stockValues, stockLevelStatusDot, nonComplianceReport, permittedLocations,
        allocationMethod, manufacturer, manufacturerPartNumber, model, reorderLevel, minimumStock,
        maximumStock, minimumShippingQuantity, costPrice, minimumSellPrice, maximumSellPrice, autoOrder, isTaxable,
        batchTracked, vendorRestricted, managed, allowDiscounts, isTopLevel, isContract, availableForJob,
        availableForPointOfSale, availableForQuote, availableForSalesOrder, availableForPurchaseOrder, deliverable, consumable,
        generalLedgerCodePurchases, generalLedgerCodeRawMaterials, generalLedgerCodeWorkInProgress,
        generalLedgerCodeFinishedGoods, generalLedgerCodeSales, packagingType, discountGroup,
        widthExcludingPackaging, heightExcludingPackaging, depthExcludingPackaging, weightExcludingPackaging, volumeExcludingPackaging,
        widthIncludingPackaging, heightIncludingPackaging, depthIncludingPackaging, weightIncludingPackaging, volumeIncludingPackaging,
        invoiceItems, quoteItems, salesOrderItems, recipientProducts, bulk, alternativeSkus, parentSkus, purchaseOrderItems, backorders,
        bomOutputUnitOfMeasure, bomOutputQuantity, status, stockCategory, baseUnitOfMeasure, isCustomerOwned, customer,
        allowAdditionOfManagedProductToPOofSalesOrder, allowAdditionOfManagedProductToPOofJob,
        displayPrice, displayCostPrice, displaySellPriceUOM, displayCostPriceUOM, avalaraTaxCode, buildToOrder, hsCommodityCode, assemblyLocation, isInternallyReplenished
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, ProductBatch, ProductLocation } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProductBatch>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProductBatch, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProductBatch, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProductBatch, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProductBatch, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(ProductBatch, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const useBefore = new DateGroup(ProductBatch, 'Use before', 'useBefore')
    const expiryDate = new DateGroup(ProductBatch, 'Expiry date', 'expiryDate')

    const id = new LinkData(ProductBatch, 'ID', ['id'])
    const identifier = new LinkData(ProductBatch, 'Batch number', ['identifier'])
    const product = new RelationOption(ProductBatch, 'SKU', 'product', Product)
    const locations = new RelationOption(ProductBatch, 'Locations', 'productLocations', ProductLocation)

    identifier.setRenderLabel(entity => entity.identifier)
    identifier.setRenderLink(entity => `/purchasing/batches/${entity.id}`)

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, product, identifier, id, locations, count, expiryDate, useBefore]
}

````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, ProductCustomDiscount } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProductCustomDiscount>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const product = new RelationOption(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const name = new TypographyData(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Name', ['name'])
    const discount = new TypographyData(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Discount %', ['discountPercentage'])
    const enabled = new BooleanData(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Enabled', 'enabled')
    const startDate = new DateGroup(ProductCustomDiscount, 'Start date', 'startDate')
    const endDate = new DateGroup(ProductCustomDiscount, 'End date', 'endDate')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, name, discount, enabled, startDate, endDate, product]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Asset, GoodsReceived, Job, Product, ProductBatch, ProductLocation, ProductUnit, ServiceContract, Shipment, WarehouseLocation } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProductLocation>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProductLocation, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProductLocation, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProductLocation, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProductLocation, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const quantity = new NumberData(ProductLocation, 'Quantity', 'quantity')
    const product = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const location = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Location', 'location', WarehouseLocation)

    const unit = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Unit', 'unit', ProductUnit)
    const batch = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Batch', 'batch', ProductBatch)
    const delivery = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Delivery', 'delivery', GoodsReceived)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)
    const job = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const contract = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Contract', 'serviceContract', ServiceContract)
    const asset = new RelationOption(ProductLocation, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)

    const totalQuantity = new AggregateData(ProductLocation, 'Total quantity', 'quantity', 'sum')
    const totalQuantityWithUnit = new AggregateData(ProductLocation, 'Total quantity with unit', 'quantity', 'sum')

    const quantityWithUnit = new NumberData(ProductLocation, 'Quantity with unit', 'quantity')

    quantityWithUnit.setPrecision(0)
    quantityWithUnit.addDependentOption(product)
    quantityWithUnit.setRenderLabel(item => `${formatInternationalNumber(item.quantity, undefined, undefined, 0)} ${item.product ? item.product.baseUnitOfMeasure : ''}`)

    quantity.setPrecision(0)
    quantity.renderContent = (entity: ProductLocation, raw: any) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(quantity.getValue(entity, raw)), undefined, undefined, 0))

    totalQuantityWithUnit.addDependentOption(product)
    totalQuantityWithUnit.renderContent = (entity: ProductLocation, raw: any) => new Typography(`${formatInternationalNumber(Number(totalQuantityWithUnit.getValue(entity, raw)), undefined, undefined, 0)} ${raw[`${product.getAlias()}_base_unit_of_measure`]}`)

    totalQuantity.setPrecision(0)
    totalQuantity.renderContent = (entity: ProductLocation, raw: any) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(totalQuantity.getValue(entity, raw)), undefined, undefined, 0))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, quantity, product, location, asset,
        delivery, shipment, job, contract, unit, batch, totalQuantity, quantityWithUnit, totalQuantityWithUnit
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DataOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Component, FragmentContainer, Icon } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Product, ProductSupplier, ProductUnitOfMeasure, Supplier } from '../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { countDecimalPlaces, formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export class IsPreferredData extends DataOption<ProductSupplier> {
    protected preferredSupplierIdAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(ProductSupplier, 'Preferred vendor')
    }

    public getValue(entity: ProductSupplier | null, raw: any): boolean {
        return entity.id === raw[this.preferredSupplierIdAlias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: ProductSupplier | null, raw: any, container: Component<any, any, any>): Component<any, any, any> {
        if (this.getValue(entity, raw) === true) {
            return new Icon('Check')
        } else {
            return new FragmentContainer()
        }
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${alias}\`.preferred_supplier_id`, this.preferredSupplierIdAlias)
                .from(Product, alias)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.id = \`${parentAlias}\`.product_id`)
        }, this.preferredSupplierIdAlias)
    }
}

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProductSupplier>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProductSupplier, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProductSupplier, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProductSupplier, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProductSupplier, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const count = new AggregateData(ProductSupplier, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const supplier = new RelationOption(ProductSupplier, 'Vendor', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const product = new RelationOption(ProductSupplier, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(ProductSupplier, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)

    const minOrder = new TypographyData(ProductSupplier, 'Min order', ['minOrder'])
    const purchasePrice = new TypographyData(ProductSupplier, 'Purchase price', ['purchasePrice'])
    const supplierDescription = new TypographyData(ProductSupplier, 'Vendor desc', ['supplierDescription'])
    const supplierPartNo = new TypographyData(ProductSupplier, 'Vendor part no', ['supplierPartNo'])
    const leadTime = new TypographyData(ProductSupplier, 'Lead time', ['leadTime'])
    const preferred = new IsPreferredData()

    minOrder.setRenderLabel(entity => formatInternationalNumber(Number(entity.minOrder), undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(entity.minOrder))))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, count, supplier, product, minOrder, purchasePrice, supplierDescription,
        supplierPartNo, leadTime, preferred, unitOfMeasure
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, ProductLocation, ProductUnit } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProductUnit>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProductUnit, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProductUnit, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProductUnit, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProductUnit, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const useBefore = new DateGroup(ProductUnit, 'Use before', 'useBefore')
    const expiryDate = new DateGroup(ProductUnit, 'Expiry date', 'expiryDate')
    const identifier = new LinkData(ProductUnit, 'Serial number', ['identifier'])
    const id = new LinkData(ProductUnit, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(ProductUnit, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const product = new RelationOption(ProductUnit, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const productLocation = new RelationOption(ProductUnit, 'Product location', 'productLocation', ProductLocation)

    identifier.setRenderLink(unit => `/purchasing/units/${unit.id}`)
    identifier.setRenderLabel(unit => unit.identifier)

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, identifier, product, productLocation, id, count, useBefore, expiryDate]
}

````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, ProductUnitOfMeasureGroup } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProductUnitOfMeasure>[] {
    const id = new TypographyData(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const name = new TypographyData(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Name', ['name'])
    const multiplier = new TypographyData(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Multiplier', ['multiplier'])

    const isDefaultPurchaseUnit = new BooleanData(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Is default purchase unit', 'isDefaultPurchaseUnit')
    const isDefaultSaleUnit = new BooleanData(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Is default sale unit', 'isDefaultSaleUnit')

    const product = new RelationOption(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const group = new RelationOption(ProductUnitOfMeasure, 'Group', 'group', ProductUnitOfMeasureGroup)

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, name, multiplier, product, group, isDefaultPurchaseUnit, isDefaultSaleUnit
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Contact, Customer, Job, Project, ProjectBranch, PurchaseOrder, Quote, SalesOrder } from '../../models'
import { getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Project>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Project, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Project, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Project, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Project, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const customer = new RelationOption(Project, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const count = new AggregateData(Project, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const name = new TypographyData(Project, 'Name', ['name'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Project, 'Status', ['status'])
    const type = new TypographyData(Project, 'Type', ['type'])
    const estimatedStartDate = new DateGroup(Project, 'Estimated Start Date', 'estimatedStartDate')
    const estimatedFinishDate = new DateGroup(Project, 'Estimated Completed Date', 'estimatedCompletionDate')
    const actualStartDate = new DateGroup(Project, 'Actual Start Date', 'actualStartDate')
    const actualFinishDate = new DateGroup(Project, 'Actual Completed Date', 'actualCompletionDate')
    const job = new RelationOption(Project, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const contact = new RelationOption(Project, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(Project, 'Sales orders', 'salesOrders', SalesOrder)
    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(Project, 'Purchase orders', 'purchaseOrders', PurchaseOrder)
    const quote = new RelationOption(Project, 'Quotes', 'quotes', Quote)
    const branch = new RelationOption(Project, 'Project branch', 'quotes', ProjectBranch)
    const projectNumber = new UniqueNumberData(Project, 'Project number', 'projectNumber')
    const projectID = new TypographyData(Project, 'Project ID', ['projectID'])
    const projectOVP = new TypographyData(Project, 'Customer Project Reference', ['ovpNo'])

    const project = new LinkData(Project, 'Project', ['id'])
    const id = new LinkData(Project, 'ID', ['id'])

    id.setRenderLink(project => `/work/projects/${project.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(project => `${_('Project')} ${project.id}`)

    project.setRenderLink(project => `/work/projects/${project.id}`)
    project.setRenderLabel(project => `${project.name} | ${project.projectID}`)

    projectNumber.setRenderLabel(project => `${project.projectNumber.uniqueNumber}`)
    projectNumber.setRenderLink(project => getViewUrl(project))

    return [
        creator,
        editor,
        created,
        edited,
        customer,
        contact,
        count,
        id,
        name,
        type,
        status,
        estimatedStartDate,
        estimatedFinishDate,
        actualStartDate,
        actualFinishDate,
        salesOrder,
        job,
        purchaseOrder,
        quote,
        branch,
        projectNumber,
        projectID,
        project,
        projectOVP
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Branch, Project, ProjectBranch } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProjectBranch>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProjectBranch, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProjectBranch, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProjectBranch, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProjectBranch, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const project = new RelationOption(ProjectBranch, 'Project', 'project', Project)
    const branch = new RelationOption(ProjectBranch, 'Branch', 'branch', Branch)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, project, branch
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { InternalProjectRole, PersonEmailAddress, PersonTelephoneNumber, Project, ProjectTeamMembers, User } from '../../models'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProjectTeamMembers>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const project = new RelationOption(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Project', 'project', Project)
    const user = new RelationOption(ProjectTeamMembers, 'User', 'user', User)
    const internalRole = new RelationOption(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Internal role', 'role', InternalProjectRole)
    const telephoneNumber = new RelationOption(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Phone Number', 'telephoneNumber', PersonTelephoneNumber)
    const emailAddress = new RelationOption(ProjectTeamMembers, 'Email address', 'emailAddress', PersonEmailAddress)

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, count, project, user, internalRole, telephoneNumber, emailAddress]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, ProgressData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Company, Customer, Department, Division, Opportunity, Person, Prospect, ProspectGroup, ProspectSource, ProspectSubGroup, Quote, SalesPipeline, SalesTerritory, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Prospect>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Prospect, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Prospect, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Prospect, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Prospect, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const company = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Company', 'company', Company)
    const person = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Person', 'person', Person)
    const customer = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const source = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Source', 'source', ProspectSource)
    const salesTerritory = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Territory', 'salesTerritory', SalesTerritory)
    const salesPipeline = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Sales pipeline', 'salesPipeline', SalesPipeline)
    const quotes = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Quotes', 'quotes', Quote)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Prospect, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const division = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Division', 'division', Division)
    const department = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Department', 'department', Department)
    const opportunities = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Opportunities', 'opportunities', Opportunity)
    const prospectGroup = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Prospect group', 'prospectGroup', ProspectGroup)
    const prospectSubGroup = new RelationOption(Prospect, 'Prospect sub group', 'prospectSubGroup', ProspectSubGroup)

    const id = new TypographyData(Prospect, 'ID', ['id'])
    const prospectType = new TypographyData(Company, 'Prospect type', ['type'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Prospect, 'Status', ['closed', 'customer'])
    const managedBy = new TypographyData(Prospect, 'Managed by', ['managedBy'])
    const rating = new ProgressData(Prospect, 'Rating', 'rating', 10)
    const estimatedAnnualSalesValue = new TypographyData(Prospect, 'Estimated annual sales value', ['estimatedAnnualSalesValue'])

    const count = new AggregateData(Prospect, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const ratings = new AggregateGroup(Prospect, 'Ratings', 'rating')

    const alias = new LinkData(Prospect, 'Alias', ['id', 'company'])

    alias.addDependentOption(company)
    alias.setRenderLabel(prospect => prospect.company ? prospect.company.alias : '')
    alias.setRenderLink(prospect => `/sales/prospects/${prospect.id}`)
    alias.setSortable(false)
    alias.clearFilterTypes()
    alias.setQuickFilter(undefined)

    const dotLink = new ListStatus(Prospect, 'Status dot', ['company'])
    dotLink.addDependentOption(company, customer)
    dotLink.setRenderLink(prospect => `/sales/prospects/${prospect.id}`)
    dotLink.setRenderLabel(prospect => `${prospect.company.alias}`) // make this the same as setRelatedPropertyToFilter
    dotLink.setRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort('alias') // make this the same as setRenderLabel
    dotLink.setSortable(true)

    // Note same logic as in getStatus of Prospect and colours in view index file of a Prospect
    dotLink.setColor(entity => {
        if (entity.closed) {
            if (entity.customer) {
                dotLink.setTooltip('Prospect won')
                return colors.green
            }

            dotLink.setTooltip('Prospect lost')
            return colors.red
        }

        dotLink.setTooltip('Prospect open')
        return colors.lime
    })

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(customer => getStatus(customer))
    status.addDependentOption(customer)

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, person, company, customer, salesPipeline, dotLink,
        source, alias, status, rating, count, ratings, prospectType, salesTerritory, managedBy,
        quotes, tradingCompany, division, department, opportunities, estimatedAnnualSalesValue, prospectGroup, prospectSubGroup
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ProspectGroup, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProspectGroup>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProspectGroup, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProspectGroup, 'Created on', 'created')
    const editor = new UserData(ProspectGroup, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProspectGroup, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const groupName = new TypographyData(ProspectGroup, 'Group name', ['groupName'])
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(ProspectGroup, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const id = new TypographyData(ProspectGroup, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(ProspectGroup, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        created, creator, count, edited, editor, groupName, id, tradingCompany
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ProspectGroup, ProspectSubGroup } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ProspectSubGroup>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ProspectSubGroup, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const created = new DateGroup(ProspectSubGroup, 'Created on', 'created')
    const editor = new UserData(ProspectSubGroup, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ProspectSubGroup, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const subGroupName = new TypographyData(ProspectSubGroup, 'Sub group name', ['subGroupName'])
    const prospectGroup = new RelationOption(ProspectSubGroup, 'Prospect group', 'prospectGroup', ProspectGroup)

    const id = new TypographyData(ProspectSubGroup, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(ProspectSubGroup, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [
        count, created, creator, edited, editor, id, prospectGroup, subGroupName
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Asset, Branch, Currency, Job, Project, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderItem, PurchaseOrderReason, SalesOrder, Supplier, SupplierInvoice, TradingCompany, User } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'
import { getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<PurchaseOrder>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(PurchaseOrder, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(PurchaseOrder, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrder, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrder, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const approvedBy = new UserData(PurchaseOrder, 'Approved by', 'approvedBy')
    const approvalDate = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrder, 'Approval date', 'approvalDate')

    const id = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'ID', ['id'])
    const orderDate = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrder, 'Order date', 'orderDate')
    const requiredDeliveryDate = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrder, 'Required delivery date', 'requiredDeliveryDate')

    const PONumber = new LinkData(PurchaseOrder, 'Order number', ['id'])

    const baseCurrency = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Base currency', 'baseCurrency', Currency)
    const purchaseCurrency = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Purchase currency', 'purchaseCurrency', Currency)
    const supplier = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const items = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Line items', 'items', PurchaseOrderItem)
    const asset = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const job = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const reason = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Reason', 'purchaseOrderReason', PurchaseOrderReason)
    const reasonHistoric = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'Reason label', ['purchaseOrderReasonLabel'])
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const branch = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Branch', 'branch', Branch)
    const project = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Project', 'project', Project)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const orderedBy = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrder, 'Ordered by', 'orderedBy', User)
    const description = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'Description', ['description'])

    const purchaseOrderNetTotal = new NumberData(PurchaseOrder, 'Purchase order net total (base currency)', 'purchaseOrderNetTotal')
    const purchaseOrderNetTotalInCurrency = new NumberData(PurchaseOrder, 'Purchase order net total (purchase currency)', 'purchaseOrderNetTotalInCurrency')
    const purchaseOrderTotal = new NumberData(PurchaseOrder, 'Purchase order total (base currency)', 'purchaseOrderTotal')
    const purchaseOrderTotalInCurrency = new NumberData(PurchaseOrder, 'Purchase order total (purchase currency)', 'purchaseOrderTotalInCurrency')

    const purchaseOrderNumber = new UniqueNumberData(PurchaseOrder, 'Purchase order number', 'purchaseOrderNumber')

    const count = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrder, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const draft = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'Draft', ['draft'])
    const complete = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'Complete', ['complete'])
    const closed = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'Closed', ['closed'])
    const onHold = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'On hold', ['hold'])
    const status = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrder, 'Status', ['closed', 'hold', 'draft', 'awaitingApproval'])
    const includeCostOnSalesOrder = new BooleanData(PurchaseOrder, 'Include cost', 'includeCostOnSalesOrder')
    const isDropShipment = new BooleanData(PurchaseOrder, 'Drop shipment', 'isDropShipment')
    const isNonStock = new BooleanData(PurchaseOrder, 'Non Stock PO', 'isNonStockPO')
    const includeSalesTaxInParentCosts = new BooleanData(PurchaseOrder, 'Include tax in parent costs', 'includeSalesTaxInParentCosts')

    PONumber.setRenderLink(purchaseOrder => `/purchasing/orders/${purchaseOrder.id}`)
    PONumber.setRenderLabel(purchaseOrder => `Order ${purchaseOrder.id}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(purchaseOrder => getStatus(purchaseOrder))

    purchaseOrderNumber.setRenderLabel(purchaseOrder => `${purchaseOrder.purchaseOrderNumber.uniqueNumber}`)
    purchaseOrderNumber.setRenderLink(purchaseOrder => getViewUrl(purchaseOrder))

    purchaseOrderNetTotal.setPrecision(2)
    purchaseOrderNetTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(purchaseOrderNetTotal.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    purchaseOrderNetTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    purchaseOrderNetTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(purchaseOrderNetTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    purchaseOrderTotal.setPrecision(2)
    purchaseOrderTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(purchaseOrderTotal.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    purchaseOrderTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    purchaseOrderTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(purchaseOrderTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, purchaseOrderNumber, supplier, count, PONumber, purchaseOrderNetTotal,
        status, items, asset, draft, complete, closed, orderDate, job, isDropShipment, description, purchaseOrderNetTotalInCurrency,
        baseCurrency, purchaseCurrency, approvedBy, approvalDate, includeCostOnSalesOrder, reason, reasonHistoric, salesOrder, branch,
        project, isNonStock, tradingCompany, requiredDeliveryDate, purchaseOrderTotal, purchaseOrderTotalInCurrency, orderedBy,
        includeSalesTaxInParentCosts, onHold
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { GeneralLedgerCode, GoodsReceived, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderItem, Shipment, SupplierInvoiceItem } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions/formatInternationalNumber'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<PurchaseOrderItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const goodsReceived = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Goods received', 'goodsReceived', GoodsReceived)
    const product = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const order = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Order', 'purchaseOrder', PurchaseOrder)
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const generalLedgerCode = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrderItem, 'General ledger code', 'generalLedgerCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const supplierInvoiceItem = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Supplier invoice item', 'supplierInvoiceItems', SupplierInvoiceItem)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)

    const id = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'ID', ['id'])
    const quantity = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const outstanding = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Outstanding', ['outstanding'])
    const price = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Price', ['price'])
    const priceInCurrency = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Price in purchase currency', ['priceInCurrency'])
    const costPrice = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Cost price', ['costPrice'])
    const costPriceInCurrency = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Cost price in purchase currency', ['costPriceInCurrency'])
    const net = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Net total', ['netTotal'])
    const netInCurrency = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Net total in purchase currency', ['netTotalInCurrency'])
    const gross = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Net total', ['grossTotal'])
    const grossInCurrency = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Gross in purchase currency', ['grossTotalInCurrency'])

    const taxValue = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Tax value', ['taxValue'])
    const taxValueInCurrency = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Tax value in purchase currency', ['taxValueInCurrency'])
    const taxValueTotal = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Tax value total', 'taxValue', 'sum')
    const taxValueTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Tax value total in purchase currency', 'taxValueInCurrency', 'sum')

    const itemName = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Item name', ['itemName'])
    const description = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Description', ['description'])

    const count = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Prices', 'price')
    const pricesInCurrency = new AggregateGroup(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Prices in purchase currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const netTotal = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Order total', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const netTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Order total in purchase currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const grossTotal = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Gross total', 'grossTotal', 'sum')
    const grossTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Gross total in purchase currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency', 'sum')

    const quantityWithUnit = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Quantity with unit', ['quantity', 'unitOfMeasure'])
    const outstandingWithUnit = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderItem, 'Outstanding with unit', ['outstanding', 'unitOfMeasure'])

    costPrice.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatInternationalNumber(Number(costPrice.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2)
    costPrice.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(costPrice.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    costPriceInCurrency.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatInternationalNumber(Number(costPriceInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2)
    costPriceInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(costPriceInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    netTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(netTotal.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))
    netTotal.setPrecision(2)

    netTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(netTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))
    netTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)

    grossTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(grossTotal.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))
    grossTotal.setPrecision(2)

    grossTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(grossTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))
    grossTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)

    quantity.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(String(Number(quantity.getFormattedValue(entity, data))))

    quantityWithUnit.addDependentOption(unitOfMeasure)
    quantityWithUnit.setRenderLabel(item => `${formatInternationalNumber(item.quantity, undefined, undefined, 2)} ${item.unitOfMeasure ? item.unitOfMeasure.name : ''}`)

    outstandingWithUnit.addDependentOption(unitOfMeasure)
    outstandingWithUnit.setRenderLabel(item => `${formatInternationalNumber(item.outstanding, undefined, undefined, 2)} ${item.unitOfMeasure ? item.unitOfMeasure.name : ''}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, goodsReceived, product, order, price, costPrice, prices,
        quantity, net, netTotal, unitOfMeasure, count, generalLedgerCode, id, itemName, grossTotal,
        quantityWithUnit, outstanding, outstandingWithUnit, supplierInvoiceItem, priceInCurrency, costPriceInCurrency,
        netInCurrency, gross, grossInCurrency, taxValue, taxValueInCurrency, taxValueTotal, taxValueTotalInCurrency,
        pricesInCurrency, netTotalInCurrency, grossTotalInCurrency, shipment, description
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { PurchaseOrderReason } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(PurchaseOrderReason, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(PurchaseOrderReason, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrderReason, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(PurchaseOrderReason, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const label = new TypographyData(PurchaseOrderReason, 'Label', ['label'])

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, label]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Asset, Branch, Contact, Currency, Customer, Opportunity, Prospect, Quote, QuoteAdditionalCost, QuoteItem, RejectionReason, SalesOrder, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus, getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Quote>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Quote, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Quote, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Quote, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Quote, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const id = new TypographyData(Quote, 'ID', ['id'])
    const customer = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const prospect = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Prospect', 'prospect', Prospect)
    const contact = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const opportunity = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Opportunity', 'opportunity', Opportunity)
    const rejectionReason = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Rejection reason', 'rejectionReason', RejectionReason)
    const asset = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const lineItems = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Items', 'lineItems', QuoteItem)
    const additionalCost = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Additional costs', 'quoteAdditionalCost', QuoteAdditionalCost)
    const baseCurrency = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Base currency', 'baseCurrency', Currency)
    const saleCurrency = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Sale currency', 'saleCurrency', Currency)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Quote, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const quoteTotal = new NumberData(Quote, 'Quote total (base currency)', 'quoteTotal')
    const quoteTotalInCurrency = new NumberData(Quote, 'Quote total (sale currency)', 'quoteTotalInCurrency')

    const approvedBy = new UserData(Quote, 'Approved by', 'approvedBy')
    const followUpBy = new UserData(Quote, 'Follow up by', 'approvedBy')

    const uniqueQuoteNumber = new UniqueNumberData(Quote, 'Unique quote number', 'quoteNumber')

    const quoteNumber = new LinkData(Quote, 'Quote number', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(Quote, 'Description', ['description'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Quote, 'Status', ['draft', 'closed', 'accepted', 'awaitingApproval'])
    const templateName = new TypographyData(Quote, 'Template name', ['templateName'])
    const templateDescription = new TypographyData(Quote, 'Template description', ['templateDescription'])
    const totalQuoteValue = new NumberData(Quote, 'Total quote value', 'id')
    const approvalDate = new DateGroup(Quote, 'Approval date', 'approvalDate')
    const validUntil = new DateGroup(Quote, 'Valid until', 'validUntil')
    const followUpDate = new DateGroup(Quote, 'Follow up date', 'followUpDate')
    const quoteDate = new DateGroup(Quote, 'Date', 'quoteDate')

    const count = new AggregateData(Quote, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const customerName = new TypographyData(Quote, 'Customer alias (Historic)', ['customerName'])

    const includeInOpportunityCalcs = new BooleanData(Quote, 'Include in opportunity value', 'includeInOpportunityCalcs')
        .addDependentOption(opportunity)

    const isTemplate = new BooleanData(Quote, 'Is template', 'isTemplate')

    const internalSalesContact = new UserData(Quote, 'Internal sales contact', 'internalSalesContact')

    quoteNumber.setRenderLink(quote => getViewUrl(quote))
    quoteNumber.setRenderLabel(quote => `Quote ${quote.id}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(quote => getStatus(quote))

    uniqueQuoteNumber.setRenderLink(quote => getViewUrl(quote))
    uniqueQuoteNumber.setRenderLabel(quote => `${quote.quoteNumber.uniqueNumber}${quote.version ? `-${quote.version}` : ''}`)

    const referenceBranch = new RelationOption(Quote, 'Reference branch data', 'referenceBranch', Branch)

    const referenceBranchLink = new LinkData(Quote, 'Reference branch', ['referenceBranch'])
    referenceBranchLink.setRenderLink(branch => branch.referenceBranch
        ? `/sales/customers/${branch.customer.id}/branches/${branch.referenceBranch.id}`
        : '')

    referenceBranchLink.setRenderLabel(branch => branch.referenceBranch ? branch.referenceBranch.name : '')

    const isCustomerAcceptanceAreaRequired = new BooleanData(Quote, `Is ${_('customer')} acceptance area required?`, 'includeCustomerAcceptanceArea')

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, quoteNumber, uniqueQuoteNumber, customer, customerName,
        contact, description, status, count, opportunity, rejectionReason, lineItems, quoteTotal, quoteTotalInCurrency,
        approvedBy, followUpBy, approvalDate, validUntil, followUpDate, asset, totalQuoteValue, quoteDate,
        baseCurrency, saleCurrency, additionalCost, prospect, includeInOpportunityCalcs, salesOrder, tradingCompany,
        isTemplate, templateName, templateDescription, referenceBranch, referenceBranchLink, internalSalesContact, isCustomerAcceptanceAreaRequired
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { IncludeInCostFilter } from './filters/includeInCost'
import { Quote, QuoteAdditionalCost } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<QuoteAdditionalCost>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const quote = new RelationOption(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Quote', 'quote', Quote)
    const description = new TypographyData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Description', ['description'])
    const includeCost = new TypographyData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Include in cost', ['includeCost'])
    const cost = new NumberData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Cost', 'cost')
    const quantity = new NumberData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Quantity', 'quantity')
    const totalCost = new NumberData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Total cost', 'totalCost')

    const count = new AggregateData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const grandTotalCost = new AggregateData(QuoteAdditionalCost, 'Total', 'totalCost', 'sum')

    grandTotalCost.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(grandTotalCost.getValue(entity, data))
    grandTotalCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalCost.getFormattedValue(entity, data))
    grandTotalCost.setPrecision(2)

    cost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(cost.getValue(entity, data))))
    totalCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(totalCost.getValue(entity, data))))

    includeCost.setSortable(false)
    includeCost.clearFilterTypes()
    includeCost.addFilterType('equals', IncludeInCostFilter)
    includeCost.setQuickFilter('equals')
    includeCost.setRenderLabel(entity => entity.includeCost ? '✔' : '✖')

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, description, cost, count, totalCost, quantity, grandTotalCost, includeCost, quote
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, Quote, QuoteItem, Shipment } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { countDecimalPlaces, formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<QuoteItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(QuoteItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(QuoteItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(QuoteItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(QuoteItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(QuoteItem, 'ID', ['id'])

    const product = new RelationOption(QuoteItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const itemName = new TypographyData(QuoteItem, 'Item name', ['itemName'])
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(QuoteItem, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const avalaraTaxCode = new TypographyData(QuoteItem, 'Avalara tax code', ['avalaraTaxCode'])
    const quote = new RelationOption(QuoteItem, 'Quote', 'quote', Quote)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(QuoteItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)

    const description = new TypographyData(QuoteItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const price = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Price', 'price')
    const priceInCurrency = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Price in sale currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const costPrice = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Cost price', 'costPrice')
    const discount = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Discount', 'calculatedDiscount')
    const discountInCurrency = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Discount in sale currency', 'calculatedDiscountInCurrency')
    const quantity = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Quantity', 'quantity')
    const quantityAndUnit = new TypographyData(QuoteItem, 'Quantity and unit', ['quantity'])

    const count = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const netTotal = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Quote total', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const netTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Quote total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(QuoteItem, 'Prices', 'price')
    const pricesInCurrency = new AggregateGroup(QuoteItem, 'Prices in sale currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const costPrices = new AggregateGroup(QuoteItem, 'Cost prices', 'costPrice')
    const quantities = new AggregateGroup(QuoteItem, 'Quantities', 'quantity')
    const discounts = new AggregateGroup(QuoteItem, 'Discounts', 'calculatedDiscount')
    const totalQuantity = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Total quantity', 'quantity', 'sum')

    const discountPercent = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Discount %', 'price')

    const netPrice = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Net UP/RSP', 'price')
    const netPriceInCurrency = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Net UP/RSP in sale currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const net = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Net total', 'netTotal')
    const netInCurrency = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Net total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency')
    const gross = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Gross total', 'grossTotal')
    const grossInCurrency = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Gross in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency')
    const grossTotal = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Gross totals', 'grossTotal', 'sum')
    const grossTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Gross total in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency', 'sum')

    const taxValue = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Tax value', 'taxValue')
    const taxValueInCurrency = new NumberData(QuoteItem, 'Tax value in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency')
    const taxValueTotal = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Tax value total', 'taxValue', 'sum')
    const taxValueTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(QuoteItem, 'Tax value total in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency', 'sum')

    discountPercent.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const discountPercent = Math.round(((1 - (Number(entity.price) - Number(entity.calculatedDiscount)) / (Number(entity.price))) * 100))
        return `${discountPercent.toFixed(2)}`
    })

    netPrice.setRenderLabel(entity => String(Number(entity.price) - Number(entity.calculatedDiscount)))
    netPriceInCurrency.setRenderLabel(entity => String(Number(entity.priceInCurrency) - Number(entity.calculatedDiscountInCurrency)))

    netTotal.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(netTotal.getValue(entity, data))
    netTotal.setPrecision(2)
    netTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(netTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    netTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(netTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data))
    netTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    netTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(netTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    grossTotal.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(grossTotal.getValue(entity, data))
    grossTotal.setPrecision(2)
    grossTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(grossTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    grossTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(grossTotalInCurrency.getValue(entity, data))
    grossTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    grossTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(grossTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    gross.setRenderLabel(entity => String(Number(entity.price) * entity.quantity))

    quantity.setRenderLabel(quoteItem => formatInternationalNumber(quoteItem.quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(quoteItem.quantity))))

    quantityAndUnit.addDependentOption(unitOfMeasure)
    quantityAndUnit.setRenderLabel(quoteItem => `${formatInternationalNumber(quoteItem.quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(quoteItem.quantity)))} ${quoteItem.unitOfMeasure ? quoteItem.unitOfMeasure.name : ''}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, product, description, price, costPrice, avalaraTaxCode,
        unitOfMeasure, discount, quantity, count, prices, costPrices, quantities, discounts,
        discountPercent, netPrice, net, netTotal, quote, gross, itemName, pricesInCurrency,
        totalQuantity, grossTotal, quantityAndUnit, priceInCurrency, discountInCurrency, netInCurrency, grossInCurrency,
        netTotalInCurrency, grossTotalInCurrency, taxValue, taxValueInCurrency,
        taxValueTotal, taxValueTotalInCurrency, shipment, id
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, RecipientProduct } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<RecipientProduct>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(RecipientProduct, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(RecipientProduct, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(RecipientProduct, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(RecipientProduct, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const bulkProduct = new RelationOption(RecipientProduct, 'Bulk product', 'bulkProduct', Product)
    const product = new RelationOption(RecipientProduct, 'Product', 'product', Product)

    const quantity = new NumberData(RecipientProduct, 'Quantity', 'quantity')

    const count = new AggregateData(RecipientProduct, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    quantity.setPrecision(0)

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, count, bulkProduct, product, quantity]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Asset, Employee, Product, Resource, ResourceAccessibility, ResourceGroup, ResourceTag } from '../../models'
import { TagData } from './reports/tagData'
import { getViewUrl } from './getViewUrl'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Resource>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Resource, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Resource, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Resource, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Resource, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new LinkData(Resource, 'ID', ['id'])
    const name = new LinkData(Resource, 'Name', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(Resource, 'Description', ['description'])
    const count = new AggregateData(Resource, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const group = new RelationOption(Resource, 'Resource group', 'resourceGroup', ResourceGroup)
    const tag = new RelationOption(Resource, 'Tag', 'tags', ResourceTag)
    const asset = new RelationOption(Resource, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const product = new RelationOption(Resource, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const employee = new RelationOption(Resource, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)
    const accessibility = new RelationOption(Resource, 'Resource accessibility', 'resourceAccessibility', ResourceAccessibility)
    const tags = new TagData()

    id.setRenderLabel(resource => `Resource ${resource.id}`)
    id.setRenderLink(resource => getViewUrl(resource))

    name.setRenderLabel(resource => resource.name)
    name.setRenderLink(resource => getViewUrl(resource))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, name, description, count, group, tag,
        asset, product, employee, tags, accessibility
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { BaseOption, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { Department, Division, Resource, ResourceAccessibility } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ResourceAccessibility>[] {
    const resource = new RelationOption(ResourceAccessibility, 'Resource', 'resource', Resource)
    const division = new RelationOption(ResourceAccessibility, 'Division', 'division', Division)
    const department = new RelationOption(ResourceAccessibility, 'Department', 'department', Department)
    const type = new TypographyData(ResourceAccessibility, 'Type', ['type'])
    const ref = new LinkData(ResourceAccessibility, 'Ref', ['refId'])
    const parent = new TypographyData(ResourceAccessibility, 'Parent', ['parent'])

    ref.addDependentOption(division)
    ref.addDependentOption(department)

    ref.setRenderLink(entity => {
        if (entity.type === 'Division') {
            return `/company/divisions/${entity.refId}`
        } else if (entity.type === 'Department') {
            return `/company/departments/${entity.refId}`
        }
    })

    ref.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        if (entity.type === 'Division') {
            return `${entity.division.name}`
        } else if (entity.type === 'Department') {
            return `${entity.department.departmentName}`
        }
    })

    return [resource, division, department, type, ref, parent]
}

````

````typescript
    name.setRenderLink(resourceTagName => getViewUrl(resourceTagName))

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, name, tags, id, count]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Customer, ReturnReason, ReturnsAuthorisation, ReturnsAuthorisationItem, SalesOrder, User } from '../../models'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus, getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ReturnsAuthorisation>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const returnsAuthorisationDate = new DateGroup(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Returns authorisation date', 'returnsAuthorisationDate')

    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const customer = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const items = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Items', 'items', ReturnsAuthorisationItem)
    const authorisedBy = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Authorised by', 'authorizedBy', User)
    const returnReason = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Return reason', 'returnReason', ReturnReason)

    const id = new TypographyData(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'ID', ['id'])
    const status = new TypographyData(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Status', ['draft', 'complete'])

    const returnsAuthorisationNumber = new UniqueNumberData(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Returns authorisation number', 'returnsAuthorisationNumber')

    const count = new AggregateData(ReturnsAuthorisation, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    id.setRenderLabel(returnsAuthorisation => `Returns authorisation ${returnsAuthorisation.id}`)

    returnsAuthorisationNumber.setRenderLabel(returnsAuthorisation => `RMA ${returnsAuthorisation.returnsAuthorisationNumber.uniqueNumber}`)
    returnsAuthorisationNumber.setRenderLink(returnsAuthorisation => getViewUrl(returnsAuthorisation))

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(returnsAuthorisation => getStatus(returnsAuthorisation))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, salesOrder, id, count, returnsAuthorisationNumber, customer,
        status, returnsAuthorisationDate, items, authorisedBy, returnReason
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { Asset, Product, ProductUnit, ReturnsAuthorisation, ReturnsAuthorisationItem, SalesOrderItem } from '../../models'
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ReturnsAuthorisationItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const salesOrderItem = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Sales order item', 'salesOrderItem', SalesOrderItem)
    const asset = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const product = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const returnsAuthorisation = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Returns authorisation', 'returnsAuthorisation', ReturnsAuthorisation)
    const productUnit = new RelationOption(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Unit', 'unit', ProductUnit)

    const quantity = new TypographyData(ReturnsAuthorisationItem, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, salesOrderItem, returnsAuthorisation, quantity, productUnit, asset,
        product
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ReturnsAuthorisationItem, ReturnsReceived, WarehouseLocation } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ReturnsReceived>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ReturnsReceived, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ReturnsReceived, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ReturnsReceived, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ReturnsReceived, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const returnsAuthorisationItem = new RelationOption(ReturnsReceived, 'Line item', 'returnsAuthorisationItem', ReturnsAuthorisationItem)
    const quantity = new TypographyData(ReturnsReceived, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const count = new AggregateData(ReturnsReceived, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const location = new RelationOption(ReturnsReceived, 'Location', 'location', WarehouseLocation)

    const totalReceived = new AggregateData(ReturnsReceived, 'Total received', 'quantity', 'sum')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, count, quantity, returnsAuthorisationItem, location, totalReceived]
}
````
