````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { Resource, RunList, RunListNumber } from '../../models'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<RunList>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(RunList, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(RunList, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(RunList, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(RunList, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const resource = new RelationOption(RunList, 'Resource', 'vehicleType', Resource)
    const status = new TypographyData(RunList, 'Status', ['active', 'draft', 'complete'])
    const vehicleIdentification = new TypographyData(RunList, 'Vehicle Identification', ['vehicleIdentification'])
    const count = new AggregateData(RunList, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const runListNumber = new RelationOption(RunList, 'RunList', 'runListNumber', RunListNumber)
    const uniqueRunlistNumber = new TypographyData(RunList, 'Unique runlist number', ['runListNumber'])

    uniqueRunlistNumber.addDependentOption(runListNumber)
    uniqueRunlistNumber.setRenderLabel(entity => `Runlist ${entity.runListNumber.uniqueNumber}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(runList => getStatus(runList))

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, resource, status, vehicleIdentification, count, uniqueRunlistNumber]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, FullStatusOption, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UniqueNumberData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { AllSoCosts, Asset, Branch, Contact, CreditNote, Currency, Customer, Delivery, Invoice, Job, Project, PurchaseOrder, Quote, ReturnsAuthorisation, SalesOrder, SalesOrderAdhoc, SalesOrderItem, TradingCompany, User } from '../../models'
import { FullStatusFilter } from './filters/fullStatus'
import { InvoiceStatusFilter } from './filters/invoiceStatus'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { getStatus, getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SalesOrder>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SalesOrder, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SalesOrder, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const approvedBy = new UserData(SalesOrder, 'Approved by', 'approvedBy')
    const approvalDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Approval date', 'approvalDate')

    const readyToInvoice = new BooleanData(SalesOrder, 'Ready to invoice', 'readyToInvoice')
    const readyToInvoiceAuthorisedBy = new UserData(SalesOrder, 'Ready to invoice authorised by', 'readyToInvoiceAuthorisedBy')

    const id = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'ID', ['id'])
    const baseCurrency = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Base currency', 'baseCurrency', Currency)
    const saleCurrency = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Sale currency', 'saleCurrency', Currency)
    const customer = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const contact = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const jobs = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const asset = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const lineItems = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Items', 'lineItems', SalesOrderItem)
    const adhocCost = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Adhoc cost', 'adhocCosts', SalesOrderAdhoc)
    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Purchase order', 'purchaseOrders', PurchaseOrder)
    const quote = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Quote', 'quote', Quote)
    const returnsAuthorisation = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Returns authorisation', 'returnsAuthorisations', ReturnsAuthorisation)
    const deliveries = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Deliveries', 'deliveries', Delivery)
    const allSoCosts = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'All SO costs', 'allSoCost', AllSoCosts)
    const allQuotes = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Quotes', 'quotes', Quote)
    const invoices = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Invoices', 'invoices', Invoice)
    const creditNotes = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Credit notes', 'creditNotes', CreditNote)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const project = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Project', 'project', Project)
    const invoiceAmountOutstanding = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Invoice amount outstanding', 'invoiceAmountOutstanding')
    const invoiceAmountOutstandingNet = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Invoice amount outstanding (net)', 'invoiceAmountOutstandingNet')
    const invoiceAmountOutstandingInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Invoice amount outstanding (in currency)', 'invoiceAmountOutstandingInCurrency')
    const invoiceAmountOutstandingNetInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Invoice amount outstanding (net in currency)', 'invoiceAmountOutstandingNetInCurrency')
    const salesOrderNumber = new UniqueNumberData(SalesOrder, 'Sales order number', 'salesOrderNumber')
    const projectOVP = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Customer Project Reference', ['ovpNo'])

    const invoiceStatus = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Invoice status', ['invoiceStatus'])

    const salesOrderTotal = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Sales order total (base currency)', 'salesOrderTotal')
    const salesOrderTotalInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Sales order total (sale currency)', 'salesOrderTotalInCurrency')
    const salesOrderNetTotal = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Net Total (base currency)', 'salesOrderNetTotal')

    const orderNumber = new LinkData(SalesOrder, 'Order number', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Description', ['description'])
    const salesContractName = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Sale contract name', ['salesContractName'])
    const salesContractNumber = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Sale contract number', ['salesContractNumber'])
    const status = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Status', ['closed', 'hold', 'draft', 'completed', 'awaitingApproval'])
    const externalOrderNumber = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'External order number', ['externalOrderNumber'])
    const orderDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Date', 'orderDate')
    const invoiceEstimatedDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Invoice estimated date', 'invoiceEstimatedDate')
    const estimatedBillingDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Estimated billing date', 'estimatedBillingDate')

    const templateName = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Template name', ['templateName'])
    const templateDescription = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Template description', ['templateDescription'])
    const isTemplate = new BooleanData(SalesOrder, 'Is template', 'isTemplate')

    const fullStatus = new FullStatusOption(SalesOrder, 'Full status') // not in widget field options but not being used anymore (14/5/21) - was in 'salesOrdersList'

    const count = new AggregateData(SalesOrder, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const referenceBranch = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Reference branch', 'referenceBranch', Branch)

    const readyToComplete = new BooleanData(SalesOrder, 'Ready to complete', 'readyToComplete')

    const internalSalesContact = new UserData(SalesOrder, 'Internal sales contact', 'internalSalesContact')

    const internalSalesContactAdvanced = new RelationOption(SalesOrder, 'Internal Sales Contact (advanced)', 'internalSalesContact', User)

    orderNumber.setRenderLink(order => `/sales/orders/${order.id}`)
    orderNumber.setRenderLabel(order => `Order ${order.id}`)

    invoiceStatus.setSortable(false)
    invoiceStatus.clearFilterTypes()
    invoiceStatus.addFilterType('equals', InvoiceStatusFilter)
    invoiceStatus.setQuickFilter('equals')

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(salesOrder => getStatus(salesOrder))

    fullStatus.setSortable(false)
    fullStatus.clearFilterTypes()
    fullStatus.addFilterType('equals', FullStatusFilter)
    fullStatus.setQuickFilter('equals')

    invoiceAmountOutstanding.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(invoiceAmountOutstanding.getValue(entity, data))))
    invoiceAmountOutstandingNet.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(invoiceAmountOutstandingNet.getValue(entity, data))))
    invoiceAmountOutstandingInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(invoiceAmountOutstandingInCurrency.getValue(entity, data))))
    invoiceAmountOutstandingNetInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(invoiceAmountOutstandingNetInCurrency.getValue(entity, data))))

    salesOrderNumber.setRenderLabel(salesOrder => `${salesOrder.salesOrderNumber.uniqueNumber}`)
    salesOrderNumber.setRenderLink(salesOrder => getViewUrl(salesOrder))

    const criticalDataRequired = new BooleanData(SalesOrder, 'Critical data required', 'criticalDataRequired')

    const contractedStartDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Contracted start date', 'contractedStartDate')
    const actualStartDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Actual start date', 'actualStartDate')
    const contractedEndDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Contracted end date', 'contractedEndDate')
    const estimatedContractedEndDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Estimated end date', 'estimatedEndDate')
    const actualEndDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrder, 'Actual end date', 'actualEndDate')
    const estimatedOverdueDays = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Estimated overdue days', 'estimatedOverdueDays')
    const actualOverdueDays = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Actual overdue days', 'actualOverdueDays')
    const reasonForlastChange = new TypographyData(SalesOrder, 'Reason for last change', ['reasonForLastChange'])

    const totalItemCosts = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Total line costs', 'totalItemCosts')
    const totalJobCosts = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Total job costs', 'totalJobCosts')
    const totalPOCosts = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Total purchase order costs', 'totalPoCosts')
    const totalAdhocCosts = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Total adhoc costs', 'totalAdhocCosts')
    const totalCosts = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Total costs', 'totalCosts')

    const profit = new NumberData(SalesOrder, 'Profit', 'profit')

    const marginPercent = new NumberData(
        SalesOrder,
        'Margin',
        'profit'
    )

    marginPercent.renderContent = entity => {
        const grossPrice = Number(entity.salesOrderNetTotal || 0)
        const profit = Number(entity.profit || 0)

        return new Typography(
            grossPrice === 0
                ? '0.00'
                : ((profit / grossPrice) * 100).toFixed(2)
        )
    }

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, orderNumber, baseCurrency, saleCurrency, readyToInvoice, readyToInvoiceAuthorisedBy,
        customer, externalOrderNumber, contact, quote, description, status, count, asset, invoiceStatus, criticalDataRequired,
        id, jobs, lineItems, adhocCost, purchaseOrder, orderDate, invoiceEstimatedDate, deliveries, returnsAuthorisation,
        allSoCosts, fullStatus, salesOrderNumber, invoices, creditNotes, approvalDate, estimatedBillingDate, isTemplate,
        invoiceAmountOutstanding, invoiceAmountOutstandingNet, invoiceAmountOutstandingInCurrency, invoiceAmountOutstandingNetInCurrency,
        approvedBy, allQuotes, tradingCompany, salesContractName, salesContractNumber, salesOrderTotal, salesOrderTotalInCurrency,
        templateName, templateDescription, project, referenceBranch, projectOVP, readyToComplete, internalSalesContact,
        contractedStartDate, actualStartDate, contractedEndDate, estimatedContractedEndDate, actualEndDate, estimatedOverdueDays,
        actualOverdueDays, reasonForlastChange, salesOrderNetTotal, totalItemCosts, totalJobCosts, totalPOCosts, totalAdhocCosts,
        totalCosts, profit, internalSalesContactAdvanced, marginPercent
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { SalesOrder, SalesOrderAdhoc } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions/formatInternationalNumber'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SalesOrderAdhoc>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const description = new TypographyData(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Description', ['description'])
    const cost = new TypographyData(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Cost', ['cost'])
    const includeCost = new BooleanData(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Include cost', 'includeCost')
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)

    const count = new AggregateData(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const totalCost = new AggregateData(SalesOrderAdhoc, 'Costs', 'cost', 'sum')

    totalCost.getFormattedValue = (entity, data) => formatInternationalNumber(Number(totalCost.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2)
    totalCost.setPrecision(2)
    totalCost.addDependentOption(salesOrder)
    totalCost.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalCost.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, description, cost, count, totalCost, salesOrder, includeCost
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { GeneralLedgerCode, Job, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, SalesOrder, SalesOrderItem, Shipment, TaxCode } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { countDecimalPlaces, formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SalesOrderItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SalesOrderItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SalesOrderItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(SalesOrderItem, 'ID', ['id'])

    const product = new RelationOption(SalesOrderItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const itemName = new TypographyData(SalesOrderItem, 'Item name', ['itemName'])
    const order = new RelationOption(SalesOrderItem, 'Sales order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(SalesOrderItem, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const avalaraTaxCode = new TypographyData(SalesOrderItem, 'Avalara tax code', ['avalaraTaxCode'])
    const generalLedgerCode = new RelationOption(SalesOrderItem, 'General ledger code', 'generalLedgerCodeSales', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const taxCode = new RelationOption(SalesOrderItem, 'Tax code', 'taxCode', TaxCode)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(SalesOrderItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)
    const job = new RelationOption(SalesOrderItem, 'Job', 'job', Job)

    const description = new TypographyData(SalesOrderItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const price = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Price', 'price')
    const priceInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Price in sale currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const costPrice = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Cost price', 'costPrice')
    const discount = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Discount', 'calculatedDiscount')
    const quantity = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Quantity', 'quantity')
    const quantityAndUnit = new TypographyData(SalesOrderItem, 'Quantity and unit', ['quantity'])
    const pickedQuantity = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Picked quantity', 'pickedQuantity')
    const pickedQuantityAndUnit = new TypographyData(SalesOrderItem, 'Picked quantity and unit', ['pickedQuantity'])
    const latestShippingDate = new DateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Latest shipping date', 'latestShippingDate')

    const count = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const costTotal = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Cost total', 'costPriceTotal', 'sum')
    const netTotal = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Order total', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const grossTotal = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Order total gross', 'grossTotal', 'sum')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Prices', 'price')
    const netTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Order total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const grossTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Order total gross in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const pricesInCurrency = new AggregateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Prices in sale currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const quantities = new AggregateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Quantities', 'quantity')
    const discounts = new AggregateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Discounts', 'calculatedDiscount')
    const discountsInCurrency = new AggregateGroup(SalesOrderItem, 'Discounts in sale currency', 'calculatedDiscountInCurrency')
    const totalQuantity = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Total quantity', 'quantity', 'sum')

    const discountPercent = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Discount %', 'price')

    const netPrice = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Net UP/RSP', 'price')
    const netPriceInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Net UP/RSP in sale currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const net = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Net total', 'netTotal')
    const netInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Net total in sale currency', 'netTotalInCurrency')
    const gross = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Gross total', 'grossTotal')
    const grossInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Gross in sale currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency')

    const taxValue = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Tax value', 'taxValue')
    const taxValueInCurrency = new NumberData(SalesOrderItem, 'Tax value in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency')
    const taxValueTotal = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Tax value total', 'taxValue', 'sum')
    const taxValueTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SalesOrderItem, 'Tax value total in sale currency', 'taxValueInCurrency', 'sum')

    discountPercent.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const discountPercent = (1 - (entity.price - Number(entity.calculatedDiscount)) / (entity.price)) * 100
        return `${discountPercent.toFixed(2)}`
    })

    netPrice.setRenderLabel(entity => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(entity.price - Number(entity.calculatedDiscount)))
    netPriceInCurrency.setRenderLabel(entity => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(entity.priceInCurrency - Number(entity.calculatedDiscountInCurrency)))

    netTotal.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    netTotal.setPrecision(2)
    netTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(netTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    netTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    netTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    netTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(netTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    grossTotal.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    grossTotal.setPrecision(2)
    grossTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(grossTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    grossTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    grossTotalInCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    grossTotalInCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(grossTotalInCurrency.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    costTotal.getFormattedValueBase = data => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(data)
    costTotal.setPrecision(2)
    costTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(costTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    quantity.setRenderLabel(salesOrderItem => formatInternationalNumber(salesOrderItem.quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(salesOrderItem.quantity))))

    quantityAndUnit.addDependentOption(unitOfMeasure)
    quantityAndUnit.setRenderLabel(salesOrderItem => `${formatInternationalNumber(salesOrderItem.quantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(salesOrderItem.quantity)))} ${salesOrderItem.unitOfMeasure ? salesOrderItem.unitOfMeasure.name : ''}`)

    pickedQuantity.setRenderLabel(salesOrderItem => formatInternationalNumber(salesOrderItem.pickedQuantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(salesOrderItem.pickedQuantity))))

    pickedQuantityAndUnit.addDependentOption(unitOfMeasure)
    pickedQuantityAndUnit.setRenderLabel(salesOrderItem => `${formatInternationalNumber(salesOrderItem.pickedQuantity, undefined, undefined, countDecimalPlaces(Number(salesOrderItem.pickedQuantity)))} ${salesOrderItem.unitOfMeasure ? salesOrderItem.unitOfMeasure.name : ''}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, product, description, price, costPrice, order, avalaraTaxCode, generalLedgerCode, taxCode,
        unitOfMeasure, discount, quantity, count, prices, quantities, discounts, discountPercent, job,
        netPrice, net, netTotal, totalQuantity, itemName, gross, grossTotal, costTotal,
        quantityAndUnit, priceInCurrency, discountsInCurrency, netInCurrency, grossInCurrency, taxValue, taxValueInCurrency,
        taxValueTotal, taxValueTotalInCurrency, netTotalInCurrency, grossTotalInCurrency, pricesInCurrency,
        pickedQuantity, pickedQuantityAndUnit, shipment, id, latestShippingDate
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Opportunity, SalesPipeline, SalesPipelineStage } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): (AggregateData<SalesPipeline> | DateGroup<SalesPipeline> | RelationOption<SalesPipeline> | TypographyData<SalesPipeline> | UserData<SalesPipeline>)[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SalesPipeline, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SalesPipeline, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SalesPipeline, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SalesPipeline, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const salesPipelineStage = new RelationOption(SalesPipeline, 'Sales pipeline stage', 'salesPipelineStage', SalesPipelineStage)
    const stepNumber = new TypographyData(SalesPipeline, 'Step number', ['stepNumber'])
    const dueDate = new DateGroup(SalesPipeline, 'Due date', 'dueDate')
    const dueBy = new UserData(SalesPipeline, 'Due by', 'dueBy')
    const completedDate = new DateGroup(SalesPipeline, 'Completed date', 'completedDate')
    const completedBy = new UserData(SalesPipeline, 'Completed by', 'completedBy')
    const count = new AggregateData(SalesPipeline, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const opportunities = new RelationOption(SalesPipeline, 'Opportunities', 'opportunities', Opportunity)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, salesPipelineStage, stepNumber,
        dueDate, dueBy, completedDate, completedBy, count, opportunities
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Job, Resource, ResourceTag, ScheduleEvent } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): (DateGroup<ScheduleEvent> | RelationOption<ScheduleEvent> | TypographyData<ScheduleEvent> | UserData<ScheduleEvent>)[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ScheduleEvent, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const created = new DateGroup(ScheduleEvent, 'Created on', 'created')
    const start = new DateGroup(ScheduleEvent, 'Event start', 'start')
    const end = new DateGroup(ScheduleEvent, 'Event end', 'end')
    const job = new RelationOption(ScheduleEvent, 'Job', 'job', Job)
    const resource = new RelationOption(ScheduleEvent, 'Resource', 'resource', Resource)
    const resourceTag = new RelationOption(ScheduleEvent, 'Resource tag', 'resourceTag', ResourceTag)

    const description = new TypographyData(ScheduleEvent, 'Description', ['description'])

    return [creator, created, description, start, end, job, resource, resourceTag]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Asset, Contact, Customer, Employee, MaintenanceSchedule, ServiceContract, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): (AggregateData<ServiceContract> | DateGroup<ServiceContract> | LinkData<ServiceContract> | RelationOption<ServiceContract> | TypographyData<ServiceContract> | UserData<ServiceContract> | ListStatus<ServiceContract>)[] {
    const id = new LinkData(ServiceContract, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(ServiceContract, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ServiceContract, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ServiceContract, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ServiceContract, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const customer = new RelationOption(ServiceContract, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const contact = new RelationOption(ServiceContract, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const manager = new RelationOption(ServiceContract, 'Manager', 'contractManager', Employee)
    const primaryEngineer = new RelationOption(ServiceContract, 'Primary engineer', 'primaryEngineer', Employee)
    const assets = new RelationOption(ServiceContract, 'Assets', 'assets', Asset)
    const maintenanceSchedules = new RelationOption(ServiceContract, 'Maintenance schedules', 'maintenanceSchedules', MaintenanceSchedule)

    const status = new TypographyData(ServiceContract, 'Status', ['closed', 'hold', 'expiryDate'])
    const statusDot = new ListStatus(ServiceContract, 'Status dot', ['id', 'closed', 'hold', 'expiryDate'])

    const description = new TypographyData(ServiceContract, 'Description', ['description'])
    const startDate = new DateGroup(ServiceContract, 'Start date', 'startDate')
    const expiryDate = new DateGroup(ServiceContract, 'Expiry date', 'expiryDate')
    const lastRenewalReminder = new DateGroup(ServiceContract, 'Last renewal reminder', 'renewalReminderLastSent')

    const count = new AggregateData(ServiceContract, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(ServiceContract, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    id.setRenderLink(contract => `/work/contracts/${contract.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(contract => `Contract ${contract.id}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(contract => getStatus(contract))

    statusDot.setSortable(false)
    statusDot.clearFilterTypes()
    statusDot.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    statusDot.setQuickFilter('equals')
    statusDot.setRenderLink(contract => `/work/contracts/${contract.id}`)
    statusDot.setRenderLabel(contract => getStatus(contract))
    statusDot.setColor(contract => {
        if (new Date(contract.expiryDate) < new Date()) {
            statusDot.setTooltip('expiryDate')
            return colors.red
        } else if (contract.hold) {
            statusDot.setTooltip('hold')
            return colors.amber
        } else if (contract.closed) {
            statusDot.setTooltip('closed')
            return colors.grey
        }
        return colors.green
    })

    return [
        id, creator, editor, created, edited, customer, manager, primaryEngineer, contact, statusDot,
        startDate, expiryDate, lastRenewalReminder, assets, status, count, maintenanceSchedules, description, tradingCompany
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, DotData, FormattedNumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CourierTrackingInformation, CreditNote, DeliveryMethod, Invoice, PurchaseOrder, Quote, SalesOrder, Shipment, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierInvoice } from '../../models'
import { ShortAddressData } from '../address/data/shortAddress'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'

export function getReportOptions(): (BaseOption<Shipment> | ShortAddressData)[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Shipment, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Shipment, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Shipment, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Shipment, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const count = new AggregateData(Shipment, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const id = new TypographyData(Shipment, 'Shipment number', ['id'])
    const quote = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Quote', 'quote', Quote)
    const salesOrder = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Order', 'salesOrder', SalesOrder)
    const salesInvoice = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Sales invoice', 'invoice', Invoice)
    const salesCreditNote = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Sales credit note', 'creditNote', CreditNote)
    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Purchase order', 'purchaseOrder', PurchaseOrder)
    const supplierInvoice = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Supplier invoice', 'supplierInvoice', SupplierInvoice)
    const supplierCreditNote = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Supplier credit note', 'supplierCreditNote', SupplierCreditNote)
    const deliveryMethod = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Delivery method', 'deliveryMethod', DeliveryMethod)
    const courierTrackingInformation = new RelationOption(Shipment, 'Courier tracking information', 'courierTrackingInformation', CourierTrackingInformation)
    const description = new TypographyData(Shipment, 'Description', ['description'])
    const label = new TypographyData(Shipment, 'Label', ['label'])
    const address = new ShortAddressData()
    const isShipToAddressValidated = new BooleanData(Shipment, 'Address validated', 'isShipToAddressValidated')
    const isDropShipment = new BooleanData(Shipment, 'Is drop shiment', 'isDropShipment')

    const preferredShippingDate = new DateGroup(Shipment, 'Preferred shipping date', 'preferredShippingDate')
    const dot = new DotData(Shipment, 'Overdue status', 'preferredShippingDate')
    const requiredDeliveryDate = new DateGroup(Shipment, 'Required delivery date', 'requiredDeliveryDate')
    const latestDeliveryDate = new DateGroup(Shipment, 'Latest delivery date', 'latestDeliveryDate')
    const latestShippingDate = new DateGroup(Shipment, 'Latest shipping date', 'latestShippingDate')
    const overdueDeliveryDays = new FormattedNumberData(Shipment, 'Overdue Delivery Days', 'requiredDeliveryDate')
    const overdueShippingDays = new FormattedNumberData(Shipment, 'Overdue Shipping Days', 'preferredShippingDate')

    const allItemsDelivered = new BooleanData(Shipment, 'All items delivered', 'allItemsDelivered')
    const allItemsPicked = new BooleanData(Shipment, 'All items fully picked', 'allItemsPicked')
    const stagingAreaName = new TypographyData(Shipment, 'Staging area name', ['stagingAreaName'])
    const stagingAreaCode = new TypographyData(Shipment, 'Staging area code', ['stagingAreacode'])
    const stagingAreaDescription = new TypographyData(Shipment, 'Staging area description', ['stagingAreaDescription'])

    // If there is an actual delivery date use it else use "now" to show how overday it was or is now.
    overdueDeliveryDays.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const requiredDate = moment(entity.requiredDeliveryDate)

        const comparisonDate = entity.latestDeliveryDate
            ? moment(entity.latestDeliveryDate)
            : moment()

        const timeDiffDays = comparisonDate.diff(requiredDate, 'days')
        return timeDiffDays ? `${timeDiffDays} day${timeDiffDays === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''
    })

    // If there is an actual shipping date use it else use "now" to show how overday it was or is now.
    overdueShippingDays.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        const requiredDate = moment(entity.preferredShippingDate)

        const comparisonDate = entity.latestShippingDate
            ? moment(entity.latestShippingDate)
            : moment()

        const timeDiffDays = comparisonDate.diff(requiredDate, 'days')
        return timeDiffDays ? `${timeDiffDays} day${timeDiffDays === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''
    })

    dot.setColor(entity => {
        const preferredDate = moment(entity.preferredShippingDate)

        const comparisonDate = entity.latestShippingDate
            ? moment(entity.latestShippingDate)
            : moment()

        const overdue = comparisonDate.isSameOrAfter(preferredDate)
        const timeDiff = Math.abs(comparisonDate.diff(preferredDate, 'seconds'))
        const timeDiffDays = Math.abs(comparisonDate.diff(preferredDate, 'days'))
        const timeDiffHours = Math.abs(comparisonDate.diff(preferredDate, 'hours'))
        const timeDiffMinutes = Math.abs(comparisonDate.diff(preferredDate, 'minutes'))

        if (!overdue) {
            if (timeDiff >= 86400) {
                dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffDays} days remaining until overdue`)
            } else if (timeDiff <= 86399 && timeDiff >= 3600) {
                dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffHours} hours remaining until overdue`)
            } else if (timeDiff <= 3599 && timeDiff > 60) {
                dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffMinutes} minutes remaining until overdue`)
            }

            return colors.green
        }

        if (timeDiff >= 86400) {
            dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffDays} days overdue`)
        } else if (timeDiff <= 86399 && timeDiff >= 3600) {
            dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffHours} hours overdue`)
        } else if (timeDiff <= 3599 && timeDiff > 60) {
            dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffMinutes} minutes overdue`)
        }

        return colors.red
    })

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, description, label, isShipToAddressValidated,
        preferredShippingDate, salesOrder, id, address, count,
        dot, allItemsDelivered, purchaseOrder, requiredDeliveryDate, latestDeliveryDate, overdueShippingDays,
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Contact, Currency, Location, ServiceContract, Site } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): (AggregateData<Site> | DateGroup<Site> | LinkData<Site> | RelationOption<Site> | TypographyData<Site> | UserData<Site>)[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Site, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Site, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Site, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Site, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const id = new LinkData(Site, 'ID', ['id'])
    const primaryContact = new RelationOption(Site, 'Primary contact', 'primaryContact', Contact)
    const contract = new RelationOption(Site, 'Contract', 'contract', ServiceContract)
    const location = new RelationOption(Site, 'Location', 'location', Location)
    const currency = new RelationOption(Site, 'Currency', 'currency', Currency)
    const name = new TypographyData(Site, 'Name', ['name'])
    const fixedContractValue = new NumberData(Site, 'Value', 'fixedContractValue')

    const count = new AggregateData(Site, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    id.setRenderLabel(site => `Site ${site.id}`)
    id.setRenderLink(site => site.contract ? `/work/contracts/${site.contract.id}/sites/${site.id}` : `/work/contracts/-/sites/${site.id}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, location, name, primaryContact, contract, count, currency, fixedContractValue
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, LinkData, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { StockCategoryPath } from '../../models'
import { StockCategoryContainsFilter } from '../../configuration/stockCategoryPath/filters/contains'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<StockCategoryPath>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(StockCategoryPath, 'ID', ['id'])
    const name = new TypographyData(StockCategoryPath, 'Category name', ['name'])

    const parentPath = new TypographyData(StockCategoryPath, 'Parent path', ['parentPath'])
    const fullPath = new TypographyData(StockCategoryPath, 'Full path', ['parentPath'])
    const ids = new TypographyData(StockCategoryPath, 'IDs', ['pathIds'])
    const depth = new TypographyData(StockCategoryPath, 'Depth', ['depth'])

    ids.addFilterType('contains', StockCategoryContainsFilter)

    return [
        id, name, parentPath, fullPath, parentPath, fullPath, depth, ids
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, StockValues } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<StockValues>[] {
    const product = new RelationOption(StockValues, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const totalStock = new TypographyData(StockValues, 'Total stock', ['totalStock'])
    const totalStockValue = new NumberData(StockValues, 'Total stock value', 'totalStockValue')
    const available = new TypographyData(StockValues, 'Available stock', ['availableToConsumeNow'])
    const unavailable = new TypographyData(StockValues, 'Unavailable stock', ['unavailable'])
    const onPoAwaitingGoods = new TypographyData(StockValues, 'On PO awaiting goods', ['onPoAwaitingGoods'])
    const pendingStock = new TypographyData(StockValues, 'Pending stock', ['pendingStock'])
    const availableToConsumeNow = new NumberData(StockValues, 'Available to consume now', 'availableToConsumeNow')
    const availableToConsumeNowUnit = new NumberData(StockValues, 'Available to consume now with base unit', 'availableToConsumeNow')
    const allocatedStockSalesOrder = new NumberData(StockValues, 'Allocated stock sales order', 'allocatedStockSalesOrder')
    const allocatedStockJob = new NumberData(StockValues, `Allocated stock ${_('job')}`, 'allocatedStockJob')
    const awaitingAssembly = new NumberData(StockValues, 'Awaiting assembly', 'awaitingAssembly')
    const backorderForSalesOrder = new NumberData(StockValues, 'Back order for sales order', 'backorderForSalesOrder')
    const backorderForJob = new NumberData(StockValues, `Back order for ${_('job')}`, 'backorderForJob')
    const scheduledForSalesOrder = new NumberData(StockValues, 'Schedule for sales order', 'scheduledForSalesOrder')
    const scheduledForJob = new NumberData(StockValues, `Schedule for ${_('job')}`, 'scheduledForJob')

    availableToConsumeNow.setPrecision(0)
    availableToConsumeNow.setRenderLabel(entity => formatInternationalNumber(entity.availableToConsumeNow))

    availableToConsumeNowUnit.addDependentOption(product)
    availableToConsumeNowUnit.setRenderLabel(stockValue => `${formatInternationalNumber(stockValue.availableToConsumeNow)}${stockValue.availableToConsumeNow > 0 ? ` ${stockValue.product.baseUnitOfMeasure}` : ''}`)

    totalStock.setRenderLabel(stockValue => formatInternationalNumber(stockValue.totalStock))

    totalStockValue.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(Number(totalStockValue.getValue(entity, data))))

    return [
        product, totalStock, available, unavailable, onPoAwaitingGoods, pendingStock,
        availableToConsumeNow, availableToConsumeNowUnit, totalStockValue, allocatedStockSalesOrder,
        allocatedStockJob, awaitingAssembly, backorderForSalesOrder, backorderForJob,
        scheduledForSalesOrder, scheduledForJob
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { GeneralLedgerCode, SubLedger, TradingCompany } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SubLedger>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SubLedger, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SubLedger, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SubLedger, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SubLedger, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(SubLedger, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const id = new TypographyData(SubLedger, 'ID', ['id'])
    const type = new TypographyData(SubLedger, 'Type', ['type'])
    const code = new TypographyData(SubLedger, 'Code', ['code'])
    const name = new TypographyData(SubLedger, 'Name', ['name'])
    const description = new TypographyData(SubLedger, 'Description', ['description'])

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(SubLedger, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const glCode = new RelationOption(SubLedger, 'Gl code', 'generalLedgerCode', GeneralLedgerCode)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, count, id, type, code, name, description, tradingCompany, glCode
    ]
}
````

````typescript
    const editor = new UserData(SubLedgerCustomerSupplier, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SubLedgerCustomerSupplier, 'Created on', 'created')

}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Company, Department, Division, NonComplianceReport, Payment, PaymentMethod, PurchaseOrder, Supplier, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierInvoice, SupplierRemittance, SupplierType, TradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<Supplier>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(Supplier, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Supplier, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Supplier, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Supplier, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(Supplier, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const accountNumber = new LinkData(Supplier, 'Account number', ['accountNumber', 'id'])
    const creditTermDays = new TypographyData(Supplier, 'Credit Term Days', ['creditTermDays'])
    const defaultPaymentMethod = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Default Payment Method', 'defaultPaymentMethod', PaymentMethod)

    const id = new LinkData(Supplier, 'ID', ['id'])

    const company = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Company', 'company', Company)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Supplier, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)
    const division = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Division', 'division', Division)
    const department = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Department', 'department', Department)
    const type = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Type', 'type', SupplierType)
    const purchaseOrder = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Purchase orders', 'purchaseOrders', PurchaseOrder)
    const supplierInvoices = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Supplier invoices', 'supplierInvoices', SupplierInvoice)
    const supplierCreditNotes = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Supplier credit notes', 'supplierCreditNotes', SupplierCreditNote)
    const payments = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Payments', 'payments', Payment)
    const supplierRemittances = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Remittances', 'supplierRemittances', SupplierRemittance)

    const expiryDate = new TypographyData(Supplier, 'Expiry date', ['expiryDate'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Supplier, 'Status', ['closed', 'hold', 'approved'])
    const certificationNumber = new TypographyData(Supplier, 'Certification number', ['certificationNumber'])
    const salesTaxNumber = new TypographyData(Supplier, 'Sales tax number', ['salesTaxNumber'])
    const balanceOwedBase = new TypographyData(Supplier, 'Balance owed', ['balanceOwed'])
    const federalTaxId = new TypographyData(Supplier, 'Federal tax id', ['federalTaxId'])

    const field1099 = new BooleanData(Supplier, '1099', 'field1099')
    const minorityOrWomenOwnedBusiness = new BooleanData(Supplier, 'Minority/Women owned business', 'minorityOrWomenOwnedBusiness')

    const nonComplianceReport = new RelationOption(Supplier, 'Non compliance reports', 'nonComplianceReports', NonComplianceReport)

    accountNumber.setRenderLink(supplier => `/purchasing/suppliers/${supplier.id}`)
    accountNumber.setRenderLabel(supplier => `${supplier.accountNumber}`)

    const alias = new LinkData(Supplier, 'Alias', ['id', 'company'])

    alias.addDependentOption(company)
    alias.setRenderLabel(supplier => `${supplier.company.alias}`)
    alias.setRenderLink(supplier => `/purchasing/suppliers/${supplier.id}`)
    alias.setSortable(false)
    alias.clearFilterTypes()
    alias.setQuickFilter(undefined)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(customer => getStatus(customer))

    const dotLink = new ListStatus(Supplier, 'Status dot', ['company'])
    dotLink.addDependentOption(company)
    dotLink.setRenderLink(supplier => `/purchasing/suppliers/${supplier.id}`)
    dotLink.setRenderLabel(supplier => `${supplier.company.alias}`) // make this the same as setRelatedPropertyToFilter
    dotLink.setRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort('alias') // make this the same as setRenderLabel
    dotLink.setSortable(true)

    dotLink.setColor(entity => {
        if (!entity.closed && !entity.hold) {
            dotLink.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} active`)
            return colors.green
        } else if (entity.hold) {
            dotLink.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} on hold`)
            return colors.amber
        } else if (entity.closed) {
            dotLink.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} closed`)
            return colors.red
        }
    })

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, company, count, accountNumber, type, expiryDate, status, purchaseOrder, id, dotLink,
        division, nonComplianceReport, tradingCompany, department, alias, supplierInvoices, supplierCreditNotes, payments,
        supplierRemittances, field1099, certificationNumber, minorityOrWomenOwnedBusiness, salesTaxNumber, balanceOwedBase, federalTaxId,
        creditTermDays, defaultPaymentMethod
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, Currency, Supplier, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierCreditNoteItem, TradingCompany, User } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'
import { getStatus } from '..'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SupplierCreditNote>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNote, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNote, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')
    const includedInVatReturn = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Included in VAT return', ['includedInVatReturn'])

    const supplierCreditNoteDate = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNote, 'Supplier credit note date', 'supplierCreditNoteDate')
    const dueDate = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNote, 'Due date', 'dueDate')

    const periodPosted = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Period posted', 'periodPosted', AccountingPeriod)
    const periodFullyPaid = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Period fully paid', 'periodFullyPaid', AccountingPeriod)
    const dateFullyPaid = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNote, 'Date fully paid', 'dateFullyPaid')

    const supplier = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const baseCurrency = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Base currency', 'baseCurrency', Currency)
    const purchaseCurrency = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Purchase currency', 'purchaseCurrency', Currency)

    const id = new LinkData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Credit note ID', ['id'])
    const tableId = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNote, 'ID', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Description', ['description'])
    const status = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Status', ['approved', 'posted'])

    const approver = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Approved by', 'approvedBy', User)
    const approvedDate = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNote, 'Approval date', 'approvalDate')

    const paid = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Paid', ['paid'])
    const creditNoteTotal = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Credit note total (base currency)', 'creditNoteTotal')
    const amountPaid = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Amount paid', 'totalAmountPaid')
    const amountOutstanding = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Amount outstanding', 'amountOutstanding')
    const totalAmountOutstanding = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Total amount outstanding', 'amountOutstanding', 'sum')

    const creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Credit note total (sale currency)', 'creditNoteTotalPurchaseCurrency')
    const creditNoteAmountPaidSaleCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Amount paid (sale currency)', 'totalAmountPaidPurchaseCurrency')
    const creditNoteAmountOSSaleCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Amount o/s (sale currency)', 'amountOutstandingPurchaseCurrency')
    const totalCredtiNoteAmountOSSaleCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Total amount o/s (sale currency)', 'amountOutstandingPurchaseCurrency', 'sum')

    const creditNoteNumber = new LinkData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Credit note number', ['creditNoteNumber'])

    creditNoteNumber.setRenderLink(creditNote => `/financials/suppliercreditnotes/${creditNote.id}`)
    creditNoteNumber.setRenderLabel(creditNote => `${creditNote.creditNoteNumber}`)

    const statusDot = new ListStatus(SupplierCreditNote, 'Status dot', ['id', 'approved', 'posted'])

    const count = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNote, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const lineItems = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Line items', 'lineItems', SupplierCreditNoteItem)

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNote, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    id.setRenderLink(creditNote => `/financials/suppliercreditnotes/${creditNote.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(creditNote => `${_('Supplier')} credit note ${creditNote.id}`)

    totalAmountOutstanding.setPrecision(2)
    totalAmountOutstanding.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalAmountOutstanding.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    creditNoteTotal.setPrecision(2)
    creditNoteTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(creditNoteTotal.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(creditNote => getStatus(creditNote))

    statusDot.setSortable(false)
    statusDot.clearFilterTypes()
    statusDot.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    statusDot.setQuickFilter('equals')
    statusDot.setRenderLink(creditNote => `/financials/suppliercreditnotes/${creditNote.id}`)
    statusDot.setRenderLabel(creditNote => `${_('Supplier')} credit note ${creditNote.id}`)
    statusDot.setColor(creditNote => {
        if (creditNote.paid) {
            statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} credit note paid (deducted)`)
            return colors.lightBlue
        }

        if (creditNote.posted) {
            if (creditNote.approved) {
                statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} credit note posted and approved`)
                return colors.green
            }

            statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} credit note Posted, awaiting approval`)
            return colors.amber
        }

        if (creditNote.approved) {
            statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} credit note unposted but approved`)
            return colors.amber
        }

        statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} credit note unposted, awaiting approval`)
        return colors.red
    })

    return [
        tableId, creator, editor, created, edited, id, description, count, status, creditNoteNumber, statusDot, includedInVatReturn,
        supplierCreditNoteDate, dueDate, lineItems, supplier, paid, amountPaid, amountOutstanding, totalAmountOutstanding, tradingCompany,
        approver, approvedDate, periodPosted, periodFullyPaid, dateFullyPaid, creditNoteTotal, baseCurrency, purchaseCurrency,
        creditNoteTotalSaleCurrency, creditNoteAmountPaidSaleCurrency, creditNoteAmountOSSaleCurrency, totalCredtiNoteAmountOSSaleCurrency, isTakeOn
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { GeneralLedgerCode, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, Shipment, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierCreditNoteItem } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SupplierCreditNoteItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const product = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const supplierCreditNote = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Credit note', 'supplierCreditNote', SupplierCreditNote)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)
    const price = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Price', 'price')
    const priceInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Price in purchase currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Prices', 'price')
    const pricesInCurrency = new AggregateGroup(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Prices in purchase currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const quantity = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const net = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Net total', 'netTotal')
    const netInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Net total in purchase currency', 'netTotalInCurrency')
    const netTotal = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Order total', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const netTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Invoice net total in purchase currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const gross = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Gross total', 'grossTotal')
    const grossInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Gross total in purchase currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency')
    const grossTotal = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Credit note gross total', 'grossTotal', 'sum')
    const grossTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Invoice gross total in purchase currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const costPrice = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Cost price', 'costPrice')
    const costPriceInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Cost price in purchase currency', 'costPriceInCurrency')
    const itemName = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Item name', ['itemName'])
    const description = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const glCode = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'General ledger code', 'glCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'UOM', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)

    const standardUnitCost = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Std unit cost', 'standardCost')
    const standardCostTotal = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Std cost total', 'standardCostTotal')
    const purchaseVariance = new NumberData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Purchase variance', 'purchaseVariance')

    const taxValue = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Tax value', ['taxValue'])
    const taxValueInCurrency = new TypographyData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Tax value in purchase currency', ['taxValueInCurrency'])
    const taxValueTotal = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Tax value total', 'taxValue', 'sum')
    const taxValueTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierCreditNoteItem, 'Tax value total in purchase currency', 'taxValueInCurrency', 'sum')

    quantity.setRenderLabel(entity => String(Number(entity.quantity)))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, product, supplierCreditNote, prices, pricesInCurrency,quantity, net, netTotal, grossTotal, costPrice,
        price, priceInCurrency, netInCurrency, netTotalInCurrency, gross, grossInCurrency, grossTotalInCurrency, costPriceInCurrency,
        taxValue, taxValueInCurrency, taxValueTotal, taxValueTotalInCurrency, pricesInCurrency, shipment, id, itemName, description,
        standardUnitCost, standardCostTotal, purchaseVariance, glCode, unitOfMeasure, count
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AccountingPeriod, Currency, Supplier, SupplierInvoice, SupplierInvoiceItem, TradingCompany, User } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, ListStatus, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'
import { getStatus } from '../../configuration/supplierInvoice/getStatus'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SupplierInvoice>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SupplierInvoice, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SupplierInvoice, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoice, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoice, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(SupplierInvoice, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')
    const includedInVatReturn = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoice, 'Included in VAT return', ['includedInVatReturn'])

    const supplierInvoiceDate = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoice, 'Supplier invoice date', 'supplierInvoiceDate')
    const dueDate = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoice, 'Due date', 'dueDate')

    const approver = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Approved by', 'approvedBy', User)
    const approvalDate = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoice, 'Approval date', 'approvalDate')

    const periodPosted = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Period posted', 'periodPosted', AccountingPeriod)
    const periodFullyPaid = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Period fully paid', 'periodFullyPaid', AccountingPeriod)
    const dateFullyPaid = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoice, 'Date fully paid', 'dateFullyPaid')

    const supplier = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const baseCurrency = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Base currency', 'baseCurrency', Currency)
    const purchaseCurrency = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Purchase currency', 'purchaseCurrency', Currency)

    const id = new LinkData(SupplierInvoice, 'Invoice ID', ['id'])
    const tableId = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoice, 'ID', ['id'])
    const description = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoice, 'Description', ['description'])
    const status = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoice, 'Status', ['awaitingApproval', 'approved', 'posted'])
    const buyerApprovalStatus = new BooleanData(SupplierInvoice, 'Buyer approval status', 'approvedByBuyer')
    const paymentApprovalRequiredByBuyer = new BooleanData(SupplierInvoice, 'Payment approval required by buyer', 'paymentApprovalRequiredByBuyer')
    const buyer = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Buyer', 'buyer', User)

    const paid = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoice, 'Paid', ['paid'])
    const invoiceTotal = new NumberData(SupplierInvoice, 'Invoice total (base currency)', 'invoiceTotal')
    const amountPaid = new NumberData(SupplierInvoice, 'Amount paid', 'totalAmountPaid')
    const amountOutstanding = new NumberData(SupplierInvoice, 'Amount outstanding', 'amountOutstanding')
    const totalAmountOutstanding = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoice, 'Total amount outstanding', 'amountOutstanding', 'sum')

    const invoiceTotalSaleCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierInvoice, 'Invoice total (sale currency)', 'invoiceTotalPurchaseCurrency')
    const invoiceAmountPaidSaleCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierInvoice, 'Amount paid (sale currency)', 'totalAmountPaidPurchaseCurrency')
    const invoiceAmountOSSaleCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierInvoice, 'Amount o/s (sale currency)', 'amountOutstandingPurchaseCurrency')
    const totalInvoiceAmountOSSaleCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoice, 'Total amount o/s (sale currency)', 'amountOutstandingPurchaseCurrency', 'sum')

    const invoiceNumber = new LinkData(SupplierInvoice, 'Invoice number', ['invoiceNumber'])

    invoiceNumber.setRenderLink(invoice => `/financials/supplierinvoices/${invoice.id}`)
    invoiceNumber.setRenderLabel(invoice => `${invoice.invoiceNumber}`)

    const statusDot = new ListStatus(SupplierInvoice, 'Status dot', ['id', 'awaitingApproval', 'approved', 'posted'])

    const count = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoice, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const lineItems = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Line items', 'lineItems', SupplierInvoiceItem)

    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoice, 'Trading company', 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    id.setRenderLink(invoice => `/financials/supplierinvoices/${invoice.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(invoice => `${_('Supplier')} invoice ${invoice.id}`)

    totalAmountOutstanding.setPrecision(2)
    totalAmountOutstanding.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(totalAmountOutstanding.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    invoiceTotal.setPrecision(2)
    invoiceTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(invoiceTotal.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    invoiceTotalSaleCurrency.setPrecision(2)
    invoiceTotalSaleCurrency.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(formatInternationalNumber(Number(invoiceTotalSaleCurrency.getValue(entity, data)), null, null, 2))

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(invoice => getStatus(invoice))

    statusDot.setSortable(false)
    statusDot.clearFilterTypes()
    statusDot.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    statusDot.setQuickFilter('equals')
    statusDot.setRenderLink(invoice => `/financials/supplierinvoices/${invoice.id}`)
    statusDot.setRenderLabel(invoice => `${_('Supplier')} invoice ${invoice.id}`)
    statusDot.setColor(invoice => {
        if (invoice.paid) {
            statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} invoice paid (deducted)`)
            return colors.lightBlue
        }

        if (invoice.posted) {
            if (invoice.approved) {
                statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} invoice posted and approved`)
                return colors.green
            }

            statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} invoice Posted, awaiting approval`)
            return colors.amber
        }

        if (invoice.approved) {
            statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} invoice unposted but approved`)
            return colors.amber
        }

        statusDot.setTooltip(`${_('Supplier')} invoice unposted, awaiting approval`)
        return colors.red
    })

    return [
        tableId, creator, editor, created, edited, id, description, count, status, invoiceNumber, statusDot,
        supplierInvoiceDate, dueDate, lineItems, supplier, paid, invoiceTotal, amountPaid, amountOutstanding, totalAmountOutstanding,
        invoiceTotalSaleCurrency, invoiceAmountPaidSaleCurrency, invoiceAmountOSSaleCurrency, totalInvoiceAmountOSSaleCurrency,
        tradingCompany, approver, approvalDate, periodPosted, periodFullyPaid, dateFullyPaid, baseCurrency, purchaseCurrency, buyerApprovalStatus,
        paymentApprovalRequiredByBuyer, buyer, isTakeOn, includedInVatReturn
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { GeneralLedgerCode, Product, ProductUnitOfMeasure, PurchaseOrderItem, Shipment, SupplierInvoice, SupplierInvoiceItem } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SupplierInvoiceItem>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const id = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'ID', ['id'])
    const count = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const product = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const supplierInvoice = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Invoice', 'supplierInvoice', SupplierInvoice)
    const shipment = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Shipment', 'shipment', Shipment)
    const price = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Price', 'price')
    const priceInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Price in purchase currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const prices = new AggregateGroup(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Prices', 'price')
    const pricesInCurrency = new AggregateGroup(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Prices in purchase currency', 'priceInCurrency')
    const quantity = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])
    const net = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Net total', 'netTotal')
    const netInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Net total in purchase currency', 'netTotalInCurrency')
    const netTotal = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Invoice net total', 'netTotal', 'sum')
    const netTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Invoice net total in purchase currency', 'netTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const gross = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Gross total', 'grossTotal')
    const grossInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Gross total in purchase currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency')
    const grossTotal = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Invoice gross total', 'grossTotal', 'sum')
    const grossTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Invoice gross total in purchase currency', 'grossTotalInCurrency', 'sum')
    const purchaseOrderItem = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Purchase order item', 'purchaseOrderItem', PurchaseOrderItem)
    const costPrice = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Cost price', 'costPrice')
    const costPriceInCurrency = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Cost price in purchase currency', 'costPriceInCurrency')
    const itemName = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Item name', ['itemName'])
    const description = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Description', ['description'])
    const glCode = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'General ledger code', 'glCode', GeneralLedgerCode)
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'UOM', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)

    const standardUnitCost = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Std unit cost', 'standardCost')
    const standardCostTotal = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Std cost total', 'standardCostTotal')
    const purchaseVariance = new NumberData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Purchase variance', 'purchaseVariance')

    const taxValue = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Tax value', ['taxValue'])
    const taxValueInCurrency = new TypographyData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Tax value in purchase currency', ['taxValueInCurrency'])
    const taxValueTotal = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Tax value total', 'taxValue', 'sum')
    const taxValueTotalInCurrency = new AggregateData(SupplierInvoiceItem, 'Tax value total in purchase currency', 'taxValueInCurrency', 'sum')

    quantity.setRenderLabel(entity => String(Number(entity.quantity)))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, product, supplierInvoice, prices, quantity, net, netTotal, grossTotal, purchaseOrderItem,
        costPrice, price, priceInCurrency, netInCurrency, gross, grossInCurrency, costPriceInCurrency, netTotalInCurrency, grossTotalInCurrency,
        taxValue, taxValueInCurrency, taxValueTotal, taxValueTotalInCurrency, pricesInCurrency, shipment, id, itemName, description,
        standardUnitCost, standardCostTotal, purchaseVariance, glCode, unitOfMeasure, count
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { AccountingPeriod, Bank, Currency, Payment, PaymentMethod, Supplier, SupplierRemittance } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { formatInternationalNumber } from '../../functions'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SupplierRemittance>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(SupplierRemittance, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SupplierRemittance, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SupplierRemittance, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SupplierRemittance, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const isTakeOn = new BooleanData(SupplierRemittance, 'Is Take-on', 'isTakeOn')

    const id = new TypographyData(SupplierRemittance, 'ID', ['id'])

    const supplier = new RelationOption(SupplierRemittance, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const bank = new RelationOption(SupplierRemittance, 'Bank', 'bank', Bank)
    const paymentMethod = new RelationOption(SupplierRemittance, 'Payment method', 'paymentMethod', PaymentMethod)
    const remittanceBankCurrency = new RelationOption(SupplierRemittance, 'Bank currency', 'currency', Currency)
    const documentsInRemittanceCurrency = new RelationOption(SupplierRemittance, 'Document currency', 'documentCurrency', Currency)

    const paymentReference = new TypographyData(SupplierRemittance, 'Payment reference', ['paymentReference'])
    const chequeNumber = new TypographyData(SupplierRemittance, 'Cheque number', ['chequeNumber'])
    const remittanceAmount = new TypographyData(SupplierRemittance, 'Remittance amount', ['amountPaid'])
    const remittanceAmountTotal = new AggregateData(SupplierRemittance, 'Remittance amount total', 'amountPaid', 'sum')
    const remittanceAmountInCurrency = new TypographyData(SupplierRemittance, 'Remittance amount currency', ['amountPaidInCurrency'])
    const notes = new TypographyData(SupplierRemittance, 'Notes', ['notes'])

    const remittanceDate = new DateGroup(SupplierRemittance, 'Remittance date', 'paymentMadeOn')

    const isVoid = new BooleanData(SupplierRemittance, 'Voided', 'isVoid')
    const voidDate = new DateGroup(SupplierRemittance, 'Void date', 'voidDate')
    const voidPeriod = new RelationOption(SupplierRemittance, 'Void period', 'voidPeriod', AccountingPeriod)
    const clearedDate = new DateGroup(SupplierRemittance, 'Cleared date', 'clearedDate')

    const payments = new RelationOption(SupplierRemittance, 'Payments', 'payments', Payment)

    remittanceAmountTotal.setPrecision(2)
    remittanceAmountTotal.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(remittanceAmountTotal.getFormattedValue(entity, data))

    id.setRenderLabel(remittance => `Remittance ${remittance.id}`)

    remittanceAmount.setRenderLabel(remittance => formatInternationalNumber(Number(remittance.amountPaid), undefined, undefined, 2))
    remittanceAmountInCurrency.setRenderLabel(remittance => formatInternationalNumber(Number(remittance.amountPaidInCurrency), undefined, undefined, 2))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, paymentReference, remittanceAmountInCurrency, supplier,
        chequeNumber, remittanceAmount, notes, id, remittanceDate, paymentMethod, bank, remittanceAmountTotal, payments,
        remittanceBankCurrency, documentsInRemittanceCurrency, isVoid, voidDate, voidPeriod, clearedDate, isTakeOn
    ]
}
````
