Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
import { Asset, CallLog, Customer, Job, JobTimeSheet, SupportTicket, Task } from '../../models'
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DateGroup, DotData, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<SupportTicket>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(SupportTicket, 'Ticket number', ['id', 'asset'])
    const tableId = new TypographyData(SupportTicket, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(SupportTicket, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(SupportTicket, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(SupportTicket, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(SupportTicket, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const closedOn = new DateGroup(SupportTicket, 'Closed on', 'closedOn')

    const count = new AggregateData(SupportTicket, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const jobs = new RelationOption(SupportTicket, 'Jobs', 'jobs', Job)
    const timeSheets = new RelationOption(SupportTicket, 'Time sheets', 'timeSheets', JobTimeSheet)
    const asset = new RelationOption(SupportTicket, 'Asset', 'asset', Asset)
    const customer = new RelationOption(SupportTicket, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const task = new RelationOption(SupportTicket, 'Task', 'task', Task)

    const status = new TypographyData(SupportTicket, 'Status', ['closed', 'awaitingResponse'])
    const timeOpen = new TypographyData(SupportTicket, 'Time open', ['timeOpen'])
    const timeBooked = new TypographyData(SupportTicket, 'Time booked', ['timeBooked'])
    const customerName = new LinkData(SupportTicket, 'CustomerName', ['customerName'])

    const dot = new DotData(SupportTicket, 'Urgency', 'timeOpen')

    dot.setColor(entity => {
        const createdDate = moment(entity.created)
        const closeDate = moment()
        const timeDiff = closeDate.diff(createdDate, 'seconds')
        const timeDiffDays = closeDate.diff(createdDate, 'days')
        const timeDiffHours = closeDate.diff(createdDate, 'hours')
        const timeDiffMinutes = closeDate.diff(createdDate, 'minutes')

        if (entity.closed) {
            dot.setTooltip('Closed')
            return colors.grey
        } else if (timeDiff >= 86400) {
            dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffDays} days`)
            return colors.red
        } else if (timeDiff <= 86399 && timeDiff >= 3600) {
            dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffHours} hours`)
            return colors.green
        } else if (timeDiff <= 3599 && timeDiff > 60) {
            dot.setTooltip(`${timeDiffMinutes} minutes`)
            return colors.green
        } else {
            dot.setTooltip('0 minutes')
            return colors.green
        }
    })

    id.setRenderLink(ticket => `/work/support/${ticket.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(ticket => `Ticket ${ticket.id}`)

    timeOpen.setRenderLabel(ticket => {
        if (ticket.timeOpen < 1) {
            return 'Still open'
        } else if (ticket.timeOpen >= 86400) {
            return `${Math.round(ticket.timeOpen / 86400)} Days`
        } else if (ticket.timeOpen > 3600 && ticket.timeOpen <= 86399) {
            return `${Math.round(ticket.timeOpen / 3600)} Hours`
        } else if (ticket.timeOpen >= 60 && ticket.timeOpen <= 3599) {
            return `${Math.round(ticket.timeOpen / 59)} Minutes`
        } else {
            return `${ticket.timeOpen} Seconds`
        }
    })

    timeBooked.setRenderLabel(ticket => `${(ticket.timeBooked / 3600).toFixed(1)} hours`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(ticket => getStatus(ticket))

    customerName.addDependentOption(customer)
    customerName.setRenderLink(supportTicket => `/sales/customers/${supportTicket.customer.id}`)

    return [
        id, tableId, dot, creator, editor, created, edited, asset, status, closedOn, timeOpen, timeBooked, task, jobs, timeSheets,
        count, customerName, customer
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, DotData, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { CallLogOutcome, Contact, Customer, Department, Employee, Prospect, Supplier, SupportTicket, Task, TradingCompany, User } from '../../models'
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'
import { taskOptions } from '../../models/task'

export function getReportOptions(): (AggregateData<Task> | DateGroup<Task> | LinkData<Task> | RelationOption<Task> | TypographyData<Task> | UserData<Task> | DotData<Task>)[] {
    const id = new LinkData(Task, 'Task ID', ['id'])
    const tableId = new TypographyData(Task, 'ID', ['id'])
    const creator = new UserData(Task, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(Task, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(Task, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(Task, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(Task, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    const assignedEmployee = new RelationOption(Task, 'Assigned Employee', 'actionedBy', Employee)
    const assignedDepartment = new RelationOption(Task, 'Assigned Department', 'assignedDepartment', Department)
    const owner = new UserData(Task, 'Owner', 'owner')
    const ownerRelation = new RelationOption(Task, 'Owner Relation', 'owner', User)
    const outcome = new RelationOption(Task, 'Outcome', 'outcome', CallLogOutcome)
    const dueDate = new DateGroup(Task, 'Due date', 'dueDate')
    const description = new TypographyData(Task, 'Description', ['description'])
    const priority = new TypographyData(Task, 'Priority', ['priority'])
    const complete = new TypographyData(Task, 'Complete', ['complete'])
    const status = new TypographyData(Task, 'Status', ['complete', 'open'])

    const supportTicket = new RelationOption(Task, 'Support ticket', 'supportTicket', SupportTicket)
    const pendingSupportTicket = new RelationOption(Task, 'Pending support ticket', 'pendingSupportTicket', SupportTicket)
    const customer = new RelationOption(Task, 'Customer', 'customer', Customer)
    const supplier = new RelationOption(Task, 'Supplier', 'supplier', Supplier)
    const prospect = new RelationOption(Task, 'Prospect', 'prospect', Prospect)
    const contact = new RelationOption(Task, 'Contact', 'contact', Contact)
    const tradingCompany = new RelationOption(Task, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'tradingCompany', TradingCompany)

    const dot = new DotData(Task, 'Urgency', 'dueDate')

    dot.setColor(entity => {
        const dueDate = moment(entity.dueDate)
        const timeNow = moment(new Date())
        const timeDiffDays = dueDate.diff(timeNow, 'days')
        const timeDiffHours = dueDate.diff(timeNow, 'hours')

        const midnight = moment('00:00:00', 'hh:mm:ss')
        const timeUntilMidnight = dueDate.diff(midnight, 's') / 86400

        if (entity.complete) {
            dot.setTooltip('Complete')
            return colors.grey
        } else if (timeUntilMidnight >= 1) {
            if (timeDiffDays >= 1) {
                dot.setTooltip(`Due in ${timeDiffDays} days`)
            } else {
                dot.setTooltip(`Due in ${timeDiffHours} hours`)
            }
            return colors.green
        } else if (timeUntilMidnight < 1) {
            dot.setTooltip('Due today')
            return colors.red
        }
    })

    priority.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        return taskOptions[entity.priority]
    })

    id.setRenderLink(task => `/my/tasks/${task.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(task => `Task ${task.id}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(task => getStatus(task))

    return [
        id, tableId, creator, editor, created, edited, count, dueDate, assignedEmployee,
        description, priority, complete, status, dot, owner, assignedDepartment, ownerRelation, outcome,
        supportTicket, pendingSupportTicket, customer, contact, tradingCompany, supplier, prospect
    ]
}

````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { TaxCode } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<TaxCode>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(TaxCode, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(TaxCode, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(TaxCode, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(TaxCode, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const code = new TypographyData(TaxCode, 'Code', ['code'])
    const description = new TypographyData(TaxCode, 'Description', ['description'])
    const amount = new TypographyData(TaxCode, 'Amount', ['amount'])

    amount.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        if (entity.code === 'TU') {
            return 'Tax on delivery address'
        }

        return `${entity.amount}%`
    })

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, code, description, amount]
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, DateGroup, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Branch, Employee, TeamMember } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions() {
    const creator = new UserData(TeamMember, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(TeamMember, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(TeamMember, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(TeamMember, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const branch = new RelationOption(TeamMember, 'Branch', 'branch', Branch)
    const employee = new RelationOption(TeamMember, 'Employee', 'employee', Employee)
    const role = new TypographyData(TeamMember, 'Role', ['role'])
    const count = new AggregateData(TeamMember, 'Count', 'id', 'count')

    return [creator, editor, created, edited, branch, employee, role, count]
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Product, ProductLocation, ProductUnitOfMeasure, ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, WarehouseLocation } from '../../models'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<ThirdPartyGoodsReceived>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const quantity = new NumberData(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Quantity', 'quantity')
    const unitOfMeasure = new RelationOption(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Unit of measure', 'unitOfMeasure', ProductUnitOfMeasure)
    const product = new RelationOption(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Product', 'product', Product)
    const location = new RelationOption(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Location', 'location', WarehouseLocation)
    const productLocation = new RelationOption(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Product location', 'productLocation', ProductLocation)
    const deliveryNoteNumber = new TypographyData(ThirdPartyGoodsReceived, 'Delivery note number', ['deliveryNoteNumber'])

    quantity.renderContent = (entity, data) => new Typography(String(Number(quantity.getFormattedValue(entity, data))))

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, quantity, unitOfMeasure, product, location, productLocation, deliveryNoteNumber
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { NotEqualStatusFilter } from './filters/notEqualStatus'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { getStatus } from './getStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<TradingCompany>[] {
    const count = new AggregateData(TradingCompany, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const creator = new UserData(TradingCompany, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(TradingCompany, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(TradingCompany, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(TradingCompany, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const companyName = new LinkData(TradingCompany, 'Company Name', ['name'])
    const id = new LinkData(TradingCompany, 'ID', ['id'])
    const status = new TypographyData(TradingCompany, 'Status', ['isDormant'])

    const divisions = new RelationOption(TradingCompany, 'Divisions', 'divisions', Division)
    const currency = new RelationOption(TradingCompany, 'Currency', 'defaultCurrency', Currency)
    const address = new RelationOption(TradingCompany, 'Address', 'addresses', Address)
    const isMultiCurrency = new BooleanData(TradingCompany, 'Multi-currency', 'multiCurrency')
    const isDormant = new BooleanData(TradingCompany, 'isDormant', 'isDormant')
    const salesTaxRegistrationNumber = new TypographyData(TradingCompany, 'VAT Registration Number', ['salesTaxNumber'])
    const eori = new TypographyData(TradingCompany, 'EORI', ['eori'])

    companyName.setRenderLink(tradingCompany => `/company/companies/${tradingCompany.id}`)
    companyName.setRenderLabel(tradingCompany => `${tradingCompany.name}`)

    status.setSortable(false)
    status.clearFilterTypes()
    status.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
    status.addFilterType('not equals', NotEqualStatusFilter)
    status.setQuickFilter('equals')
    status.setRenderLabel(tradingCompany => getStatus(tradingCompany))

    const defaultOption = new TypographyData(TradingCompany, DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND, ['id'])
    defaultOption.renderContent = () => new Typography('Data option not found', 'caption').setColor('error')

    return [
        defaultOption, // This (defaultOption) must remain as the first report option. For use in getDefaultReportOption.ts
        creator, count, editor, created, edited, companyName, id, divisions, currency, address, isMultiCurrency, status, isDormant, eori,
        salesTaxRegistrationNumber
    ]
}
````

Complete callback, including private/non-returned dependencies, calculated projections, group nesting and final mutations. These definitions supersede citation-only summaries for integration; do not serialize declaration variable names as labels.
````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { Person, User, UserTradingCompany } from '../../models'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../../application'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { UserStatusFilterdDetailed } from '../../reports/data/user/filters/detailedStatus'
import { UserStatusFilterdSimplified } from '../../reports/data/user/filters/simplifiedStatus'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<User>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(User, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(User, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(User, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(User, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')
    const count = new AggregateData(User, 'Count', 'id', 'count')
    const passwordExpiryDate = new DateGroup(User, 'Password Expiry Date', 'passwordExpiryDate')
    const passwordIsHardExpiryDate = new BooleanData(User, 'Password Is Hard Expiry', 'passwordIsHardExpiryDate')

    const id = new LinkData(User, 'ID', ['id'])
    const person = new RelationOption(User, 'Person', 'person', Person)
    const userTradingCompany = new RelationOption(User, TRADINGCOMPANY, 'userTradingCompany', UserTradingCompany)
    const loginEmail = new TypographyData(User, 'Login email', ['loginEmail'])
    const lastPasswordChangedDate = new DateGroup(User, 'Last password changed date', 'lastPasswordChangedDate')

    const lastLogin = new DateGroup(User, 'Last login', 'lastLogin')
    const lastRestore = new DateGroup(User, 'Last restore', 'lastRestore')

    const detailedUserStatus = new TypographyData(User, 'Status detailed', ['passwordExpiryDate'])

    detailedUserStatus.renderContent = (entity, data) => {
        const status = entity.passwordExpiryDate
            ? entity.passwordExpiryDate <= new Date()
                ? entity.passwordIsHardExpiryDate
                    ? 'Disabled'
                    : 'Password soft expired'
                : 'Active'
            : 'Active'

        return new Typography(status)
    }

    detailedUserStatus.setSortable(false)
    detailedUserStatus.clearFilterTypes()
    detailedUserStatus.addFilterType('equals', UserStatusFilterdDetailed)
    detailedUserStatus.setQuickFilter('equals')

    const simplifiedUserStatus = new TypographyData(User, 'Status simplified', ['passwordExpiryDate'])

    simplifiedUserStatus.renderContent = (entity, data) => {
        const status = entity.passwordExpiryDate && entity.passwordExpiryDate <= new Date() && entity.passwordIsHardExpiryDate
            ? 'Disabled'
            : 'Enabled'

        return new Typography(status)
    }

    simplifiedUserStatus.setSortable(false)
    simplifiedUserStatus.clearFilterTypes()
    simplifiedUserStatus.addFilterType('equals', UserStatusFilterdSimplified)
    simplifiedUserStatus.setQuickFilter('equals')

    id.setRenderLabel(user => `User ${user.id}`)
    id.setRenderLink(user => `/company/users/${user.id}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, id, person, count, userTradingCompany, loginEmail, passwordExpiryDate, passwordIsHardExpiryDate,
        lastPasswordChangedDate, lastLogin, lastRestore, detailedUserStatus, simplifiedUserStatus
    ]
}

````

````typescript
import { DateGroup, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'

}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, DateGroup, LinkData, NumberData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'

    const created = new DateGroup(VatAdjustment, 'Created on', 'created')

    const date = new DateGroup(VatAdjustment, 'Date', 'date')

    const description = new TypographyData(VatAdjustment, 'Description', ['description'])

    const box01Value = new NumberData(VatAdjustment, 'Box 1 Value', 'box01Value')

    const box03Value = new NumberData(VatAdjustment, 'Box 3 Value', 'box03Value')

    const box06Value = new NumberData(VatAdjustment, 'Box 6 Value', 'box06Value')
    const box07Value = new NumberData(VatAdjustment, 'Box 7 Value', 'box07Value')
    const box08Value = new NumberData(VatAdjustment, 'Box 8 Value', 'box08Value')

    return [

}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { Department, Division, WarehouseAccessibility, WarehouseLocation } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<WarehouseAccessibility>[] {
    const warehouseLocation = new RelationOption(WarehouseAccessibility, 'Warehouse location', 'warehouseLocation', WarehouseLocation)
    const division = new RelationOption(WarehouseAccessibility, 'Division', 'division', Division)
    const department = new RelationOption(WarehouseAccessibility, 'Department', 'department', Department)
    const type = new TypographyData(WarehouseAccessibility, 'Type', ['type'])
    const path = new TypographyData(WarehouseAccessibility, 'Path', ['path'])
    const ref = new LinkData(WarehouseAccessibility, 'Ref', ['refId'])
    const parent = new TypographyData(WarehouseAccessibility, 'Parent', ['parent'])

    ref.addDependentOption(division)
    ref.addDependentOption(department)

    ref.setRenderLink(entity => {
        if (entity.type === 'division') {
            return `/company/divisions/${entity.refId}`
        } else if (entity.type === 'department') {
            return `/company/departments/${entity.refId}`
        }
    })

    ref.setRenderLabel(entity => {
        if (entity.type === 'division') {
            return `${entity.division.name}`
        } else if (entity.type === 'department') {
            return `${entity.department.departmentName}`
        }
    })

    return [
        warehouseLocation, type, path, ref, division, department, parent
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, BooleanData, DateGroup, LinkData, RelationOption, TypographyData, UserData } from '../../reports'
import { ProductLocation, TradingCompany, WarehouseAccessibility, WarehouseLocation, WarehouseLocationPath } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<WarehouseLocation>[] {
    const creator = new UserData(WarehouseLocation, 'Created by', 'creator')
    const editor = new UserData(WarehouseLocation, 'Edited by', 'editor')
    const created = new DateGroup(WarehouseLocation, 'Created on', 'created')
    const edited = new DateGroup(WarehouseLocation, 'Edited on', 'lastEdited')

    const id = new LinkData(WarehouseLocation, 'ID', ['id'])
    const name = new LinkData(WarehouseLocation, 'Name', ['name'])
    const availableForAllocation = new BooleanData(WarehouseLocation, 'Available for allocation', 'availableForAllocation')
    const allowGoodsReceive = new BooleanData(WarehouseLocation, 'Allow for goods receiving', 'allowGoodsReceive')
    const code = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocation, 'Code', ['code'])
    const description = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocation, 'Description', ['description'])
    const route = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocation, 'Route', ['route'])
    const parent = new RelationOption(WarehouseLocation, 'Parent', 'parent', WarehouseLocation)
    const parentCompany = new RelationOption(WarehouseLocation, 'Parent company', 'parentCompany', TradingCompany)
    const productLocations = new RelationOption(WarehouseLocation, 'Product Locations', 'productLocations', ProductLocation)
    const warehouseAccessibility = new RelationOption(WarehouseLocation, 'Warehouse accessibility', 'warehouseAccessibility', WarehouseAccessibility)

    const path = new RelationOption(WarehouseLocation, 'Warehouse location path', 'path', WarehouseLocationPath)

    id.setRenderLink(location => `/purchasing/warehouse/${location.id}`)
    id.setRenderLabel(location => `${location.id}`)

    name.setRenderLink(location => `/purchasing/warehouse/${location.id}`)
    name.setRenderLabel(location => `${location.name}`)

    return [
        creator, editor, created, edited, name, path, parent, allowGoodsReceive,
        parentCompany, productLocations, availableForAllocation, id, warehouseAccessibility,
        code, description, route
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, LinkData, MultiPropertyDataOption, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { Component, FlexContainer, Link, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { ContainsFilter } from '../../reports/data/link/filters/contains'
import { EqualsFilter } from '../../reports/data/link/filters/equals'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { WarehouseLocation, WarehouseLocationPath } from '../../models'
import { getViewUrl } from '../../configuration'

class PathData extends MultiPropertyDataOption<WarehouseLocationPath> {
    public constructor(entity: { new(): WarehouseLocationPath }, label: string, protected path: keyof WarehouseLocationPath, protected ids: keyof WarehouseLocationPath) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('equals', EqualsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
    }

    public renderLink(entity: WarehouseLocationPath, raw: any): Component {
        const parts = (entity[this.path] as string).split(' ➔ ')
        const ids = (entity[this.ids] as string).split(',')

        const container = new FlexContainer(true, false)
            .setAlignItems('center')
            .setSpacing(8)

        parts.forEach((part, index) => {
            const location = new WarehouseLocation()
            location.id = ids[index]

            if (index !== 0) {
                container.addChild(
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(new Typography('➔'))
                )
            }

            const link = new Link(getViewUrl(location))
                .addChild(new Typography(part))

            container.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(link)
            )
        })

        return container
    }

    public renderLabel(entity: WarehouseLocationPath, raw: any): string {
        return `${entity[this.path]}`
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${this.path}`)) {
            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.path}`)
            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.ids}`)
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(
            `${parentAlias}.${this.path}`
        )
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof WarehouseLocationPath)[] {
        return [this.path, this.ids]
    }

    public getValue(entity: WarehouseLocationPath | null, raw: any): string | Component {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        }

        return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: WarehouseLocationPath | null, raw: any): Component {
        if (entity === null) {
            return new Typography('')
        }

        return this.renderLink(entity, raw)
    }
}

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<WarehouseLocationPath>[] {
    const id = new LinkData(WarehouseLocationPath, 'ID', ['id'])
    const locationName = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocationPath, 'Location name', ['locationName'])

    const parentPath = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocationPath, 'Parent path', ['parentPath'])
    const parentPathLinkable = new PathData(WarehouseLocationPath, 'Parent path linkable', 'parentPath', 'parentPathIds')

    const fullPath = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocationPath, 'Full path', ['parentPath'])
    const fullPathLinkable = new PathData(WarehouseLocationPath, 'Full path linkable', 'path', 'pathIds')

    const depth = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocationPath, 'Depth', ['depth'])

    return [
        id, locationName, parentPath, parentPathLinkable,
        fullPath, fullPathLinkable, parentPath, fullPath, depth
    ]
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseOption, LinkData, TypographyData } from '../../reports'
import { WarehouseLocationStockQuantity } from '../../models'

export function getReportOptions(): BaseOption<WarehouseLocationStockQuantity>[] {
    const location = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocationStockQuantity, 'Location', ['locationId'])
    const productSku = new LinkData(WarehouseLocationStockQuantity, 'Product', ['productSku'])

    const productDescription = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocationStockQuantity, 'Description', ['productDescription'])
    const quantity = new TypographyData(WarehouseLocationStockQuantity, 'Quantity', ['quantity'])

    return [location, productSku, productName, productDescription, quantity]
}
````

## Widget construction and host-context contract

Four shape families: ListView has list; ChartView has chart; SummaryView has summary plus its optional click-through list; DynamicListView has summaryItems containing a summary and list per tab. Shared members are icon, theme palette object, title, type, removable and item layout. The ordinary serializer does not invent restricted. Exact complete serializer and consumer source is embedded in the core capsules.

DataOption defaults: align=left; groupable=false; sortable=false; visible=true; sticky=false; wrap=false; groupBy=false; subSummary=false; required=false. width, minimumWidth, totalType, summaryType and quickFilter begin undefined; subclasses and callbacks can override. Fresh ordinary list selection passes option align/sticky/wrap/width/minimumWidth and the chosen heading; totalType is not passed on that path. Dynamic-tab selection also passes totalType/groupBy/subSummary/summaryType. Undefined members disappear in JSON.stringify; do not replace undefined with the documentation marker, zero, null or a guessed total. Dynamic-tab summary types are exactly sum, count, avg, min, max.

A domain dashboard may have no ReportContext (free eligible-source selector), or an entity context without an ID (the source is that entity). A detail host supplies {entity, id} or a contextual ID set. The related widget stores its own selected data entity and the forward display-label relation path from host entity to source. ReportQuery reverses that path when applying the current ID. The ID is normally supplied by the page on each load, not embedded in a shared per-user layout.

The record-context source selector can navigate a to-one relation to reach a to-many choice. Therefore “all traversal is to-many” is inaccurate: a selectable related source endpoint must be to-many in this wizard branch. Its own skip rules reject prior labels, returns to the host/root or parent, and inverse back-links. The column/group/axis picker has separate rules: at an immediate OneToMany boundary it offers aggregates and suppresses further relation traversal; its isOneToMany implementation does not treat ManyToMany or inherited metadata identically by assumption. Preserve the exact picker rules embedded below.

Ordinary Summary selection requests aggregate terminals; chart X requests nonaggregates and chart Y requests aggregates. List columns must be visible and list-compatible; grouping selections must be groupable and list-compatible. Grouping restricts ordinary column choices to selected group fields and aggregates. These constraints combine with per-option filter maps and permission checks.

Customer Details uses dashboard name customer, entity Customer and id customer.id for both /sales/customers/:customer and /sales/customers/:customer/dashboard. Dashboard selection first checks an active dashboard_user_relation for current user + relationDashboard, then the user/name row, then clones the factory default if absent. Thus a widget inserted into this layout can appear for that user on multiple Customers and receive each current Customer as context. It is not a per-customer layout merely because it is seen on one Customer page. Some other Customer tabs are ConfigurableListView or DocumentModule and are not interchangeable with this widget array.

Cross-entity SummaryView is a source-level hazard: the ordinary wizard emits summary.path=[]; applying a Customer context to a Quote summary with that empty path constrains Quote.id using Customer.id. The separately stored list path does not repair the summary. Dynamic-tab summary serialization does preserve config.path. Later integration must define a tested supported contract for this case or reject it; this evidence capture does not patch behaviour.

SummaryView list is optional in the item/renderer contract, but Dashboard.checkPermissions directly reads itemConfiguration.list.columns for SummaryView. Consequently, a missing list is not safe to advertise merely because the standalone SummaryView renderer accepts it. The ordinary wizard emits its associated list; preserve the complete host load contract.

````typescript
setDetailsMenuItem = (): void => {
            const dashboard = new Dashboard('customer', {
                entity: Customer,
                id: customer.id
            })

            router.addChild(
                new Route('/sales/customers/:customer').setExact(true).addChild(dashboard),
                new Route('/sales/customers/:customer/dashboard').addChild(dashboard)
            )

            actions.addChild(
                new Route('/sales/customers/:customer').setExact(true).addChild(...dashboard.getActions()),
                new Route('/sales/customers/:customer/dashboard').addChild(...dashboard.getActions())
            )
        }
````

````typescript
setBranchDetailsDashboard = async (): Promise<void> => {
                const branchDetailDashboard = new Dashboard('customerBranches', {
                    entity: Branch,
                    id: request.params.branch
                })

                router.addChild(
                    new Route(`/sales/customers/:customer/branches/:branch`).addChild(
                        new Breadcrumb('Branches', `/sales/customers/${customer.id}/branches${foundSetQueryStringAddition}`),
                        branchDetailDashboard
                    )
                )

                actions.addChild(
                    new Route(`/sales/customers/:customer/branches/:branch`).addChild(
                        ...branchDetailDashboard.getActions()
                    )
                )

                const branch = await getRepository(Branch).findOne(request.params.branch)

                layout.addSummary({ label: `${_('Branch')} status`, value: getBranchStatus(branch) })

                // TODO: This does nothing currently. Need to decide what it should do. If it should be for the customer
                // we need a way of getting the query string set. ViewBranch
                // May need a "View in found set" for branches so user can open in a new tab.
                if (request.query?.foundsetcode) {
                    layout.addSummary({ label: 'Found set', value: foundSetSummaryValue })
                } else if (application.isASuperUser()) {
                    layout.addSummary({ label: 'All records', value: '' })
                }

                if (getBranchStatus(branch) === 'Active') {
                    layout.addAction(new ButtonAction(`Close ${_('branch')}`).on('click', async () => {
                        await changeStatusBranch(branch, this, BranchStatus.CLOSED)
                    }))
                } else {
                    layout.addAction(new ButtonAction(`Activate ${_('branch')}`).on('click', async () => {
                        await changeStatusBranch(branch, this, BranchStatus.ACTIVE)
                    }))
                }
            }
````

````typescript
export function getReportOptions<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, maxFields: number = DEFAULT_MAX_CUSTOM_FIELDS): BaseOption<T>[] {
    // Get the configured callback
    const customFieldOptions = []

    if (typeof entity === 'function') {
        if (tablesWithCustomFields.includes(pascalToSnakeCase(entity.name))) {
            for (let i = 1; i < maxFields + 1; i++) {
                customFieldOptions.push(new CustomFieldData(entity, i))
            }
        }
    }

    const callback = reportOptions.get(entity)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        const options = callback()
        options.push(...customFieldOptions)
        return options
    }
    // No callback configured, return an empty array by default
    return []
}
````

````typescript
export function getStatus<T extends Base>(entity: T): string | undefined {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = statuses.get(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback(entity)
    }

    // No callback configured, return undefined by default
    return undefined
}
````

````typescript
public checkPathPermissions(application: Application, model: string, paths: string[][]): boolean {
        const entity = (models as any)[model]
        const query = new ReportQuery(entity)

        for (const fullPath of paths) {
            if (fullPath !== null) {
                for (let index = 1; index <= fullPath.length; index++) {
                    const path = fullPath.slice(0, index)
                    const dataOption = query.getDataOption(path, true)
                    const dataEntityName = dataOption.getEntity()
                    const dataEntity = new (dataEntityName)()

                    const properties = []

                    if (dataOption instanceof MultiPropertyDataOption) {
                        properties.push(...dataOption.getProperties())
                    } else if (dataOption instanceof SinglePropertyDataOption || dataOption instanceof RelationOption) {
                        properties.push(dataOption.getProperty())
                    }

                    for (const property of properties) {
                        const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(dataEntity, String(property))

                        if (permissionKey && !application.canUser('read', permissionKey)) {
                            return false
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return true
    }
````

````typescript
protected checkPermissions(application: Application, itemConfiguration: ItemConfiguration): [boolean, ItemConfiguration] {
        let hasPermission = true

        switch (itemConfiguration.type) {
            case 'ListView': {
                const paths = itemConfiguration.list.columns.map(dataPoint => dataPoint.path)
                const model = itemConfiguration.list.entity
                hasPermission = this.checkPathPermissions(application, model, paths)
                break
            }

            case 'ChartView': {
                const paths = itemConfiguration.chart.data.map(dataPoint => dataPoint.path)
                const model = itemConfiguration.chart.entity
                hasPermission = this.checkPathPermissions(application, model, paths)
                break
            }

            case 'SummaryView': {
                const paths = [itemConfiguration.summary.data, ...itemConfiguration.list.columns.map(column => column.path)]
                const model = itemConfiguration.summary.entity
                hasPermission = this.checkPathPermissions(application, model, paths)
                break
            }

            case 'DynamicListView': {
                itemConfiguration.summaryItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                    const paths = item.list.columns.map(dataPoint => dataPoint.path)
                    const model = item.list.entity
                    itemConfiguration.summaryItems[index].permitted = this.checkPathPermissions(application, model, paths)
                })
                break
            }

            case 'Card': {
                if (cards[itemConfiguration.cardType]) {
                    const permissionKey = cards[itemConfiguration.cardType].getPermissionKey()

                    if (permissionKey) {
                        hasPermission = application.canUser('read', permissionKey)
                    }
                }

                break
            }
        }

        return [hasPermission, itemConfiguration]
    }
````

````typescript
const showCustomFieldConfiguration = async (item: DashboardItem, value: boolean): Promise<void> => {
            const resolvedConfig = JSON.parse(configuration.configuration)

            const config = item.getConfiguration()

            const index = resolvedConfig.findIndex(
                value => value.cardType === config.cardType
            )

            if (index >= 0) {
                resolvedConfig[index].showCustomField = value
            }

            const customFields = await getRepository(models.CustomField).find({
                where: {
                    table: this.context ? pascalToSnakeCase(this.context.entity.name) : null,
                    cardName: cards[config.cardType].getName()
                }
            })

            if (customFields.length) {
                await getRepository(models.CustomField).save(
                    customFields.map(item => ({
                        ...item,
                        showField: value
                    }))
                )
            }

            configuration.configuration = JSON.stringify(resolvedConfig)

            await repository.save(configuration)

            this.rebuild()
        }
````

````typescript
const addItem = async (itemConfiguration: ItemConfiguration, hasPermission = true): Promise<void> => {
            const dynamicConfigRepository = getRepository(models.DynamicWindowConfiguration)
            let dynamicConfig: models.DynamicWindowConfiguration

            if (itemConfiguration.type === 'DynamicView') {
                dynamicConfig = await dynamicConfigRepository.findOne({
                    where: {
                        hash: itemConfiguration.hash,
                        user: application.getUser()
                    }
                })

                if (dynamicConfig === undefined) {
                    dynamicConfig = await dynamicConfigRepository.save(
                        dynamicConfigRepository.create({
                            user: application.getUser(),
                            hash: itemConfiguration.hash
                        })
                    )
                }
            }

            const item = new DashboardItem(application, this, itemConfiguration, this.context, dynamicConfig, hasPermission)

            item.on('remove', () => {
                container.removeChild(item)
                updateConfiguration()
            })

            item.on('mergeCard', (data: { context: ReportContext }): void => {
                mergeCardConfiguration(item, data.context)
            })

            item.on('showCustomFields', ({ value }): void => {
                showCustomFieldConfiguration(item, value)
            })

            item.on('save', () => updateConfiguration())

            item.on('newSummaryConfig', async () => this.rebuild())

            container.addChild(item)
        }
````

````typescript
case 'DynamicListView': {
                const widget = new DetailsCard(`${configuration.title}`)
                    .setHeaderVariant('none')

                const shareWidgetAction = new MenuItem('Share widget')
                    .on('click', async () => {
                        await shareWidget(this, configuration)
                    })

                const getTabLastActiveId = (): number => configuration.lastActiveTab || 0

                const saveTabLastActiveId = (index: number): void => {
                    configuration.lastActiveTab = index
                    this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                }

                const activeTab = getTabLastActiveId()

                const tabs = new TabGroup()
                    .setContentPadding(0)
                    .setTabPadding(8)
                    .setDragHandle(true)
                    .setActive(activeTab)
                    .on('setActive', ({ index }) => saveTabLastActiveId(index))

                widget.addChild(tabs)

                const showAddTabDialog = (tabIndex?: number): void => {
                    let activeTabConfiguration: DynamicListViewItem['summaryItems'][number]

                    if (tabIndex !== undefined) {
                        activeTabConfiguration = configuration.summaryItems[tabIndex]
                    }

                    const configurator: WizardDialog<{}, AddDynamicTabEvents> = addDynamicTab(this.context, this.getRootComponent(), activeTabConfiguration, this.dashboard.getName())
                        .on('addTab', ({ tabConfiguration }): void => {
                            if (tabIndex === undefined) {
                                // Add tab
                                this.configuration.lastActiveTab = tabs.getChildren().length; // <-- Semicolon required
                                (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.push(tabConfiguration)
                            } else {
                                // Edit tab
                                const { summaryItems } = this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem; // <-- Semicolon required
                                (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems = [...summaryItems.slice(0, tabIndex), tabConfiguration, ...summaryItems.slice(tabIndex + 1)]
                            }

                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                                const paths = item.list.columns.map(dataPoint => dataPoint.path)
                                const model = item.list.entity;
                                (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[index].permitted = this.dashboard.checkPathPermissions(this.application, model, paths)
                            })

                            this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                            this.parseConfiguration()

                            this.removeChild(configurator)
                        })
                        .on('close', () => this.removeChild(configurator))
                }

                const addTabFromCurrentTab = async (tabIndex?: number): Promise<void> => {
                    const activeTabConfiguration: DynamicListViewItem['summaryItems'][number] = configuration.summaryItems[tabIndex]
                    const newActiveTabConfiguration = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(activeTabConfiguration))
                    newActiveTabConfiguration.summary.title = `${activeTabConfiguration.summary.title} (Duplicate)`

                    const { summaryItems } = this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem; // <-- Semicolon required
                    (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems = [...summaryItems, newActiveTabConfiguration];

                    (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                        const paths = item.list.columns.map(dataPoint => dataPoint.path)
                        const model = item.list.entity;
                        (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[index].permitted = this.dashboard.checkPathPermissions(this.application, model, paths)
                    })

                    this.configuration.lastActiveTab = tabs.getChildren().length

                    await this.saveOldDashboard()

                    this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                    this.parseConfiguration()
                }

                const removeTabList = async (): Promise<void> => {
                    await this.saveOldDashboard()
                    this.emit('remove', {})
                }

                const actionMenu = new MenuAction('Widget')
                    .addChild(new Menu().addChild(
                        new MenuItem(`${configuration.title ? configuration.title : 'unnamed'} | ${this.dashboard.getName()}`)
                            .setSecondary('DynamicListView | dashboard name')
                            .setIcon(new Icon('Dashboard'))
                    ),
                    new Divider(),
                    new Menu().addChild(
                        !configuration.removeAddTab
                            ? new MenuItem('Add tab').on('click', async () => showAddTabDialog())
                            : null,
                        !configuration.removeDuplicateCurrentTab
                            ? new MenuItem('Duplicate current tab')
                                .on('click', async () => addTabFromCurrentTab(tabs.getActive()))
                            : null,
                        configuration.removable
                            ? new MenuItem('Remove tabbed list').on('click', async () => removeTabList(this))
                            : null
                    ),
                    new Menu().addChild(shareWidgetAction))

                if (configuration.summaryItems && configuration.summaryItems.length > 0) {
                    for (const summaryItem of Array.from(configuration.summaryItems)) {
                        const entity = models[summaryItem.summary.entity]

                        const tab = new TabGroupTab().setTabTheme(getTheme(entity))

                        // Force permitted to true and hide content if not permitted instead
                        summaryItem.permitted = true

                        if (summaryItem.permitted) {
                            tab
                                .setTabContent(
                                    new TabSummaryView(summaryItem.summary, this.application, this.application.getTradingCompany(), this.context)
                                )
                                .addChild(
                                    new Theme(getTheme(entity), getTheme(entity)).addChild(
                                        new ListView(this.dashboard, summaryItem.list, this.application, undefined, this.context)
                                            .setTitle(summaryItem.summary.title)
                                            .on('updateSort', ({ label, direction }) => {
                                                summaryItem.list.sort = { label, direction }
                                                this.emit('save', configuration)
                                            })
                                            .on('updateRowsPerPage', ({ rowsPerPage }) => {
                                                summaryItem.list.defaultRowsPerPage = rowsPerPage

                                                this.emit('save', configuration)
                                            })
                                    )
                                )
                        } else {
                            tab
                                .setTabContent(
                                    new Theme(getTheme(entity), getTheme(entity)).addChild(
                                        new TabSummary('-', summaryItem.summary.title)
                                            .setSize('small')
                                            .setIcon(new Icon('Lock'))
                                    )
                                )
                                .addChild(
                                    new ErrorMessage('Insufficent permissions', 'You do not have permission to access the data on this tab')
                                )
                        }

                        tabs.addChild(tab)
                    }

                    const moveTabRight = async (tabIndex: number): Promise<void> => {
                        // Old dashboard not saved because an order change seems too trivial
                        if (tabIndex !== tabs.getChildren().length - 1) {
                            this.configuration.lastActiveTab += 1
                            // Semi-colons required
                            const temporaryTab = (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex + 1];
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex + 1] = (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex];
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex] = temporaryTab

                            this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                            this.parseConfiguration()
                        }
                    }

                    const moveTabLeft = async (tabIndex: number): Promise<void> => {
                        // Old dashboard not saved because an order change seems too trivial
                        if (tabIndex !== 0) {
                            this.configuration.lastActiveTab -= 1
                            // Semi-colons required
                            const temporaryTab = (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex - 1];
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex - 1] = (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex];
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex] = temporaryTab

                            this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                            this.parseConfiguration()
                        }
                    }

                    const moveTabToFarLeft = async (tabIndex: number): Promise<void> => {
                        // Old dashboard not saved because an order change seems too trivial
                        if (tabIndex !== 0) {
                            this.configuration.lastActiveTab = 0
                            // Semi-colons required
                            const temporaryTab = (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex];
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.splice(tabIndex, 1);
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.unshift(temporaryTab)

                            this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                            this.parseConfiguration()
                        }
                    }

                    const moveTabToFarRight = async (tabIndex: number): Promise<void> => {
                        // Old dashboard not saved because an order change seems too trivial
                        const numberOfTabs = tabs.getChildren().length

                        if (tabIndex !== numberOfTabs - 1) {
                            this.configuration.lastActiveTab = numberOfTabs - 1
                            // Semi-colons required
                            const temporaryTab = (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems[tabIndex];
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.splice(tabIndex, 1);
                            (this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.push(temporaryTab)

                            this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                            this.parseConfiguration()
                        }
                    }

                    const removeTab = async (tabIndex: number): Promise<void> => {
                        InformationDialog(
                            this,
                            'Remove tab',
                            'Are you sure you want to remove this tab?',
                            'warning',
                            async () => {
                                await this.saveOldDashboard()

                                this.configuration.lastActiveTab = this.configuration.lastActiveTab === 0
                                    ? 0
                                    : this.configuration.lastActiveTab - 1

                                ;(this.configuration as DynamicListViewItem).summaryItems.splice(tabIndex, 1)
                                this.emit('save', this.configuration)
                                this.parseConfiguration()
                            }
                        )
                    }

                    actionMenu.addChild(
                        new Divider(),
                        new Menu().addChild(
                            new MenuItem('Current tab').addChild(
                                new Menu().addChild(
                                    new MenuItem('Edit tab').on('click', () => showAddTabDialog(tabs.getActive())),
                                    configuration.removeTab
                                        ? null
                                        : new MenuItem('Remove tab').on('click', async () => removeTab(tabs.getActive()))
                                ),
                                new Divider(),
                                new Menu().addChild(
                                    new MenuItem('Move tab left').on('click', async () => moveTabLeft(tabs.getActive())),
                                    new MenuItem('Move tab right').on('click', async () => moveTabRight(tabs.getActive())),
                                    new MenuItem('Move tab to far left').on('click', async () => moveTabToFarLeft(tabs.getActive())),
                                    new MenuItem('Move tab to far right').on('click', async () => moveTabToFarRight(tabs.getActive()))
                                ),
                                new Menu().addChild(shareWidgetAction)
                            )
                        )
                    )
                } else {
                    const tab = new TabGroupTab()
                        .setTabContent(
                            new TabSummary()
                                .setSize('small')
                                .setIcon(new Icon('TabUnselected'))
                        )
                        .addChild(
                            new FlexContainer(true, false)
                                .setPadding(32, 0)
                                .setJustifyContent('center')
                                .addChild(
                                    new Typography('Empty dynamic window', 'h6'),
                                    new FlexContainer(true, true)
                                        .setJustifyContent('center')
                                        .setPadding(16, 0)
                                        .addChild(
                                            new Button('Add tab')
                                                .setColor('primary')
                                                .on('click', async () => showAddTabDialog())
                                        )
                                )
                        )
                    tabs.addChild(tab)
                }

                tabs.addAction(actionMenu)

                item = widget

                break
            }
````

## Complete shared implementation capsules

These capsules preserve literal code, interfaces and constants so a later agent need not follow a source citation. They are evidence to translate into skill contracts, not scripts to execute. External ORM/UI library identifiers describe runtime behaviour and are not imported by this document. Filter option values loaded from application records remain target data. Some core source contains incidental Card/DynamicView branches; no card implementation was gathered.

### Capsule server/reports/option.ts

Source `server/reports/option.ts:1`.

````typescript
/* eslint-disable max-classes-per-file */
import { Application } from '../application'
import { Base } from '../models/base'
import { Component, TableCell } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Filter } from './filter'
import { RelationMetadata } from 'typeorm/metadata/RelationMetadata'
import { SelectQueryBuilder, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { getPermissionKey } from '../functions/permissionKey'
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto'

type FilterConstructor<C extends object = object, O extends DataOption<any> = DataOption<any>> = new (option: O, configuration?: C) => Filter<C, O>

// Tables to exclude from table dropdowns and have unrestricted access through parent tables (if here then must not be in tablePermissionLookUp)
export const allowedSubTables: string[] = [
    'AccountingPeriod', 'Address', 'BankStatement', 'BankStatementTransaction', 'BillOfMaterials', 'Branch',
    'CallLogOutcome', 'CanadaTaxCode', 'Company', 'CustomProductPrice', 'CustomerDiscount', 'DeliveryMethod',
    'DeliveryNoteNumber', 'DepartmentMember', 'DepartmentResource', 'EmailAddress', 'FinanceReportHeading', 'FinanceReportSubHeading',
    'GoodsReceived', 'ThirdPartyGoodsReceived', 'InventoryCost', 'InvoiceNumber', 'JobTitles', 'LatLong', 'Location', 'MaintenanceSchedule',
    'MaintenanceScheduleResourceTag', 'NetTotalDiscount', 'OperationDependency', 'PermittedWarehouseLocation', 'Person', 'PersonAddress',
    'PersonEmailAddress', 'PersonTelephoneNumber', 'ProductCustomDiscount', 'ProductSupplier', 'ProductQuantityDiscount',
    'ProductUnitOfMeasure', 'ProductUnitOfMeasureGroup', 'ProjectBranch', 'ProjectPersonRole', 'ProjectRole', 'ProspectSource',
    'RejectionReason', 'ResourceAccessibility', 'ResourceTag', 'ResourceTagName', 'ReturnNote', 'ReturnReason', 'ReturnsReceived',
    'SalesPipelineStage', 'SalesTerritory', 'ScheduleEvent', 'StockCategory', 'StockCategoryPath', 'SubLedger',
    'SubLedgerCustomerSupplier', 'SupplierType', 'TeamMember', 'Title', 'UnitOfMeasure', 'USTaxCode', 'UserTradingCompany',
    'WarehouseAccessibility', 'WarehouseDepartment', 'WarehouseDivision', 'WarehouseLocationPath', 'WarehouseLocationStockQuantity'
]
// 'Delivery' and 'Shipment' removed and put in tablePermissionLookUp in release 1.7.25

export type ReportContext = 'chart' | 'list'

/**
 * Base class for reporting options, contains all of the common functionality between all types
 * of reporting options.
 */
export abstract class BaseOption<T extends Base> {
    protected dependentOptions: Set<BaseOption<T>> = new Set()
    protected required: boolean = false
    protected path: string[]

    public constructor(
        protected entity: new () => T,
        protected label: string
    ) { }

    /**

    public abstract applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void

    /**

        return this

    public getDependentOptions(): BaseOption<T>[] {

    public getEntity(): typeof Base {

    }

     */
    public getLabel(): string {
        return this.label
    }

    /**

    public getRandomAlias(): string {
        return randomBytes(3).toString('hex')
    }

     * query is created for this entity.

    public getRequired(): boolean {
        return this.required

    /**

     * query is created for this entity.

    public setRequired(required: boolean): this {
        this.required = required

        return this

    public getContexts(): ReportContext[] {
        return ['chart', 'list']
    }

    /**
     * Get whether the option can be viewed
     * NB: This placeholder is functionally defined in derived classes
     */
    public getCanView(application: Application): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected property: keyof T

    public getCanViewData(): string {
        const entity = new this.entity()
        const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, this.property as string)

        return permissionKey || ''
    }

    public getDateProperty(): keyof T {

    }

/**
 * The base report option which represent a point of data which can be represented in a list view,

export abstract class DataOption<T extends Base> extends BaseOption<T> {

    protected groupable: boolean = false

    protected quickFilter?: string
    protected sortable: boolean = false
    protected sticky: boolean = false
    protected visible: boolean = true
    protected totalType?: string
    protected width?: number
    protected wrap: boolean = false
    protected isEntity: boolean = false
    protected groupBy: boolean = false
    protected subSummary: boolean = false
    protected summaryType?: string

    /**
     * Return the raw value represented by this data option.
     */
    public abstract getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any): any

    public getFormattedValue(entity: T | null, raw: any): string {
        return this.getFormattedValueBase(this.getValue(entity, raw))
    }

    public getFormattedValueBase(value: any): string {
        return `${value}`
    }

    /**
     * Render a component for when this individual point of data needs to be viewed.
     */
    public abstract renderContent(
        entity: T | null,
        raw: any,
        container: Component<any, any, any>
    ): Component<any, any, any>

    /**
     * Apply any necessary changes to a select query in order to group the results by this point of
     * data.
     */
    public applyGroup(
        query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>,
        parentAlias: string
    ): void { }

    /**
     * Apply any necessary changes to a select query in order to sort the results by this point of
     * data.
     */
    public applySort(
        query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>,
        parentAlias: string,
        direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'
    ): void { }

    /**
     * Render a `TableCell` component to contain the results of `renderComponent()` when this point
     * of data needs to be displayed in a `ListView`.
     */
    public renderCell(): TableCell {
        const cell = new TableCell()

        cell.setAlign(this.align)
        cell.setMinimumWidth(this.minimumWidth)
        cell.setSticky(this.sticky)
        cell.setWidth(this.width)
        cell.setWrap(this.wrap)

        return cell
    }

    /**
     * Add a `Filter` which can be used to filter queries using this point of data.
     */
    public addFilterType(operator: string, filter: FilterConstructor): this {
        this.filterTypes.set(operator, filter)

        this.filterTypes.delete(operator)

    public clearFilterTypes(): this {

    /**

export abstract class SinglePropertyDataOption<T extends Base> extends DataOption<T> {
    protected property: keyof T

    public getProperty(): keyof T {
        return this.property
    }

    public getCanView(application: Application): boolean {
        if (!application || application.isASuperUser() || allowedSubTables.includes(this.entity.name) || !this.property) {
            return true
        }

        const entity = new this.entity()
        const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, this.property as string)

        return this.property === 'id' || !permissionKey
            ? true
            : application.canUser('view', permissionKey)
    }

    public getCanViewData(): string {
        const entity = new this.entity()
        const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, this.property as string)

        return permissionKey || ''
    }
}

export abstract class MultiPropertyDataOption<T extends Base> extends DataOption<T> {
    protected properties: (keyof T)[]

    public getProperties(): (keyof T)[] {
        return this.properties
    }

    public getCanView(application: Application): boolean {
        if (!application || application.isASuperUser() || allowedSubTables.includes(this.entity.name) || !this.properties || this.properties.length <= 0) {
            return true
        }

        const entity = new this.entity()

        for (const property of this.properties) {
            const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, property as string)

            if (!permissionKey) {
                return true
            }

            if (property !== 'id' && !application.canUser('view', permissionKey)) {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }

    public getCanViewData(): string {
        const entity = new this.entity()

        if (!Array.isArray(this.properties)) {
            return ''
        }

        for (const property of this.properties) {
            const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, property as string)

            if (!permissionKey) {
                return ''
            }

            return permissionKey || ''
        }
    }
}

/**
 * A group of report options, used to simplify the selection process when navigating the list of
 * available report options.
 */
export class GroupOption<T extends Base> extends BaseOption<T> {
    protected children: Set<BaseOption<T>> = new Set()

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        // No-op. This option can't be selected, so no changes need to be made to the query.
    }

    /**
     * Returns an array of report options available as a child of this group.
     */
    public getChildren() {
        return Array.from(this.children)
    }

    /**
     * Add a report option to this group.
     */
    public addChild(...children: BaseOption<T>[]): this {
        for (const child of children) {
            this.children.add(child)
        }

        return this
    }

    /**
     * Remove a report option from this group.
     */
    public removeChild(...children: BaseOption<T>[]): this {
        for (const child of children) {
            this.children.add(child)
        }

        return this
    }

    /**
     * Get properties of children
     */
    public getPropertiesOfChildren(): (keyof T)[] {
        const properties: (keyof T)[] = []

        for (const child of this.children) {
            const property = child.getDateProperty()

            if (!properties.includes(property)) {
                properties.push(property)
            }
        }

        return properties
    }

    public getCanView(application: Application): boolean {
        if (!application || application.isASuperUser() || allowedSubTables.includes(this.entity.name)) {
            return true
        }

        const entity = new this.entity()
        const properties = this.getPropertiesOfChildren()

        for (const property of properties) {
            const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, property as string)

            if (!permissionKey) {
                return true
            }

            if (property !== 'id' && !application.canUser('view', permissionKey)) {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }

    public getCanViewData(): string {
        const entity = new this.entity()
        const properties = this.getPropertiesOfChildren()

        if (!Array.isArray(properties)) {
            return ''
        }

        for (const property of properties) {
            const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, property as string)

            if (!permissionKey) {
                return ''
            }

            return permissionKey
        }
    }
}

/**
 * A relation option, allowing report options which are related to the base entity to be displayed
 * for selection, and for use in the generated report query.
 */
export class RelationOption<T extends Base> extends BaseOption<T> {
    protected alias: string = this.getRandomAlias()
    protected relation: RelationMetadata
    protected toMany: boolean

    public constructor(
        entity: new () => T,
        label: string,
        protected property: keyof T,
        protected target: typeof Base
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        // Fetch the metadata for the relationship
        const { metadata } = getRepository(entity)
        const relation = metadata.relations.find(relation => relation.propertyName === this.property)

        // If metadata could not be found, throw an error
        if (relation === undefined) {
            throw new Error(`Unknown relation "${entity.name}.${property}"`)
        }

        // Store relevant parts of the metadata for later use
        this.relation = relation
        this.toMany = relation.relationType === 'one-to-many' || relation.relationType === 'many-to-many'
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        if (this.toMany === false) {
            // If relationship is "many-to-one", left join the record and select the fields
            query.leftJoinAndSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, this.alias)
        } else {
            // If relationship is "one-to-many", left join but do not select any fields
            query.leftJoin(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, this.alias)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Apply the reverse join to a select query, used for filtering when a related record is used
     * as the context for the query.
     */
    public applyReverse(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        if (this.relation.relationType === 'many-to-one' || this.relation.relationType === 'one-to-one') {
            query.innerJoin(this.entity, this.alias, `${this.alias}.${this.relation.propertyPath} = ${parentAlias}.id`)
        } else {
            query.innerJoin(this.entity, this.alias, `${parentAlias}.${this.relation.inverseSidePropertyPath} = ${this.alias}.id`)
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the table alias used in the query for this relationship.
     */
    public getAlias() {
        return this.alias
    }

    /**
     * Returns the property name which represents this relationship in the entity.
     */
    public getProperty() {
        return this.property as string
    }

    /**
     * Returns the configuration metadata for this relationship.
     */
    public getRelation() {
        return this.relation
    }

    /**
     * Returns the target entity of this relationship.
     */
    public getTarget() {
        return this.target
    }

    /**
     * Returns whether this option represents a "one-to-many" relationship.
     */
    public getToMany() {
        return this.toMany
    }

    public getCanView(application: Application): boolean {
        if (!application || application.isASuperUser() || allowedSubTables.includes(this.entity.name) || !this.property) {
            return true
        }

        const entity = new this.entity()
        const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, this.property as string)

        return this.property === 'id' || !permissionKey
            ? true
            : application.canUser('view', permissionKey)
    }

    public getCanViewData(): string {
        const entity = new this.entity()
        const permissionKey = getPermissionKey(entity, this.property as string)

        return permissionKey || ''
    }
}
````

````typescript
/* eslint-disable max-classes-per-file */
import { Component } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DataOption } from './option'
import { EventEmitter } from 'events'
import { Input } from '../component'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { User } from '../models'

export interface FilterClause {
    configuration?: object
    operator: string
    path: string[]
}

export interface FilterGroup {
    conjunction: 'and' | 'or'
    conditions: (FilterClause | FilterGroup)[]
}

/**
 * A method for filtering a report query using a given `DataOption`.
 */
export abstract class Filter<C extends object, O extends DataOption<any>> extends EventEmitter {
    public constructor(
        protected option: O,
        protected configuration?: C
    ) {
        super()
    }

    /**
     * Apply any necessary changes to a select query in order to filter the results using this
     * filter configuration.
     */
    public abstract applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, loggedOnUser?: User): boolean

    /**
     * Render a component for when this filter's configuration needs to be managed.
     */
    public abstract render(): Component<any, any, any>

    /**
     * Returns the current configuration for this filter.
     */
    public getConfiguration() {
        return this.configuration
    }

    /**
     * Returns the `DataOption` this filter is responsible for filtering.
     */
    public getOption() {
        return this.option
    }
}

// Define a common configuration shape that all text filters use
export interface InputFilterConfiguration {
    value: string | null
}

export abstract class BaseInputFilter<C extends InputFilterConfiguration, O extends DataOption<any>> extends Filter<C, O> {
    protected cachedInput?: Input
    protected isFocused: boolean = false

    public render(): Input {
        if (this.cachedInput) {
            return this.cachedInput
        }

        const input = new Input()
        this.cachedInput = input

        if (this.configuration) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('focus', () => {
            this.isFocused = true
        })

        input.on('blur', () => {
            this.isFocused = false
        })

        input.on('change', event => {
            this.configuration = { ...this.configuration, value: event.value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        // We were having issues with letters vanishing from the Input. SOLUTION: If the user has focus, we ignore any setValue calls from
        // the server that don't match what the user has physically typed.

        // Capture the original method to avoid infinite recursion
        const originalSetValue = input.setValue.bind(input)

        // UI Shield: Intercept server-side value updates. Prevents the "Life of its own" bug where a slow DB query returns and
        // overwrites the letters the user is currently typing.
        input.setValue = (value: string | null) => {
            if (this.isFocused) {
                // Only allow the update if it exactly matches the current box content.
                // This allows internal state sync but blocks stale server "rollbacks".
                if (value === input.getValue()) {
                    return originalSetValue(value)
                }

                // Set the values the same so that when the BACK button is clicked the input displays the correct value.
                // However this does introduce some glitchiness.
                originalSetValue(value)

                // Block the update: User is typing something newer than what the server sent.
                return input
            }

            // Not focused? Safe to let the server update the value normally.
            return originalSetValue(value)
        }

        return input
    }
}
````
