````typescript
import * as models from '../models'
import { AllJobCost, AllSoCosts, Asset, CreditNoteItem, InvoiceItem, JobCost, JobItem, OpportunityAdditionalCost, PurchaseOrderItem, QuoteAdditionalCost, QuoteItem, ReturnsAuthorisation, SalesOrderAdhoc, SalesOrderItem, Site, SupportTicket, TradingCompany, User } from '../models'
import { Base } from '../models/base'
import { BaseOption, DataOption, Filter, FilterClause, FilterGroup, GroupOption, MenuData, RecordSelectData, RelationOption, ReportContext, getDefaultReportOption } from '../reports'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder, getConnection, getManager, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { DEFAULT_MAX_CUSTOM_FIELDS } from '../application/settings'
import { TRADINGCOMPANY } from '../application'
import { getReportOptions } from '../configuration'
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto'

type ModelConstructor<T> = new () => T

interface ParsedFilterClause {
    alias: string
    filter: Filter<any, any>
}

interface ParsedFilterGroup {
    conjunction: 'and' | 'or'
    conditions: (ParsedFilterClause | ParsedFilterGroup)[]
}

interface ParsedOption {
    alias: string
    availableOptions: BaseOption<any>[]
    entity: ModelConstructor<Base>
    nextAlias: string
    option: BaseOption<any>
    path: string[]
    propertyPath: string[]
}

export const DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND = 'Data option not found'

/*
 * Entities with tradingCompany property: Bank, BankReconciliationRule, CashJournal, CreditNote, Customer, Department, GeneralLedger, Invoice, Job, Opportunity, Product, Prospect, PurchaseOrder,
 *    Quote, Resource, SalesOrder, ServiceContract, Shipment, Supplier, SupplierCreditNote, SupplierInvoice, User (plus numbering/audits/notes), VatAdjustment, VatReturn
 * Entity with parentCompany property: Division, WarehouseLocation
 * These entities use one of the above so is used to get the trading company:
*/
export const entitiesToRestrict = [
    AllJobCost.name, AllSoCosts.name, Asset.name, CreditNoteItem.name, InvoiceItem.name, JobCost.name,
    JobItem.name, OpportunityAdditionalCost.name, PurchaseOrderItem.name, QuoteItem.name,
    QuoteAdditionalCost.name, ReturnsAuthorisation.name, SalesOrderItem.name, SalesOrderAdhoc.name,
    Site.name, SupportTicket.name
]

// These are saved in multiple lines so cause list values to multiply up incorrectly in certain circumstances so will be excluded.
// For example if you have 3 lines on a sales order and 2 'allSoCost' items it multiples the 'allSoCost' by 3. It also multiples any total figures by the number of 'allSoCost' lines.
// Therefore it is best to not allow these to be added to lists as relations. Users should create a list of 'allSoCost' etc separately.
// 'allJobCost', 'costs' are similar but if only one is on the list the figures are correct so will leave out of array for now.
// If users use it on other lists that have other line item totals it will likely cause total errors.
export const propertiesThatCannotBeUsedAsRelationsOnLists = ['adhocCosts', 'allSoCost']

export function replaceDiscriminatorValue(sql: string, entityName: string): string {
    const discriminatorValue = `'${entityName}'`
    return sql.replace(/:\.\.\.discriminatorColumnValues/g, discriminatorValue)
}

export class ReportQuery<T extends Base> {
    // SQL aliases must not begin with a number, so prepend a random character a-z
    protected alias: string = String.fromCharCode(Math.floor((Math.random() * 25) + 97)) + randomBytes(3).toString('hex')
    protected cache: ParsedOption[] = []
    protected context?: ReportContext
    protected defaultGrouping: boolean = false
    protected groups: Set<DataOption<any>> = new Set()
    protected limit?: number
    protected offset: number = 0
    protected path?: string[]
    protected select: Set<DataOption<any>> = new Set()
    protected sort?: [DataOption<any>, 'ASC' | 'DESC']
    protected where?: FilterClause | FilterGroup
    protected loggedOnUser: User
    protected loggedOnUserTradingCompany: TradingCompany
    protected clientId: string
    protected tradingCompanyPath: string[] = []

    public constructor(protected entity: ModelConstructor<T>, protected maxCustomFields: number = DEFAULT_MAX_CUSTOM_FIELDS) {
        this.tradingCompanyPath = this.getTradingCompanyPath(entity.name)
    }

    // TODO: rename properties for trading company that are called parentCompany to tradingCompany - Division and WarehouseLocation
    // Also change the report options so they are all 'Trading company' (more specifically they use the constant TRADINGCOMPANY)
    // Division is using 'Company'. WarehouseLocation doesn't have the option currently.
    public getTradingCompanyPath(entityName: string): string[] {
        switch (entityName) {
            case ReturnsAuthorisation.name:
            case SupportTicket.name:
                return ['Customer', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case SalesOrderItem.name:
            case AllSoCosts.name:
            case SalesOrderAdhoc.name:
                return ['Sales order', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case QuoteItem.name:
            case QuoteAdditionalCost.name:
                return ['Quote', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case InvoiceItem.name:
                return ['Invoice', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case CreditNoteItem.name:
                return ['Credit note', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case OpportunityAdditionalCost.name:
                return ['Opportunity', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case PurchaseOrderItem.name:
                return ['Order', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case JobItem.name:
            case JobCost.name:
            case AllJobCost.name:
                return ['Job', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            case Asset.name:
            case Site.name:
                return ['Contract', TRADINGCOMPANY, 'ID']
            default:
                return []
        }
    }

    /**
     * Adds a `MenuData` report option to the query
     */
    public addMenu(menu: MenuData<T>): void {
        this.cache.push({
            alias: this.alias,
            availableOptions: [],
            entity: this.entity,
            option: menu,
            nextAlias: this.alias,
            path: [],
            propertyPath: []
        })

        this.select.add(menu)
    }

    public removeMenu(menu: MenuData<T>): void {
        const index = this.cache.findIndex(item => item.option === menu && item.alias === this.alias)

        if (index !== -1) {
            this.cache.splice(index, 1)
        }

        this.select.delete(menu)
    }

    /**
     * Adds a `RecordSelectData` report option to the query
     */
    public addRecordSelect(recordSelect: RecordSelectData<T>): void {
        this.cache.push({
            alias: this.alias,
            availableOptions: [],
            entity: this.entity,
            option: recordSelect,
            nextAlias: this.alias,
            path: [],
            propertyPath: []
        })

        this.select.add(recordSelect)
    }

    /**
     * Add a report option to the query for selection given its path
     */
    public addSelect(path: string[]): DataOption<any> {
        const option = this.getDataOption(path)

        this.select.add(option)

        return option
    }

    /**
     * Add a report option to the query to group the results given its path
     */
    public addGroupBy(path: string[]): DataOption<any> {
        const option = this.getDataOption(path)

        this.groups.add(option)

        return option
    }

    /**
     * Sets the context for this query, ensuring all results are related to an entity given the
     * report option path.
     */
    public setContext(context: ReportContext, path: string[]): void {
        this.context = context
        this.path = path
    }

    /**
     * Sets whether the query should be grouped by the base entity ID by default if no other groups
     * are provided.
     */
    public setDefaultGrouping(defaultGrouping: boolean): void {
        this.defaultGrouping = defaultGrouping
    }

    /**
     * Limit the number of results returned by this query.

    public setLimit(limit: number): void {
        this.limit = limit
    }

    /**
     * Get the Limit for the number of results returned by this query.
     */
    public getLimit(): number {
        return this.limit
    }

    /**
     * Set the offset for results returned by this query.
     */
    public setOffset(offset: number): void {
        this.offset = offset
    }

    /**

    public setOrderBy(path: string[], direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): DataOption<any> {

    /**

    public setWhere(filter: FilterClause | FilterGroup): void {
        this.where = filter

    public addWhereCondition(filter: FilterClause): void {
        if ('conditions' in this.where && 'conjunction' in this.where) {
            this.where.conditions.push(filter)
        } else {
            throw new Error('Wrong where type. Must be a FilterGroup with existing conditions.')
        }
    }

    public setClientId(clientId: string): this {
        this.clientId = clientId

    public getClientId(): string {

    public setLoggedOnUserTradingCompany(tradingCompany: TradingCompany): this {

    public getAliasForColumn(property: string, entity: any): string | undefined {
        const cached = this.cache.find(cached => JSON.stringify(property) === JSON.stringify(cached.path[cached.path.length - 1]))

        return cached ? cached.alias : undefined
    }

    /**
     * Given a report option path, find a matching `DataOption` if one exists and add it to the
     * query cache.
     */
    public getDataOption(path: string[], allowRelationOptions = false): DataOption<any> {
        // Keep track of the current entity, available options, and table alias
        let { alias } = this
        let { entity } = this
        let availableOptions = getReportOptions(entity, this.maxCustomFields)
        let nextAlias = alias
        let option: BaseOption<any>
        let propertyPath: string[] = []

        // Iterate through the path, and update the current entity and options as necessary
        if (path !== undefined && path !== null) {
            for (let index = 0; index < path.length; index++) {
            // Check if this portion of the path has already been cached
                const partialPath = path.slice(0, index + 1)
                const cached = this.cache.find(cached => JSON.stringify(partialPath) === JSON.stringify(cached.path))

                // eslint-disable-next-line no-negated-condition
                if (cached !== undefined) {
                // Partial path has been cached, update the current entity, available options, and
                // table alias
                    availableOptions = cached.availableOptions
                    entity = cached.entity
                    nextAlias = cached.nextAlias
                    option = cached.option
                    propertyPath = cached.propertyPath
                } else {
                // Cache all available options which have been flagged as required, to ensure that
                // they are selected when this query is executed
                    for (const required of availableOptions.filter(option => option.getRequired() === true)) {
                        const requiredPath = [...path.slice(0, index), required.getLabel()]

                        if (required instanceof RelationOption) {
                            this.cache.push({
                                alias,
                                availableOptions: getReportOptions(required.getTarget(), this.maxCustomFields),
                                entity: required.getTarget(),
                                nextAlias: required.getAlias(),
                                option: required,
                                propertyPath: [...propertyPath, required.getProperty()],
                                path: requiredPath
                            })
                        } else {
                            this.cache.push({
                                alias,
                                availableOptions,
                                entity,
                                nextAlias,
                                option,
                                propertyPath,
                                path: requiredPath
                            })
                        }
                    }

                    // Find the current option in the available options
                    option = availableOptions.find(option => option.getLabel() === path[index])

                    if (option === undefined) {
                        option = getDefaultReportOption()
                        console.error(`Option "${path[index]}" not found`)
                    }

                    // Cache all options which have been flagged as depedencies of this option, to
                    // ensure that they are selected when this query is executed
                    for (const dependent of option.getDependentOptions()) {
                        const dependentPath = [...path.slice(0, index), dependent.getLabel()]

                        if (dependent instanceof RelationOption) {
                            this.cache.push({
                                alias,
                                availableOptions: getReportOptions(dependent.getTarget(), this.maxCustomFields),
                                entity: dependent.getTarget(),
                                nextAlias: dependent.getAlias(),
                                option: dependent,
                                propertyPath: [...propertyPath, dependent.getProperty()],
                                path: dependentPath
                            })
                        } else {
                            this.cache.push({
                                alias,
                                availableOptions,
                                entity,
                                nextAlias,
                                option,
                                propertyPath,
                                path: dependentPath
                            })
                        }
                    }

                    if (option instanceof GroupOption) {
                    // Option represents a group, get the new available options from the group
                        availableOptions = option.getChildren()
                    } else if (option instanceof RelationOption) {
                    // Option represents a relationship, update the current entity and table alias
                    // and get the new available options
                        nextAlias = option.getAlias()
                        entity = option.getTarget()
                        availableOptions = getReportOptions(entity, this.maxCustomFields)
                        propertyPath = [...propertyPath, option.getProperty()]
                    }

                    // Add the option to the cache
                    this.cache.push({
                        alias,
                        availableOptions,
                        entity,
                        nextAlias,
                        option,
                        propertyPath,
                        path: partialPath
                    })
                }

                alias = nextAlias
            }
        }

        // If the resolved option isn't a `DataOption`, throw an error
        if (option === undefined) {
            option = getDefaultReportOption()
            console.error(`Option "${path !== null ? path[path.length - 1] : null}" not found`)
        }

        if (!(option instanceof DataOption) && (option instanceof DataOption && !allowRelationOptions)) {
            throw new Error(`Option "${path !== null ? path[path.length - 1] : null}" is of type ${option.constructor.name}, which is not a DataOption`)
        }

        return option
    }

    /**
     * Execute the current query, returning the number of found records only
     */
    public async getCount(): Promise<number> {
        return await this.parseQuery(true, true).getCount() // Simple total
    }

    /**
     * Execute the current query, returning a set of results where a result is a map where the key
     * is the `DataOption` instance, and the value is a tuple containing the entity instance and the
     * raw result values.
     */
    public async getResults(isQueryForAggregate = false, isSimpleAggregate = false): Promise<Set<Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]>>> {
        // Execute the query
        const results: Set<Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]>> = new Set()

        const { entities, raw } = await this.parseQuery(isQueryForAggregate, isSimpleAggregate).getRawAndEntities()

        // Iterate through the results, mapping the results to the `DataOption` that requested the data
        for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
            const result: Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]> = new Map()

            for (const option of this.select) {
                const cachedOption = this.cache.find(cached => cached.option === option)

                if (!cachedOption) {
                    continue
                }

                let entity: Base | null = entities[i]

                for (const property of cachedOption.propertyPath) {
                    if (
                        entity !== null &&
                        entity !== undefined &&
                        (entity as any)[property] !== undefined &&
                        (entity as any)[property] !== null
                    ) {
                        entity = (entity as any)[property]
                    } else {
                        entity = null
                    }
                }

                result.set(option, [entity, raw[i]])
            }

            results.add(result)
        }

        return results
    }

    public getCompactSql(): string {
        const sourceMetadata = getConnection().getMetadata(this.entity)
        const { tableName } = sourceMetadata
        const originalQuery = this.parseQuery()
        const parameters = originalQuery.getParameters()
        const originalSQL = originalQuery.getQuery()

        // Need the joins in case the list requires the id from a relation (e.g. project_branch)
        const indexofLastFrom = originalSQL.lastIndexOf('FROM `' + `${tableName}` + '` `')
        const fromWhereGroupOrder = originalSQL.substring(indexofLastFrom)

        let sql = `/* User ID: ${this.loggedOnUser.id} [compact results] */ SELECT \`${this.alias}\`.\`id\` ${fromWhereGroupOrder}`

        // For Task and CallLog specifically because they use TableInheritance (from TaskCallLog) we need to inject the model_type
        sql = replaceDiscriminatorValue(sql, this.entity.name)

        for (const item of Object.entries(parameters)) {
            sql = sql.replace(`:${item[0]}`, `'${item[1]}'`)
        }

        return sql
    }

    public clone(): ReportQuery<T> {
        const query = new ReportQuery<T>(this.entity, this.maxCustomFields)

        query.alias = this.alias
        query.cache = [...this.cache]
        query.context = this.context
        query.defaultGrouping = this.defaultGrouping
        query.groups = new Set(this.groups)
        query.limit = this.limit
        query.offset = this.offset
        query.path = this.path ? [...this.path] : undefined
        query.select = new Set(this.select)
        query.sort = this.sort
        query.loggedOnUser = this.loggedOnUser
        query.loggedOnUserTradingCompany = this.loggedOnUserTradingCompany
        query.clientId = this.clientId
        query.tradingCompanyPath = [...this.tradingCompanyPath]

        return query
    }

    // Get just the id of the entity to reduce time taken to fetch massively. Used for record selection checkboxes only.
    public async getCompactResults(existingSql?: string): Promise<Base[]> {
        const sql = existingSql ? existingSql : this.getCompactSql()
        const results = await getManager().query(sql, [])
        const entities: Base[] = []

        for (const result of results) {
            // Convert RowPacketData object to a model (with just the id)
            const instance = new models[this.entity.name as keyof typeof models]()
            instance.id = result.id
            entities.push(instance)
        }

        return entities
    }

    /**
     * Creates an SQL query using the current configuration of this report query.
     */
    public parseQuery(isQueryForAggregate = false, isSimpleAggregate = false): SelectQueryBuilder<T> {
        // Create a select query against this report query's base entity
        const repository = getRepository(this.entity)
        const query = repository.createQueryBuilder(this.alias)
        const hasTradingCompanyfield = repository.metadata.ownColumns.find(column => column.databaseName === 'trading_company_id') !== undefined
        const hasParentCompanyfield = repository.metadata.ownColumns.find(column => column.databaseName === 'parent_company_id') !== undefined

        const primaryField = repository.metadata.primaryColumns[0].databaseName || 'id'

        query.comment(`User ID: ${this.loggedOnUser.id}`)

        // Apply limit and offset to query
        if (this.limit !== -1) {
            query.limit(this.limit)
            query.offset(this.offset)
        }

        // If the query is for a total there is no need to order the data
        // isQueryForAggregate = false // #3779 uncomment this to stop use of this if there is a problem

        if (!isQueryForAggregate) {
            // Apply ordering to the query
            if (this.sort !== undefined) {
                // Apply user defined sorting to the query
                const cachedOption = this.cache.find(cached => cached.option === this.sort[0])

                this.sort[0].applySort(query, cachedOption.alias, this.sort[1])
            } else {
                // No sorting has been provided, sort by the the base entity's  primaryField (usually ID but can be different - see StockValues but only a probem if there is a report option for id)
                query.addOrderBy(`\`${this.alias}\`.\`${primaryField}\``, 'DESC')
            }
        }

        // groupBy is required sometimes by totals depending on how data is built.
        // isSimpleAggregate = false // #3793 uncomment this to stop use of this if there is a problem
        if (!isSimpleAggregate) {
            // Apply grouping to this query
            if (this.groups.size === 0 && this.defaultGrouping === true) {
                // No grouping has been provided, and default grouping is enabled, group by the base
                // entity's primaryField (usually ID but can be different - see StockValues but only a probem if there is a report option for id)
                query.groupBy(`\`${this.alias}\`.\`${primaryField}\``)
            } else {
                // Apply all user defined groups to this query
                for (const option of this.groups) {
                    const cachedOption = this.cache.find(cached => cached.option === option)

                    option.applyGroup(query, cachedOption.alias)
                }
            }
        }

        // Apply filtering to this query
        const tradingCompanyCondition: FilterClause = {
            path: this.tradingCompanyPath,
            operator: 'equals',
            configuration: { value: this.loggedOnUserTradingCompany.id }
        }

        const tradingCompanyFilterGroup: FilterGroup = {
            conjunction: 'and',
            conditions: [tradingCompanyCondition]
        }

        if (this.where === undefined) {
            if (entitiesToRestrict.includes(this.entity.name)) {
                this.setWhere(tradingCompanyFilterGroup)
                this.applyCondition(query, this.parseCondition(this.where))
            }
        } else {
            if (entitiesToRestrict.includes(this.entity.name)) {
                if ('conditions' in this.where && 'conjunction' in this.where) {
                    if (!this.where.conditions.find(condition => (condition as FilterClause).path && (condition as FilterClause).path.includes(TRADINGCOMPANY))) {
                        this.addWhereCondition(tradingCompanyCondition)
                    }
                }
            }

            this.applyCondition(query, this.parseCondition(this.where))
        }

        // Select all cached `DataOption` as required by this query
        for (const cached of this.cache) {
            cached.option.applySelect(query, cached.alias)
        }

        // Apply context filtering to the query if required
        this.applyContext(query)

        // Hide user 1 and 2 from user queries (admin and system) if user is not super user
        if (this.entity.name === 'User' && Number(this.loggedOnUser.id) > 2) {
            query.andWhere(`\`${this.alias}\`.\`id\` > 2`)
        }

        // Hide user 1 and 2 from userTradingCompany (join table) queries (admin and system) if user is not super user
        if (this.entity.name === 'UserTradingCompany' && Number(this.loggedOnUser.id) > 2) {
            query.andWhere(`\`${this.alias}\`.\`user_id\` > 2`)
        }

        // Apply filtering so data is specific to user's trading company --- unless showing a list of userTradingCompanies
        if ((hasTradingCompanyfield || hasParentCompanyfield) && this.entity.name !== 'UserTradingCompany') {
            if (!this.loggedOnUserTradingCompany) {
                throw new Error('User\'s trading company has not been set')
            }

            const tradingOrParentCompanyPropertyName = hasTradingCompanyfield ? 'trading_company_id' : 'parent_company_id'

            query.andWhere(new Brackets(subQuery => {
                subQuery.where(`\`${this.alias}\`.\`${tradingOrParentCompanyPropertyName}\` = :tradingCompanyId`, { tradingCompanyId: this.loggedOnUserTradingCompany.id })
                subQuery.orWhere(`\`${this.alias}\`.\`${tradingOrParentCompanyPropertyName}\` IS NULL`)
            }))
        }

        return query
    }

    protected applyContext(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>): void {
        if (this.context !== undefined) {
            const options: RelationOption<any>[] = []

            let currentAlias = this.alias
            let currentEntity = this.context.entity
            let currentOptions: BaseOption<any>[] = getReportOptions(currentEntity, this.maxCustomFields)

            for (const item of this.path) {
                let option = currentOptions.find(option => option.getLabel() === item)

                if (option === undefined) {
                    option = getDefaultReportOption()
                    console.error(`Invalid option "${item}"`)
                }

                if (option instanceof RelationOption) {
                    options.unshift(option)
                    currentEntity = option.getTarget()
                    currentOptions = getReportOptions(currentEntity, this.maxCustomFields)
                } else if (option instanceof GroupOption) {
                    currentOptions = option.getChildren()
                }
            }

            for (const option of options) {
                option.applyReverse(query, currentAlias)
                currentAlias = option.getAlias()
            }

            if (this.context.id) {
                query.andWhere(`${currentAlias}.id = :id`, { id: this.context.id })
            } else if (this.context.ids.length > 0) {
                query.andWhere(`${currentAlias}.id IN(:ids)`, { ids: this.context.ids })
            } else if (this.context.ids.length === 0) {
                query.andWhere('1 = 0')
            }
        }
    }

    protected applyCondition(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, condition: ParsedFilterClause | ParsedFilterGroup): void {
        const isFilterClause = (condition: any): condition is ParsedFilterClause => typeof condition === 'object' &&
            typeof condition.alias === 'string' &&
            condition.filter instanceof Filter

        const testClause = (condition: ParsedFilterClause): boolean => {
            const query = new SelectQueryBuilder(getRepository(this.entity).manager.connection)

            return condition.filter.applyWhere(query, condition.alias, this.loggedOnUser)
        }

        const testGroup = (condition: ParsedFilterGroup): boolean => {
            let apply = false

            for (const clause of condition.conditions) {
                if (isFilterClause(clause)) {
                    if (testClause(clause)) {
                        apply = true
                    }
                } else if (testGroup(clause)) {
                    apply = true
                }
            }

            return apply
        }

        const parseGroup = (query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, condition: ParsedFilterGroup): Brackets => {
            if (testGroup(condition)) {
                return new Brackets(query => {
                    for (const clause of condition.conditions) {
                        let parsed: Brackets

                        if (isFilterClause(clause)) {
                            if (testClause(clause)) {
                                parsed = new Brackets(query => parseClause(query as SelectQueryBuilder<any>, clause))
                            }
                        } else {
                            parsed = parseGroup(query as SelectQueryBuilder<any>, clause)
                        }

                        if (parsed !== undefined) {
                            if (condition.conjunction === 'and') {
                                query.andWhere(parsed)
                            } else {
                                query.orWhere(parsed)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                })
            }
        }

        const parseClause = (query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, condition: ParsedFilterClause) => condition.filter.applyWhere(query, condition.alias, this.loggedOnUser)

        if (isFilterClause(condition)) {
            parseClause(query, condition)
        } else {
            const parsed = parseGroup(query, condition)

            if (parsed !== undefined) {
                query.andWhere(parsed)
            }
        }
    }

    protected parseCondition(condition: FilterClause | FilterGroup): ParsedFilterClause | ParsedFilterGroup {
        const isFilterClause = (condition: any): condition is FilterClause => typeof condition.operator === 'string' &&
            Array.isArray(condition.path)

        if (isFilterClause(condition)) {
            const option = this.getDataOption(condition.path)
            const cachedOption = this.cache.find(cache => cache.option === option)
            const filterType = option.getFilter(condition.operator)

            if (filterType === undefined) {
                throw new Error(`Filter operator "${condition.operator}" is unknown`)
            }

            return {
                alias: cachedOption.alias,
                filter: new filterType(option, condition.configuration)
            }
        }

        return {
            conjunction: condition.conjunction,
            conditions: condition.conditions.map(condition => this.parseCondition(condition))
        }
    }
}
````

### Capsule server/reports/getOptionForPath.ts

Source `server/reports/getOptionForPath.ts:1`.

````typescript
import { Base } from '../models/base'
import { BaseOption, DataOption, GroupOption, RelationOption, getDefaultReportOption } from '../reports'
import { getReportOptions } from '../configuration'

/**
 * Given a base entity and a path, return the `DataOption` if one exists.
 *
 * For example if the base entity is `Customer` and the path is `["Company", "Name"]`, the
 * `DataOption` with the label `"Name"` will be returned from the `Company` entity via the
 * `Customer.company` relation.
 */
export function getOptionForPath(entity: typeof Base, path: string[]): DataOption<any> {
    // Keep track of current entity and options in the path
    let currentEntity: typeof Base = entity
    let currentOption: BaseOption<any>
    let availableOptions: BaseOption<any>[] = getReportOptions(currentEntity)

    // Iterate through the path, and update the current entity and options as necessary
    for (const entry of path) {
        // Find the current option in the available options
        currentOption = availableOptions.find(option => option.getLabel() === entry)

        // If no option was found, throw an error
        if (currentOption === undefined) {
            currentOption = getDefaultReportOption()
            console.error(`Option "${entry}" not found`)
        }

        if (currentOption instanceof GroupOption) {
            // Option represents a group, get the new available options from the group
            availableOptions = currentOption.getChildren()
        } else if (currentOption instanceof RelationOption) {
            // Option represents a relationship, update the current entity and get the new options
            currentEntity = currentOption.getTarget()
            availableOptions = getReportOptions(currentEntity)
        }
    }

    // If the resolved option isn't a `DataOption`, throw an error
    if (!(currentOption instanceof DataOption)) {
        throw new Error(`Option "${path.join('.')}" is not a DataOption`)
    }

    return currentOption
}
````

````typescript
import * as models from '../models'
import { Application, Permissions } from '../application'
import { allowedSubTables } from '../reports'
import { getReportOptions } from '../configuration'

function hasFieldKeyStartingWith(permissions: Permissions, prefix: string): boolean {
    for (const [key, permission] of Object.entries(permissions)) {
        if (key.startsWith(prefix) && permission.type === 'field') {
            return true
        }
    }

    return false
}

function hasFieldGroupKeyStartingWith(permissions: Permissions, prefix: string): boolean {
    for (const [key, permission] of Object.entries(permissions)) {
        if (key.startsWith(prefix) && permission.type === 'group' && permission.description === 'Fields') {
            return true
        }
    }

    return false
}

export function getSourceTables(application: Application, dashboardName: string): any[] {
    let sourceTables = Object.values(models).filter(model => getReportOptions(model).length > 0 && !allowedSubTables.includes(model.name))

    if (dashboardName === 'myhr') {
        sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(
            item => item.name === 'Employee' ||
            item.name === 'EmployeeNextOfKin' ||
            item.name === 'StaffDisciplinary' ||
            item.name === 'Absence' ||
            item.name === 'AbsenceApproval' ||
            item.name === 'AbsenceType'
        )
    }

    if (!application.isASuperUser()) {
        const lookup = application.getTablePermissionLookUp()
        const allSecurityPermissions: Permissions = application.getPermissions()

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('project')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== 'Project')
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('warehouse')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== 'WarehouseLocation')
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('opportunity')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== 'Opportunity' && item.name !== 'OpportunityAdditionalCost')
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('humanResource')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(
                item => item.name !== 'Employee' &&
                item.name !== 'EmployeeNextOfKin' &&
                item.name !== 'StaffDisciplinary'
            )
        }

        if (!application.isModuleEnabled('serviceContract')) {
            sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(
                item => item.name !== 'Asset' &&
                item.name !== 'ServiceContract' &&
                item.name !== 'Site' &&
                item.name !== 'SupportTicket'
            )
        }

        for (const sourceTable of sourceTables) {
            if (lookup.some(item => item.table === sourceTable.name)) {
                const permissionName = lookup.find(item => item.table === sourceTable.name).permission

                if (
                    allSecurityPermissions[permissionName] ||
                    hasFieldGroupKeyStartingWith(allSecurityPermissions, `${permissionName}/`) ||
                    hasFieldKeyStartingWith(allSecurityPermissions, `${permissionName}/`)
                ) {
                    continue
                }

                sourceTables = sourceTables.filter(item => item.name !== sourceTable.name)
            } else {
                throw new Error(`Table missing - details need to be added to tablePermissionLookup or allowedSubTables for: ${sourceTable.name}`)
            }
        }
    }

    return sourceTables
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, AggregateGroup, BaseOption, DataOption, GroupOption, RelationOption, propertiesThatCannotBeUsedAsRelationsOnLists } from '../reports'
import { Application } from '../application'
import { Base } from '../models/base'
import { ColumnList, HorizontalScrollContainer, ListItem } from '.'
import { Component, FlexContainer, Icon, List, Menu, MenuItem } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DEFAULT_MAX_CUSTOM_FIELDS } from '../application/settings'
import { getMetadataArgsStorage } from 'typeorm'
import { getReportOptions } from '../configuration'

interface ListOptionsContainerEvents {
    click: { option: DataOption<any>, path: string[] }
}

export class ListOptionsContainer extends Component<{}, ListOptionsContainerEvents> {
    protected items: ListItem[] = []
    protected listContainer = new HorizontalScrollContainer()
    protected list: ColumnList
    protected maxFields: number = DEFAULT_MAX_CUSTOM_FIELDS
    protected relationIsOneOfMany: boolean = false

    public constructor(
        protected entity: typeof Base,
        protected application: Application,
        protected showNonAggregate: boolean = true,
        protected showAggregate: boolean = true,
        protected exceptions: string[][] = [],
        protected filterCallback: (option: DataOption<any>) => boolean = () => true,
        protected path: string[] = [],
        protected parentContainer?: Component,
        protected parent?: typeof Base
    ) {
        super()

        this.maxFields = application.getMaxCustomFields()

        const pathOptionNameToCheck = path.length > 0 ? path[path.length - 1] : undefined
        const reportOptionsOfParent = parent ? getReportOptions(parent) : undefined
        const reportOptionOfActualEntity = reportOptionsOfParent && reportOptionsOfParent.find(option => option.getLabel() === pathOptionNameToCheck)

        if (reportOptionOfActualEntity && reportOptionOfActualEntity instanceof RelationOption) {
            const propertyToCheck = reportOptionOfActualEntity.getProperty()

            const isPropertyOneToMany = propertyToCheck ? this.isOneToMany(parent, propertyToCheck) : false

            if (isPropertyOneToMany) {
                this.showNonAggregate = false
                this.showAggregate = true
                this.relationIsOneOfMany = true
            }
        }

        this.items = this.parseOptions(
            entity,
            getReportOptions(entity, this.maxFields).sort(this.sortOptions),
            path,
            this.showNonAggregate,
            this.showAggregate,
            parent
        )
    }

    protected getAsync(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    public async build(): Promise<Component> {
        this.list = new ColumnList().addChild(...this.items)

        this.listContainer.clearChildren().addChild(this.list)

        const container = new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(this.listContainer)

        return this.parentContainer ? this.list : container
    }

    protected sortOptions(first: BaseOption<any>, second: BaseOption<any>): number {
        const firstLabel = first.getLabel()
        const secondLabel = second.getLabel()

        if (firstLabel < secondLabel) {
            return -1
        } else if (firstLabel > secondLabel) {
            return 1
        }

        return 0
    }

    protected parseOptions(
        entity: typeof Base,
        options: BaseOption<any>[],
        path: string[],
        showNonAggregate: boolean,
        showAggregate: boolean,
        parent?: typeof Base
    ): ListItem[] {
        const items: ListItem[] = []

        for (const option of options.filter(opt => opt.getCanView(this.application))) {
            let item = new ListItem(option.getLabel()).setIsButton(true)

            if (option instanceof GroupOption) {
                if (option instanceof AggregateGroup && !showAggregate) {
                    continue
                }

                const groupOptions = Array.from(option.getChildren()).sort(this.sortOptions)

                if (
                    (groupOptions.length <= 0) ||
                    (showAggregate && !showNonAggregate && groupOptions.every(option => !(option instanceof AggregateData))) ||
                    (!showAggregate && showNonAggregate && groupOptions.every(option => option instanceof AggregateData)) ||
                    (!showAggregate && !showNonAggregate)
                ) {
                    continue
                }

                if (groupOptions.length > 0) {
                    item.setEndIcon(new Icon('ArrowForwardIos'))
                        .on('click', () => {
                            const groupOptionItems = this.parseOptions(
                                entity,
                                groupOptions,
                                [...path, option.getLabel()],
                                showNonAggregate,
                                showAggregate,
                                entity
                            )

                            const groupMenu = new List()

                            if (groupOptionItems.length > 0) {
                                groupMenu.addChild(...groupOptionItems)
                            } else {
                                groupMenu.addChild(new ListItem('No options found'))
                            }

                            this.rebuildList(item, groupMenu)
                        })
                }
            } else if (option instanceof RelationOption) {
                if (propertiesThatCannotBeUsedAsRelationsOnLists.includes(option.getProperty())) {
                    continue
                }

                // Removed check for option being the same as the entity so that options that refer to themselves can be chosen. E.g. parent job.
                // Do not show non aggregate options of One To Many relations.
                if (option.getTarget() !== parent && !path.includes(option.getLabel()) && this.relationIsOneOfMany === false) {
                    const relationOptions = getReportOptions(option.getTarget(), this.maxFields).sort(this.sortOptions)

                    if (relationOptions.length > 0) {
                        item.setEndIcon(new Icon('ArrowForwardIos'))
                            .on('click', () => {
                                const container = this.parentContainer ? this.parentContainer : this.listContainer
                                const relationList = new ListOptionsContainer(
                                    option.getTarget(), this.application, showNonAggregate, showAggregate, undefined, this.filterCallback, [...path, option.getLabel()], container, entity
                                )
                                    .on('click', ({ option, path }) => this.emit('click', { option, path }))

                                this.rebuildList(item, relationList)
                            })
                    } else {
                        item.addChild(new Menu().addChild(new MenuItem('No options found').setDisabled(true)))
                    }
                } else {
                    continue
                }
            } else {
                let isException = false

                for (const exception of this.exceptions) {
                    if (
                        JSON.stringify(exception.slice(0, -1)) === JSON.stringify([...path]) &&
                        option.getLabel() === exception[exception.length - 1]
                    ) {
                        isException = true
                    }
                }

                if (
                    isException === false &&
                    (this.filterCallback(option as DataOption<any>) === false ||
                        showNonAggregate === false && !(option instanceof AggregateData) ||
                        (showAggregate === false || this.showAggregate === false) && option instanceof AggregateData)
                ) {
                    continue
                }

                item.on('click', async () => {
                    item.setSelected(true)
                    this.emit('click', { option: option as DataOption<any>, path: [...path, option.getLabel()] })
                })
            }

            items.push(item)
        }

        return items
    }

    protected rebuildList(item: ListItem, list: (ListOptionsContainer | List)): void {
        this.items.forEach(item => item.setSelected(false))
        item.setSelected(true)
        const newChildren = this.getFilteredChildren()

        if (this.parentContainer) {
            this.parentContainer.clearChildren().addChild(...newChildren, list).invalidateCache()
        } else {
            this.listContainer.clearChildren().addChild(...newChildren, list).invalidateCache()
        }
    }

    protected getFilteredChildren(): Component[] {
        const children = this.parentContainer ? this.parentContainer.getChildren() : this.listContainer.getChildren()
        const newChildren: Component[] = []

        for (const child of children) {
            newChildren.push(child)

            if (child === this || child === this.list) {
                break
            }
        }

        return newChildren
    }

    private isOneToMany(entity: typeof Base, propertyName: string): boolean {
        const relationMetadata = getMetadataArgsStorage().relations.find(
            relation => relation.target === entity && relation.propertyName.toLowerCase() === propertyName.toLowerCase()
        )

        return relationMetadata && relationMetadata.relationType === 'one-to-many'
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData, BaseOption, DataOption, GroupOption, NumberData, RelationOption, getDefaultReportOption } from '../reports'
import { Base } from '../models/base'
import { Button, Input } from '../component'
import { Checkbox, Component, Dialog, Divider, DropdownMenu, Icon, Menu, MenuItem, Tooltip } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { getReportOptions } from '../configuration'

export interface ListColumnConfigurationEvents {
    change: {}
    remove: {}
    up: {}
    down: {}
    toTop: {}
    toBottom: {}
}

export interface ListColumnConfigurationProps {
    dialog?: Dialog
    label: string
    menu: DropdownMenu
    path: string[]
    groupBy?: boolean
    subSummary?: boolean
    summaryType?: string
}

export class ListColumnConfiguration extends Component<ListColumnConfigurationProps, ListColumnConfigurationEvents> {
    protected dialog?: Dialog
    protected menu: DropdownMenu
    protected option: DataOption<any>

    protected align?: 'center' | 'left' | 'right'
    protected label?: string
    protected sticky?: boolean
    protected wrap?: boolean
    protected width?: number
    protected minimumWidth?: number
    protected totalType?: string
    protected groupBy?: boolean
    protected subSummary?: boolean
    protected summaryType?: string = 'sum'
    protected moveDown = new MenuItem('Move down (right)')
    protected moveUp = new MenuItem('Move up (left)')
    protected moveToTop = new MenuItem('Move to top')
    protected moveToBottom = new MenuItem('Move to bottom')

    public constructor(
        protected entity: typeof Base,
        protected path: string[]
    ) {
        super()

        this.label = this.path !== undefined && this.path !== null
            ? this.path[this.path.length - 1]
            : '-'

        this.menu = new DropdownMenu().addChild(
            new Menu().addChild(
                new MenuItem('Remove').on('click', this.onRemove.bind(this))
            )
        )

        let currentOption: BaseOption<any> | undefined
        let currentOptions: BaseOption<any>[] = getReportOptions(this.entity)

        if (this.path !== undefined && this.path !== null) {
            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/prefer-for-of
            for (let index = 0; index < this.path.length; index++) {
                currentOption = currentOptions.find(option => option.getLabel() === this.path[index])

                if (currentOption === undefined) {
                    currentOption = getDefaultReportOption()
                    console.error(`Invalid option "${this.path[index]}"`)
                }

                if (currentOption instanceof RelationOption) {
                    currentOptions = getReportOptions(currentOption.getTarget())
                } else if (currentOption instanceof GroupOption) {
                    currentOptions = currentOption.getChildren()
                }
            }
        }

        this.option = currentOption as DataOption<any>
    }

    protected setUpMenuAsDisabled(disabled: boolean): void {
        this.moveUp.setDisabled(disabled)
    }

    protected setDownMenuAsDisabled(disabled: boolean): void {
        this.moveDown.setDisabled(disabled)
    }

    protected setToTopMenuAsDisabled(disabled: boolean): void {
        this.moveToTop.setDisabled(disabled)
    }

    protected setToBottomMenuAsDisabled(disabled: boolean): void {
        this.moveToBottom.setDisabled(disabled)
    }

    public setToTopAndUpMenusAsDisabled(disabled: boolean): void {
        this.setUpMenuAsDisabled(disabled)
        this.setToTopMenuAsDisabled(disabled)
    }

    public setToBottomAndDownMenusAsDisabled(disabled: boolean): void {
        this.setDownMenuAsDisabled(disabled)
        this.setToBottomMenuAsDisabled(disabled)
    }

    public setConfiguration(
        align: 'center' | 'left' | 'right',
        label: string,
        sticky: boolean,
        wrap: boolean,
        width?: number,
        minimumWidth?: number,
        totalType?: string,
        position?: 'FIRST' | 'LAST' | 'MIDDLE' | 'ONLY',
        groupBy?: boolean,
        subSummary?: boolean,
        summaryType?: string
    ): this {
        this.align = align
        this.label = label
        this.sticky = sticky
        this.wrap = wrap
        this.width = width
        this.minimumWidth = minimumWidth
        this.totalType = totalType
        this.groupBy = groupBy
        this.subSummary = subSummary
        this.summaryType = summaryType

        this.dialog = new Dialog().setOpen(false)

        const alignLeft = new MenuItem('Left').setInset(true).setIcon(this.align === 'left' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined).setStopPropagation(true)
        const alignCenter = new MenuItem('Center').setInset(true).setIcon(this.align === 'center' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined).setStopPropagation(true)
        const alignRight = new MenuItem('Right').setInset(true).setIcon(this.align === 'right' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined).setStopPropagation(true)
        const toggleSticky = new MenuItem('Sticky').setInset(true).setIcon(this.sticky ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined).setStopPropagation(true)
        const toggleWrap = new MenuItem('Wrap text').setInset(true).setIcon(this.wrap ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined).setStopPropagation(true)
        const setWidth = new MenuItem('Width').on('click', () => this.onSetWidth(toggleWrap))

        const setsubSummarySum = new MenuItem('sum')
            .setIcon(this.summaryType === 'sum' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setInset(true)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                this.summaryType = 'sum'
                setsubSummarySum.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
                setsubSummaryAvg.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMin.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMax.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryCount.setIcon(undefined)
            })

        const setsubSummaryAvg = new MenuItem('avg')
            .setIcon(this.summaryType === 'avg' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setInset(true)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                this.summaryType = 'avg'
                setsubSummarySum.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryAvg.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
                setsubSummaryMin.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMax.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryCount.setIcon(undefined)
            })

        const setsubSummaryMin = new MenuItem('min')
            .setIcon(this.summaryType === 'min' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setInset(true)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                this.summaryType = 'min'
                setsubSummarySum.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryAvg.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMin.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
                setsubSummaryMax.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryCount.setIcon(undefined)
            })

        const setsubSummaryMax = new MenuItem('max')
            .setIcon(this.summaryType === 'max' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setInset(true)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                this.summaryType = 'max'
                setsubSummarySum.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryAvg.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMin.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMax.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
                setsubSummaryCount.setIcon(undefined)
            })

        const setsubSummaryCount = new MenuItem('count')
            .setIcon(this.summaryType === 'count' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setInset(true)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                this.summaryType = 'count'
                setsubSummarySum.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryAvg.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMin.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryMax.setIcon(undefined)
                setsubSummaryCount.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
            })

        const setSubSummary = new MenuItem(subSummary ? 'Remove sub summary' : 'Make as sub summary').on('click', () => {
            this.subSummary = !this.subSummary
            this.summaryType = 'sum'

            setsubSummarySum.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
            setsubSummaryAvg.setIcon(undefined)
            setsubSummaryMin.setIcon(undefined)
            setsubSummaryMax.setIcon(undefined)
            setsubSummaryCount.setIcon(undefined)
        })

        const setGroupBy = new MenuItem(groupBy ? 'Remove group' : 'Make as group').on('click', () => {
            this.groupBy = !this.groupBy
        })

        this.moveDown.on('click', this.onDown.bind(this))
        this.moveUp.on('click', this.onUp.bind(this))
        this.moveToTop.on('click', this.onToTop.bind(this))
        this.moveToBottom.on('click', this.onToBottom.bind(this))

        if (position === 'FIRST') {
            this.setToTopAndUpMenusAsDisabled(true)
        } else if (position === 'LAST') {
            this.setToBottomAndDownMenusAsDisabled(true)
        } else if (position === 'ONLY') {
            this.setToTopAndUpMenusAsDisabled(true)
            this.setToBottomAndDownMenusAsDisabled(true)
        }

        this.emit('up', {})

        this.menu.setOpen(false)

        alignLeft.on('click', () => {
            alignLeft.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
            alignCenter.setIcon(undefined)
            alignRight.setIcon(undefined)

            this.align = 'left'

            this.emit('change', {})
        })

        alignCenter.on('click', () => {
            alignLeft.setIcon(undefined)
            alignCenter.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))
            alignRight.setIcon(undefined)

            this.align = 'center'

            this.emit('change', {})
        })

        alignRight.on('click', () => {
            alignLeft.setIcon(undefined)
            alignCenter.setIcon(undefined)
            alignRight.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))

            this.align = 'right'

            this.emit('change', {})
        })

        toggleSticky.on('click', () => {
            this.sticky = !this.sticky

            toggleSticky.setIcon(this.sticky ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)

            this.emit('change', {})
        })

        toggleWrap.on('click', () => {
            this.wrap = !this.wrap

            toggleWrap.setIcon(this.wrap ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)

            this.emit('change', {})
        })

        const totalsMenu = this.buildTotalsMenu()

        this.menu.clearChildren().addChild(
            new Menu().addChild(
                new MenuItem('Alignment').addChild(
                    new Menu().addChild(alignLeft, alignCenter, alignRight)
                )
            ),
            new Divider()
        )

        if (this.option instanceof AggregateData || this.option instanceof NumberData) {
            this.menu.addChild(totalsMenu, new Divider())
        }

        this.menu.addChild(
            new Menu().addChild(setWidth),
            new Divider(),
            new Menu().addChild(toggleWrap, toggleSticky),
            new Divider(),
            new Menu().addChild(setGroupBy, setSubSummary),
            new Menu().addChild(
                new MenuItem('Summary type').addChild(
                    new Tooltip('These total types can increase load times if there are a large number of records')
                        .setPlacement('top')
                        .addChild(
                            new MenuItem('Types').setDisabled(true),
                            new Menu().addChild(setsubSummarySum, setsubSummaryAvg, setsubSummaryMin, setsubSummaryMax, setsubSummaryCount)
                        )
                )
            ),
            new Divider(),
            new Menu().addChild(
                new MenuItem('Rename').on('click', this.onEditColumnName.bind(this)),
                new MenuItem('Remove').on('click', this.onRemove.bind(this))
            ),
            new Divider(),
            new Menu().addChild(
                this.moveUp,
                this.moveDown,
                this.moveToTop,
                this.moveToBottom
            )
        )

        return this
    }

    protected buildTotalsMenu(): Menu {
        const unsetAllChecks = (): void => {
            sumTotal.setIcon(undefined)
            avgTotal.setIcon(undefined)
            noneTotal.setIcon(undefined)
            minValue.setIcon(undefined)
            maxValue.setIcon(undefined)
        }

        const noneTotal = new MenuItem('None').setInset(true)
            .setIcon(this.totalType === 'none' || this.totalType === undefined ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                unsetAllChecks()
                noneTotal.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))

                this.totalType = 'none'

                this.emit('change', {})
            })

        const sumTotal = new MenuItem('Sum').setInset(true)
            .setIcon(this.totalType === 'sum' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                unsetAllChecks()
                sumTotal.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))

                this.totalType = 'sum'

                this.emit('change', {})
            })

        const avgTotal = new MenuItem('Average').setInset(true)
            .setIcon(this.totalType === 'avg' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                unsetAllChecks()
                avgTotal.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))

                this.totalType = 'avg'

                this.emit('change', {})
            })

        const minValue = new MenuItem('Min').setInset(true)
            .setIcon(this.totalType === 'min' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                unsetAllChecks()
                minValue.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))

                this.totalType = 'min'

                this.emit('change', {})
            })

        const maxValue = new MenuItem('Max').setInset(true)
            .setIcon(this.totalType === 'max' ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined)
            .setStopPropagation(true)
            .on('click', () => {
                unsetAllChecks()
                maxValue.setIcon(new Icon('CheckSharp'))

                this.totalType = 'max'

                this.emit('change', {})
            })

        const totalsMenu = new Menu().addChild(
            new MenuItem('Totals').addChild(
                new Menu().addChild(
                    new Tooltip('These total types can increase load times if there are a large number of records.')
                        .setPlacement('top-start')
                        .addChild(new MenuItem('Types')),
                    noneTotal, sumTotal, avgTotal, minValue, maxValue
                )
            )
        )

        return totalsMenu
    }

    protected onRemove(): void {
        this.emit('remove', {})

        this.menu.setOpen(false)
    }

    protected onSetWidth(toggleWrap: MenuItem): void {
        this.dialog.clearActions()
        this.dialog.clearChildren()
        this.dialog.setTitle(`Edit column: ${this.label}`)

        const width = new Input()
            .setType('number')
            .setLabel('Width').setValue(String(this.width))
            .setHelper('Setting as 1 will set as narrow as possible. Setting as any other number will set to that that fixed width (if possible, depending on other columns). Removing the number will auto set the width (variable).')

        const minimumWidth = new Input()
            .setType('number')
            .setLabel('Minimum width')
            .setValue(String(this.minimumWidth))
            .setHelper('Setting this will override the width above and force a minimum width.')

        const wrap = new Checkbox()
            .setLabel('Wrap text')
            .setChecked(this.wrap)
            .setHelper('Setting this and "Width" will force a maximum width.')

        const onSave = (): void => {
            let isValid = true
            width.clearErrors().invalidateCache()
            minimumWidth.clearErrors().invalidateCache()

            if (width.getValue() && Number(width.getValue()) < 0) {
                width.setError('Enter a positive value').invalidateCache()
                isValid = false
            }

            if (minimumWidth.getValue() && Number(minimumWidth.getValue()) < 0) {
                minimumWidth.setError('Enter a positive value').invalidateCache()
                isValid = false
            }

            if (!isValid) {
                return
            }

            this.width = width.getValue() ? Number(width.getValue()) : undefined
            this.minimumWidth = minimumWidth.getValue() ? Number(minimumWidth.getValue()) : undefined
            this.wrap = wrap.getChecked()
            toggleWrap.setIcon(this.wrap ? new Icon('CheckSharp') : undefined).invalidateCache()

            this.dialog.setOpen(false)

            // Do not emit change. The save will happen in the calling function
        }

        const confirmButton = new Button().setLabel('confirm').setColor('primary')

        confirmButton.on('click', onSave)
        this.dialog.addShortcut('enter', onSave)

        this.dialog.addChild(width, minimumWidth, wrap)
        this.dialog.addAction(confirmButton)
        this.dialog.setOpen(true)
        this.menu.setOpen(false)
    }

    protected onEditColumnName(): void {
        this.dialog.clearActions()
        this.dialog.clearChildren()
        this.dialog.setTitle(`Edit column: ${this.label}`)

        const label = new Input().setLabel('Label').setValue(this.label).setAutoFocus(true)

        const onSave = (): void => {
            this.label = label.getValue() || ''

            this.dialog.setOpen(false)

            this.emit('change', {})
        }

        const save = new Button().setLabel('Save').setColor('primary')

        save.on('click', onSave)
        this.dialog.addShortcut('enter', onSave)

        this.dialog.addChild(label)
        this.dialog.addAction(save)
        this.dialog.setOpen(true)
        this.menu.setOpen(false)
    }

    protected onUp(): void {
        this.emit('up', {})

        this.menu.setOpen(false)
    }

    protected onDown(): void {
        this.emit('down', {})

        this.menu.setOpen(false)
    }

    protected onToTop(): void {
        this.emit('toTop', {})

        this.menu.setOpen(false)
    }

    protected onToBottom(): void {
        this.emit('toBottom', {})

        this.menu.setOpen(false)
    }

    public getAlign(): 'center' | 'left' | 'right' {
        return this.align
    }

    public getLabel(): string {
        return this.label
    }

    public getMinimumWidth(): number | undefined {
        return this.minimumWidth

    public getOption(): DataOption<any> {
        return this.option
    }

    public getPath(): string[] {
        return this.path
    }

    public getSticky(): boolean {
        return this.sticky
    }

    public getWidth(): number | undefined {
        return this.width
    }

    public getWrap(): boolean {
        return this.wrap
    }

    public getTotalType(): string {
        return this.totalType
    }

    public getGroupBy(): boolean {
        return this.groupBy
    }

    public getSubSummary(): boolean {
        return this.subSummary
    }

    public getSummaryType(): string {
        return this.summaryType
    }

    protected getDependencies(): (Dialog<{}> | DropdownMenu<{}>)[] {
        return [this.dialog, this.menu]
    }

    protected getType(): string {
        return 'list_column_configuration'
    }

    protected getProps(): ListColumnConfigurationProps {
        return {
            dialog: this.dialog,
            label: this.label,
            menu: this.menu,
            path: this.path,
            groupBy: this.groupBy,
            subSummary: this.subSummary,
            summaryType: this.summaryType
        }
    }
}
````

````typescript
}

}

export interface WidgetConfiguration {

    icon: keyof typeof icons

    saveAsTemplateName?: string

    defaultRowsPerPage?: number
}

export interface AddWidgetEvents {
    addWidget: { configuration: ItemConfiguration }
}

export function addWidget(reportContext: ReportContext, container: Component, fromConfiguration?: ItemConfiguration, dashboardName?: string): WizardDialog {
    const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
    const dialog = new WizardDialog<{}, AddWidgetEvents>('Configure widget')
        .setMaxWidth('lg')

        title: undefined,

            minimumWidth: 2,
            minimumHeight: 2,
            draggable: true,
            resizable: true,
            static: false
        },
        summaryItems: [],
        icon: 'Widgets',
        theme: colors.blueGrey
    }

    let sourceSet = false
    let parsedConfiguration = false
    const parseItemConfiguration = (itemConfiguration: ItemConfiguration): void => {
        config.icon = itemConfiguration.icon
        config.item = itemConfiguration.item
        config.theme = itemConfiguration.theme
        config.title = itemConfiguration.title
        config.type = itemConfiguration.type

        if ((itemConfiguration as ChartItemConfiguration).chart && (itemConfiguration as ChartItemConfiguration).chart.entity) {
            const chartConfig = (itemConfiguration as ChartItemConfiguration).chart
            const entity = (models as any)[chartConfig.entity]
            config.chartType = chartConfig.chartType

            let where: WhereConfiguration[]
            if (chartConfig.where === undefined) {
                where = [{ conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] }]
            } else if (Array.isArray(chartConfig.where)) {
                where = chartConfig.where
            } else {
                where = [chartConfig.where]
            }

            config.chart = {
                entity,
                columns: chartConfig.data.map(column => new ListColumnConfiguration(entity, column.path)),
                path: chartConfig.path,
                where,
                legendLabels: chartConfig.legendLabels || []
            }
        }

        if ((itemConfiguration as ListItemConfiguration | SummaryItemConfiguration).list) {
            const listConfig = (itemConfiguration as ListItemConfiguration | SummaryItemConfiguration).list
            const entity = (models as any)[listConfig.entity]

            config.list = {
                entity,
                groups: listConfig.groups.map(group => new ListColumnConfiguration(entity, group)),
                columns: listConfig.columns.map((column, index) => new ListColumnConfiguration(entity, column.path).setConfiguration(
                    column.align,
                    column.label,
                    column.sticky,
                    column.wrap,
                    column.width,
                    column.minimumWidth,
                    column.totalType,
                    listConfig.columns.length <= 1 ? 'ONLY' : index === 0 ? 'FIRST' : index === listConfig.columns.length - 1 ? 'LAST' : 'MIDDLE'
                )),
                where: listConfig.where || { conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] },
                path: listConfig.path,
                defaultRowsPerPage: listConfig.defaultRowsPerPage || 25
            }
        }

        if ((itemConfiguration as SummaryItemConfiguration).summary) {
            const summaryConfig = (itemConfiguration as SummaryItemConfiguration).summary
            const entity = (models as any)[summaryConfig.entity]
            config.summary = {

                data: new ListColumnConfiguration(config.list.entity, summaryConfig.data)

        if (config.saveAsTemplate) {

    const compareObjects = (objectA: object, objectB: object, keys?: string[]): boolean => {
        if (objectA === objectB) {
            return true
        }

        if (objectA === undefined || objectB === undefined) {
            return false
        }

        const aKeys = Object.keys(objectA)
        const bKeys = Object.keys(objectB)

        if (keys === undefined && aKeys.length !== bKeys.length) {
            return false
        }

        for (const key of Array.from(aKeys)) {
            if ((keys === undefined || keys.includes(key)) && (objectA as any)[key] !== (objectB as any)[key]) {
                return false
            }
        }

        return true
    }

    const widgetTypeStep = new WizardStep('Widget type')

    const templateStep = new WizardStep('Template')

    const sourceStep = new WizardStep('Data source')

    const filtersStep = new WizardStep('Filters')

        .setDetails('Set any legend labels')

    const summaryDataStep = new WizardStep('Summary data')
        .setDetails('Choose which colummn to total for the summary')

    const customizeStep = new WizardStep('Customize')
        .setDetails('Customize the look of the widget')

    let hasReset = false
    let generateSteps: (resetConfig?: boolean) => void

    const resetSource = (sourceParam: Partial<WidgetListConfiguration | WidgetChartConfiguration> = {}): WidgetListConfiguration | WidgetChartConfiguration => {
        const source = {
            entity: undefined,
            groups: [],

        }

        filtersStep.setError(false)

            if (!config.list.entity) {
                sourceStep.setError(true)
                dialog.rebuild(true)

            const templates: models.DashboardWidgetTemplate[] = await getRepository(models.DashboardWidgetTemplate).find({ where })

            .setDisabled(true)

            .on('blur', () => {

            })

            saveTemplate.setChecked(config.saveAsTemplate)

        }

        if (config.saveAsTemplateName !== undefined) {
            newTemplateName.setValue(config.saveAsTemplateName)
        }

        const newTemplate = new FlexContainer(true, false)
            .setPadding(8, 16)

        if (config.fromTemplate) {

            if (customize.getChecked()) {

        if (config.fromTemplate) {

        } else if (parsedConfiguration && !hasReset) {
            templateStep.setComplete(true)

            if (fromConfiguration) {

        } else {

        content.addChild(
````
