````typescript
    const generateSourceStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8)

        let sourceConfig: WidgetListConfiguration | WidgetChartConfiguration

        if (config.list) {
            sourceConfig = config.list
        } else if (config.chart) {
            sourceConfig = config.chart
        } else {
            sourceConfig = {
                entity: undefined,
                groups: [],
                columns: [],
                where: { conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] },
                path: []
            }
        }

        if (reportContext === undefined) {
            const source = new NullableSelect<typeof Base>()
                .setLabel('Data source')
                .setOptions(getSourceTables(application, dashboardName))
                .setNullable(false)
                .setValue(sourceConfig.entity)

            if (sourceConfig.entity) {
                sourceStep.setValue(sourceConfig.entity.name).setComplete(true)
            }

            source.getOptionHash = entity => createHash('md5').update(entity === null ? '' : entity.name).digest('hex')
            source.getOptionPrimary = entity => entity.name
                .replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')
                .toLowerCase()
                .trim()
                .replace(/^./, match => match.toUpperCase())

            source.on('change', () => {
                sourceConfig = resetSource({
                    entity: source.getValue()
                })

                if (sourceConfig.entity === null) {
                    sourceStep.setValue('Not set')
                } else {
                    config.icon = getIcon(source.getValue()).getIcon() as keyof typeof icons
                    config.theme = getTheme(source.getValue())

                    if (config.type === 'ListView') {
                        config.title = `${sourceConfig.entity.name} list`
                    }

                    if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
                        config.title = `${sourceConfig.entity.name} chart`
                    }

                    if (config.type === 'SummaryView') {
                        config.title = `${sourceConfig.entity.name} summary`
                    }

                    sourceStep.setValue(sourceConfig.entity.name)
                }

                generateSteps()
            })

            content.addChild(source)
        } else if (!fromConfiguration && reportContext.id === undefined) {
            // Setting the source deletes the data when it is a summaryView so only reset on first run through
            if (!sourceSet || config.type !== 'SummaryView') {
                sourceConfig = resetSource({
                    entity: reportContext.entity
                })

                sourceSet = true
            }
        } else {
            const selected = new Typography('')

            if (config.list && config.list.entity && config.list.path) {
                selected.setContent(config.list.path.join(' ➔ '))
                sourceStep.setValue(config.list.path.join(' ➔ ')).setComplete(true)
            } else if (config.chart && config.chart.entity && config.chart.path) {
                selected.setContent(config.chart.path.join(' ➔ '))
                sourceStep.setValue(config.chart.path.join(' ➔ ')).setComplete(true)
            }

            const ignoreRelationsMap: Map<typeof Base, Set<string>> = new Map()

            const parseOptions = (entity: typeof Base, path: string[], depth: number, parent?: typeof Base, parentContainer?: Component): ColumnList => {
                const columnList = new ColumnList()

                let ignoreRelations = ignoreRelationsMap.get(entity)

                if (ignoreRelations === undefined) {
                    ignoreRelations = new Set()
                    ignoreRelationsMap.set(entity, ignoreRelations)
                }

                for (const option of Array.from(getReportOptions(entity))) {
                    if (option instanceof RelationOption) {
                        if (ignoreRelations.has(option.getProperty()) || option.getTarget() === reportContext.entity || option.getTarget() === parent || path.includes(option.getLabel())) {
                            continue
                        }

                        const item = new ListItem(option.getLabel()).setIsButton(true)
                        let add = false

                        if (option.getToMany()) {
                            let targetIgnoreRelations = ignoreRelationsMap.get(option.getTarget())

                            if (targetIgnoreRelations === undefined) {
                                targetIgnoreRelations = new Set()
                                ignoreRelationsMap.set(option.getTarget(), targetIgnoreRelations)
                            }

                            targetIgnoreRelations.add(option.getRelation().inverseSidePropertyPath)

                            item.on('click', () => {
                                sourceConfig = resetSource({
                                    entity: option.getTarget(),
                                    path: [...path, option.getLabel()]
                                })

                                config.icon = getIcon(sourceConfig.entity).getIcon() as keyof typeof icons
                                config.theme = getTheme(sourceConfig.entity)
                                config.title = sourceConfig.path.join(' ➔ ')

                                sourceStep.setValue(sourceConfig.path.join(' ➔ '))

                                selected.setContent(config.title).invalidateCache()
                            })

                            add = true
                        }

                        if (getReportOptions(option.getTarget()).filter(option => option instanceof RelationOption && option.getToMany()).length > 0) {
                            item.setEndIcon(new Icon('ArrowForwardIos'))

                            item.on('click', () => {
                                item.clearChildren()
                                const child = parseOptions(option.getTarget(), [...path, option.getLabel()], depth + 1, entity, parentContainer)

                                if (child.getChildren().length > 0) {
                                    const existingChildren: Component[] = []

                                    for (const child of Array.from(parentContainer.getChildren())) {
                                        existingChildren.push(child)

                                        if (child === columnList) {
                                            break
                                        }
                                    }

                                    parentContainer.clearChildren().addChild(...existingChildren, child).invalidateCache()
                                } else {
                                    item.addChild(new ListItem('No options found'))
                                }
                            })

                            add = true
                        }

                        if (add) {
                            columnList.addChild(item)
                        }
                    }
                }

                return columnList
            }

            const scrollContainer = new HorizontalScrollContainer()
            scrollContainer.addChild(parseOptions(reportContext.entity, [], 0, undefined, scrollContainer))

            content.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 2).addChild(
                    new Typography('Selected data source: ')
                        .setInline(true)
                        .setColor('textSecondary')
                ),
                new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 8).addChild(selected),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(scrollContainer)
            )
        }

        sourceStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateGroupsStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8)
        const addContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)

        if (config.list) {
            const container = new List()
            const label = new Typography(`${config.list.groups.length} columns selected`, 'dialog')

            const setStepValue = (): void => {
                label.setContent(`${config.list.groups.length} columns selected`)
                const value = config.list.groups.map(group => group.getLabel()).join(', ')
                groupsStep.setValue(value)
            }

            const addGroup = (column: ListColumnConfiguration): ListColumnConfiguration => {
                column.removeAllListeners()
                column.on('remove', () => {
                    config.list.groups.splice(config.list.groups.findIndex(group => group === column), 1)
                    config.list.columns.length = 0
                    container.removeChild(column)

                    setStepValue()
                    validate()
                })

                container.addChild(column)
                setStepValue()

                return column
            }

            const add = new IconButton(new Icon('Add'))
                .setColor('default')
                .on('click', () => {
                    if (addContainer.getChildren().length === 0) {
                        addContainer.addChild(
                            new TitleBar('Choose column'),
                            new ListOptionsContainer(
                                config.list.entity,
                                application,
                                true,
                                false,
                                [],
                                option => option.getGroupable() === true && option.getContexts().includes('list')
                            )
                                .on('click', event => {
                                    config.list.groups.push(addGroup(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.list.entity, event.path)))
                                    config.list.columns.length = 0
                                    addContainer.clearChildren()

                                    setStepValue()
                                    validate()
                                })
                        )
                    }
                })

            if (config.list.groups.length > 0) {
                for (const group of Array.from(config.list.groups)) {
                    addGroup(group)
                }
                groupsStep.setComplete(true)
            }

            content.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8).setAlignItems('center').addChild(
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', true).addChild(label),
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(add)
                ),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(addContainer),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(new TitleBar('Selected column(s)')),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(
                    new Typography('Totals on columns can increase load times if there are a large number of records.', 'dialog')
                ),
                container
            )
        }

        groupsStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateColumnsStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8)
        const addContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)

        if (config.type === 'ListView' || config.type === 'SummaryView') {
            const container = new List()
            const label = new Typography(`${config.list.groups.length} columns selected`, 'dialog')

            const setStepValue = (): void => {
                label.setContent(`${config.list.columns.length} columns selected`)
                const value = config.list.columns.map(column => column.getLabel()).join(', ')
                columnsStep.setValue(value)
            }

            const addColumn = (column: ListColumnConfiguration): ListColumnConfiguration => {
                column.removeAllListeners()
                column.on('remove', () => {
                    config.list.columns.splice(config.list.columns.findIndex(existing => existing === column), 1)
                    container.removeChild(column)

                    setStepValue()
                    validate()
                })

                addColumnMovementListeners(column, config.list.columns, container)

                container.addChild(column)
                setStepValue()

                return column
            }

            const add = new IconButton(new Icon('Add'))
                .setColor('default')
                .on('click', () => {
                    if (addContainer.getChildren().length === 0) {
                        addContainer.addChild(
                            new TitleBar('Choose column'),
                            new ListOptionsContainer(
                                config.list.entity,
                                application,
                                config.list.groups.length === 0,
                                true,
                                config.list.groups.map(column => column.getPath()),
                                option => option.getVisible() === true && option.getContexts().includes('list')
                            )
                                .on('click', event => {
                                    const confirmLabelNameDialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Edit column')
                                    const label = new Input()
                                        .setLabel('Label')
                                        .setValue(event.option.getLabel())
                                        .setAutoFocus(true)

                                    const onSave = (): void => {
                                        config.list.columns.push(addColumn(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.list.entity, event.path).setConfiguration(
                                            event.option.getAlign(),
                                            label.getValue(),
                                            event.option.getSticky(),
                                            event.option.getWrap(),
                                            event.option.getWidth(),
                                            event.option.getMinimumWidth()
                                        )))

                                        addContainer.clearChildren()
                                        setStepValue()
                                        validate()
                                    }

                                    const save = new Button().setLabel('Save').setColor('primary')
                                    save.on('click', onSave)

                                    confirmLabelNameDialog
                                        .addChild(label)
                                        .addAction(save)
                                        .addShortcut('enter', onSave)

                                    addContainer.addChild(confirmLabelNameDialog)
                                })
                        )
                    }
                })

            if (config.list.columns.length > 0) {
                for (const column of Array.from(config.list.columns)) {
                    addColumn(column)
                }

                columnsStep.setComplete(true)
            }

            const listContainer = new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(container)

            content.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8).setAlignItems('center').addChild(
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', true).addChild(label),
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(add)
                ),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(addContainer),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(new TitleBar('Selected column(s)')),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(
                    new Typography('Totals on columns can increase load times if there are a large number of records.', 'dialog')
                ),
                listContainer
            )
        }

        columnsStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateChartAxesStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setDirection('column').setSpacing(8)

        if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
            let axisLabel = 'Category Axis'

            if (config.chartType === 'LineChart') {
                axisLabel = 'Date Axis'
            }

            if (config.chartType === 'PieChart') {
                axisLabel = 'Categories'
            }

            const axisSelected = new Typography('Choose...')

            const setStepValue = (): void => {
                const values: string[] = []

                if (config.chart.columns[0]) {
                    axisSelected.setContent(config.chart.columns[0].getPath().join(' ➔ '))
                    values.push(config.chart.columns[0].getPath().slice(-1)[0])
                }

                chartAxesStep.setValue(values.join(', '))
            }

            setStepValue()
            chartAxesStep.setComplete(Boolean(config.chart.columns[0]))

            const columnList = new HorizontalScrollContainer().addChild(
                new ListOptionsContainer(
                    config.chart.entity,
                    application,
                    true,
                    false,
                    [],
                    option => option.getVisible() && option.getContexts().includes('chart')
                ).on('click', event => {
                    axisSelected.setContent(event.path.join(' ➔ '))
                    config.chart.columns[0] = new ListColumnConfiguration(config.chart.entity, event.path).setConfiguration(
                        event.option.getAlign(),
                        event.option.getLabel(),
                        event.option.getSticky(),
                        event.option.getWrap(),
                        event.option.getWidth(),
                        event.option.getMinimumWidth()
                    )

                    setStepValue()
                    validate()
                })
            )

            content.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(
                    new TitleBar(axisLabel),
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(
                        axisSelected,
                        columnList
                    )
                )
            )
        }

        chartAxesStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateChartSeriesStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setDirection('column').setSpacing(8)

        if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
            const addContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)
            const container = new List()
            const label = new Typography(`${config.chart.columns.slice(1).length} columns selected`, 'dialog')
            const add = new IconButton(new Icon('Add'))
                .setColor('default')
                .setDisabled(config.chart.columns.length > 1 && config.chartType === 'PieChart')

            const setStepValue = (): void => {
                let value: string

                if (config.chart.columns.slice(1).length > 0) {
                    label.setContent(`${config.chart.columns.slice(1).length} columns selected`)
                    value = config.chart.columns.slice(1).map(column => column.getLabel()).join(', ')
                }

                chartSeriesStep.setValue(value)
            }

            setStepValue()

            const addColumn = (column: ListColumnConfiguration): ListColumnConfiguration => {
                column.removeAllListeners()
                column.on('remove', () => {
                    const index = config.chart.columns.findIndex(col => col === column)
                    config.chart.columns.splice(index, 1)
                    config.chart.where.splice(index, 1)
                    container.removeChild(column)

                    setStepValue()
                    validate()
                    add.setDisabled(config.chart.columns.length > 1 && config.chartType === 'PieChart')
                })

                container.addChild(column)
                setStepValue()

                return column
            }

            add.on('click', () => {
                if (addContainer.getChildren().length === 0) {
                    addContainer.addChild(
                        new TitleBar('Choose column'),
                        new ListOptionsContainer(
                            config.chart.entity,
                            application,
                            false,
                            true,
                            [],
                            option => option.getVisible() === true && option.getContexts().includes('chart')
                        )
                            .on('click', event => {
                                config.chart.columns.push(addColumn(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.chart.entity, event.path)))
                                config.chart.where.push({ conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] })
                                addContainer.clearChildren()

                                add.setDisabled(config.chart.columns.length > 1 && config.chartType === 'PieChart')
                                setStepValue()
                                validate()
                            })
                    )
                }
            })

            if (config.chart.columns.length > 1) {
                for (const column of Array.from(config.chart.columns.slice(1))) {
                    addColumn(column)
                }
            }

            const listContainer = new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(container)

            content.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8).setAlignItems('center').addChild(
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', true).addChild(label),
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(new Tooltip('Add series').addChild(add))
                ),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(addContainer),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(new TitleBar('Selected column(s)')),
                listContainer
            )

            chartSeriesStep
                .setContent(content)
                .setComplete((parsedConfiguration && !hasReset) || config.chart.columns.length > 1)
        }
    }

    const generateFiltersStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FragmentContainer()

        const setStepValue = (filter: FilterClause | FilterGroup): void => {
            const valuesFromFilter = (filter: FilterClause | FilterGroup): string[] => {
                const values: string[] = []
                if ((filter as FilterGroup).conjunction) {
                    values.push(...(filter as FilterGroup).conditions.map(condition => valuesFromFilter(condition)).reduce((values, value) => values.concat(value), []))
                } else {
                    values.push((filter as FilterClause).path.slice(-1)[0])
                }

                return values
            }

            const value = valuesFromFilter(filter).join(', ')
            filtersStep.setValue(value)
        }

        if (config.type === 'ListView' || config.type === 'SummaryView') {
            const configurator = new FilterConfigurator(config.list.entity, config.list.where, application).on('change', filter => {
                config.list.where = filter
                setStepValue(filter)
            })

            if (config.list.where) {
                setStepValue(config.list.where)
            }

            content.addChild(configurator)
        }

        filtersStep
            .setComplete(parsedConfiguration && !hasReset)
            .setContent(content)
    }

    const generateChartFiltersStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FragmentContainer()

        const setStepValue = (): void => {
            const valuesFromFilter = (filter: FilterClause | FilterGroup): string[] => {
                const values: string[] = []
                if ((filter as FilterGroup).conjunction) {
                    values.push(...(filter as FilterGroup).conditions.map(condition => valuesFromFilter(condition)).reduce((values, value) => values.concat(value), []))
                } else {
                    values.push((filter as FilterClause).path.slice(-1)[0])
                }

                return values
            }

            const values = config.chart.where.map(filter => valuesFromFilter(filter).join(', ')).join(',')
            chartFiltersStep.setValue(values)
        }

        if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
            for (const [index, column] of Array.from(config.chart.columns.slice(1).entries())) {
                const title = new Typography(column.getLabel())
                const configurator = new FilterConfigurator(config.chart.entity, config.chart.where[index], application).on('change', filter => {
                    config.chart.where.splice(index, 1, filter)
                    setStepValue()
                })

                content.addChild(title, configurator)
            }

            if (config.chart.where) {
                setStepValue()
            }

            chartFiltersStep
                .setComplete((parsedConfiguration && !hasReset) || config.chart.columns.length > 1)
                .setContent(content)
        }
    }

    const generateChartLegendLabelsStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8)

        const setStepValue = (): void => {
            const values = config.chart.legendLabels.join(',')
            chartLegendLabelsStep.setValue(values)
        }

        if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
            for (const [index, column] of Array.from(config.chart.columns.slice(1).entries())) {
                const title = new Typography(column.getLabel())
                const input = new Input()
                    .setLabel('Label')
                    .setValue(config.chart.legendLabels[index])
                    .on('change', event => {
                        config.chart.legendLabels[index] = event.value
                        setStepValue()
                    })

                content.addChild(new FlexContainer(true, false).setPadding(8).addChild(title, input))
            }

            if (config.chart.legendLabels) {
                setStepValue()
            }

            chartLegendLabelsStep
                .setComplete((parsedConfiguration && !hasReset) || config.chart.legendLabels.length > 0)
                .setContent(content)
        }
    }

    const generateSummaryDataStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8)

        if (config.summary) {
            const dataSelected = new TitleBar('Choose column', true, 'Clear summary')

            dataSelected.on('onClear', () => {
                summaryDataStep.setValue('').invalidateCache()
                dataSelected.setTitle('Choose column')
                config.summary.data = undefined

                content.clearChildren()

                const menu = new ListOptionsContainer(
                    config.list.entity,
                    application,
                    false,
                    true,
                    [],
                    option => option.getVisible() === true
                ).on('click', event => {
                    config.summary.data = setData(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.list.entity, event.path))
                    validate()
                })

                content.addChild(
                    new FlexContainer(true, false).setPadding(16, 0).setAlignItems('center').addChild(
                        new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 2).addChild(
                            new Typography('Selected summary column: ')
                                .setInline(true)
                                .setColor('textSecondary')
                        ),
                        new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).setPadding(8, 0).addChild(dataSelected),
                        new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(menu)
                    )
                )
            })

            const setData = (column: ListColumnConfiguration): ListColumnConfiguration => {
                dataSelected.setTitle(column.getPath().join(' ➔ '))
                summaryDataStep.setValue(column.getPath() ? column.getPath().slice(-1)[0] : '')
                column
                    .removeAllListeners()
                    .on('remove', () => {
                        config.summary.data = undefined
                    })

                return column
            }

            if (config.summary.data) {
                dataSelected.setTitle(config.summary.data.getPath() ? config.summary.data.getPath().length > 0 ? config.summary.data.getPath().join(' ➔ ') : 'Choose column' : '')
                summaryDataStep
                    .setValue(config.summary.data.getPath() ? config.summary.data.getPath().slice(-1)[0] : '')
                    .setComplete(true)
            }

            const menu = new ListOptionsContainer(
                config.list.entity,
                application,
                false,
                true,
                [],
                option => option.getVisible() === true
            ).on('click', event => {
                config.summary.data = setData(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.list.entity, event.path))
                validate()
            })

            content.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(true, false).setPadding(16, 0).setAlignItems('center').addChild(
                    new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 2).addChild(
                        new Typography('Selected summary column: ')
                            .setInline(true)
                            .setColor('textSecondary')
                    ),
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).setPadding(8, 0).addChild(dataSelected),
                    new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(menu)
                )
            )
        }

        summaryDataStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateCustomizeStep = (): void => {
        const theme = new Select<string>().setLabel('Theme')
        const icon = new Select<string>().setLabel('Icon')
        const title = new Input().setLabel('Title')
        const defaultRowsPerPage = new Select<number>()
            .setLabel('Default rows per page')
            .setValue(config.list && config.list.defaultRowsPerPage ? config.list.defaultRowsPerPage : 25)
            .setOptions([10, 25, 50, 100])
            .on('change', () => {
                config.list.defaultRowsPerPage = defaultRowsPerPage.getValue()
            })

        theme.setOptions(Object.keys(colors).filter(color => color !== 'common').sort())

        icon.setOptions(Object.keys(icons).filter(name => !name.endsWith('Outlined') &&
            !name.endsWith('Rounded') &&
            !name.endsWith('Sharp') &&
            !name.endsWith('TwoTone')))

        const themeObject = fromConfiguration
            ? config.theme || config.list && getTheme(config.list.entity) || config.chart && getTheme(config.chart.entity)
            : reportContext && getTheme(reportContext.entity) || config.theme || config.list && getTheme(config.list.entity) || config.chart && getTheme(config.chart.entity)

        icon.setValue(config.icon)
        theme.setValue(Object.keys(colors).find(color => compareObjects((colors as any)[color], themeObject)) || theme.getOptions()[0])
        title.setValue(config.title)

        config.theme = (colors as any)[theme.getValue()]

        icon.on('change', () => {
            config.icon = icon.getValue() as keyof typeof icons
        })

        theme.on('change', () => {
            config.theme = (colors as any)[theme.getValue()]
        })

        title.on('change', () => {
            config.title = title.getValue()
        })

        const content = new FragmentContainer()

        if (config.type !== 'Card' && config.type !== 'DynamicListView') {
            content.addChild(title)
            content.addChild(icon)
        }

        content.addChild(
            theme,
            config.type === 'SummaryView'
                ? new FlexContainer(false, true)
                    .addChild(defaultRowsPerPage)
                    .setWidth(50)
                    .setPadding(16)
                : null
        )

        if (config.type === 'ListView') {
            const checkboxConfig = new Checkbox()
                .setChecked(config.showCheckboxes)
                .setLabel('Show record selection checkboxes')
                .on('change', () => {
                    config.showCheckboxes = checkboxConfig.getChecked()
                })

            const rowsperPageContainer = new FlexContainer(false, true)
                .addChild(defaultRowsPerPage)
                .setWidth(50)
                .setPadding(16)

            content.addChild(checkboxConfig, rowsperPageContainer)
        }

        customizeStep
            .setComplete(parsedConfiguration && !hasReset)
            .setContent(content)
    }

    generateSteps = (reset: boolean = false): void => {
        if (reset) {
            sourceStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            groupsStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            columnsStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            templateStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            chartAxesStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            chartSeriesStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            summaryDataStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            filtersStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            chartFiltersStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            chartLegendLabelsStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            customizeStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)

            if (config.type === 'Card') {
                customizeStep.setVisible(true)
            } else {
                delete config.cardType
            }

            if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
                config.chart = {
                    entity: null,
                    columns: [],
                    where: [{ conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] }],
                    path: [],
                    legendLabels: []
                }
            } else {
                delete config.chart
                delete config.chartType
            }

            delete config.fromTemplate

            if (config.type === 'ListView' || config.type === 'SummaryView') {
                config.list = {
                    entity: null,
                    groups: [],
                    columns: [],
                    where: { conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] },
                    path: []
                }
            } else {
                delete config.list
            }

            if (config.type === 'DynamicView') {
                config.icon = 'DynamicFeed'
                config.title = 'Dynamic window'
            }

            if (config.type === 'SummaryView') {
                config.summary = {
                    entity: null,
                    data: undefined
                }

                config.item.height = 2
                config.item.width = 3
                config.item.maximumHeight = 2
            } else {
                delete config.summary
                config.item.width = 6
                config.item.height = 9
                config.item.maximumHeight = undefined
            }

            hasReset = true
        }

        sourceStep.setVisible(false)
        groupsStep.setVisible(false)
        columnsStep.setVisible(false)
        templateStep.setVisible(false)
        chartAxesStep.setVisible(false)
        chartSeriesStep.setVisible(false)
        summaryDataStep.setVisible(false)
        filtersStep.setVisible(false)
        chartFiltersStep.setVisible(false)
        chartLegendLabelsStep.setVisible(false)
        customizeStep.setVisible(false)

        if (config.type === 'Card') {
            customizeStep.setVisible(true)
        }

        if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
            sourceStep.setVisible(true)
            templateStep.setVisible(true)
            chartAxesStep.setVisible(true)
            chartSeriesStep.setVisible(true)
            chartFiltersStep.setVisible(true)
            chartLegendLabelsStep.setVisible(true)
            customizeStep.setVisible(true)

            if (reportContext && !reportContext.id) {
                sourceStep.setVisible(false)
            }
        }

        if (config.type === 'DynamicListView') {
            customizeStep.setVisible(true)
        }

        if (config.type === 'ListView') {
            sourceStep.setVisible(true)
            templateStep.setVisible(true)
            groupsStep.setVisible(true)
            columnsStep.setVisible(true)
            filtersStep.setVisible(true)
            customizeStep.setVisible(true)

            if (reportContext && !reportContext.id) {
                sourceStep.setVisible(false)
            }
        }

        if (config.type === 'DynamicView') {
            customizeStep.setVisible(true)
        }

        if (config.type === 'SummaryView') {
            sourceStep.setVisible(true)
            summaryDataStep.setVisible(true)
            columnsStep.setVisible(true)
            filtersStep.setVisible(true)
            customizeStep.setVisible(true)

            if (reportContext && !reportContext.id) {
                sourceStep.setVisible(false)
            }
        }

        generateChartTemplateStep()
        generateSourceStep()
        generateGroupsStep()
        generateColumnsStep()
        generateChartAxesStep()
        generateChartSeriesStep()
        generateSummaryDataStep()
        generateFiltersStep()
        generateChartFiltersStep()
        generateChartLegendLabelsStep()
        generateCustomizeStep()

        validate()

        if (config.type === 'SummaryView') {
            if (reportContext && !config.list.entity) {
                config.list.entity = reportContext.entity
            }

            if (reportContext && !config.summary.entity) {
                config.summary.entity = reportContext.entity
            }
        }
    }

    const generateWidgetTypeStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FragmentContainer()

        const cardNames = Object.keys(cards).map(cardName => {
            const card = cards[cardName as keyof typeof cards]
            const label = card.getName()
            const context = card.getContext()

            if (label === undefined) {
                return null
            }

            if (reportContext) {
                if (context.includes('enableCard') && reportContext.entity && context.includes(`entity:${reportContext.entity.name}`)) {
                    return { label, value: cardName }
                }

                if (reportContext.entity && [`entity:any`, `entity:${reportContext.entity.name}`].filter(value => context.includes(value)).length === 0) {
                    return null
                }

                if (reportContext.entityOf && [`ofEntity:${reportContext.entityOf.name}`, `entity:any`].filter(value => context.includes(value)).length === 0) {
                    return null
                }

                if (reportContext.id && [`entityId:any`, `entity:${reportContext.id}`].filter(value => context.includes(value)).length === 0) {
                    return null
                }

                if (!reportContext.id) {
                    let remove = false
                    for (const value of Array.from(context)) {
                        if (value.includes('entityId')) {
                            remove = true
                        }
                    }

                    if (remove) {
                        return null
                    }
                }

                // These use the dashboard name to distinguish between job and consignment dashboard so specific cards can be shown
                if (dashboardName === 'consignment') {
                    // May need more work if consignment cards are changed or timeline/notes added.
                    if (!context.includes('alternative:consignment')) {
                        return null
                    }
                }

                if (dashboardName === 'job') {
                    if (context.includes('alternative:consignment')) {
                        return null
                    }
                }
            } else if ([`dashboard`].filter(value => context.includes(value)).length === 0) {
                return null
            }

            return { label, value: cardName }
        })

        const chartOptions = new RadioGroup()
            .setOptions([
                { label: 'Bar chart', value: 'BarChart' },
                { label: 'Column chart', value: 'ColumnChart' },
                { label: 'Line chart', value: 'LineChart' },
                { label: 'Pie chart', value: 'PieChart' },
                { label: 'Radar chart', value: 'RadarChart' }
            ])

        content.addChild(
            new Typography('Charts', 'h6'),
            chartOptions
        )

        const listOptions = new RadioGroup().setOptions([
            { label: 'Tabbed list', value: 'DynamicListView' },
            { label: 'Fixed list', value: 'ListView' }
        ])

        content.addChild(
            new Typography('List', 'h6'),
            listOptions
        )

        const dynamicOptions = new RadioGroup().setOptions([
            { label: 'Summary', value: 'SummaryView' },
            { label: 'Dynamic window', value: 'DynamicView' }
        ])

        content.addChild(
            new Typography('Dynamic', 'h6'),
            dynamicOptions
        )

        const cardOptions = new RadioGroup()
        const cardCount = cardNames.filter(value => value).length

        if (cardCount > 0) {
            cardOptions.setOptions(cardNames.filter(value => value))
            content.addChild(
                new Typography('Cards', 'h6'),
                cardOptions
            )
        }

        const sharedWidgetOption = new RadioGroup().setOptions(application.getSharedWidgetOptions().map(option => ({
            label: option.name,
            value: option.sharedConfiguration
        })))

        content.addChild(
            new Typography('Shared widgets', 'h6'),
            sharedWidgetOption
        )

        const onChangeChartOptions = (): void => {
            listOptions.setValue(undefined)
            cardOptions.setValue(undefined)
            dynamicOptions.setValue(undefined)
            sharedWidgetOption.setValue(undefined)

            config.type = 'ChartView'
            config.chartType = chartOptions.getValue()
            widgetTypeStep.setValue(config.chartType.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim())

            generateSteps(true)
        }

        if (!fromConfiguration) {
            chartOptions.setValue('BarChart')
            onChangeChartOptions()
        }

        chartOptions.on('change', onChangeChartOptions)

        listOptions.on('change', () => {
            chartOptions.setValue(undefined)
            cardOptions.setValue(undefined)
            dynamicOptions.setValue(undefined)
            sharedWidgetOption.setValue(undefined)
            config.type = listOptions.getValue() as 'ListView' | 'DynamicListView'
            widgetTypeStep.setValue(config.type === 'ListView' ? 'Fixed list' : 'Dynamic list')

            generateSteps(true)
        })

        dynamicOptions.on('change', () => {
            listOptions.setValue(undefined)
            chartOptions.setValue(undefined)
            cardOptions.setValue(undefined)
            sharedWidgetOption.setValue(undefined)

            config.type = dynamicOptions.getValue() as 'SummaryView' | 'DynamicView'
            widgetTypeStep.setValue(config.type === 'SummaryView' ? 'Summary' : 'Dynamic window')

            generateSteps(true)
        })

        sharedWidgetOption.on('change', () => {
            listOptions.setValue(undefined)
            chartOptions.setValue(undefined)
            cardOptions.setValue(undefined)
            dynamicOptions.setValue(undefined)

            widgetTypeStep.setValue('Shared widgets').setComplete(true)

            templateStep.setVisible(false)
            sourceStep.setVisible(false)
            groupsStep.setVisible(false)
            columnsStep.setVisible(false)
            chartAxesStep.setVisible(false)
            chartSeriesStep.setVisible(false)
            filtersStep.setVisible(false)
            chartFiltersStep.setVisible(false)
            chartLegendLabelsStep.setVisible(false)
            summaryDataStep.setVisible(false)
            customizeStep.setVisible(false)

            parseItemConfiguration(JSON.parse(sharedWidgetOption.getValue()))

            dialog.rebuild(true)
        })

        cardOptions.on('change', () => {
            listOptions.setValue(undefined)
            chartOptions.setValue(undefined)
            dynamicOptions.setValue(undefined)
            sharedWidgetOption.setValue(undefined)

            const cardType = cardOptions.getValue() as keyof typeof cards

            config.type = 'Card'
            config.cardType = cardType
            config.removable = cards[cardType].getRemovable()
            widgetTypeStep.setValue(cardType)

            generateSteps(true)
        })

        if (config.type) {
            switch (config.type) {
                case 'ChartView':
                    chartOptions.setValue(config.chartType)
                    widgetTypeStep.setValue(config.chartType.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').trim()).setComplete(true)
                    break

                case 'ListView':
                    listOptions.setValue('ListView')
                    widgetTypeStep.setValue('Fixed list').setComplete(true)
                    break

                case 'DynamicListView':
                    listOptions.setValue('DynamicListView')
                    widgetTypeStep.setValue('Tabbed list').setComplete(true)
                    break

                case 'SummaryView':
                    dynamicOptions.setValue('SummaryView')
                    widgetTypeStep.setValue('Summary').setComplete(true)
                    break

                case 'DynamicView':
                    dynamicOptions.setValue('DynamicView')
                    widgetTypeStep.setValue('Dynamic window').setComplete(true)
                    break
            }

            validate()
        }

        widgetTypeStep.setContent(content)
    }

    if (fromConfiguration) {
        parseItemConfiguration(fromConfiguration)
    }

    generateWidgetTypeStep()
    generateSteps()

    dialog.on('beforeNext', ({ successHandler }) => {
        validate()

        const activeStep = dialog.getActiveStep(true)

        if (!activeStep.getError()) {
            successHandler()
            generateSteps()
        }
    })

    dialog.addStep(
        widgetTypeStep,
        templateStep,
        sourceStep,
        groupsStep,
        columnsStep,
        chartAxesStep,
        chartSeriesStep,
        filtersStep,
        chartFiltersStep,
        chartLegendLabelsStep,
        summaryDataStep,
        customizeStep
    )

    if (fromConfiguration) {
        if (config.type === 'ListView') {
            dialog.setActiveStep('list-columns')
        }

        if (config.type === 'ChartView') {
            dialog.setActiveStep('chart-series')
        }

        if (config.type === 'SummaryView') {
            dialog.setActiveStep('list-columns')
        }
    }

    application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)

    return dialog
}
````

### Capsule server/component/dashboard/configurator/addDynamicTab.ts

Source `server/component/dashboard/configurator/addDynamicTab.ts:1`.

````typescript
import * as icons from '@mui/icons-material'
import * as models from '../../../models'
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { Button, Input, ListColumnConfiguration, ListOptionsContainer, ListViewConfiguration, SummaryViewConfiguration, TitleBar, WizardDialog, WizardStep } from '../../../component'
import { Checkbox, Component, Dialog, DropdownMenu, FlexContainer, FragmentContainer, Icon, IconButton, List, Menu, MenuItem, NullableSelect, Select, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { FilterClause, FilterGroup, RelationOption, ReportContext } from '../../../reports'
import { FilterConfigurator } from '../configurator'
import { PaletteColorOptions } from '@mui/material/styles/createPalette'
import { addColumnMovementListeners } from '../../configurableListView/addColumnMovementListeners'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { createHash } from 'crypto'
import { getIcon, getReportOptions, getTheme } from '../../../configuration'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { getSourceTables } from '../../../functions/getSourceTables'

interface WidgetSourceConfiguration {
    columns: ListColumnConfiguration[]
}

interface SummaryItem {
    data: ListColumnConfiguration
    title: string
}

export interface TabConfiguration {
    icon: keyof typeof icons
    entity: typeof Base
    where: FilterClause | FilterGroup
    theme: PaletteColorOptions
    list: WidgetSourceConfiguration
    summary: SummaryItem
    path: string[]
    showCheckboxes: boolean
    defaultRowsPerPage?: number
}

interface DynamicTabConfiguration {
    summary: SummaryViewConfiguration
    list: ListViewConfiguration
}

export interface AddDynamicTabEvents {
    addTab: {
        tabConfiguration: DynamicTabConfiguration
    }
}

export function addDynamicTab(reportContext: ReportContext, container: Component, fromConfiguration?: DynamicTabConfiguration, dashboardName?: string): WizardDialog<{}, AddDynamicTabEvents> {
    const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
    const dialog = new WizardDialog<{}, AddDynamicTabEvents>('Configure dynamic tab')
        .setMaxWidth('md')

    const config: TabConfiguration = {
        icon: 'Widgets',
        entity: undefined,
        theme: colors.blueGrey,
        where: undefined,
        list: {
            columns: []
        },
        summary: {
            data: undefined,
            title: undefined
        },
        path: [],
        showCheckboxes: false,
        defaultRowsPerPage: 25
    }

    const parseConfiguration = (itemConfiguration: DynamicTabConfiguration): void => {
        config.icon = itemConfiguration.summary.icon
        config.entity = models[itemConfiguration.list.entity]
        config.theme = getTheme(config.entity)
        config.where = itemConfiguration.summary.where
        config.list.columns = itemConfiguration.list.columns.map((column, index) => new ListColumnConfiguration(config.entity, column.path).setConfiguration(
            column.align || 'right',
            column.label,
            column.sticky,
            column.wrap,
            column.width,
            column.minimumWidth || 0,
            column.totalType,
            itemConfiguration.list.columns.length <= 1 ? 'ONLY' : index === 0 ? 'FIRST' : index === itemConfiguration.list.columns.length - 1 ? 'LAST' : 'MIDDLE',
            column.groupBy,
            column.subSummary,
            column.summaryType
        ))
        config.summary.data = new ListColumnConfiguration(models[itemConfiguration.summary.entity], itemConfiguration.summary.data)
        config.summary.title = itemConfiguration.summary.title
        config.showCheckboxes = itemConfiguration.list.showCheckboxes
        config.path = itemConfiguration.list.path
        config.defaultRowsPerPage = itemConfiguration.list.defaultRowsPerPage || 25
    }

    dialog.on('finish', async () => {
        const repository = getRepository(models.DashboardConfiguration)
        const restoreRepository = getRepository(models.DashboardRestoreConfiguration)

        const defaultConfig = await repository.findOne({
            name: dashboardName,
            user: application.getUser()
        })

        const restoreConfiguration = await restoreRepository.findOne({
            user: application.getUser(),
            name: dashboardName
        })

        if (restoreConfiguration) {
            restoreConfiguration.configuration = defaultConfig.configuration
            restoreRepository.save(restoreConfiguration)
        } else {
            const configuration = await restoreRepository.save(
                restoreRepository.create({
                    configuration: defaultConfig && defaultConfig.configuration || JSON.stringify([]),
                    name: dashboardName,
                    user: application.getUser()
                })
            )
        }

        const tabConfiguration: DynamicTabConfiguration = {
            summary: {
                data: config.summary.data ? config.summary.data.getPath() : [],
                entity: config.entity.name as keyof typeof models,
                icon: config.icon,
                path: config.path,
                title: config.summary.title,
                where: config.where
            },
            list: {
                columns: config.list.columns.map(column => ({
                    align: column.getAlign(),
                    label: column.getLabel(),
                    minimumWidth: column.getMinimumWidth(),
                    path: column.getPath(),
                    sticky: column.getSticky(),
                    width: column.getWidth(),
                    wrap: column.getWrap(),
                    totalType: column.getTotalType(),
                    groupBy: column.getGroupBy(),
                    subSummary: column.getSubSummary(),
                    summaryType: column.getSummaryType()
                })),
                entity: config.entity.name,
                groups: [],
                path: config.path,
                where: config.where,
                showCheckboxes: config.showCheckboxes,
                defaultRowsPerPage: config.defaultRowsPerPage || 25
            }
        }

        dialog.emit('addTab', { tabConfiguration })
        application.getContainer().removeChild(dialog)
    })

    const sourceStep = new WizardStep('Data source')
        .setDetails('Set the data source for the tab')

    const summaryDataStep = new WizardStep('Summary data')
        .setDetails('Choose which colummn to total for the summary')

    const columnsStep = new WizardStep('List columns')
        .setDetails('Pick the columns to display on the tab')

    const filtersStep = new WizardStep('Filters')
        .setDetails('Set any criteria for filtering the data')

    const customizeStep = new WizardStep('Customize')
        .setDetails('Customize the look of the tab')
        .setComplete(true)

    let generateSteps: (resetConfig?: boolean) => void

    const validate = (): boolean => {
        sourceStep.setError(false)
        summaryDataStep.setError(false)
        columnsStep.setError(false)
        filtersStep.setError(false)
        customizeStep.setError(false)

        if (!config.entity) {
            sourceStep.setError(true)
            dialog.rebuild(true)

            return false
        }

        if (!config.summary.title) {
            summaryDataStep.setError(true)
            dialog.rebuild(true)

            return false
        }

        dialog.rebuild(true)

        return true
    }

    const generateSourceStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FragmentContainer()

        if (reportContext && reportContext.id) {
            const dropdown = new DropdownMenu().setColor('inherit')
            const selected = new Typography('')
            const ignoreRelationsMap: Map<typeof Base, Set<string>> = new Map()

            if (config.path.length === 0) {
                selected.setContent('Choose a data source...')
            } else {
                selected.setContent(config.path.join(' ➔ '))
            }

            const parseOptions = (entity: typeof Base, path: string[], depth: number, parent?: typeof Base): Menu => {
                const menu = new Menu()

                let ignoreRelations = ignoreRelationsMap.get(entity)

                if (ignoreRelations === undefined) {
                    ignoreRelations = new Set()
                    ignoreRelationsMap.set(entity, ignoreRelations)
                }

                for (const option of getReportOptions(entity)) {
                    if (option instanceof RelationOption) {
                        if (ignoreRelations.has(option.getProperty()) || option.getTarget() === reportContext.entity || option.getTarget() === parent || path.includes(option.getLabel())) {
                            continue
                        }

                        const item = new MenuItem(option.getLabel())
                        let add = false

                        if (option.getToMany()) {
                            let targetIgnoreRelations = ignoreRelationsMap.get(option.getTarget())

                            if (targetIgnoreRelations === undefined) {
                                targetIgnoreRelations = new Set()
                                ignoreRelationsMap.set(option.getTarget(), targetIgnoreRelations)
                            }

                            targetIgnoreRelations.add(option.getRelation().inverseSidePropertyPath)

                            item.on('click', () => {
                                config.entity = option.getTarget(),
                                config.path = [...path, option.getLabel()]

                                config.icon = getIcon(config.entity).getIcon()
                                config.theme = getTheme(config.entity)

                                sourceStep.setValue(config.path.join(' ➔ '))
                                dropdown.setOpen(false)

                                generateSteps()
                            })

                            add = true
                        }

                        if (getReportOptions(option.getTarget()).filter(option => option instanceof RelationOption && option.getToMany()).length > 0) {
                            const placeholder = new MenuItem('Loading...').setDisabled(true)

                            item.on('open', () => {
                                item.clearChildren()
                                item.addChild(new MenuItem('Loading...').setDisabled(true))
                                const child = parseOptions(option.getTarget(), [...path, option.getLabel()], depth + 1, entity)

                                item.clearChildren()
                                if (child.getChildren().length > 0) {
                                    item.addChild(child)
                                } else {
                                    item.addChild(new MenuItem('No options found').setDisabled(true))
                                }
                            })

                            item.on('close', () => {
                                item.clearChildren()
                                item.addChild(placeholder)
                            })

                            item.addChild(placeholder)
                            add = true
                        }

                        if (add) {
                            menu.addChild(item)
                        }
                    }
                }

                return menu
            }

            dropdown.addChild(parseOptions(reportContext.entity, [], 0))
            content.addChild(selected, dropdown)
        } else if (!fromConfiguration && reportContext && reportContext.id === undefined) {
            config.entity = reportContext.entity
            config.path = []
            config.where = { conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] }
            config.summary.data = undefined
            config.list.columns = []
            sourceStep.setVisible(false)
        } else {
            const source = new NullableSelect<typeof Base>()
                .setLabel('Data source')
                .setOptions(getSourceTables(application, dashboardName))
                .setNullable(false)
                .setValue(config.entity)

            source.getOptionHash = entity => createHash('md5').update(entity === null ? '' : entity.name).digest('hex')
            source.getOptionPrimary = entity => entity.name
                .replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')
                .toLowerCase()
                .trim()
                .replace(/^./, match => match.toUpperCase())

            source.on('change', () => {
                config.entity = source.getValue()
                config.path = []
                config.where = { conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] }
                config.summary.data = undefined
                config.list.columns = []

                config.icon = getIcon(config.entity).getIcon()
                config.theme = getTheme(config.entity)

                sourceStep.setValue(config.path.join(' ➔ '))
                generateSteps()
            })

            content.addChild(source)
        }

        sourceStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateFiltersStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FragmentContainer()

        const setStepValue = (filter: FilterClause | FilterGroup): void => {
            const valuesFromFilter = (filter: FilterClause | FilterGroup): string[] => {
                const values: string[] = []

                if ((filter as FilterGroup).conjunction) {
                    values.push(...(filter as FilterGroup).conditions.map(condition => valuesFromFilter(condition)).reduce((values, value) => values.concat(value), []))
                } else {
                    values.push((filter as FilterClause).path.slice(-1)[0])
                }

                return values
            }

            const value = valuesFromFilter(filter).join(', ')
            filtersStep.setValue(value).setComplete(true)
        }

        const configurator = new FilterConfigurator(config.entity, config.where || { conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] }, application)
            .on('change', filter => {
                config.where = filter
                setStepValue(filter)
            })

        if (config.where) {
            setStepValue(config.where)
        }

        content.addChild(configurator)
        filtersStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateSummaryDataStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8)
        const addContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)

        const titleInput = new Input()
            .setLabel('Tab title')
            .setValue(config.summary.title)
            .on('change', () => {
                config.summary.title = titleInput.getValue()
            })

        const dataSelected = new TitleBar('Choose column', true, 'Clear summary')

        dataSelected.on('onClear', () => {
            summaryDataStep.setValue('').invalidateCache()
            dataSelected.setTitle('Choose column')
            config.summary.data = undefined

            addContainer
                .clearChildren()
                .addChild(
                    dataSelected,
                    new ListOptionsContainer(
                        config.entity,
                        application,
                        false,
                        true,
                        [],
                        option => option.getVisible() === true
                    ).on('click', event => {
                        config.summary.data = setData(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.entity, event.path))

                        validate()
                        dialog.rebuild()
                    })
                )
        })

        const setData = (column: ListColumnConfiguration): ListColumnConfiguration => {
            dataSelected.setTitle(column.getPath().join(' ➔ '))
            summaryDataStep.setValue(column.getPath().slice(-1)[0])
            column
                .removeAllListeners()
                .on('remove', () => {
                    config.summary.data = undefined
                })

            return column
        }

        if (config.summary.data) {
            dataSelected.setTitle(config.summary.data.getPath().length > 0 ? config.summary.data.getPath().join(' ➔ ') : 'Choose column')
            summaryDataStep
                .setValue(config.summary.data.getPath().slice(-1)[0])
                .setComplete(true)
        }

        addContainer
            .clearChildren()
            .addChild(
                dataSelected,
                new ListOptionsContainer(
                    config.entity,
                    application,
                    false,
                    true,
                    [],
                    option => option.getVisible() === true
                ).on('click', event => {
                    config.summary.data = setData(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.entity, event.path))

                    validate()
                    dialog.rebuild()
                })
            )

        content.addChild(
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(titleInput),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(
                new Typography('Choose data to show in tab', 'body2').setInline(true).setColor('textSecondary')
            ),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(addContainer)
        )

        summaryDataStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateColumnsStep = (): void => {
        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8)
        const addContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)

        const container = new List()
        const label = new Typography(`${config.list.columns.length} columns selected`, 'dialog')

        const setStepValue = (): void => {
            label.setContent(`${config.list.columns.length} columns selected`)
            const value = config.list.columns.map(column => column.getLabel()).join(', ')
            columnsStep.setValue(value)
        }

        const addColumn = (column: ListColumnConfiguration): ListColumnConfiguration => {
            column.removeAllListeners()
            column.on('remove', () => {
                const index = config.list.columns.findIndex(existing => existing === column)

                if (config.list.columns.length > 1) {
                    if (index === 0) {
                        config.list.columns[index + 1].setToTopAndUpMenusAsDisabled(true)
                    }

                    if (index === config.list.columns.length - 1) {
                        config.list.columns[index - 1].setToBottomAndDownMenusAsDisabled(true)
                    }
                }

                config.list.columns.splice(index, 1)
                container.removeChild(column)

                setStepValue()
                validate()
            })

            addColumnMovementListeners(column, config.list.columns, container)

            container.addChild(column)
            setStepValue()

            return column
        }

        const add = new IconButton(new Icon('Add'))
            .setColor('inherit')
            .on('click', () => {
                if (addContainer.getChildren().length === 0) {
                    addContainer.addChild(
                        new TitleBar('Choose column'),
                        new ListOptionsContainer(
                            config.entity,
                            application,
                            true,
                            true,
                            [],
                            option => option.getVisible() === true && option.getContexts().includes('list')
                        )
                            .on('click', event => {
                                let position: 'FIRST' | 'LAST' | 'MIDDLE' | 'ONLY' = 'LAST'

                                if (config.list.columns.length === 0) {
                                    position = 'ONLY'
                                } else {
                                    config.list.columns[config.list.columns.length - 1].setToBottomAndDownMenusAsDisabled(false)
                                }

                                const confirmLabelNameDialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Edit column')
                                const label = new Input()
                                    .setLabel('Label')
                                    .setValue(event.option.getLabel())
                                    .setAutoFocus(true)

                                const onSave = (): void => {
                                    if (!label.getValue()) {
                                        label.setError('Label is required').invalidateCache()

                                        return
                                    }

                                    if (addAsSummaryColumn.getChecked() && summaryTypeSelect.getValue() === undefined) {
                                        summaryTypeSelect.setError('Summary type is required').invalidateCache()

                                        return
                                    }

                                    config.list.columns.push(addColumn(new ListColumnConfiguration(config.entity, event.path).setConfiguration(
                                        event.option.getAlign(),
                                        label.getValue(),
                                        event.option.getSticky(),
                                        event.option.getWrap(),
                                        event.option.getWidth(),
                                        event.option.getMinimumWidth(),
                                        event.option.getTotalType(),
                                        position,
                                        event.option.getGroupBy(),
                                        event.option.getSubSummary(),
                                        event.option.getSummaryType()
                                    )))

                                    addContainer.clearChildren()
                                    setStepValue()
                                    validate()
                                }

                                const save = new Button().setLabel('Save').setColor('primary')
                                save.on('click', onSave)

                                const addAsGroupColumn = new Checkbox()
                                    .setLabel('Make as group')
                                    .setChecked(event.option.getGroupBy())
                                    .on('change', () => {
                                        if (addAsGroupColumn.getChecked()) {
                                            event.option.setGroupBy(true)
                                            addAsSummaryColumn.setDisabled(true)
                                            summaryTypeSelect.setDisabled(true)
                                        } else {
                                            event.option.setGroupBy(false)
                                            addAsSummaryColumn.setDisabled(false)
                                            summaryTypeSelect.setDisabled(false)
                                        }
                                    })

                                const addAsSummaryColumn = new Checkbox()
                                    .setLabel('Make as summary')
                                    .setChecked(event.option.getSubSummary())
                                    .on('change', () => {
                                        if (addAsSummaryColumn.getChecked()) {
                                            event.option.setSubSummary(true)
                                            addAsGroupColumn.setDisabled(true)
                                            summaryTypeSelect.setDisabled(false)
                                        } else {
                                            event.option.setSubSummary(false)
                                            addAsGroupColumn.setDisabled(false)
                                            summaryTypeSelect.setDisabled(true)
                                        }
                                    })

                                const options = ['sum', 'count', 'avg', 'min', 'max']
                                const summaryTypeSelect = new Select()
                                    .setLabel('Summary Type')
                                    .setOptions(options)
                                    .setValue(event.option.getSummaryType())
                                    .on('change', selected => {
                                        event.option.setSummaryType(summaryTypeSelect.getValue() as string)
                                    })

                                summaryTypeSelect.getOptionPrimary = option => option

                                confirmLabelNameDialog
                                    .addChild(label, addAsGroupColumn, addAsSummaryColumn, summaryTypeSelect)
                                    .addAction(save)
                                    .addShortcut('enter', onSave)

                                addContainer.addChild(confirmLabelNameDialog)
                            })
                    )
                }
            })

        if (config.list.columns.length > 0) {
            for (const column of config.list.columns) {
                addColumn(column)
            }

            columnsStep.setComplete(true)
        }

        const listContainer = new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(container)

        content.addChild(
            new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8).setAlignItems('center').addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', true).addChild(label),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(add)
            ),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(addContainer),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(new TitleBar('Selected column(s)')),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(
                new Typography('Totals on columns can increase load times if there are a large number of records.', 'dialog')
            ),
            listContainer
        )

        columnsStep.setContent(content)
    }

    const generateCustomizationStep = (): void => {
        const checkboxConfig = new Checkbox()
            .setChecked(config.showCheckboxes)
            .setLabel('Show record selection checkboxes')
            .on('change', () => {
                config.showCheckboxes = checkboxConfig.getChecked()
            })

        const rowSelectData = [10, 25, 50, 100]

        const defaultRowsPerPage = new Select<number>()
            .setLabel('Default rows per page')
            .setValue(config.defaultRowsPerPage || 25)
            .setOptions(rowSelectData)
            .on('change', () => {
                config.defaultRowsPerPage = defaultRowsPerPage.getValue()
            })

        const rowsperPageContainer = new FlexContainer(false, true)
            .addChild(defaultRowsPerPage)
            .setWidth(50)
            .setPadding(16)

        const content = new FlexContainer(true, false).setSpacing(8).addChild(checkboxConfig, rowsperPageContainer)

        customizeStep.setContent(content)
    }

    generateSteps = (reset: boolean = false): void => {
        if (reset) {
            sourceStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            filtersStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            summaryDataStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            columnsStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(false)
            customizeStep.setDisabled(false).setComplete(true)
        }

        if (reportContext && !reportContext.id) {
            sourceStep.setVisible(false)
        }

        generateSourceStep()
        generateFiltersStep()
        generateSummaryDataStep()
        generateColumnsStep()
        generateCustomizationStep()

        validate()
    }

    if (fromConfiguration) {
        parseConfiguration(fromConfiguration)
    }

    generateSteps()

    dialog.on('beforeNext', ({ successHandler }) => {
        validate()

        const activeStep = dialog.getActiveStep(true)

        if (!activeStep.getError()) {
            successHandler()
        }
    })

    dialog.addStep(
        sourceStep,
        filtersStep,
        summaryDataStep,
        columnsStep,
        customizeStep
    )

    application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)

    return dialog
}
````
