````typescript
/* eslint-disable max-classes-per-file */
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { DropdownMenu, FlexContainer, FragmentContainer, Icon, IconButton, Select, Typography, Menu, MenuItem } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { FilterClause, FilterGroup, getOptionForPath } from '../../../reports'
import { ListOptionsMenu } from '../../../component'

export class FilterConfiguratorEvents {
    change: FilterClause | FilterGroup
    remove: {}
}

export class FilterConfigurator extends FragmentContainer<FilterConfiguratorEvents> {
    public constructor(protected entity: typeof Base, protected configuration: FilterClause | FilterGroup, protected application?: Application) {
        super()

        if (this.isFilterClause(configuration)) {
            this.addChild(this.buildClauseConfigurator(configuration))
        } else {
            this.addChild(this.buildGroupConfigurator(configuration))
        }
    }

    protected isFilterClause(configuration: any): configuration is FilterClause {
        return (
            typeof configuration.operator === 'string' &&
            Array.isArray(configuration.path)
        )
    }

    protected buildClauseConfigurator(clause: FilterClause): FlexContainer<{}> {
        const option = getOptionForPath(this.entity, clause.path)
        const operators = new Select<string>().setOptions(option.getFilterOperators()).setValue(clause.operator)
        const container = new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 4)
        const remove = new IconButton(new Icon('Delete')).on('click', () => this.emit('remove', {}))

        const filterType = option.getFilter(operators.getValue())
        const filter = new filterType(option, clause.configuration)

        container.clearChildren()
        container.addChild(filter.render())

        clause.operator = operators.getValue()

        filter.on('change', () => {
            clause.configuration = filter.getConfiguration()
            this.emit('change', clause)
        })

        operators.on('change', () => {
            const filterType = option.getFilter(operators.getValue())
            const filter = new filterType(option, clause.configuration)

            container.clearChildren()
            container.addChild(filter.render())

            clause.operator = operators.getValue()

            filter.on('change', () => {
                clause.configuration = filter.getConfiguration()
                this.emit('change', clause)
            })

            this.emit('change', clause)
        })

        return new FlexContainer(true, false).setDirection('row').setAlignItems('center').setSpacing(8).addChild(
            new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', true).setAlignItems('center').setSpacing(8).addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 4).addChild(new Typography(clause.path.join(' ➔ '), 'dialog')),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 4).addChild(operators),
                container
            ),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(remove)
        )
    }

    protected buildGroupConfigurator(group: FilterGroup): FlexContainer<{}> {
        const conjunction = new Select<'and' | 'or'>().setOptions(['and', 'or']).setValue(group.conjunction)
        const container = new FragmentContainer()
        const addMenu = new DropdownMenu().setIcon(new Icon('Add')).setColor('inherit')
        const optionsMenu = new ListOptionsMenu(this.entity, true, false, [], option => option.getFilterOperators().length > 0, this.application)
        const addGroup = new MenuItem('Group')
        const remove = new IconButton(new Icon('Delete')).on('click', () => this.emit('remove', {}))

        addMenu.addChild(new Menu().addChild(new MenuItem('Clause').addChild(optionsMenu), addGroup))

        addGroup.on('click', () => {
            const condition: FilterGroup = {
                conjunction: 'and',
                conditions: []
            }

            const configurator = new FilterConfigurator(this.entity, condition, this.application)

            configurator.on('change', () => this.emit('change', group))

            configurator.on('remove', (state) => {
                group.conditions.splice(group.conditions.indexOf(condition), 1)
                container.removeChild(configurator)
                this.emit('change', group)
            })

            container.addChild(configurator)
            group.conditions.push(condition)

            this.emit('change', group)
        })

        optionsMenu.on('click', event => {
            const operators = event.option.getFilterOperators()

            const condition: FilterClause = {
                operator: operators[0],
                path: event.path
            }

            const configurator = new FilterConfigurator(this.entity, condition, this.application)

            configurator.on('change', () => this.emit('change', group))

            configurator.on('remove', (state) => {
                group.conditions.splice(group.conditions.indexOf(condition), 1)
                container.removeChild(configurator)
                this.emit('change', group)
            })

            container.addChild(configurator)
            group.conditions.push(condition)

            this.emit('change', group)
        })

        conjunction.on('change', () => {
            group.conjunction = conjunction.getValue()
            this.emit('change', group)
        })

        for (const condition of group.conditions) {
            const configurator = new FilterConfigurator(this.entity, condition, this.application)

            configurator.on('change', (state) => this.emit('change', group))

            configurator.on('remove', (state) => {
                group.conditions.splice(group.conditions.indexOf(condition), 1)
                container.removeChild(configurator)
                this.emit('change', group)
            })

            container.addChild(configurator)
        }

        return new FlexContainer(true, false).setPadding(16).setSpacing(32).addChild(
            new FlexContainer(true, true).setAlignItems('center').setSpacing(8).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', true).addChild(conjunction),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(remove),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(addMenu)
            ),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12).addChild(container)
        )
    }
}
````

````typescript
import * as models from '../models'
import { Application } from '../application'
import { Base } from '../models/base'
import { Chart, ChartType } from '../component'
import { Component, ErrorMessage, FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DataOption, FilterClause, FilterGroup, ReportContext, ReportQuery } from '../reports'

const months = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December']

export interface ChartDataConfiguration {
    label: string
    path: string[]
}

export type WhereConfiguration = FilterClause | FilterGroup

export interface ChartConfiguration {
    data: ChartDataConfiguration[]
    entity: string
    path: string[]
    where?: WhereConfiguration | WhereConfiguration[]
    chartType: string
    legendLabels: string[]
}

interface ColumnConfiguration {
    x: [DataOption<Base>, string, string[]]
    y: [DataOption<Base>, string, string[]]
}

export class ChartView extends Component {
    protected container: FragmentContainer
    protected series: ColumnConfiguration[] = []
    protected queries: ReportQuery<any>[] = []
    protected stacked = false
    protected legendLabels: string[] = []

    public constructor(protected configuration: ChartConfiguration, context?: ReportContext) {
        super()

        const entity = (models as any)[configuration.entity]

        this.container = new FragmentContainer()

        for (const [index, column] of Array.from(configuration.data.slice(1).entries())) {
            const query = new ReportQuery(entity)

            query.setDefaultGrouping(true)
            query.addGroupBy(configuration.data[0].path)

            if (context && (context.id || context.ids)) {
                query.setContext(context, configuration.path)
            }

            this.series.push({
                x: [query.addSelect(configuration.data[0].path), configuration.data[0].label, configuration.data[0].path],
                y: [query.addSelect(column.path), column.label, column.path]
            })

            if (configuration.where !== undefined) {
                if (Array.isArray(configuration.where)) {
                    query.setWhere(configuration.where[index])
                } else {
                    query.setWhere(configuration.where)
                }
            }

            this.queries.push(query)
        }

        if (this.configuration.legendLabels) {
            this.legendLabels.push(...Array.from(this.configuration.legendLabels))
        }
    }

    protected getAsync(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected getEager(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected getUnloadOnUnmount(): boolean {
        return false
    }

    protected async parseResults(): Promise<void> {
        const application = this.getRootComponent() as Application
        const data = []
        let tooltipDateFormat: string
        let canView = true

        for (const [index, query] of Array.from(this.queries.entries())) {
            query.setLoggedOnUser(application.getUser())
            query.setLoggedOnUserTradingCompany(application.getTradingCompany())
            const results = await query.getResults()

            for (const result of Array.from(results)) {
                const row: any = {}

                const [xOption, xLabel] = this.series[index].x
                const [yOption, yLabel] = this.series[index].y
                const [xEntity, xRaw] = result.get(xOption)
                const [yEntity, yRaw] = result.get(yOption)

                if (xOption.getCanView(application) === false || yOption.getCanView(application) === false) {
                    canView = false
                }

                if (this.configuration.chartType === 'LineChart') {
                    switch (xLabel) {
                        case 'Year':
                            row[xLabel] = new Date(xOption.getValue(xEntity, xRaw), 1)
                            tooltipDateFormat = 'yyyy'
                            break
                        case 'Month':
                            row[xLabel] = new Date().setMonth(xOption.getValue(xEntity, xRaw))
                            tooltipDateFormat = 'MMM'
                            break
                        default:
                            row[xLabel] = xOption.getValue(xEntity, xRaw)
                    }
                } else {
                    row[xLabel] = xOption.getValue(xEntity, xRaw)
                }

                row[`${yLabel}-${index}`] = yOption.getValue(yEntity, yRaw)

                data.push(row)
            }
        }

        if (this.series[0].x[1] === 'Month name') {
            data.sort((valueA, valueB) => {
                return months.indexOf(valueA[this.series[0].x[1]]) - months.indexOf(valueB[this.series[0].x[1]])
            })
        } else {
            data.sort((valueA, valueB) => {
                const dateValueA = new Date(valueA[this.series[0].x[1]])
                const dateValueB = new Date(valueB[this.series[0].x[1]])

                return dateValueA > dateValueB ? 1 : -1
            })
        }

        const chartConfigs: { [key: string]: {} } = {
            BarChart: {
                data,
                type: 'XYChart',
                yAxes: [{
                    type: 'CategoryAxis',
                    renderer: {
                        minGridDistance: 1
                    },
                    dataFields: {
                        category: this.series[0].x[1]
                    }
                }],
                xAxes: [{
                    type: 'ValueAxis',
                    min: 0
                }],
                legend: this.series.length > 1 ? {} : undefined,
                series: this.series.map((series, index) => ({
                    type: 'ColumnSeries',
                    columns: {
                        template: {
                            column: {
                                cornerRadiusTopRight: 4,
                                cornerRadiusBottomRight: 4
                            },
                            tooltipText: '{categoryY}: [bold]{valueX}[/]',
                            strokeOpacity: 0,
                            fillOpacity: 0.8
                        }
                    },
                    dataFields: {
                        categoryY: this.series[0].x[1],
                        valueX: `${series.y[1]}-${index}`
                    },
                    legendSettings: {
                        labelText: '[bold {color}]{name}[/]'
                    },
                    name: this.legendLabels[index] || series.y[2].join(','),
                    stacked: this.stacked
                }))
            },
            ColumnChart: {
                data,
                type: 'XYChart',
                yAxes: [{
                    type: 'ValueAxis',
                    min: 0
                }],
                xAxes: [{
                    type: 'CategoryAxis',
                    renderer: {
                        minGridDistance: 8,
                        labels: {
                            truncate: true,
                            tooltipText: '{category}'
                        }
                    },
                    dataFields: {
                        category: this.series[0].x[1]
                    }
                }],
                legend: this.series.length > 1 ? {} : undefined,
                series: this.series.map((series, index) => ({
                    type: 'ColumnSeries',
                    columns: {
                        template: {
                            column: {
                                cornerRadiusTopRight: 4,
                                cornerRadiusTopLeft: 4
                            },
                            tooltipText: '{categoryX}: [bold]{valueY}[/]',
                            strokeOpacity: 0,
                            fillOpacity: 0.8
                        }
                    },
                    dataFields: {
                        categoryX: this.series[0].x[1],
                        valueY: `${series.y[1]}-${index}`
                    },
                    legendSettings: {
                        labelText: '[bold {color}]{name}[/]'
                    },
                    name: this.legendLabels[index] || series.y[2].join(','),
                    stacked: this.stacked
                }))
            },
            LineChart: {
                data,
                type: 'XYChart',
                yAxes: [{
                    type: 'ValueAxis',
                    min: 0
                }],
                xAxes: [{
                    type: 'DateAxis',
                    renderer: {
                        minGridDistance: 30
                    },
                    periodChangeDateFormats: {
                        month: 'MMM'
                    },
                    tooltipDateFormat: tooltipDateFormat ? tooltipDateFormat : undefined
                }],
                legend: this.series.length > 1 ? {} : undefined,
                series: this.series.map((series, index) => ({
                    type: 'LineSeries',
                    dataFields: {
                        valueY: `${series.y[1]}-${index}`,
                        dateX: this.series[0].x[1]
                    },
                    name: this.legendLabels[index] || series.y[2].join(','),
                    tooltipText: '{valueY}',
                    legendSettings: {
                        labelText: '[bold {color}]{name}[/]'
                    },
                    bullets: [{
                        type: 'CircleBullet',
                        circle: {
                            strokeWidth: 2,
                            radius: 4,
                            fill: '#fff'
                        },
                        bullethover: {
                            states: {
                                create: 'hover'
                            },
                            properties: {
                                scale: 1.3
                            }
                        }
                    }],
                    stacked: this.stacked
                })),
                cursor: {
                    lineY: {
                        disabled: true
                    }
                }
            },
            PieChart: {
                data,
                type: 'PieChart',
                series: [{
                    type: 'PieSeries',
                    radius: '85%',
                    labels: {
                        maxWidth: 70,
                        wrap: true
                    },
                    ticks: {
                        disabled: false
                    },
                    dataFields: {
                        category: this.series[0].x[1],
                        value: `${this.series[0].y[1]}-0`
                    },
                    colors: {
                        step: 3
                    },
                    slices: {
                        template: {
                            cornerRadius: 4
                        }
                    }
                }]
            },
            RadarChart: {
                data,
                type: 'RadarChart',
                xAxes: [{
                    type: 'CategoryAxis',
                    dataFields: {
                        category: this.series[0].x[1]
                    }
                }],
                yAxes: [{
                    type: 'ValueAxis',
                    min: 0
                }],
                legend: this.series.length > 1 ? {} : undefined,
                series: this.series.map((series, index) => ({
                    type: 'RadarColumnSeries',
                    columns: {
                        template: {
                            tooltipText: '{categoryX}: [bold]{valueY}[/]'
                        }
                    },
                    dataFields: {
                        categoryX: this.series[0].x[1],
                        valueY: `${series.y[1]}-${index}`
                    },
                    name: this.legendLabels[index] || series.y[2].join(','),
                    legendSettings: {
                        labelText: '[bold {color}]{name}[/]'
                    }
                }))
            }
        }

        this.container.clearChildren()

        if (canView) {
            this.container.addChild(new Chart(this.configuration.chartType as ChartType, chartConfigs[this.configuration.chartType]))
        } else {
            this.container.addChild(new ErrorMessage('Insufficient permissions', 'You do not have permission to view this chart.'))
        }
    }

    protected async build(): Promise<FragmentContainer> {
        await this.parseResults()

        return this.container
    }
}
````

````typescript
import * as models from '../models'
import { Application } from '../application'
import { Component, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND, DataOption, FilterClause, FilterGroup, ReportContext, ReportQuery } from '../reports'
import { Summary } from '../component'
import { replaceDictionaryTermsWithPreferredTerms } from '../functions/replaceDictionaryTermsWithPreferredTerms'

export interface SummaryViewConfiguration {
    data: string[]
    entity: string
    icon: string
    path: string[]
    title: string
    where?: FilterClause | FilterGroup
}

export class SummaryView extends Component {
    protected option: DataOption<any>
    protected query: ReportQuery<any>
    protected summary: Summary

    public constructor(configuration: SummaryViewConfiguration, context?: ReportContext) {
        super()

        const entity = (models as any)[configuration.entity]

        this.query = new ReportQuery(entity)
        this.option = this.query.addSelect(configuration.data)

        if (context && (context.id || context.ids)) {
            this.query.setContext(context, configuration.path)
        }

        if (configuration.where !== undefined) {
            this.query.setWhere(configuration.where)
        }

        configuration.title = replaceDictionaryTermsWithPreferredTerms(configuration.title)
        this.summary = new Summary(configuration.title).setIcon(configuration.icon as any)
    }

    protected getAsync(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected getEager(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected getUnloadOnUnmount(): boolean {
        return false
    }

    protected async parseResults(): Promise<void> {
        const application = this.getRootComponent() as Application

        this.query.setLoggedOnUser(application.getUser())
        this.query.setLoggedOnUserTradingCompany(application.getTradingCompany())
        const results = await this.query.getResults()

        this.summary.clearData()

        for (const result of Array.from(results)) {
            const canView = this.option.getCanView(application)

            if (canView) {
                if (this.option.getLabel() === DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND && !this.option.getEntity()) {
                    this.summary.clearChildren().addChild(new Typography('Data option not found', 'caption').setColor('error'))
                } else if (this.option.getEntity() && this.option.getLabel() === DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND) {
                    this.summary.clearChildren().addChild(new Typography('', 'caption'))
                } else {
                    const [entity, raw] = result.get(this.option)
                    this.summary.clearChildren().addChild(this.option.renderContent(entity, raw, this))
                }
            } else {
                this.summary.clearChildren().addChild(new Typography('Access denied to value', 'caption').setColor('error'))
            }
        }
    }

    protected async build(): Promise<Summary> {
        this.parseResults()

        return this.summary
    }
}
````
