    protected noResultsText?: string
    protected sortColumn?: [TableSortLabel, boolean]
    protected table = new ListTable().setSize('small')
    protected query: ReportQuery<any>
    protected where: FilterGroup = { conjunction: 'and', conditions: [] }
    protected rowClick: boolean = false
    protected tabTheme: any
    // Negative margins removed due to a visual/rendering issue in Firefox (caused layout glitches)
    protected exportPdfButton: IconButton = new IconButton(new Icon('PictureAsPdf'))
    protected exportButton: IconButton = new IconButton(new Icon('CloudDownload'))
    protected exportStockTakePdfButton: IconButton = new IconButton(new Icon('AssignmentTurnedIn'))
    protected askAiButton: IconButton = new IconButton(new Icon('MonitorHeart'))
    protected title?: string
    protected selectedRecordsCount: Typography
    protected resultsCount: number = 0
    protected selectAllCheckbox: Checkbox
    protected selectAllTooltip: Tooltip
    protected checkboxes: Checkbox[] = []
    protected selectAllCheckboxOnChangeSetup: boolean = false
    protected entities: Base[] = []
    protected uuid: string
    protected menu: MenuData<Base>

    protected entity: string
    protected entityModel: any

    protected paginationInput: Input = new Input().setType('number').setVariant('standard').setLabel('Current page')

    protected noOfRecord: void = null

    protected finalPageInput: Input = new Input().setType('number')
        .setVariant('standard')
        .setDisabled(true)
        .setDisableUnderline(true)

    private debounceTimer: any
    protected abortController?: AbortController

    protected isGrouped: boolean = false
    protected hasGroupBy: boolean = false
    protected hasSubSummary: boolean = false
    protected optionPaths = new Map<DataOption<any>, string[]>()

    public constructor(
        protected container: Component,
        protected configuration: ListViewConfiguration,
        protected application: Application,
        settingsButton?: Component,
        context?: ReportContext,
        protected rowClickHandler?: (entity: Base) => void | Promise<void>
    ) {
        super()

        this.uuid = uuidv4()

        this.entityModel = (models as any)[configuration.entity]
        this.entity = configuration.entity

        this.table.on('onChangeShowSelect', data => {
            this.table.setShowSelected()
            this.parseResults(data.show, true)
        })

        this.selectedRecordsCount = new Typography(`0 of ${this.resultsCount} records selected`, 'body1')

        this.query = new ReportQuery(this.entityModel)
        this.table.setBody(this.body)

        if (configuration.maxHeight !== undefined) {
            this.table.setMaxHeight(configuration.maxHeight)
        }

        const rowSelectData = [10, 25, 50, 100]

        this.customPagination.setRowsPerPageOptions(rowSelectData)

        this.customPagination.setRowsPerPage(configuration.defaultRowsPerPage || 25)

        this.isGrouped = configuration.columns.some(column => column.groupBy)

        const aiAskContainer = application.canUser('view', 'ai/actions/useAi')
            ? new Tooltip('Ask AI about the data in the list')
                .setContainer(true)
                .setPlacement('top')
                .addChild(this.askAiButton.on('click', async () => this.getAiReply(container, configuration)))
            : null

        this.table.setFooter(
            new TableFooter().addChild(
                new TableRow().addChild(
                    new ListTableCell().addChild(
                        configuration.hideFooterTools
                            ? null
                            : new Tooltip('Generate PDF')
                                .setContainer(true)
                                .setPlacement('top')
                                .addChild(this.exportPdfButton.on('click', async () => this.exportResults('pdf', container, configuration))),
                        configuration.hideFooterTools
                            ? null
                            : new Tooltip('Export data')
                                .setContainer(true)
                                .setPlacement('top')
                                .addChild(this.exportButton.on('click', async () => this.exportResults('export', container, configuration))),
                        configuration.hideFooterTools
                            ? null
                            : this.entity === 'Product'
                                ? new Tooltip('Generate stock take PDF')
                                    .setContainer(true)
                                    .setPlacement('top')
                                    .addChild(this.exportStockTakePdfButton.on('click', async () => this.exportForStockTake('pdf', container)))
                                : null,
                        aiAskContainer,
                        configuration.hideFooterTools
                            ? null
                            : settingsButton ? new Tooltip('Edit list').setPlacement('right').addChild(settingsButton) : null
                    ),
                    configuration.showCheckboxes && !this.isGrouped ? new TableCell().addChild(this.selectedRecordsCount) : null,
                    new TableCell().addChild(this.customPagination).setPadding('none')
                )
            )
        )

        this.table.setHead(new TableHead().addChild(this.header))

        this.customPagination.on('onPageChange', async val => {
            this.customPagination.setPage(Number(val))
            await this.parseResults(this.table.getShowSelected())
        })

        this.customPagination.on('onRowsPerPageChange', async val => {
            this.customPagination.setRowsPerPage(Number(val))

            this.emit('updateRowsPerPage', { rowsPerPage: Number(val) })

            await this.parseResults(this.table.getShowSelected())
        })

        if (context && (context.id || context.ids)) {
            this.query.setContext(context, configuration.path)
        }

        if (configuration.rowClick) {
            this.rowClick = configuration.rowClick
        }

        if (configuration.noResultsText !== undefined) {
            this.noResultsText = configuration.noResultsText
        }

        if (configuration.showCheckboxes && !this.isGrouped) {
            this.selectAllCheckbox = new Checkbox()
            this.selectAllTooltip = new Tooltip('Select all').addChild(this.selectAllCheckbox)

            const recordSelect = new RecordSelectData<Base>(this.entityModel).setAlign('center')
            this.query.addRecordSelect(recordSelect)
            this.header.addChild(new ListTableCell().setSticky(true).addChild(this.selectAllTooltip))

            this.columns.push([recordSelect, undefined])
        }

        // Add the code for menus here (before column output) to put the menus at the left (or after for the right) - also consider listTableCell.tsx
        if (configuration.groups.length === 0) {
            this.query.setDefaultGrouping(true)

            if (!configuration.hideMenu && !this.isGrouped) {
                this.menu = getReportMenu(this.entityModel, this.uuid)

                if (this.menu !== undefined) {
                    this.hasRowMenu = true
                    this.query.addMenu(this.menu)
                    this.header.addChild(new ListTableCell().setSticky(true))
                    this.columns.push([this.menu, undefined])
                }
            }
        }

        this.hasGroupBy = configuration.columns.some(column => column.groupBy)
        this.hasSubSummary = configuration.columns.some(column => column.subSummary)
        const showGroupedView = this.hasGroupBy && this.hasSubSummary

        for (const column of configuration.columns) {
            if (showGroupedView && !column.groupBy && !column.subSummary) {
                continue
            }

            const option = this.query.addSelect(column.path)
            this.optionPaths.set(option, column.path)

            option.setAlign(column.align)
            option.setMinimumWidth(column.minimumWidth)
            option.setSticky(column.sticky)
            option.setTotalType(column.totalType)
            option.setWidth(column.width)
            option.setWrap(column.wrap)

            let sortLabel: TableSortLabel | undefined = undefined

            const color = getTheme(this.entityModel)
            const theme = new Theme(color, color)
            this.tabTheme = color
            const cell = option.renderCell().addChild(theme)

            column.label = replaceDictionaryTermsWithPreferredTerms(column.label)

            const label = new Typography(column.label)
            const canView = option.getCanView(application)

            if (canView && option.getSortable()) {
                sortLabel = new TableSortLabel().addChild(label)

                if (configuration.sort && configuration.sort.label === column.label) {
                    this.query.setOrderBy(column.path, configuration.sort.direction)
                    this.sortColumn = [sortLabel, configuration.sort.direction === 'ASC']
                    this.sortColumn[0].setActive(true).setDirection(configuration.sort.direction)
                }

                sortLabel.on('click', () => {
                    if (this.sortColumn !== undefined) {
                        this.sortColumn[0].setActive(false).setDirection(undefined)
                    }

                    if (this.sortColumn === undefined || this.sortColumn[0] !== sortLabel) {
                        this.sortColumn = [sortLabel, true]
                    } else {
                        this.sortColumn[1] = !this.sortColumn[1]
                    }

                    this.sortColumn[0].setActive(true).setDirection(this.sortColumn[1] ? 'ASC' : 'DESC')

                    this.query.setOrderBy(column.path, this.sortColumn[1] ? 'ASC' : 'DESC')

                    this.emit('updateSort', {
                        label: column.label,
                        direction: this.sortColumn[1] ? 'ASC' : 'DESC'
                    })

                    this.parseResults(this.table.getShowSelected())
                })

                theme.addChild(sortLabel)
            } else {
                theme.addChild(label)
            }

            const operator = option.getQuickFilter()

            if (canView && operator !== undefined) {
                const QuickFilter = option.getFilter(operator)
                const filter = new QuickFilter(option)

                const condition = { path: column.path, operator, configuration: filter.getConfiguration() }

                this.where.conditions.push(condition)

                filter.on('change', async () => {
                    this.customPagination.setSpinner(true)
                    this.customPagination.setPage(0)

                    clearTimeout(this.debounceTimer)

                    this.debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                        const config = filter.getConfiguration()
                        const isEmpty = !config || config.value === '' || config.value === null

                        condition.configuration = config

                        if (isEmpty) {
                            condition.configuration = undefined
                        }

                        this.customPagination.setPage(0)

                        this.parseResults(this.table.getShowSelected())
                    }, 600)
                })

                const renderedFilter = filter.render()

                if (renderedFilter instanceof Input) {
                    renderedFilter.setEndAdornment(
                        new Icon('SearchOutlined')
                            .setColor('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.54)')
                            .setSize('small')
                    )
                }

                cell.addChild(renderedFilter)
            }

            this.columns.push([option, sortLabel])
            this.header.addChild(cell)
        }

        // Add the code for menus here (after column output) to put the menus at the right (or before for the left) - also consider listTableCell.tsx
        if (configuration.groups.length !== 0) {
            for (const path of configuration.groups) {
                this.query.addGroupBy(path)
            }
        }

        if (configuration.where !== undefined) {
            this.where.conditions.push(configuration.where)
        }

        this.query.setWhere(this.where)
    }

    protected groupResults(
        results: Set<Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]>>
    ): GroupedResult[] {
        const groupColumn = this.configuration.columns.find(column => column.groupBy)

        if (!groupColumn) {
            return [{
                key: '',
                rows: results
            }]
        }

        const groupOption = this.columns.find(([option]) => JSON.stringify(this.optionPaths.get(option)) === JSON.stringify(groupColumn?.path))?.[0]

        if (!groupOption) {
            return [{
                key: '',
                rows: results
            }]
        }

        const groups = new Map<any, Set<Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]>>>()

        for (const result of results) {
            const [entity, raw] = result.get(groupOption)
            const value = groupOption.getValue(entity, raw)

            if (!groups.has(value)) {
                groups.set(value, new Set())
            }

            groups.get(value).add(result)
        }

        return Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([key, rows]) => ({
            key,
            rows,
            displayRow: Array.from(rows)[0]
        }))
    }

    protected calculateGroupSummary(
        rows: Set<Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]>>
    ): Map<DataOption<any>, any> {
        const summary = new Map<DataOption<any>, any>()

        for (const [option] of this.columns) {
            const column = this.configuration.columns.find(col => JSON.stringify(col.path) === JSON.stringify(this.optionPaths.get(option)))

            if (!column?.subSummary || !column.summaryType) {
                continue
            }

            const values: number[] = []

            for (const row of rows) {
                const [entity, raw] = row.get(option)
                const value = option.getValue(entity, raw)

                values.push(
                    value?.toString().trim().replace(/,/g, '') ?? ''
                )
            }

            let result: any

            switch (column.summaryType) {
                case 'sum':
                    result = values.reduce((a, b) => Number(a) + Number(b), 0)
                    break

                case 'count':
                    result = values.length
                    break

                case 'avg':
                    result = values.length
                        ? values.reduce((a, b) => Number(a) + Number(b), 0) / values.length
                        : 0
                    break

                case 'min':
                    result = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : 0
                    break

                case 'max':
                    result = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : 0
                    break

                default:
                    result = undefined
            }

            summary.set(option, result)
        }

        return summary
    }

    protected buildSubSummaryRow(
        group: any,
        summary: Map<DataOption<any>, any>
    ): TableRow {
        const row = new TableRow()

        const groupColumn = this.configuration.columns.find(col => col.groupBy)
        const groupOption = this.columns.find(([option]) => JSON.stringify(this.optionPaths.get(option)) === JSON.stringify(groupColumn?.path))?.[0]

        let firstColumn = true
        let addedValue = 0

        for (const [option] of this.columns) {
            const cell = new ListTableCell()
                .setAlign(option.getAlign())
                .setIsTopHeader(false)

            if (summary.get(option) === undefined) {
                if (firstColumn) {
                    const value = group.displayRow.get(groupOption)

                    if (value) {
                        const [entity, raw] = value

                        cell.addChild(
                            groupOption.renderContent(entity, raw, this.container)
                        )
                    }

                    firstColumn = false
                }
            } else {
                const configValue = []

                this.where.conditions.map(cond => {
                    if (JSON.stringify(cond.path) === JSON.stringify(this.optionPaths.get(option))) {
                        if (cond.configuration) {
                            configValue.push(cond.configuration?.value)
                        }
                    }
                })

                if (configValue.length > 0) {
                    if (
                        (option.getFormattedValueBase(summary.get(option)) ?? '')
                            .toString()
                            .replace(/,/g, '')
                            .includes(
                                configValue[0]
                                    .toString()
                                    .replace(/,/g, '')
                            )
                    ) {
                        cell.addChild(
                            new Typography(
                                option.getFormattedValueBase(summary.get(option)),
                                'subtitle2'
                            )
                        )

                        addedValue = addedValue + 1
                    } else {
                        return
                    }
                } else {
                    cell.addChild(
                        new Typography(
                            option.getFormattedValueBase(summary.get(option)),
                            'subtitle2'
                        )
                    )

                    addedValue = this.customPagination.getCount()
                }
            }

            row.addChild(cell)
        }

        this.customPagination.setCount(addedValue)

        return row
    }

    private getSelectedResults(
        results: Set<Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]>>
    ): Set<Map<DataOption<any>, [Base, any]>> {
        return new Set(
            [...results].filter(result => {
                const [option] = this.columns[0]
                const value = result.get(option)

                if (!value) {
                    return false
                }

                const [entity] = value
                const model = entity.constructor as new () => Base

                return this.application
                    .getSelectedRecords(model)
                    .some(record => record.id === entity.id)
            })
        )
    }

    protected async exportResults(
        exportType: 'export' | 'pdf' | 'csv_data' | 'json_data',
        container: Component,
        configuration: ListViewConfiguration
    ): Promise<void | string> {
        this.query.setLimit(undefined)
        this.query.setOffset(undefined)

        const allResults = await this.query.getResults()

        const results = this.table.getShowSelected()
            ? this.getSelectedResults(allResults)
            : allResults

        const data: [Data[]] = [[]]
        const headings: Heading[] = []

        const { countries, zones } = require('moment-timezone/data/meta/latest.json')
        const timeZoneToCountry: Country[] = []

        Object.keys(zones).forEach(zone => {
            timeZoneToCountry.push({
                abbr: countries[zones[zone].countries[0]].abbr,
                timezone: zones[zone].name
            })
        })

        let userCountry: Country
        const timeZone = this.application.getUserTimezone()

        if (timeZone) {
            userCountry = timeZoneToCountry.find(country => country.timezone === timeZone)
        }

        for (const result of Array.from(results)) {
            const set: Data[] = []

            for (const [option] of this.columns) {
                const [entity, raw] = result.get(option)
                if (option instanceof SinglePropertyDataOption || option instanceof MultiPropertyDataOption || option instanceof CustomFieldData) {
                    const canView = option.getCanView(this.application)

                    if (option.getLabel() === 'Formatted date') {
                        let formattedDate: string

                        if (userCountry && userCountry.abbr && userCountry.abbr.toUpperCase() === 'US') {
                            formattedDate = moment(option.getValue(entity, raw)).format('MM/DD/YYYY')
                        } else {
                            formattedDate = moment(option.getValue(entity, raw)).format('DD/MM/YYYY')
                        }

                        set.push({
                            data: canView ? formattedDate : 'Access denied',
                            align: option.getAlign()
                        })
                    } else if (option.getLabel() === 'Tags') {
                        set.push({
                            data: canView ? option.getValue(entity, raw).join(', ') : 'Access denied',
                            align: option.getAlign()
                        })
                    } else if (option instanceof NumberData || option instanceof AggregateData) {
                        set.push({
                            data: canView
                                ? (exportType === 'csv_data' || exportType === 'json_data') // remove formatting (inc commas)
                                    ? option.getValue(entity, raw) ? String(Number(option.getValue(entity, raw))) : ''
                                    : option.getValue(entity, raw) ? option.getValue(entity, raw) : ''
                                : 'Access denied',
                            align: option.getAlign()
                        })
                    } else {
                        set.push({
                            data: canView ? option.getValue(entity, raw) ? option.getValue(entity, raw) : '' : 'Access denied',
                            align: option.getAlign()
                        })
                    }
                }
            }

            data.push(set)
        }

        let count = 0
        for (const column of configuration.columns) {
            headings.push({
                label: column.label,
                count
            })

            count++
        }

        const source = configuration.entity
        const totals = await this.calculateTotal()

        if (exportType === 'csv_data') {
            return exportListView(data, headings, this.title, container, true)
        }

        if (exportType === 'json_data') {
            type Cell = { data: any, align: string }
            type CellWithHeader = Cell & { header: string }

            const dataWithHeaders: CellWithHeader[][] = data.map(row => (
                row.map((cell, index) => {
                    const heading = headings[index]

                    return {
                        header: heading?.label ?? '',
                        ...cell
                    }
                })
            ))
                .filter(item => Array.isArray(item) && item.length > 0)

            return JSON.stringify(dataWithHeaders)
        }

        if (exportType === 'export') {
            exportListView(data, headings, this.title, container)
        } else if (exportType === 'pdf') {
            exportListViewPdf(data, headings, source, this.title, totals, container)
        }
    }

    protected async exportForStockTake(exportType: 'csv' | 'pdf', container: Component): Promise<void> {
        this.query.setLimit(undefined)
        this.query.setOffset(undefined)

        const allResults = await this.query.getResults()

        const results = this.table.getShowSelected()
            ? this.getSelectedResults(allResults)
            : allResults

        const skus: string[] = []

        for (const result of results) {
            for (const [option] of this.columns) {
                const [entity, raw] = result.get(option)

                if (option instanceof SinglePropertyDataOption || option instanceof MultiPropertyDataOption) {
                    if (option.getLabel() === 'SKU') {
                        skus.push(option.getValue(entity, raw))
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (exportType === 'pdf') {
            exportStockTakePdf(skus, container)
        }
    }

    protected async getAiReply(container: Component, configuration: ListViewConfiguration): Promise<void> {
        const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
        const askButton = new Button('Ask AI')

        const aiAbortController = new AbortController()

        const aiModels = await getRepository(models.AiModel).find({
            where: { tradingCompany: application.getTradingCompany().id, isActive: true },
            relations: ['aiProvider']
        })

        const modelSelect = new Select<models.AiModel>()
            .setOptions(aiModels)
            .setLabel('Select AI model')
            .setHelper('Note this will incur cost on AI provider and will incur higher costs on better models')

        modelSelect.getOptionPrimary = providerAndModel => `${providerAndModel.aiProvider.name}:${providerAndModel.name}`

        const saveHTMLCheckBox = new Checkbox().setLabel('Save Web/HTML report as document')

        const question = new Input()
            .setLabel('Question')
            .setRows(6)
            .setVariant('outlined')
            .setRowsMax(30)
            .setMultiline(true)
            .setValue('Produce graphical report and comment on anything notable')
            .on('change', () => {
                if (question.getValue() && question.getValue().length === 1) {
                    question.clearErrors().invalidateCache()
                }
            })

        const dataType: 'csv_data' | 'json_data' = 'csv_data' // let user choose in case differences?
        const data = await this.exportResults(dataType, container, configuration) as string
        const listTitle = `${configuration.entity}: ${this.title ? this.title : 'No title'}`

        const titleInput = new Input()
            .setLabel('Output title')
            .setType('text')
            .setValue(listTitle)
            .setHelper('Remove if you want the AI to set title')

        const outputOptions = [
            { value: 'Web', label: 'Web/HTML page' },
            { value: 'Text', label: 'Text only' }
        ]

        const outputTypeRadioGroup = new RadioGroup()
            .setValue('Web')
            .setOptions(outputOptions)

        const dialog = new Dialog()
            .setTitle(`Ask AI about data in the list (${listTitle})`)
            .addChild(modelSelect)
            .addChild(titleInput)
            .addChild(question)
            .addChild(outputTypeRadioGroup)
            .addChild(new Tooltip(
                `If Web/HTML chosen then save the report as an HTML document in your user area in a folder called ${AI_REPORT_FOLDER_NAME}`
            ).addChild(saveHTMLCheckBox))
            .addChild(new Typography('The question will include the data that is shown on the list. The AI tokens used will increase in line with the amount of data sent so filter only required data.'))
            .addChild(new Typography('A response creating a web/HTML page will displayed in a new tab. It can take a few minutes. You can save as a PDF using the print option.'))
            .addChild(new Typography('Asking for any other type of output format may result in an error.'))
            .addChild(new Typography('AI can make mistakes. Please double-check the response.'))
            .addAction(askButton)

        container.addChild(dialog)

        dialog.on('close', () => aiAbortController.abort())

        const validate = (): boolean => {
            question.clearErrors().invalidateCache()
            modelSelect.clearErrors().invalidateCache()
            let isValid = true

            if (!question.getValue() || question.getValue().length === 1) {
                question.setError('Enter a question').invalidateCache()
                isValid = false
            }

            if (!modelSelect.getValue()) {
                modelSelect.setError('Select model').invalidateCache()
                isValid = false
            }

            if (titleInput.getValue() && titleInput.getValue().length > 99) {
                modelSelect.setError('Text should be less than 100 characters').invalidateCache()
                isValid = false
            }

            return isValid
        }

        askButton.on('click', async () => {
            if (validate()) {
                const startDate = new Date()

                const aiKey = await getRepository(models.AiKey).findOne({
                    where: {
                        tradingCompany: application.getTradingCompany(),
                        aiProvider: modelSelect.getValue().aiProvider,
                        isDefault: true,
                        isActive: true
                    }
                })

                if (!aiKey) {
                    InformationDialog(
                        container,
                        'AI API Error',
                        `No AI API for chosen Ai provider ${modelSelect.getValue().aiProvider.name}.
                        Add key in Financial Settings area under BME Pulse AI`
                    )

                    return
                }

                askButton.setBusy(true)

                let developerPrompt = 'Use the given data.'
                let suffixPrompt = ''

                if (outputTypeRadioGroup.getValue() === 'Web') {
                    developerPrompt += `${titleInput.getValue() ? `Title of report is ${titleInput.getValue()}` : ''}`
                    developerPrompt += 'MANDATORY: Every numeric data value (such as currency, quantities, weights, or percentages) in the '
                    developerPrompt += 'table must be formatted to exactly 2 decimal places. For example, write "10.00" instead of "10". '
                    developerPrompt += 'If the number is for a count then it would normally not have decimal places - you decide on that '
                    developerPrompt += 'type of number\'s format. '
                    developerPrompt += 'Right justify these numbers. '
                    developerPrompt += 'EXCEPTION: Do not add decimal places to numeric identifiers, reference codes, or dates '
                    developerPrompt += '(e.g., Quote Numbers, ID numbers, Invoice Numbers, or Years). '
                    developerPrompt += 'Treat these strictly as whole numbers or text strings. '
                    developerPrompt += 'Please return a structured JSON object that contains HTML with one property:'
                    developerPrompt += '"htmlContent" that contains the HTML that I can just use on a web page without alteration.'
                    developerPrompt += 'Your entire response must be a single, valid JSON object containing only the requested properties.'
                    developerPrompt += 'Do not include markdown code block syntax (like ```json), conversational commentary,'
                    developerPrompt += 'introductory text, or concluding observations outside the JSON structure.'
                    developerPrompt += 'Begin your response directly with { and end with } '
                    developerPrompt += 'Use the width so the output looks as nice as possible.'
                    developerPrompt += `CRITICAL LAYOUT RULES FOR CHARTS:`
                    developerPrompt += 'If a graph is requested always use https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4/dist/chart.umd.min.js '
                    developerPrompt += ' graph package. '
                    developerPrompt += 'When generating Chart.js code with `responsive: true` and `maintainAspectRatio: false`,'
                    developerPrompt += 'you will need to choose an appropriate pixel height for the chart container '
                    developerPrompt += '(e.g., 300px, 350px, 400px) based on the layout complexity.'
                    developerPrompt += 'You MUST apply this chosen height to a dedicated, relatively positioned wrapper `<div>` '
                    developerPrompt += 'around the `<canvas>`. Never place the height style directly on the `<canvas>` tag itself,'
                    developerPrompt += 'as this triggers an infinite resizing layout loop in responsive grids/flexbox.'
                    developerPrompt += 'Correct Structural Template to Follow:'
                    developerPrompt += '<div style="position: relative; height: [INSERT_YOUR_CHOSEN_HEIGHT_HERE]px; width: 100%;">'
                    developerPrompt += '<canvas id="yourChartId"></canvas></div>'

                    suffixPrompt += 'Always return a structured JSON object that contains HTML with one property: "htmlContent" '
                    suffixPrompt += 'regardless of what type of output is asked for.'
                    suffixPrompt += 'For example if you are asked for a Word or PDF document '
                    suffixPrompt += 'ignore that format request and also don\'t mention the requested type in the output.'
                    // AIs can ignore this but usually produce HTML
                } else {
                    developerPrompt = 'Just return a text response for output to a text (only) box.'
                    developerPrompt = 'Don\'t attempts to output as markdown or html or PDF/Word/Excel documents etc.'
                    developerPrompt = 'Don\'t output tables or graphs or anything that isn\'t pure text'
                }

                const userQuestion = question.getValue()

                const response = await getAiResponse(
                    aiAbortController,
                    container,
                    `${developerPrompt}\n ${userQuestion}\n ${suffixPrompt}`,
                    data,
                    modelSelect.getValue(),
                    aiKey,
                    undefined,
                    'csv_data'
                )

                const reportTitle = titleInput.getValue() ? titleInput.getValue() : listTitle

                if (!response) {
                    askButton.setBusy(false)
                    return
                }

                if (response.response.startsWith('Error') || response.response.startsWith('Aborted')) {
                    const errorText = response.response.startsWith('Aborted') ? 'was aborted' : 'had an unexpected error'

                    InformationDialog(container, 'Error', `AI response.\n${response.response}`)

                    await recordAIUsage(
                        application,
                        response,
                        modelSelect.getValue().aiProvider,
                        modelSelect.getValue(),
                        aiKey,
                        'ListView',
                        `${reportTitle} ${errorText}`,
                        startDate,
                        `An AI report (${reportTitle}) (from list view ${listTitle}) ${errorText}.`
                    )

                    askButton.setBusy(false)
                    return
                }

                const responseDetail = response.response

                if (outputTypeRadioGroup.getValue() === 'Web') {
                    const isThereValidHtmlContentJson = isValidHtmlContentJson(responseDetail)

                    if (isThereValidHtmlContentJson === true) {
                        await recordAIUsage(
                            application,
                            response,
                            modelSelect.getValue().aiProvider,
                            modelSelect.getValue(),
                            aiKey,
                            'ListView',
                            reportTitle,
                            startDate,
                            `An AI report (${reportTitle}) (from list view ${listTitle}) was generated as a web page.`
                        )

                        try {
                            const parsedResponse = JSON.parse(responseDetail)
                            const dashboard = new AiDashboardResponse(parsedResponse.htmlContent)
                            dashboard.setNewPage(true)
                            dashboard.setTitle(titleInput.getValue())
                            container.addChild(dashboard)

                            if (saveHTMLCheckBox.getChecked()) {
                                const timestampInSeconds = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)
                                const fileName = `${reportTitle}_${timestampInSeconds}.html`

                                await saveAIHTMLDocument(
                                    application,
                                    parsedResponse.htmlContent,
                                    fileName,
                                    `Document "${fileName}" was uploaded. Created by AI from list ${listTitle}`
                                )
                            }

                            askButton.setBusy(false)
                        } catch (error) {
                            console.error('Cannot create report due to unexpected error', error)
                            InformationDialog(container, 'Error', 'Cannot create report due to unexpected error')
                            askButton.setBusy(false)
                        }

                        return
                    }

                    InformationDialog(container, 'Error', `AI response error.\n${responseDetail}`)
                } else {
                    await recordAIUsage(
                        application,
                        response,
                        modelSelect.getValue().aiProvider,
                        modelSelect.getValue(),
                        aiKey,
                        'ListView',
                        reportTitle,
                        startDate,
                        `An AI response (${titleInput.getValue()}) (from list view ${listTitle}) was generated as text only.`
                    )

                    try {
                        InformationDialog(container, 'AI response', responseDetail)
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error('Unable to output AI response due to unexpected error\n', error, responseDetail)
                        InformationDialog(container, 'Error', `Unable to output AI response due to unexpected error.\n${error}`)
                    }
                }

                askButton.setBusy(false)
            }
        })
    }

    protected async calculateTotal(): Promise<TotalsList[]> {
        // Set the limit to -1 so when we call parseQuery() it knows not to add a limit or offset to the query
        this.query.setLimit(-1)
        const fullQuery = this.query.parseQuery(true) // Just totals
        const totalsSelectStatements = []
        const useNewCode = true // #3777 Old code uses "results" individually for each aggregate. New code doesn't.

        for (const [option] of this.columns) {
            const type = option.getTotalType()

            if (type !== undefined && type !== 'none') {
                const alias = this.query.getAliasForColumn(option.getLabel(), option.getEntity())
                const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(option.getEntity().name, String((option as AggregateData<any>).getProperty()))

                if (useNewCode) {
                    totalsSelectStatements.push(option instanceof AggregateData // new
                        ? `(${type}(\`${(option).getAlias()}\`)) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `
                        : `(${type}(${alias}_${databaseName})) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `)
                } else {
                    totalsSelectStatements.push(option instanceof AggregateData // old
                        ? `(SELECT ${type}(\`${(option).getAlias()}\`) from results) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `
                        : `(SELECT ${type}(${alias}_${databaseName}) from results) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `)
                }
            }
        }

        if (totalsSelectStatements.length === 0) {
            return []
        }

        const totalsQuery = useNewCode
            ? `WITH results AS (${fullQuery.getSql()}) SELECT ${totalsSelectStatements.join()} from results` // new
            : `WITH results AS (${fullQuery.getSql()}) SELECT ${totalsSelectStatements.join()}` // old

        const results = await getConnection().manager.query(totalsQuery, Object.values(fullQuery.getParameters()))

        const totalsList: TotalsList[] = []
        let column = 0

        for (const [option] of this.columns) {
            if (results[0][option.getLabel()] !== undefined) {
                const result = results && results.length > 0
                    ? results[0][option.getLabel()] === null ? 0 : results[0][option.getLabel()]
                    : undefined

                totalsList.push({
                    total: option.getFormattedValueBase(result),
                    column,
                    type: option.getTotalType() === 'sum' ? 'Total' : 'Avg'
                })
            }

            column++
        }

        return totalsList
    }

    // Add a property to the class to track the latest request
    protected currentRequestId: number = 0

    protected async parseResults(showSelected?: boolean, moveToFirst: boolean = false): Promise<void> {
        // Create a new uuid for the list for the new found set
        this.uuid = uuidv4()

        // Redraw the menus so they have a new UUID for a found set
        if (!this.configuration.hideMenu && FOUND_SET_ENTITIES.includes(this.entity) && !this.isGrouped) {
            this.menu = getReportMenu(this.entityModel, this.uuid)

            if (this.menu !== undefined) {
                this.query.removeMenu(this.menu)
                this.query.addMenu(this.menu)

                const indexOfMenu = this.columns.findIndex(column => column[0] instanceof MenuData)

                if (indexOfMenu !== -1) {
                    this.columns.splice(indexOfMenu, 1)
                }

                const indexOfRecordSelect = this.columns.findIndex(column => column[0] instanceof RecordSelectData)

                if (indexOfRecordSelect === 0) {
                    this.columns.splice(indexOfRecordSelect + 1, 0, [this.menu, undefined])
                } else {
                    this.columns.unshift([this.menu, undefined])
                }
            }
        }

        this.customPagination.setSpinner(true)

        // Increment the ID every time a new fetch starts
        const requestId = ++this.currentRequestId

        // If there is a fetch running, ABORT IT physically
        if (this.abortController) {
            this.abortController.abort()
        }

        this.abortController = new AbortController()

        // This small so that when user types in header it doesn't then cause teh width of column 1 to increase creating a bad UX
        const progressTableRow = new TableRow().addChild(new TableCell().setWidth(1).addChild(
            new CircularProgress('indeterminate').setSize(10)
        ))

        this.body.addChild(progressTableRow)

        this.checkboxes = []
        this.query.setLimit(this.customPagination.getRowsPerPage())
        this.query.setOffset(this.customPagination.getPage() * this.customPagination.getRowsPerPage())

        this.query.setLoggedOnUser(this.application.getUser())
        this.query.setLoggedOnUserTradingCompany(this.application.getTradingCompany())
        this.query.setClientId(this.application.getClientId())

        const results = await this.query.getResults()
        const count = await this.query.getCount()

        const isLastPage = Math.ceil(count / this.customPagination.getRowsPerPage())

        this.finalPageInput.setValue(String(isLastPage))

        this.customPagination.setCount(count)

        // GUARD: If a newer search (keystroke) started while we were awaiting the DB, this request is now "stale."
        // Abandoning ensures we don't overwrite newer data with older results.
        if (requestId !== this.currentRequestId) {
            return
        }

        this.body.clearChildren()

        if (count === 0) {
            this.table.setNoResults(true)
            this.exportButton.setDisabled(true)
            this.exportPdfButton.setDisabled(true)

            if (this.noResultsText !== undefined) {
                this.table.setNoResultText(this.noResultsText)
            }
        } else {
            this.table.setNoResults(false)
            this.exportButton.setDisabled(false)
            this.exportPdfButton.setDisabled(false)
        }

        const isRowToBeDisplayed = (entity: Base): boolean => {
            let showRow = true

            if (entity && entity.constructor.name === 'AuditEvent') {
                const auditEntityName = entity.entity && entity.entity[0].toLocaleLowerCase() + entity.entity.substr(1)

                if (
                    entity.description &&
                    entity.description.includes(NOTE_WAS_CREATED_UPDATED_TEXT) &&
                    !this.application.canUser('read', `note/cards/${auditEntityName}`)
                ) {
                    showRow = false
                }
            }

            return showRow
        }

        let isAllSelected = true

        const fullQuery = this.query.clone()

        fullQuery.setLimit(-1)
        fullQuery.setOffset(undefined)
        fullQuery.setWhere(this.where)

        const allResults = await fullQuery.getResults()

        const selectedResults = [...allResults].filter(result => {
            const [option] = this.columns[0]
            const [entity] = result.get(option)

            const model = entity.constructor as new () => Base

            return this.application
                .getSelectedRecords(model)
                .some(record => record.id === entity.id)
        })

        const page = this.customPagination.getPage()
        const rowsPerPage = this.customPagination.getRowsPerPage()

        const displayResults = showSelected
            ? new Set(
                selectedResults.slice(
                    page * rowsPerPage,
                    (page + 1) * rowsPerPage
                )
            )
            : results

        if (showSelected) {
            const count = selectedResults.length

            this.customPagination.setCount(count)

            this.finalPageInput.setValue(
                String(
                    Math.max(
                        1,
                        Math.ceil(count / rowsPerPage)
                    )
                )
            )

            if (moveToFirst) {
                this.customPagination.setPage(0)
            }
        }

        const groups = this.groupResults(showSelected ? new Set(selectedResults) : allResults)

        if (this.sortColumn) {
            const activeColumn = this.columns.find(
                ([, label]) => label === this.sortColumn[0]
            )?.[0]

            if (activeColumn) {
                groups.sort((a, b) => {
                    const aValue = this.calculateGroupSummary(a.rows).get(activeColumn)
                    const bValue = this.calculateGroupSummary(b.rows).get(activeColumn)

                    if (aValue < bValue) {
                        return this.sortColumn[1] ? -1 : 1
                    }

                    if (aValue > bValue) {
                        return this.sortColumn[1] ? 1 : -1
                    }

                    return 0
                })
            }
        }

        const pagedGroups = groups.slice(
            page * rowsPerPage,
            (page + 1) * rowsPerPage
        )

        if (groups.length > 1 && this.hasGroupBy && this.hasSubSummary) {
            this.customPagination.setCount(groups.length)

            for (const group of pagedGroups) {
                const summary = this.calculateGroupSummary(group.rows)
                const row = this.buildSubSummaryRow(group, summary)

                if (row) {
                    this.body.addChild(row)
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (const result of Array.from(displayResults)) {
                const row = new TableRow()
                const rowState = { selectionTriggeredByLink: false }
                const getRowEntity = (): Base | undefined => {
                    const [option] = this.columns[0]
                    const [entity] = result.get(option)

                    return entity
                }

                if (this.rowClick && this.columns.length > 0) {
                    row.setHover(true)
                    row.on('click', () => {
                        if (rowState.selectionTriggeredByLink) {
                            rowState.selectionTriggeredByLink = false

                            return
                        }

                        const entity = getRowEntity()

                        if (!entity) {
                            return
                        }

                        if (this.rowClickHandler) {
                            this.rowClickHandler(entity)
                        } else {
                            const url = getViewUrl(entity)
                            this.pushUrl(url)
                        }
                    })
                }

                let showRow = true

                for (const [option] of this.columns) {
                    const value = result.get(option)

                    if (!value) {
                        continue
                    }

                    const [entity, raw] = result.get(option)

                    const color = getTheme(option.getEntity())
                    const theme = new Theme(color, color)
                    const cell = option.renderCell()

                    showRow = isRowToBeDisplayed(entity)

                    let content = option.renderContent(entity, raw, this.container)

                    if (this.rowClick && this.rowClickHandler) {
                        const shouldPreserveThisLink = this.configuration.preserveLinksOnRowClick && (
                            !this.configuration.rowClickPreservedLinkLabels ||
                        this.configuration.rowClickPreservedLinkLabels.length === 0 ||
                        this.configuration.rowClickPreservedLinkLabels.includes(option.getLabel())
                        )

                        if (shouldPreserveThisLink && content instanceof Link) {
                            const children = content.getChildren().filter(child => child !== undefined)
                            const replacement = new Link('#').setReplace(true)
                            const currentRowEntity = getRowEntity()

                            replacement.on('click', this.getPreservedLinkClickHandler(rowState, currentRowEntity))

                            if (children.length > 0) {
                                replacement.addChild(...children)
                            }

                            content = replacement
                        } else if (!shouldPreserveThisLink) {
                            content = this.stripLinks(content)
                        }
                    }

                    if (option instanceof RecordSelectData) {
                        const checkbox = content as Checkbox
                        const model = entity.constructor as new () => Base
                        const selectedRecords = this.application.getSelectedRecords(model) || []

                        checkbox
                            .setChecked(selectedRecords.findIndex(record => record.id === entity.id) >= 0)
                            .on('change', event => {
                                const selectedRecords = this.application.getSelectedRecords(model) || []
                                const index = selectedRecords.findIndex(record => record.id === entity.id)

                                if (event.checked) {
                                    if (index < 0) {
                                        selectedRecords.push(entity)
                                        this.table.setSelectedRecords(selectedRecords)
                                    }
                                } else if (index >= 0) {
                                    selectedRecords.splice(index, 1)

                                    if (selectedRecords.length === 0 && showSelected) {
                                        this.parseResults(false)
                                        this.table.setShowSelected()
                                    }

                                    this.table.setSelectedRecords(selectedRecords)
                                }

                                this.application.setSelectedRecords(model, selectedRecords)
                                this.selectedRecordsCount.setContent(`${this.application.getSelectedRecords(model).length} of ${this.resultsCount} records selected`)

                                if (this.configuration.showCheckboxes && !this.isGrouped) {
                                    this.selectAllCheckbox.setChecked(this.application.getSelectedRecords(model).length === this.resultsCount)
                                }
                            })

                        this.checkboxes.push(checkbox)

                        if (!checkbox.getChecked()) {
                            isAllSelected = false
                        }
                    }

                    const canView = option.getCanView(this.application)

                    if (canView) {
                        row.addChild(cell.addChild(theme.addChild(content)))
                    } else {
                        const canViewData = option.getCanViewData() ? option.getCanViewData().toString() : ''

                        row.addChild(cell.addChild(theme.addChild(new Tooltip()
                            .setTitle(`To view enable permission :` +
                         ` ${canViewData.split('/').join('-->')}`)
                            .setPlacement('top')
                            .addChild(new Typography('Access denied', 'caption').setColor('error')))))
                    }
                }

                if (showRow) {
                    this.body.addChild(row)
                }
            }
        }

        if (this.configuration.showCheckboxes && !this.isGrouped) {
            this.selectAllCheckbox.setChecked(isAllSelected)
        }

        await this.buildSummaryRow(count)

        const previousLimit = this.query.getLimit()
        const foundSetAllowed = FOUND_SET_ENTITIES.includes(this.entity)
        let setFoundSetRedisKeyInfo = false

        const foundSetSQLRedisKey = getFoundSetRedisKey(
            this.entity,
            this.application.getUser().id,
            this.application.getTradingCompany().id,
            this.uuid
        )

        if (this.configuration.showCheckboxes && !this.isGrouped) {
            this.query.setLimit(-1)
            const entity = (models as any)[this.configuration.entity]

            // Fetch just the id of the entity (using getCompactResults instead of getResults) to reduce time taken to fetch massively.
            // Need the entity list for the "select all" below - all being all of the records in the (filtered) list.
            // Set based on whether the selected records include any of the items in the entities array, so if the list is filtered it
            // will get exclude ones that WERE in the list but aren't now in the differently filtered list. If it didn't do that it
            // might show the selected quantity as more than the total count.

            const sql = this.query.getCompactSql()
            this.entities = await this.query.getCompactResults(sql)
            this.resultsCount = this.entities.length

            const selectedRecords = this.application.getSelectedRecords(entity) || []

            this.application.setSelectedRecords(entity, selectedRecords)

            this.selectedRecordsCount.setContent(
                `${this.application.getSelectedRecords(entity).length} of ${this.resultsCount} records selected`
            )

            // To prevent new listeners being created when user goes to a new pagination pages
            if (this.selectAllCheckboxOnChangeSetup === false) {
                this.selectAllCheckboxOnChangeSetup = true

                this.selectAllCheckbox.on('change', async event => {
                    for (const checkbox of this.checkboxes) {
                        checkbox.setChecked(event.checked)
                    }

                    if (event.checked) {
                        const selectedRecords = []
                        selectedRecords.push(...this.entities)
                        this.application.setSelectedRecords(entity, selectedRecords)
                    } else {
                        this.resetSelectedEntities(entity, this.application)
                    }

                    this.selectAllTooltip.setTitle(event.checked ? 'Unselect all' : 'Select all')
                    this.selectedRecordsCount
                        .setContent(`${this.application.getSelectedRecords(entity).length} of ${this.resultsCount} records selected`)
                })

                if (foundSetAllowed) {
                    // Use the compact sql already created for found set
                    setFoundSetRedisKeyData(foundSetSQLRedisKey, sql, count)
                }
            } else {
                setFoundSetRedisKeyInfo = true
            }
        } else {
            setFoundSetRedisKeyInfo = true
        }

        if (setFoundSetRedisKeyInfo) {
            this.query.setLimit(-1)

            if (foundSetAllowed) {
                // Get compact SQL for found set
                const sql = this.query.getCompactSql()
                setFoundSetRedisKeyData(foundSetSQLRedisKey, sql, count)
            }
        }

        this.query.setLimit(previousLimit)

        this.invalidateCache()
        this.customPagination.setSpinner(false)
    }

    protected stripLinks(content: Component | undefined): Component | undefined {
        if (!content) {
            return content
        }

        if (content instanceof Link) {
            const replacement = new FlexContainer(true, false).setAlignItems('center').setSpacing(0)
            const children = content.getChildren().filter(child => child !== undefined)
            const strippedChildren = children
                .map(child => this.stripLinks(child))
                .filter((child): child is Component => Boolean(child))

            if (strippedChildren.length > 0) {
                replacement.addChild(...strippedChildren)
            }

            return replacement
        }

        const children = content.getChildren().filter(child => child !== undefined)

        if (children.length === 0) {
            return content
        }

        const strippedChildren = children
            .map(child => this.stripLinks(child))
            .filter((child): child is Component => Boolean(child))

        content.clearChildren()

        if (strippedChildren.length > 0) {
            content.addChild(...strippedChildren)
        }

        return content
    }

    protected async buildSummaryRow(count: number): Promise<void> {
        // Set the limit to -1 so when we call parseQuery() it knows not to add a limit or offset to the query
        const previousLimit = this.query.getLimit()
        this.query.setLimit(-1)
        const fullQuery = this.query.parseQuery(true) // Just totals
        const totalsSelectStatements = []
        const useNewCode = true // #3777 Old code uses "results" individually for each aggregate. New code doesn't.

        for (const [option] of this.columns) {
            if (option && option.getLabel() !== DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND) {
                const canView = option.getCanView(this.application)
                const type = option.getTotalType()

                if (type !== undefined && type !== 'none') {
                    const alias = this.query.getAliasForColumn(option.getLabel(), option.getEntity())
                    const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(option.getEntity().name, String((option as AggregateData<any>).getProperty()))

                    if (canView) {
                        if (useNewCode) {
                            totalsSelectStatements.push(option instanceof AggregateData // new
                                ? `(${type}(\`${(option).getAlias()}\`)) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `
                                : `(${type}(${alias}_${databaseName})) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `)
                        } else {
                            totalsSelectStatements.push(option instanceof AggregateData // old
                                ? `(SELECT ${type}(\`${(option).getAlias()}\`) from results) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `
                                : `(SELECT ${type}(${alias}_${databaseName}) from results) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `)
                        }
                    } else {
                        totalsSelectStatements.push(`(SELECT 0 LIMIT 0) as \`${option.getLabel()}\` `)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (totalsSelectStatements.length === 0) {
            this.table.setSummary(undefined)
            this.query.setLimit(previousLimit)

            return
        }

        const totalsQuery = useNewCode
            ? `WITH results AS (${fullQuery.getSql()}) SELECT ${totalsSelectStatements.join()} from results` // new
            : `WITH results AS (${fullQuery.getSql()}) SELECT ${totalsSelectStatements.join()}` // old

        const results = await getConnection().manager.query(totalsQuery, Object.values(fullQuery.getParameters()))

        const row = new TableRow()

        for (const [option] of this.columns) {
            const cell = new ListTableCell().setAlign(option.getAlign()).setIsTopHeader(false)
            const result = results && results.length > 0
                ? results[0][option.getLabel()] === null ? 0 : results[0][option.getLabel()]
                : undefined

            if (this.tabTheme.light !== undefined) {
                cell.setSummaryBackgroundColor(this.tabTheme.light)
            } else {
                cell.setSummaryBackgroundColor(this.tabTheme['50'])
            }

            if (results && results.length > 0 && results[0][option.getLabel()] !== undefined) {
                cell.addChild(new Typography(option.getFormattedValueBase(result), 'body2'))
            } else if (option.getLabel() === DATA_OPTION_NOT_FOUND) {
                cell.addChild(new Typography('Data option not found', 'caption').setColor('error'))
            }

            row.addChild(cell)
        }

        this.table.setSummary(row)

        this.query.setLimit(previousLimit)
    }

    public setRowsPerPage(value: number): this {
        this.customPagination.setRowsPerPage(value)

        return this
    }

    public setTitle(title?: string): this {
        this.title = title

        return this
    }

    protected resetSelectedEntities(entity: { new(): Base }, application: Application): this {
        application.setSelectedRecords(entity, [])
        this.selectedRecordsCount.setContent(`0 of ${this.resultsCount} records selected`)

        return this
    }

    protected getAsync(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected getEager(): boolean {
        return true
    }

    protected getWatchEntity(): string {
        return this.entity
    }

    protected entityChangeHandler(): void {
        // Do nothing. I.e. don't automatically update lists. It causes performance issues and crashing
        // in particular when mass uploading or deleting
    }

    protected getPreservedLinkClickHandler(
        rowState: { selectionTriggeredByLink: boolean },
        currentRowEntity?: Base
    ): () => void {
        return (): void => {
            if (!currentRowEntity || !this.rowClickHandler) {
                return
            }

            rowState.selectionTriggeredByLink = true
            this.rowClickHandler(currentRowEntity)
        }
    }

    protected async build(props: RequestProps): Promise<Component> {
        const entity = (models as any)[this.configuration.entity]

        this.resetSelectedEntities(entity, this.application)

        // This parseResults call is not needed.
        // If it is here it parses results and then the results are parsed again because of pagination (customTablePagination.tsx)
        // await this.parseResults()

        return this.table
    }
}

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { Link, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { LinkData } from '../../data'
import { LoggedOnUserFilter } from './filters/loggedOnUser'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { UserFilter } from './filters/user'
import { formatPersonName } from '../../../functions'
import { getViewUrl } from '../../../configuration'

export class UserData<T extends Base> extends LinkData<T> {
    protected userAlias: string
    protected personAlias: string

    public constructor(entity: { new(): T }, label: string, protected property: keyof T) {
        super(entity, label, [property])

        this.userAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.personAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

        this.clearFilterTypes()
        this.addFilterType('equals', UserFilter)
        this.addFilterType('logged on user', LoggedOnUserFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('equals')
        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)

        this.setRenderLink(entity => getViewUrl(entity[this.property]))
        this.setRenderLabel(entity => formatPersonName((entity[this.property] as any).person))
    }

    public getUserAlias(): string {
        return this.userAlias
    }

    public getPersonAlias(): string {
        return this.personAlias
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any): string {
        if (entity === null || entity[this.property] === null) {
            return ''
        }

        return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        if (entity === null || entity[this.property] === null) {
            return new Typography('')
        } else {
            let renderedLink = this.renderLink(entity, raw)

            if (!(renderedLink instanceof Link)) {
                renderedLink = new Link(renderedLink)
            }

            return renderedLink.addChild(new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw)))
        }
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.leftJoin(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, this.userAlias)
        query.leftJoin(`${this.userAlias}.person`, this.personAlias)

        query.addSelect(`${this.userAlias}.id`)
        query.addSelect(`${this.personAlias}.forename`)
        query.addSelect(`${this.personAlias}.surname`)
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { ContainsFilter } from './filters/contains'
import { EqualsFilter } from './filters/equals'
import { ExternalLink } from '../../../component'
import { Link, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { MultiPropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { NotEqualFilter } from './filters/notEqual'
import { NotNullFilter } from './filters/notNull'
import { NullFilter } from './filters/isNull'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

export class LinkData<T extends Base> extends MultiPropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link | ExternalLink)
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)

    public constructor(entity: { new(): T }, label: string, protected properties: (keyof T)[]) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)

        this.renderLink = () => ''
        this.renderLabel = result => this.properties.map(property => result[property]).join(', ')

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('equals', EqualsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('notEqual', NotEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('notNull', NotNullFilter)
        this.addFilterType('isNull', NullFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
    }

    public setRenderLink(renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link | ExternalLink)): this {
        this.renderLink = renderLink

        return this
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        for (const property of this.properties) {
            const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(property))

            if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
                query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${property}`)
            }
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(
            `CONCAT(${this.properties.map(property => `${parentAlias}.${property}`).join(', ')})`
        )
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        for (const property of this.properties) {
            query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${property}`, direction)
        }
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof T)[] {
        return this.properties
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any): string {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        }

        return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any): Link | ExternalLink | Typography<{}> {
        if (entity === null) {
            return new Typography('')
        }

        let renderedLink = this.renderLink(entity, raw)

        if (!(renderedLink instanceof Link) && !(renderedLink instanceof ExternalLink)) {
            renderedLink = new Link(renderedLink)
        }

        return renderedLink.addChild(new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw)))
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseInputFilter } from '../../../filter'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { LinkData } from '../../link'

interface ContainsFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class ContainsFilter extends BaseInputFilter<ContainsFilterConfiguration, LinkData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

                    query.orWhere(`LOWER(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) LIKE :${alias}`, {
                        [alias]: `%${this.configuration.value.toLowerCase()}%`
                    })
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { Input } from '../../../../component'
import { LinkData } from '../../link'

interface EqualsFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class EqualsFilter extends Filter<EqualsFilterConfiguration, LinkData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

                    query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} = :${alias}`, {
                        [alias]: this.configuration.value
                    })
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): Input {
        const input = new Input()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { ContainsFilter, EqualsFilter, NotEqualFilter, NotNullFilter, NullFilter } from './filters'
import { MultiPropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

export class TypographyData<T extends Base> extends MultiPropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)

    public constructor(entity: new () => T, label: string, protected properties: (keyof T)[]) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)
        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('equals', EqualsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('notEqual', NotEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('notNull', NotNullFilter)
        this.addFilterType('isNull', NullFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')

        this.renderLabel = result => this.properties.map(property => {
            if (typeof result[property] === 'boolean') {
                return result[property] ? 'Yes' : 'No'
            }

            return result[property]
        }).filter(property => property !== null).join(', ')
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        for (const property of this.properties) {
            const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(property))

            if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
                query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${property}`)
            }
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(
            `CONCAT(${this.properties.map(property => `COALESCE(${parentAlias}.${property}, '${property}')`).join(', ')})`
        )
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        for (const property of this.properties) {
            query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${property}`, direction)
        }
    }

    public getProperties() {
        return this.properties
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        }
        return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        return new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw))
    }
}

````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { TypographyData } from '../../typography'

/**
 * Only returns records where the desired property exists
 */
export class NotNullFilter extends Filter<{}, TypographyData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
            for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                query.orWhere(`LOWER(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) IS NOT NULL`)
            }
        }))

        return true
    }

    public render(): FragmentContainer {
        return new FragmentContainer()
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'

export function convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(tableName: string, property: string): string {
    const { metadata } = getRepository(tableName)
    let databaseName = ''

    for (const column of metadata.nonVirtualColumns) {
        if (column.propertyName === property) {
            databaseName = column.databaseName
        }
    }

    return databaseName
}
````

````typescript
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { ModelNullableSelect } from '../../../../component'
import { User } from '../../../../models'
import { UserData } from '../../user'
import { SelectQueryBuilder, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { formatPersonName } from '../../../../functions'

interface UserFilterConfiguration {
    user: User
}

export class UserFilter extends Filter<UserFilterConfiguration, UserData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

            query.andWhere(`${this.getOption().getUserAlias()}.id = :${alias}`, { [alias]: this.configuration.user.id })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): ModelNullableSelect<User> {
        const query = getRepository(User).createQueryBuilder('e').innerJoinAndSelect('e.person', 'p')
        const input = new ModelNullableSelect<User>(query).setNullPrimary('All')

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.user)
        }

        input.getOptionPrimary = user => formatPersonName(user.person)

        input.on('change', () => {
            const user = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = user === null ? undefined : { user }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Person } from '../models'

type PersonNameFormat = 'firstLast' | 'titleFirstLast' | 'initialsFirstLast'

export function formatPersonName({ forename, surname, title }: Partial<Person>, format: PersonNameFormat = 'firstLast'): string {
    if (format === 'firstLast') {
        return `${forename || ''} ${surname || ''}`.trim()
    } else if (format === 'titleFirstLast') {
        if (title && title.title) {
            return `${title.title || ''} ${forename || ''} ${surname || ''}`.trim().replace('  ', ' ')
        }

        return formatPersonName({ forename, surname })
    } else if (format === 'initialsFirstLast') {
        return `${forename && forename[0] || ''}${surname && surname[0] || ''}`.trim()
    }

    return ''
}

````
