````typescript
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { User } from '../../../../models'
import { UserData } from '../../user'

export class LoggedOnUserFilter extends Filter<{}, UserData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, loggedOnUser: User): boolean {
        if (loggedOnUser) {
            const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()
            const userAlias = this.getOption().getUserAlias()

            query.andWhere(`${userAlias}.id = :${alias}`, { [alias]: loggedOnUser.id })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FragmentContainer {
        return new FragmentContainer()
    }
}
````

````typescript
type ModelConstructor<T> = { new(): T }

const avatars = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, (entity: Base) => Avatar | undefined>()
const fullStatuses = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, (entity: Base) => Promise<string>>()
const icons = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, () => Icon>()
const listActions = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, (container: Component<any, any, any>, application?: Application) => BaseAction[]>()
const listUrls = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, () => string>()
const reportOptions = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, () => BaseOption<any>[]>()
const statuses = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, (entity: Base) => string>()
const summaries = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, (entity: Base) => Promise<Component>>()
const themes = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, PaletteColorOptions>()
const viewActions = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, (entity: Base, container: Component<any, any, any>, application?: Application) => BaseAction[]>()
const viewUrls = new Map<ModelConstructor<Base>, (entity: Base) => string>()
const globalActions = new Set<(container: Component<any, any, any>) => BaseAction[]>()

/**
 * Set the callback function to generate an avatar component for an instance of a given entity.
 */
export function setAvatar<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, avatar: (entity: T) => Avatar | undefined): void {
    avatars.set(entity, avatar)
}

/**
 * Set the callback function to generate an icon for a given entity.
 */
export function setIcon<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, icon: () => Icon): void {
    icons.set(entity, icon)
}

 * Set the callback function to generate the full status text for an instance of a given entity.
 */
export function setFullStatus<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, fullStatus: (entity: T) => Promise<string>): void {
    fullStatuses.set(entity, fullStatus)
}

/**
 * Set the callback function to generate an array of actions when viewing a list where the base.

 */
export function setListActions<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, actions: (container: Component<any, any, any>, application?: Application) => BaseAction[]): void {
    listActions.set(entity, actions)
}

/**
 * Set the callback function to generate the URL to view a list of a given entity.
 */
export function setListUrl<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, listUrl: () => string): void {

}

export function setReportOptions<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, options: () => BaseOption<T>[]): void {

}

}

export function setViewActions<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, actions: (entity: T, container: Component<any, any, any>, application?: Application) => BaseAction[]): void {

}

    globalActions.add(actions)
}

/**
 * Returns the configured avatar for an instance of a given entity.
 */
export function getAvatar<T extends Base>(entity: T): Avatar {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = avatars.get(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        const avatar = callback(entity)
        if (avatar !== undefined) {
            return avatar
        }
    } else {
        // No callback configured, use the configured icon by default
        const icon = getIcon(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

        return new Avatar().setIcon(icon)
    }
}

/**
 * Returns the configured icon for an instance of a given entity.
 */
export function getIcon<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>): Icon {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = icons.get(entity)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback()
    }

    // No callback configured, return a default icon
    return new Icon('Widgets')
}

/**
 * Returns the configured full status text for an instance of a given entity.
 */
export async function getFullStatus<T extends Base>(entity: T): Promise<string | undefined> {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = fullStatuses.get(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback(entity)
    }

    // No callback configured, return undefined by default
    return undefined
}

/**
 * Returns the configured actions to be displayed when viewing a list of a given entity.
 */
export function getListActions<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, container: Component<any, any, any>, application?: Application): BaseAction[] {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = listActions.get(entity)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback(container, application)
    }

    // No callback configured, return an empty array by default
    return []
}

/**
 * Returns the configured URL to view a list of a given entity.
 */
export function getListUrl<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>): string | undefined {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = listUrls.get(entity)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback()
    }

    // No callback configured, return undefined by default
    return undefined
}

/**
 * Returns the configured report options available for a given entity.
 */
export function getReportOptions<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, maxFields: number = DEFAULT_MAX_CUSTOM_FIELDS): BaseOption<T>[] {
    // Get the configured callback
    const customFieldOptions = []

    if (typeof entity === 'function') {
        if (tablesWithCustomFields.includes(pascalToSnakeCase(entity.name))) {
            for (let i = 1; i < maxFields + 1; i++) {
                customFieldOptions.push(new CustomFieldData(entity, i))
            }
        }
    }

    const callback = reportOptions.get(entity)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        const options = callback()
        options.push(...customFieldOptions)
        return options
    }
    // No callback configured, return an empty array by default
    return []
}

/**
 * Returns the configured status text for an instance of a given entity.
 */
export function getStatus<T extends Base>(entity: T): string | undefined {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = statuses.get(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback(entity)
    }

    // No callback configured, return undefined by default
    return undefined
}

/**
 * Returns the configured color palette options to change the application theme when viewing a given
 * entity.
 */
export function getTheme<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>): PaletteColorOptions {
    // Get the configured palette
    const theme = themes.get(entity)

    if (theme !== undefined) {
        return theme
    }

    // No palette configured, return teal by default
    return colors.teal
}

/**
 * Returns a `MenuData` instance to be displayed when viewing a report widget containing an instance
 * of a given entity.
 */
export function getReportMenu<T extends Base>(entity: ModelConstructor<T>, parentUuid: string): MenuData<T> | undefined {
    // Get the actions array and view URL of the entity
    const actionsCallback = viewActions.get(entity)
    const urlCallback = viewUrls.get(entity)

    if (actionsCallback !== undefined || urlCallback !== undefined) {
        return new MenuData(entity).setRenderMenu((entity, raw, container) => {
            const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
            const menus: (Menu | Divider)[] = []

            if (urlCallback !== undefined) {
                menus.push(new Menu().addChild(new MenuItem('View').setTo(urlCallback(entity))))
            }

            if (actionsCallback !== undefined) {
                const actions = actionsCallback(entity, container, application).filter(action => action.getShowInReportMenu())

                for (const action of actions) {
                    action.setParentComponentUuid(parentUuid)
                }

                if (actions.length > 0) {
                    if (menus.length > 0) {
                        menus.push(new Divider())
                    }

                    menus.push(new Menu().addChild(...actions.map(action => action.getMenuItem())))
                }
            }

            return menus
        })
    }
}

/**
 * Returns the configured actions to be displayed when viewing an instance of a given entity.
 */
export function getViewActions<T extends Base>(entity: T, container: Component<any, any, any>, application?: Application): BaseAction[] {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = viewActions.get(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback(entity, container, application).filter(action => action.getShowInView())
    }

    // No callback configured, return an empty array by default
    return []
}

/**
 * Returns the configured URL for viewing an instance of a given entity.
 */
export function getViewUrl<T extends Base>(entity: T): string | undefined {
    // Get the configured callback
    const callback = viewUrls.get(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

    if (callback !== undefined) {
        return callback(entity)
    }

    // No callback configured, return undefined by default
    return undefined
}

export function hasSummary<T extends Base>(entity: T): boolean {
    return summaries.has(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)
}

export async function getSummary<T extends Base>(entity: T): Promise<Component> | undefined {
    const callback = summaries.get(entity.constructor as ModelConstructor<T>)

    if (callback === undefined) {
        return undefined
    }

    return callback(entity)
}

export function getGlobalActions(container: Component<any, any, any>): BaseAction[] {
    const actions: BaseAction[] = []

    for (const callbackFn of Array.from(globalActions.values())) {
        actions.push(...callbackFn(container))
    }

    return actions
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../models/base'
import { CalendarDateData, ChartDateData, DateData, FormattedDateData, RelativeDateData } from '../data'
import { GroupOption } from '../option'

// These date labels are related to the date types below (see class DateData for more details)
export class DateGroup<T extends Base> extends GroupOption<T> {
    protected typeLabel: { [key in DateData<T>['type']]: string } = {
        dayname: 'Day of the week',
        dayofmonth: 'Day of the month',
        dayofyear: 'Day of the year',
        hour: 'Hour',
        minute: 'Minute',
        month: 'Month',
        monthname: 'Month name',
        quarter: 'Quarter',
        second: 'Second',
        weekofyear: 'Week of the year',
        year: 'Year',
        time: 'Time'
    }

    protected chartTypeLabel: { [key in ChartDateData<T>['type']]: string } = {
        datetoday: 'Date to day precision',
        datetomonth: 'Date to month precision',
        datetoyear: 'Date to year precision'
    }

    public constructor(
        entity: new () => T,
        label: string,
        property: keyof T,
        types: (DateData<T>['type'] | ChartDateData<T>['type'])[] = [
            'dayname', 'dayofmonth', 'dayofyear', 'hour', 'minute', 'month',
            'monthname', 'quarter', 'second', 'weekofyear', 'year',
            'datetoday', 'datetomonth', 'datetoyear', 'time'
        ],
        displayAsTimeOnly: boolean = false
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.addChild(new CalendarDateData(entity, 'Calendar date', property))
        this.addChild(new FormattedDateData(entity, 'Formatted date', property, displayAsTimeOnly))
        this.addChild(new RelativeDateData(entity, 'Relative date', property))

        for (const type of types) {
            if (this.typeLabel[(type as DateData<T>['type'])] !== undefined) {
                this.addChild(
                    new DateData(entity, this.typeLabel[type as DateData<T>['type']], property, type as DateData<T>['type'])
                )
            }

            if (this.chartTypeLabel[type as ChartDateData<T>['type']]) {
                this.addChild(
                    new ChartDateData(entity, this.chartTypeLabel[type as ChartDateData<T>['type']], property, type as ChartDateData<T>['type'])
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { ContainsFilter } from './filters/contains'
import { IsDateBetweenFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateBetween'
import { IsDateGreaterThanEqualFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/isDateGreaterthanEqual'
import { IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDays'
import { IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDaysFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDays'
import { IsDateInLastMonthFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateLastMonth'
import { IsDateInThisYearFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateThisYear'
import { IsDateLessThanEqualFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/isDateLessthanEqual'
import { IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDays'
import { IsDateMonthFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateMonth'
import { IsDateNotEqualFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateNotEqual'
import { IsDateNotInRangeFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateNotInRange'
import { ReportContext, SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

// These date types are simply taken from the database using the mariadb date types
// Therefore they will not then have timezone details attached so will display as per
// the data as they are effectly just text. Specifically a problem with 'time' and 'hour'
type DateType = 'dayname' | 'dayofmonth' | 'dayofyear' | 'hour' | 'minute' |
'month' | 'monthname' | 'quarter' | 'second' | 'weekofyear' | 'year' | 'time'

export class DateData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected alias: string = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor(
        entity: { new(): T },
        label: string,
        protected property: keyof T,
        protected type: DateType
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than or equal to', IsDateGreaterThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is less than or equal to', IsDateLessThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than X but less than Y', IsDateBetweenFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is less than today’s date minus X days', IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than today’s date plus X days', IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than today’s date minus X days', IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Not equal to', IsDateNotEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Not within a date range X - Y', IsDateNotInRangeFilter)
        this.addFilterType('This month', IsDateMonthFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Last Month', IsDateInLastMonthFilter)
        this.addFilterType('This year', IsDateInThisYearFilter)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof T)[] {
        return [this.property]
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(`${this.type.toUpperCase()}(${parentAlias}_${databaseName})`)) {
            const select = `${this.type.toUpperCase()}(${parentAlias}.${this.property})`

            query.addSelect(select, this.alias)
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(`${this.type.toUpperCase()}(${parentAlias}.${this.property})`)
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC') {
        query.addOrderBy(`${this.type.toUpperCase()}(${parentAlias}.${this.property})`, direction)
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, data: any) {
        return data[this.alias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, data: any) {
        return new Typography(this.getValue(entity, data))
    }

    public getContexts(): ReportContext[] {
        return ['list', 'chart']
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { DateData } from '../'
import { DateRangePicker } from '../../../../component'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import moment from 'moment'

interface ContainsFilterConfiguration {
    dates: { startDate?: Date, endDate?: Date } | undefined
    noDateSelected: boolean
    operatorFilter: {
        operator: string
        date: string
    }

    anyDateSelected: boolean
}

export class ContainsFilter extends Filter<ContainsFilterConfiguration, DateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    if (this.configuration.noDateSelected) {
                        query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                            for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                                query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NULL`)
                            }
                        }))
                    } else if (this.configuration.anyDateSelected) {
                        query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                            for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                                query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NOT NULL`)
                            }
                        }))
                    } else if (this.configuration.operatorFilter) {
                        const prefixes = ['=', '>', '<', '>=', '<=', '<>']
                        const inputDateValue = this.configuration.operatorFilter.date
                        const inputOperator = this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator
                        const validOperator = prefixes.includes(this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator)

                        if (validOperator) {
                            const dateValue = inputDateValue
                            const datevalue = moment(dateValue, 'MMM/DD/YYYY').format('YYYY-MM-DD')

                            if (inputDateValue && inputOperator !== '<>') {
                                query.orWhere(`DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)})${this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator}:datevalue`, {
                                    datevalue: `${datevalue}`
                                })
                            } else if (inputDateValue && inputOperator === '<>') {
                                query.orWhere(`DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)})!=:datevalue`, {
                                    datevalue: `${datevalue}`
                                })
                            }
                        } else {
                            return
                        }
                    } else {
                        const startDate = new Date(this.configuration.dates.startDate)
                        const endDate = new Date(this.configuration.dates.endDate)

                        query.orWhere(`(DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) >= DATE(:startDate) AND DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) <= DATE(:endDate))`, {
                            startDate: `${startDate.toISOString()}`,
                            endDate: `${endDate.toISOString()}`
                        })
                    }
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): DateRangePicker {
        const input = new DateRangePicker()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setDates(this.configuration.dates)
        }

        input.on('change', (dates: { startDate?: Date, endDate?: Date }) => {
            input.setDates(dates).invalidateCache()

            if (input.getNoDate()) {
                this.configuration = {
                    dates: {
                        startDate: new Date(),
                        endDate: new Date()
                    },
                    noDateSelected: true,
                    anyDateSelected: false,
                    operatorFilter: null
                }
            } else if (input.getAnyDate()) {
                this.configuration = {
                    dates: {
                        startDate: new Date(),
                        endDate: new Date()
                    },
                    noDateSelected: false,
                    anyDateSelected: true,
                    operatorFilter: null
                }
            } else {
                this.configuration = dates === null ? undefined : { dates, noDateSelected: false, anyDateSelected: false, operatorFilter: null }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('clear', () => {
            this.configuration = undefined
            input.clearDates()
            input.setOperatorSelected(null)
            input.setInputDate(null)
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('noDate', () => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setNoDate()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: {
                    startDate: new Date(),
                    endDate: new Date()
                },
                noDateSelected: true,
                anyDateSelected: false,
                operatorFilter: null
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('anyDate', () => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setAnyDate()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: {
                    startDate: new Date(),
                    endDate: new Date()
                },
                noDateSelected: false,
                anyDateSelected: true,
                operatorFilter: null
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('dateValue', (value: string) => {
            input.setInputDate(value).invalidateCache()
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('operatorValue', (value: string) => {
            input.setOperatorSelected(value).invalidateCache()
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('applyDate', (value: { operator: string, date: string }) => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setInputDate(value.date).invalidateCache()
            input.setOperatorSelected(value.operator).invalidateCache()

            this.configuration = {
                dates: { startDate: new Date(), endDate: new Date() },
                noDateSelected: false,
                anyDateSelected: false,
                operatorFilter: { operator: value.operator, date: value.date }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { CalendarDateData } from '../'
import { DateTimePicker } from '../../../../component'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class IsDateGreaterThanEqualFilter extends Filter<{ value: Date }, CalendarDateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        const property = this.getOption().getProperty()
        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.value) {
            const date = new Date(this.configuration.value)
            date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 1)

            query.andWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} >= :value`, { value: date.toISOString() })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): DateTimePicker {
        const input = new DateTimePicker().setFormat('DD-MM-YYYY').setType('date')

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.value) {
            input.setValue(new Date(String(this.configuration.value).slice(0, 10)))
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const raw = input.getValue()
            this.configuration = raw ? { value: new Date(raw) } : undefined
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { CalendarDate, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { ContainsFilter } from './filters/contains'
import { IsDateBetweenFilter } from './filters/IsDateBetween'
import { IsDateGreaterThanEqualFilter } from './filters/isDateGreaterthanEqual'
import { IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter } from './filters/IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDays'
import { IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDaysFilter } from './filters/IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDays'
import { IsDateInLastMonthFilter } from './filters/IsDateLastMonth'
import { IsDateInThisYearFilter } from './filters/IsDateThisYear'
import { IsDateLessThanEqualFilter } from './filters/isDateLessthanEqual'
import { IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter } from './filters/IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDays'
import { IsDateMonthFilter } from './filters/IsDateMonth'
import { IsDateNotEqualFilter } from './filters/IsDateNotEqual'
import { IsDateNotInRangeFilter } from './filters/IsDateNotInRange'
import { ReportContext, SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

export class CalendarDateData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    public constructor(
        entity: { new(): T },
        label: string,
        protected property: keyof T
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than or equal to', IsDateGreaterThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is less than or equal to', IsDateLessThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than X but less than Y', IsDateBetweenFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is less than today’s date minus X days', IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than today’s date plus X days', IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than today’s date minus X days', IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Not equal to', IsDateNotEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Not within a date range X - Y', IsDateNotInRangeFilter)
        this.addFilterType('This month', IsDateMonthFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Last Month', IsDateInLastMonthFilter)
        this.addFilterType('This year', IsDateInThisYearFilter)

        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof T)[] {
        return [this.property]
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(`date(${parentAlias}_${databaseName})`)) {
            query.addSelect(`date(${parentAlias}.${this.property})`)
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(`date(${parentAlias}.${this.property})`)
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC') {
        query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, direction)
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, data: any): Date | null {
        if (entity === null) {
            return null
        }

        const value = entity[this.property]

        if (value === null) {
            return null
        }

        if (!(value instanceof Date)) {
            const createdDate = new Date(`${value}`)

            if (createdDate instanceof Date && !isNaN(createdDate)) {
                return createdDate
            }

            return 'Invalid date or format'
            // If an error is thrown it disables the whole page so this was removed.
            // If returning a string causes problems with filtering then an old date should be used instead.
        }

        return value
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, data: any) {
        const value = this.getValue(entity, data)

        if (value === null) {
            return new Typography('')
        } else {
            return new CalendarDate(this.getValue(entity, data))
        }
    }

    public getContexts(): ReportContext[] {
        return ['list']
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { CalendarDateData } from '../'
import { DateTimePicker } from '../../../../component'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { FlexContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class IsDateBetweenFilter extends Filter<{ start: Date, end: Date }, CalendarDateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        const property = this.getOption().getProperty()

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.start && this.configuration.end) {
            const start = new Date(this.configuration.start)
            const end = new Date(this.configuration.end)
            start.setHours(0, 0, 0, 1)
            end.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)

            query.andWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} > :start AND ${parentAlias}.${String(property)} < :end`, {
                start: start.toISOString(),
                end: end.toISOString(),
            })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FlexContainer {
        const container = new FlexContainer(true, false)

        const startPicker = new DateTimePicker().setFormat('DD-MM-YYYY').setType('date').setLabel('From date')
        const endPicker = new DateTimePicker().setFormat('DD-MM-YYYY').setType('date').setLabel('To date')

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.start) startPicker.setValue(new Date(this.configuration.start))
        if (this.configuration &&this.configuration.end) endPicker.setValue(new Date(this.configuration.end))

        const handleChange = () => {
            const startRaw = startPicker.getValue()
            const endRaw = endPicker.getValue()

            this.configuration = (startRaw && endRaw) ? {
                start: new Date(startRaw),
                end: new Date(endRaw),
            } : undefined

            this.emit('change')
        }

        startPicker.on('change', handleChange)
        endPicker.on('change', handleChange)

        container.addChild(startPicker, endPicker)

        return container
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { CalendarDateData } from '../'

import { Input } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter extends Filter<{ days: number }, CalendarDateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        const property = this.getOption().getProperty()

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.days !== undefined) {
            const cutoff = new Date()
            cutoff.setDate(cutoff.getDate() - this.configuration.days)
            cutoff.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)

            query.andWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} < :cutoff`, { cutoff: cutoff.toISOString() })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): Input {
        const input = new Input().setType('number').setPlaceholder('Days before today')

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.days !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(String(this.configuration.days))
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = parseInt(input.getValue())
            this.configuration = !isNaN(value) ? { days: value } : undefined
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { CalendarDateData } from '../'
import { DateTimePicker } from '../../../../component'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class IsDateNotEqualFilter extends Filter<{ value: Date }, CalendarDateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        const property = this.getOption().getProperty()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.value) {
            const date = new Date(this.configuration.value)
            date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)

            const nextDay = new Date(date)
            nextDay.setDate(date.getDate() + 1)

            query.andWhere(
                `(${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NULL OR ${parentAlias}.${String(property)} < :start OR ${parentAlias}.${String(property)} >= :end)`,
                {
                    start: date.toISOString(),
                    end: nextDay.toISOString()
                }
            )

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): DateTimePicker {
        const input = new DateTimePicker()
            .setFormat('DD-MM-YYYY')
            .setType('date')

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.value) {
            input.setValue(new Date(this.configuration.value))
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const raw = input.getValue()
            this.configuration = raw ? { value: new Date(raw) } : undefined
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { CalendarDateData } from '../'
import { DateTimePicker } from '../../../../component'
import { FlexContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

interface RangeConfig {
    from: Date
    to: Date
}

export class IsDateNotInRangeFilter extends Filter<RangeConfig, CalendarDateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        const property = this.getOption().getProperty()

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.from && this.configuration.to) {
            const from = new Date(this.configuration.from)
            const to = new Date(this.configuration.to)

            from.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
            to.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)

            query.andWhere(
                `(${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NULL OR ${parentAlias}.${String(property)} < :from OR ${parentAlias}.${String(property)} > :to)`,
                {
                    from: from.toISOString(),
                    to: to.toISOString()
                }
            )

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FlexContainer {
        const container = new FlexContainer(true, false)

        const fromInput = new DateTimePicker().setFormat('DD-MM-YYYY').setType('date').setLabel('From date')
        const toInput = new DateTimePicker().setFormat('DD-MM-YYYY').setType('date').setLabel('To date')

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.from) {
            fromInput.setValue(new Date(this.configuration.from))
        }

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.to) {
            toInput.setValue(new Date(this.configuration.to))
        }

        const updateConfig = (): void => {
            const from = fromInput.getValue()
            const to = toInput.getValue()
            this.configuration = from && to ? { from: new Date(from), to: new Date(to) } : undefined
            this.emit('change')
        }

        fromInput.on('change', updateConfig)
        toInput.on('change', updateConfig)

        container.addChild(fromInput)
        container.addChild(toInput)

        return container
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { ReportContext, SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

type DateType = 'datetoday' | 'datetomonth' | 'datetoyear'

export class ChartDateData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected alias: string = this.getRandomAlias()
    protected transform = ':date'

    public constructor(
        entity: new () => T,
        label: string,
        protected property: keyof T,
        protected type: DateType
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        switch (type) {
            case 'datetoday':
                this.transform = 'CONCAT(LEFT(:date, 10), " 00:00:00")'
                break

            case 'datetomonth':
                this.transform = 'CONCAT(LEFT(:date, 8), "01 00:00:00")'
                break

            case 'datetoyear':
                this.transform = 'CONCAT(LEFT(:date, 5), "01:01 00:00:00")'
                break
        }

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(this.transform.replace(':date', `${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`))) {
            const select = this.transform.replace(':date', `${parentAlias}.${this.property}`)

            query.addSelect(select, this.alias)
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(this.transform.replace(':date', `${parentAlias}.${this.property}`))
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        query.addOrderBy(this.transform.replace(':date', `${parentAlias}.${this.property}`), direction)
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, data: any) {
        return entity[this.property]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, data: any) {
        return new Typography(this.getValue(entity, data))
    }

    public getContexts(): ReportContext[] {
        return ['chart']
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { BeforeTodayFilter, TodayDateFilter } from './filters'
import { ColumnType, SelectQueryBuilder, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { ContainsFilter } from './filters/contains'
import { FormattedDate, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { IsDateBetweenFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateBetween'
import { IsDateGreaterThanEqualFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/isDateGreaterthanEqual'
import { IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDays'
import { IsDateInLastMonthFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateLastMonth'
import { IsDateInThisYearFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateThisYear'
import { IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDaysFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDays'
import { IsDateLessThanEqualFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/isDateLessthanEqual'
import { IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDays'
import { IsDateMonthFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateMonth'
import { IsDateNotEqualFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateNotEqual'
import { IsDateNotInRangeFilter } from '../calendarDate/filters/IsDateNotInRange'
import { ReportContext, SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

export class FormattedDateData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected type: ColumnType

    public constructor(
        entity: new () => T,
        label: string,
        protected property: keyof T,
        protected displayAsTimeOnly: boolean = false
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')

        this.setGroupable(false)
        this.setSortable(true)
        this.addFilterType('beforeToday', BeforeTodayFilter)
        this.addFilterType('todayDate', TodayDateFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than or equal to', IsDateGreaterThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is less than or equal to', IsDateLessThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than X but less than Y', IsDateBetweenFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is less than today’s date minus X days', IsDateLessThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than today’s date plus X days', IsDateGreaterThanTodayPlusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than today’s date minus X days', IsDateGreaterThanTodayMinusXDaysFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Not equal to', IsDateNotEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Not within a date range X - Y', IsDateNotInRangeFilter)
        this.addFilterType('This month', IsDateMonthFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Last Month', IsDateInLastMonthFilter)
        this.addFilterType('This year', IsDateInThisYearFilter)

        const metadata = getRepository(entity).metadata.findColumnWithPropertyName(this.property as string)

        if (metadata === undefined) {
            throw new Error('Property not found')
        }

        this.type = metadata.type
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof T)[] {
        return [this.property]
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(`\`${parentAlias}\`.\`${databaseName}\``)) {
            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`)
        }
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC') {
        query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, direction)
    }

    public getProperty(): keyof T {
        return this.property
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, data: any): Date | null {
        if (entity === null) {
            return null
        }

        const value = entity[this.property]

        if (value === null) {
            return null
        }

        if (!(value instanceof Date)) {
            const createdDate = new Date(`${value}`)

            if (createdDate instanceof Date && !isNaN(createdDate)) {
                return createdDate
            }

            return 'Invalid date or format'
            // If an error is thrown it disables the whole page so this was removed.
            // If returning a string causes problems with filtering then an old date should be used instead.
        }

        return value
    }

    public getDateOrdinal(number: number): string {
        let ending = 'th'

        if (number === 31 || number === 21 || number === 1) {
            ending = 'st'
        } else if (number === 22 || number === 2) {
            ending = 'nd'
        } else if (number === 23 || number === 3) {
            ending = 'rd'
        }

        return `${number}${ending}`
    }

    public getManuallyFormattedDate(isoDateString: string): string {
        // formats as Do MMM YYYY
        const months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
        const dateArray = isoDateString.slice(0, 10).split('-')
        const year = dateArray[0]
        const month = months[Number(dateArray[1]) - 1]
        const dayOfMonth = this.getDateOrdinal(Number(dateArray[2]))

        return `${dayOfMonth} ${month} ${year}`
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, data: any): Typography | FormattedDate {
        const value = this.getValue(entity, data)

        if (value === null) {
            return new Typography('')
        }

        if (this.displayAsTimeOnly) {
            return new FormattedDate(this.getValue(entity, data), 'HH:mm:ss')
        }

        switch (this.type) {
            case 'datetime':
            case 'timestamp':
                return new FormattedDate(this.getValue(entity, data), 'Do MMM YYYY HH:mm:ss')

            case 'time':
                return new FormattedDate(this.getValue(entity, data), 'HH:mm:ss')

            case 'date':
            default:
                // Keep date as the date provided and don't adjust for time zone
                return new Typography(this.getManuallyFormattedDate(this.getValue(entity, data).toISOString()))
        }
    }

    public getContexts(): ReportContext[] {
        return ['list']
    }
}
````

````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { DateRangePicker } from '../../../../component/dateRangePicker'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { FormattedDateData } from '../'

interface ContainsFilterConfiguration {
    dates: {startDate?: Date, endDate?: Date} | undefined
    noDateSelected: boolean
    operatorFilter: {
        operator: string
        date: string
    }

    anyDateSelected: boolean
}

export class ContainsFilter extends Filter<ContainsFilterConfiguration, FormattedDateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    if (this.configuration.noDateSelected) {
                        query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                            for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                                query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NULL`)
                            }
                        }))
                    } else if (this.configuration.anyDateSelected) {
                        query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                            for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                                query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NOT NULL`)
                            }
                        }))
                    } else if (this.configuration.operatorFilter) {
                        const prefixes = ['=', '>', '<', '>=', '<=', '<>']
                        const inputDateValue = this.configuration.operatorFilter.date
                        const inputOperator = this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator
                        const validOperator = prefixes.includes(this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator)

                        if (validOperator) {
                            const dateValue = inputDateValue
                            const datevalue = moment(dateValue, 'MMM/DD/YYYY').format('YYYY-MM-DD')

                            if (inputDateValue && inputOperator !== '<>') {
                                query.orWhere(`DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)})${this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator}:datevalue`, {
                                    datevalue: `${datevalue}`
                                })
                            } else if (inputDateValue && inputOperator === '<>') {
                                query.orWhere(`DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)})!=:datevalue`, {
                                    datevalue: `${datevalue}`
                                })
                            }
                        } else {
                            return
                        }
                    } else {
                        const startDate = new Date(this.configuration.dates.startDate)
                        const endDate = new Date(this.configuration.dates.endDate)

                        query.orWhere(`(DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) >= DATE(:startDate) AND DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) <= DATE(:endDate))`, {
                            startDate: `${startDate.toISOString()}`,
                            endDate: `${endDate.toISOString()}`
                        })
                    }
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): DateRangePicker {
        const input = new DateRangePicker()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setDates(this.configuration.dates)
        }

        input.on('change', (dates: {startDate?: Date, endDate?: Date}) => {
            input.setDates(dates).invalidateCache()

            if (input.getNoDate()) {
                this.configuration = {
                    dates: {
                        startDate: new Date(),
                        endDate: new Date()
                    },
                    noDateSelected: true,
                    anyDateSelected: false,
                    operatorFilter: null
                }
            } else if (input.getAnyDate()) {
                this.configuration = {
                    dates: {
                        startDate: new Date(),
                        endDate: new Date()
                    },
                    noDateSelected: false,
                    anyDateSelected: true,
                    operatorFilter: null
                }
            } else {
                this.configuration = dates === null ? undefined : { dates, noDateSelected: false, anyDateSelected: false, operatorFilter: null }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('clear', () => {
            this.configuration = undefined
            input.clearDates()
            input.setOperatorSelected(null)
            input.setInputDate(null)
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('noDate', () => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setNoDate()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: {
                    startDate: new Date(),
                    endDate: new Date()
                },
                noDateSelected: true,
                anyDateSelected: false,
                operatorFilter: null
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('anyDate', () => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setAnyDate()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: {
                    startDate: new Date(),
                    endDate: new Date()
                },
                noDateSelected: false,
                anyDateSelected: true,
                operatorFilter: null
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('dateValue', (value: string) => {
            input.setInputDate(value).invalidateCache()
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('operatorValue', (value: string) => {
            input.setOperatorSelected(value).invalidateCache()
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('applyDate', (value: { operator: string, date: string}) => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setInputDate(value.date).invalidateCache()
            input.setOperatorSelected(value.operator).invalidateCache()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: { startDate: new Date(), endDate: new Date() },
                noDateSelected: false,
                anyDateSelected: false,
                operatorFilter: { operator: value.operator, date: value.date }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}

````

````typescript
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    if (this.configuration.noDateSelected) {
                        query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                            for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                                query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NULL`)
                            }
                        }))
                    } else if (this.configuration.anyDateSelected) {
                        query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                            for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                                query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IS NOT NULL`)
                            }
                        }))
                    } else if (this.configuration.operatorFilter) {
                        const prefixes = ['=', '>', '<', '>=', '<=', '<>']
                        const inputDateValue = this.configuration.operatorFilter.date
                        const inputOperator = this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator
                        const validOperator = prefixes.includes(this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator)

                        if (validOperator) {
                            const dateValue = inputDateValue
                            const datevalue = moment(dateValue, 'MMM/DD/YYYY').format('YYYY-MM-DD')

                            if (inputDateValue && inputOperator !== '<>') {
                                query.orWhere(`DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)})${this.configuration.operatorFilter.operator}:datevalue`, {
                                    datevalue: `${datevalue}`
                                })
                            } else if (inputDateValue && inputOperator === '<>') {
                                query.orWhere(`DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)})!=:datevalue`, {
                                    datevalue: `${datevalue}`
                                })
                            }
                        } else {
                            return
                        }
                    } else {
                        const startDate = new Date(this.configuration.dates.startDate)
                        const endDate = new Date(this.configuration.dates.endDate)

                        query.orWhere(`(DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) >= DATE(:startDate) AND DATE(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) <= DATE(:endDate))`, {
                            startDate: `${startDate.toISOString()}`,
                            endDate: `${endDate.toISOString()}`
                        })
                    }
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): DateRangePicker {
        const input = new DateRangePicker()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setDates(this.configuration.dates)
        }

        input.on('change', (dates: {startDate?: Date, endDate?: Date}) => {
            input.setDates(dates).invalidateCache()

            if (input.getNoDate()) {
                this.configuration = {
                    dates: {
                        startDate: new Date(),
                        endDate: new Date()
                    },
                    noDateSelected: true,
                    anyDateSelected: false,
                    operatorFilter: null
                }
            } else if (input.getAnyDate()) {
                this.configuration = {
                    dates: {
                        startDate: new Date(),
                        endDate: new Date()
                    },
                    noDateSelected: false,
                    anyDateSelected: true,
                    operatorFilter: null
                }
            } else {
                this.configuration = dates === null ? undefined : { dates, noDateSelected: false, anyDateSelected: false, operatorFilter: null }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('clear', () => {
            this.configuration = undefined
            input.clearDates()
            input.setOperatorSelected(null)
            input.setInputDate(null)
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('noDate', () => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setNoDate()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: {
                    startDate: new Date(),
                    endDate: new Date()
                },
                noDateSelected: true,
                anyDateSelected: false,
                operatorFilter: null
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('anyDate', () => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setAnyDate()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: {
                    startDate: new Date(),
                    endDate: new Date()
                },
                noDateSelected: false,
                anyDateSelected: true,
                operatorFilter: null
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('dateValue', (value: string) => {
            input.setInputDate(value).invalidateCache()
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('operatorValue', (value: string) => {
            input.setOperatorSelected(value).invalidateCache()
            this.emit('change')
        })

        input.on('applyDate', (value: { operator: string, date: string}) => {
            input.clearDates()
            input.setInputDate(value.date).invalidateCache()
            input.setOperatorSelected(value.operator).invalidateCache()
            this.configuration = {
                dates: { startDate: new Date(), endDate: new Date() },
                noDateSelected: false,
                anyDateSelected: false,
                operatorFilter: { operator: value.operator, date: value.date }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { ContainsFilter } from './filters/contains'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

type AggregateType = 'avg' | 'count' | 'max' | 'min' | 'stddev_pop' | 'stddev_samp' | 'sum' | 'var_pop' | 'var_samp'

export class AggregateData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected alias: string = this.getRandomAlias()
    protected precision?: number

    public constructor(
        entity: new () => T,
        label: string,
        protected property: keyof T,
        protected type: AggregateType
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.setAlign('right')
        this.setGroupable(false)
        this.setSortable(true)
        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
    }

    public getProperty(): keyof T {
        return this.property
    }

    public setPrecision(precision?: number): this {
        this.precision = precision

        return this
    }

    public getFormattedValueBase(value: any): string {
        return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: this.precision, maximumFractionDigits: this.precision }).format(value)
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        const distinct = this.type === 'count' ? 'DISTINCT ' : ''

        let select = `COALESCE(${this.type.toUpperCase()}(${distinct}${parentAlias}.${this.property}), 0)`

        if (this.precision !== undefined) {
            select = `ROUND(${select}, ${this.precision})`
        }

        query.addSelect(select, this.alias)
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC') {
        query.addOrderBy(`COALESCE(${this.type.toUpperCase()}(${parentAlias}.${this.property}), 0)`, direction)
    }

    public getAlias() {
        return this.alias
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, data: any) {
        return data[this.alias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, data: any) {
        return new Typography(this.getValue(entity, data))
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { AggregateData } from '../../aggregate'
import { BaseInputFilter } from '../../../filter'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../../functions/convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName'

interface ContainsFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class ContainsFilter extends BaseInputFilter<ContainsFilterConfiguration, AggregateData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()
        const property = this.getOption().getProperty()
        const tablename = this.getOption().getEntity().name
        const totalProp = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(tablename, property.toString())

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            const inputValue = this.configuration.value.trim()

            /*
               Multi-character operators are placed first in the array so that single character
               matches are not incorrectly matched first (as part of the multi-character operators)
            */

            const prefixes = ['<>', '>=', '<=', '=', '>', '<']
            const matchingPrefix = prefixes.find(prefix => inputValue.startsWith(prefix))

            if (matchingPrefix) {
                const checkAggregateTableName = ['QuoteItem', 'SalesOrderItem', 'AllJobCost', 'PurchaseOrderItem']
                const groupByField = {
                    QuoteItem: 'quote_id',
                    SalesOrderItem: 'sales_order_id',
                    AllJobCost: 'job_id',
                    PurchaseOrderItem: 'purchase_order_id'
                }
                const formattedValue = inputValue.slice(matchingPrefix.length)
                const operatorMap: Record<string, string> = {
                    '=': '=',
                    '>': '>',
                    '<': '<',
                    '>=': '>=',
                    '<=': '<=',
                    '<>': '!='
                }

                if (formattedValue.length >= 1 &&
                    Number.isFinite(Number(formattedValue)) &&
                    operatorMap[matchingPrefix]) {
                    if (checkAggregateTableName.includes(tablename)) {
                        const fetchField = groupByField[tablename]
                        const subQuery = query.subQuery()
                            .select(`${parentAlias}.${fetchField}`)
                            .from(tablename, parentAlias)
                            .groupBy(`${parentAlias}.${fetchField}`)
                            .andHaving(`ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}), 0), 2) ${operatorMap[matchingPrefix]}:tagCount`, { tagCount: Number(formattedValue) })

                        query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.${fetchField} IN ${subQuery.getQuery()}`)
                    } else {
                        query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${totalProp} ${operatorMap[matchingPrefix]} :${alias}`, {
                            [alias]: formattedValue
                        })
                    }
                } else {
                    query.orWhere(`LOWER(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) LIKE :${alias}`, {
                        [alias]: `%${inputValue.toLowerCase()}%`
                    })
                }

                return true
            }

            query.orWhere(`LOWER(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) LIKE :${alias}`, {
                [alias]: `%${inputValue.toLowerCase()}%`
            })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { BooleanData } from '../'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { MultipleSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface BooleanFilterConfiguration {
    value: string | string[]
}

export class BooleanFilter extends Filter<BooleanFilterConfiguration, BooleanData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            const property = this.getOption().getProperty()

            if (this.configuration.value !== undefined) {
                const queryValues = Array.isArray(this.configuration.value)
                    ? `(${this.configuration.value.map((value: string) => value).join(', ')})`
                    : `(${this.configuration.value})`

                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} IN ${queryValues}`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === undefined) {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.orWhere(`(${parentAlias}.${String(property)} <> '0' AND ${parentAlias}.${String(property)} <> '1')`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): MultipleSelect<string> {
        const getFilterValues: string[] = []

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value) {
                if (Array.isArray(this.configuration.value)) {
                    this.configuration.value.map((value: string) => {
                        if (value === '1') {
                            getFilterValues.push('✔')
                        } else if (value === '0') {
                            getFilterValues.push('✖')
                        }
                    })
                } else {
                    const addToFilterList = this.configuration.value === '1' ? '✔' : '✖'
                    getFilterValues.push(addToFilterList)
                }
            }
        }

        const booleanOptionValues: string[] = ['✔', '✖']
        const select = new MultipleSelect<string>().setOptions(booleanOptionValues)
            .setValues(getFilterValues.length ? getFilterValues : [])

        // select.setValues are what options are displayed in filter
        // select.setValues can be used to set the selected filter conditions in the configuration section of views
        // this.configuration.values are what is filtered
        // this.configuration.value can be an array item if both options are selcted and single item if single option is selected
        // this.configuration = undefined - 'return all results'
        // this.configuration.value = undefined - 'return no results'
        // booleanOptionValues are true (1) and false (0) options

        const convertValues = (): string[] => {
            const values = select.getValues()
            if (values.length === 1) {
                return values[0] === '✔' ? ['1'] : ['0']
            } else if (values.length === 2) {
                return ['1', '0']
            }

            return undefined
        }

        select.on('open', () => {
            if (!this.configuration) {
                select.setValues(booleanOptionValues)
            }
        })

        select.on('close', () => {
            // if both selected show options in the header and show all lines
            if (select.getValues().length === 2) {
                select.setValues(booleanOptionValues)
                this.configuration = { value: convertValues() }
            } else {
                this.configuration = { value: convertValues() }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        select.on('clear', () => {
            this.configuration = { value: undefined }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        select.on('toggle', async () => {
            if (select.getValues().length) {
                this.configuration = { value: convertValues() }
            } else {
                this.configuration = { value: convertValues() }
            }

            this.emit('change')
        })

        return select
    }
}
````

````typescript
export class NumberData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {

        super(entity, label)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)
        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('compare', CompareFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Equal to', IsEqualToFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than or equal to', IsGreaterThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is less than or equal to', IsLessThanEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('Is greater than X but less than Y', IsBetweenFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')

        this.renderLabel = result => `${result[property]}`
    }

    public getFormattedValueBase(value: any): string {
        return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: this.precision, maximumFractionDigits: this.precision }).format(value)
    }

        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public setPrecision(precision: number): this {

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`)
        }
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC') {
        query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, direction)
    }

    public getProperty(): keyof T {
        return this.property
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        } else {
            return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
        }
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        return new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw))
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../../models/base'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { FlexContainer, Select } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { NumberData } from '../../number'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { getReportOptions } from '../../../../configuration'

type operator = '<' | '<=' | '=' | '>=' | '>' | '<>'
const operatorMap = {
    '<': 'Less than',
    '<=': 'Less than or equal to',
    '=': 'Equals',
    '>=': 'Greater than or equal to',
    '>': 'Greater than',
    '<>': 'Does not equal'
}

interface CompareFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
    operator: operator
    valueIsNumber?: boolean
}

export class CompareFilter extends Filter<CompareFilterConfiguration, NumberData<Base>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<Base>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.value !== undefined && this.configuration.operator !== undefined) {
            const property = this.getOption().getProperty()
            const { value, operator, valueIsNumber } = this.configuration

            if (valueIsNumber) {
                query.andWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} ${operator} ${value}`)
            } else {
                const optionForComparison = getReportOptions(this.getOption().getEntity()).find(option => option.getLabel() === value)
                const propertyForComparison = (optionForComparison as NumberData<Base>).getProperty()

                query.andWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} ${operator} ${parentAlias}.${String(propertyForComparison)}`)
            }

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FlexContainer {
        const container = new FlexContainer(true, false)
        const options = getReportOptions(this.getOption().getEntity())
            .filter(option => option instanceof NumberData && option.getLabel() !== this.getOption().getLabel())
            .map(option => option.getLabel())

        const propertySelect = new Select<string>()
            .setOptions(options)
            .setPlaceholder('Property')

        const operatorSelect = new Select<operator>()
            .setOptions(['<', '<=', '=', '<>', '>=', '>'])
            .setPlaceholder('Operator')
        operatorSelect.getOptionPrimary = operator => operatorMap[operator]

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value !== undefined) {
                propertySelect.setValue(this.configuration.value)
            }

            if (this.configuration.operator !== undefined) {
                operatorSelect.setValue(this.configuration.operator)
            }
        }

        const handleChange = (): void => {
            const value = propertySelect.getValue()
            const operator = operatorSelect.getValue()

            this.configuration = !operator && !value ? undefined : { value, operator }
            this.emit('change')
        }

        propertySelect.on('change', handleChange)
        operatorSelect.on('change', handleChange)

        container.addChild(operatorSelect, propertySelect)

        return container
    }
}
````

````typescript
export function pascalToSnakeCase(text: string): string {
    return text.replace(/[A-Z]/g, letter => `_${letter.toLowerCase()}`).replace(/^_/, '')
}

export function snakeToPascalCase(snakeCaseString: string): string {
    const words = snakeCaseString.split('_')
    const pascalCaseWords = words.map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
    return pascalCaseWords.join('')
}

export function pascalToNormal(pascalCaseString: string): string {
    const result = pascalCaseString
        .replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')
        .trim()

    return result.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + result.slice(1)
}

export function toCamelCase(text: string): string {
    if (!text) {
        return text
    }

    const pascalCase = text.includes('_')
        ? snakeToPascalCase(text)
        : text

    return pascalCase.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + pascalCase.slice(1)
}
````

````typescript
import moment from 'moment'
````
