````typescript
import { EqualsFilter } from './filters/equals'
import { NotEqualFilter } from './filters/notEqual'
import { NotNullFilter } from './filters/notNull'
import { NullFilter } from './filters/isNull'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { pascalToSnakeCase } from '../../../functions/pascalToSnakeCase'

export function getSubQueryForCustomFieldId(
    query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>,
    customFieldAlias: string,
    returnAlias: string,
    tableName: string,
    customFieldNumber: number
): SelectQueryBuilder<CustomField> {
    return query.subQuery()
        .select('id', returnAlias)
        .from(CustomField, customFieldAlias)
        .where(`${customFieldAlias}.table_name = '${tableName}'`)
        .orderBy('id')
        .offset(customFieldNumber - 1)
        .limit(1)
}

export class CustomFieldData<T extends Base> extends DataOption<T> {
    protected preferredAlias = `pa${this.getRandomAlias()}pa`
    protected customFieldIdAlias = `cf${this.getRandomAlias()}cf`
    protected entityTableName: string

    // Sometimes seeing error like "ER_ILLEGAL_VALUE_FOR_TYPE: Illegal double '6e594' value found during parsing"
    // It looks like an alias is being treated as a double if it has an "e" in it (scientific notation).

    public constructor(entity: new () => T, protected customFieldNumber: number) {
        super(entity, `_Custom Field ${String(customFieldNumber).padStart(2, '0')}`)

        this.entityTableName = pascalToSnakeCase(entity.name)

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('notNull', NotNullFilter)
        this.addFilterType('isNull', NullFilter)
        this.addFilterType('notEqual', NotEqualFilter)
        this.addFilterType('equals', EqualsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
        this.setSortable(true)
    }

    public getEntityTableName(): string {
        return this.entityTableName
    }

    public getPreferredAlias(): string {
        return this.preferredAlias
    }

    public getCustomFieldNumber(): number {
        return this.customFieldNumber
    }

    public getCustomFieldIdAlias(): string {
        return this.customFieldIdAlias
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => getSubQueryForCustomFieldId(
            subQuery,
            this.getRandomAlias(),
            this.customFieldIdAlias,
            this.entityTableName,
            this.customFieldNumber
        ), this.customFieldIdAlias)

        query.addSelect(subQuery2 => {
            const alias = `custom${this.getRandomAlias()}2c`

            return subQuery2
                .select(`COALESCE(text_value, number_value, date_value, cfo.label)`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(CustomFieldValue, alias)
                .leftJoin(`${alias}.customFieldOption`, 'cfo')
                .where(`${alias}.${this.entityTableName}_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .andWhere(`${alias}.custom_field_id = ${this.customFieldIdAlias}`)
                // this should only ever return one record
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any): string {
        return entity === null ? '' : raw[this.preferredAlias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any): Typography<{}> {
        const value = this.getValue(entity, raw)

        if (value && moment(value, moment.ISO_8601, true).isValid()) {
            return new Typography(moment(value).format('Do MMM, YYYY'))
        }

        return new Typography(value)
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        const alias1 = this.getRandomAlias()
        const alias2 = this.getRandomAlias()
        const aliasForCFO = this.getRandomAlias()

        const subQueryGetCustomFieldId = getSubQueryForCustomFieldId(
            query,
            this.getRandomAlias(),
            this.getRandomAlias(),
            this.entityTableName,
            this.customFieldNumber
        )

        const subQueryGetIfValueIsNumber = query.subQuery()
            .select(
                `CASE
                    WHEN number_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'NUMBER'
                    WHEN date_value IS NOT NULL THEN 'DATE'
                    ELSE 'TEXT'
                END`,
                'valueType'
            )
            .from(CustomFieldValue, alias1)
            .where(`${alias1}.${this.entityTableName}_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
            .andWhere(`${alias1}.custom_field_id = (${subQueryGetCustomFieldId.getQuery()})`)

        const subQueryForCustomFieldValue = query.subQuery()
            .select(`COALESCE(text_value, number_value, date_value, ${aliasForCFO}.label)`, 'result')
            .from(CustomFieldValue, alias2)
            .leftJoin(`${alias2}.customFieldOption`, aliasForCFO)
            .where(`${alias2}.${this.entityTableName}_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
            .andWhere(`${alias2}.custom_field_id = (${subQueryGetCustomFieldId.getQuery()})`)

        query
            .addOrderBy(`CASE WHEN (${subQueryGetIfValueIsNumber.getQuery()}) = 1 THEN CAST((${subQueryForCustomFieldValue.getQuery()}) AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END`, direction)
            .addOrderBy(`CASE WHEN (${subQueryGetIfValueIsNumber.getQuery()}) = 1 THEN CAST((${subQueryForCustomFieldValue.getQuery()}) AS SIGNED) ELSE (${subQueryForCustomFieldValue.getQuery()}) END`, direction)
        // Need to do two ordering statements with the first one with a NULL in the ELSE so that ordering of nulls is correct
        // (if 0 used then nulls are put between positives and negatives.
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { CustomFieldData, getSubQueryForCustomFieldId } from '..'
import { CustomFieldValue } from '../../../../models'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { Input } from '../../../../component'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

interface ContainsFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class ContainsFilter extends Filter<ContainsFilterConfiguration, CustomFieldData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

            const subQueryGetCustomFieldId = getSubQueryForCustomFieldId(
                query,
                this.getOption().getRandomAlias(),
                this.getOption().getRandomAlias(),
                this.getOption().getEntityTableName(),
                this.getOption().getCustomFieldNumber()
            )

            const subQueryForCustomFieldValue = query.subQuery()
                .select(`COALESCE(text_value, number_value, date_value, cfo.label)`, 'result')
                .from(CustomFieldValue, 'cfv')
                .leftJoin(`cfv.customFieldOption`, 'cfo')
                .where(`cfv.${this.getOption().getEntityTableName()}_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .andWhere(`cfv.custom_field_id = ${subQueryGetCustomFieldId.getQuery()}`)

            query.andWhere(`${subQueryForCustomFieldValue.getQuery()} LIKE :${alias}`, {
                [alias]: `%${this.configuration.value.toLowerCase()}%`
            })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): Input {
        const input = new Input()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../../models/base'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { FlexContainer, Input } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { NumberData } from '../../number'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

interface CompareFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
    operator: '='
    valueIsNumber?: boolean
}

export class IsEqualToFilter extends Filter<CompareFilterConfiguration, NumberData<Base>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<Base>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.value !== undefined) {
            const property = this.getOption().getProperty()
            const { value } = this.configuration

            query.andWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} = :compareValue`, {
                compareValue: Number(value)
            })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FlexContainer {
        const container = new FlexContainer(true, false)

        const valueField = new Input()
            .setType('number')
            .setPlaceholder('Enter exact value')

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.value) {
            valueField.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        valueField.on('change', () => {
            const value = valueField.getValue()
            this.configuration = value ? { value, operator: '=', valueIsNumber: true } : undefined
            this.emit('change')
        })

        container.addChild(valueField)

        return container
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../../models/base'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { FlexContainer, Input } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { NumberData } from '../../number'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

interface BetweenFilterConfiguration {
    lower?: string
    upper?: string
    valueIsNumber?: boolean
}

export class IsBetweenFilter extends Filter<BetweenFilterConfiguration, NumberData<Base>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<Base>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (
            this.configuration &&
            this.configuration.lower !== undefined &&
            this.configuration.upper !== undefined
        ) {
            const property = this.getOption().getProperty()
            const lower = Number(this.configuration.lower)
            const upper = Number(this.configuration.upper)

            query.andWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} > :lower AND ${parentAlias}.${String(property)} < :upper`, {
                lower,
                upper
            })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FlexContainer {
        const container = new FlexContainer(true, false)

        const lowerField = new Input()
            .setType('number')
            .setPlaceholder('Greater than (Y)')

        const upperField = new Input()
            .setType('number')
            .setPlaceholder('Less than (X)')

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.lower) {
            lowerField.setValue(this.configuration.lower)
        }

        if (this.configuration && this.configuration.upper) {
            upperField.setValue(this.configuration.upper)
        }

        const handleChange = (): void => {
            const lower = lowerField.getValue()
            const upper = upperField.getValue()

            this.configuration = lower && upper
                ? { lower, upper, valueIsNumber: true } 
                : undefined

            this.emit('change')
        }

        lowerField.on('change', handleChange)
        upperField.on('change', handleChange)

        container.addChild(lowerField, upperField)

        return container
    }
}

````

````typescript
import { Absence } from '../../../models'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<Absence>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            switch (this.configuration.value) {
                case 'Approved':
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.approved = '1'`)

                    return true
                case 'Pending':
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.pending = '1'`)

                    return true
                case 'Declined':
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.declined = '1'`)

                    return true
                case 'Draft':
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = '1'`)

                    return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render() {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Draft', 'Pending', 'Approved', 'Declined'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { LinkData } from '..'
import { Filter } from '../../..'

interface IdArrayFilterConfiguration {
    ids: string[]
}

export class ArrayFilter extends Filter<IdArrayFilterConfiguration, LinkData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.ids.length > 0) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

                    query.orWhere(`LOWER(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) IN (:${alias})`, {
                        [alias]: this.configuration.ids
                    })
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FragmentContainer {
        return new FragmentContainer()
    }
}
````

````typescript
import type { CurrencyIsoCode } from '../models'

export function formatInternationalNumber(value: number, currency?: CurrencyIsoCode, preferredLocale?: string, precision?: number, showCurrencyCode: boolean = true): string {
    const locale = preferredLocale || Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().locale || 'en-US'

    const formatter: Intl.NumberFormat = currency
        ? new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
            style: 'currency',
            currency,
            currencyDisplay: showCurrencyCode ? 'symbol' : 'code'
        })
        : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, {
            minimumFractionDigits: precision,
            maximumFractionDigits: precision
        })

    try {
        return showCurrencyCode ? formatter.format(value) : (formatter.format(value)).replace(/(^....)/, '')
    } catch (error) {
        throw new Error(error)
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { AllJobCost } from '../../../models'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface CostTypeFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class CostTypeFilter extends Filter<CostTypeFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<AllJobCost>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Purchase order cost') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.type = 'Purchase order cost'`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Adhoc cost') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.type = 'Adhoc cost'`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Inventory cost') {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.type = 'Inventory cost'`)

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Labour cost') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.type = 'Labour cost`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Purchase order cost', 'Adhoc cost', 'Inventory cost', 'Labour cost'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { DictionaryTerm } from '../../models'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'

interface DictionaryTerms {
    [key: string]: string
}

/**
 * Class used for the synchronous fetching of correct termionology for use in strings
 **/
class DictionaryClass {
    protected terms: DictionaryTerms = {}

    /**
     * Update the stored terms of the class to the latest database definitions
     **/
    public async setTerms(): Promise<void> {
        const dictionaryTerms = await getRepository(DictionaryTerm).find()

        if (dictionaryTerms) {
            dictionaryTerms.forEach(term => {
                this.terms[term.defaultTerm] = term.preferredTerm
            })
        }
    }

    public translate(term: string): string {
        return this.terms[term] || term
    }

    public getTerms(): DictionaryTerms {
        return this.terms
    }
}

export const Dictionary = new DictionaryClass()

/**
 * Translator function to use correct terminology for strings
 * @param term a string to be converted; if it matches a stored database term it will be translated,
 * else the term is returned as entered
 **/
export function _(term: string): string {
    const splitWords = term.split(' ')

    // Convert each word of term to uppercase to ensure translation match
    const termToTranslate = splitWords.map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.substring(1)).join(' ')
    const translatedTerm = Dictionary.translate(termToTranslate)

    if (term[0].match(/[A-Z]/)) {
        return translatedTerm
    }

    // If translated term is all capitals, e.g. VAT or V.A.T. then leave as it is
    if (translatedTerm === translatedTerm.toUpperCase()) {
        return translatedTerm
    }

    const splitTranslatedWords = translatedTerm.split(' ')

    return splitTranslatedWords.map(word => word.toLowerCase()).join(' ')
}
````

````typescript
import * as models from '../../../models'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

interface EntityFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class EntityFilter extends Filter<EntityFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<models.AuditEvent>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            const alias = this.option.getRandomAlias()

            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.entity = :${alias}`, { [alias]: this.configuration.value })

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render() {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()

        input.setNullPrimary('All').setOptions(Object.keys(models).filter(model => ['Base'].indexOf(model) === -1))

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.getOptionPrimary = option => {
            return option.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1').toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^./, match => match.toUpperCase())
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { EnumOption } from '../'
import { Filter } from '../../../filter'
import { Input } from '../../../../component'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface EnumFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class EnumFilter extends Filter<EnumFilterConfiguration, EnumOption<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                const property = this.getOption().getProperty()
                const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

                query.orWhere(`${parentAlias}.${String(property)} = :${alias}`, {
                    [alias]: this.configuration.value
                })
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> | Input {
        const entity = this.getOption().getEntity().name
        const property = this.getOption().getProperty()
        const column = getRepository(entity).metadata.findColumnWithPropertyName(String(property))

        const input = column && column.type === 'enum'
            ? new NullableSelect<string>()
                .setNullPrimary('All')
                .setOptions(column.enum as string[])
            : new Input()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../models/base'
import { ContainsFilter } from '../../reports/data/link/filters/contains'
import { EqualsFilter } from '../../reports/data/link/filters/equals'
import { FragmentContainer, Link, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { MultiPropertyDataOption } from '../../reports/option'
import { Repository, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Skeleton } from '../../component'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../functions'
import { getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { _ } from '../../functions/dictionary'

export class AdvancedLinkData<T extends Base> extends MultiPropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)

    public constructor(entity: { new(): T }, label: string, protected properties: (keyof T)[]) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)

        this.renderLink = () => ''
        this.renderLabel = result => this.properties.map(property => result[property]).join(', ')

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.addFilterType('equals', EqualsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
    }

    public setRenderLink(renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)): this {
        this.renderLink = renderLink

        return this
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        for (const property of this.properties) {
            const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(property))

            if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
                query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${property}`)
            }
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(
            `CONCAT(${this.properties.map(property => `${parentAlias}.${property}`).join(', ')})`
        )
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        for (const property of this.properties) {
            query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${property}`, direction)
        }
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        }

        return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any): FragmentContainer | Typography {
        if (entity === null) {
            return new Typography('')
        }

        const repository: Repository<T> = getRepository(entity.constructor)
        const { metadata } = repository
        const relations = this.properties
            .filter(property => Boolean(metadata.findRelationWithPropertyPath(property as string)))
            .map(property => String(property))

        if (!relations || relations.length === 0) {
            throw new Error('No relations found')
        }

        relations.forEach((relation: string) => {
            if (relation === 'salesOrder') {
                relations.push('salesOrder.salesOrderNumber')
            } else if (relation === 'job') {
                relations.push('job.jobNumber')
            }
        })

        const contentContainer = new FragmentContainer().addChild(new Skeleton());

        (async () => {
            const entityWithRelations = await repository.findOne(entity.id, { relations })

            let renderLabel: string
            let renderLink: string

            if (!entityWithRelations) {
                return contentContainer.clearChildren()
            }

            for (const property of this.properties) {
                if (entityWithRelations[property]) {
                    if (property === 'salesOrder') {
                        renderLabel = `Sales order ${entityWithRelations.salesOrder.salesOrderNumber.uniqueNumber}`
                        renderLink = `/sales/orders/${entityWithRelations.salesOrder.id}`
                    } else if (property === 'job') {
                        renderLabel = `${_('Job')} ${entityWithRelations.job.jobNumber.uniqueNumber}`
                        renderLink = `/work/jobs/${entityWithRelations.job.id}`
                    } else {
                        renderLabel = `${property} ${entityWithRelations[property].id}`
                    }

                    break
                }
            }

            this.setRenderLabel(entity => renderLabel)
            this.setRenderLink(entity => renderLink)

            let renderedLink = this.renderLink(entity, raw)

            if (!(renderedLink instanceof Link)) {
                renderedLink = new Link(renderedLink)
            }

            contentContainer.clearChildren().addChild(renderedLink.addChild(new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw))))
        })()

        return contentContainer
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Backorder } from '../../../models'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<Backorder>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Pending') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.active = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.pending = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Active') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.active = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.pending = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Complete') {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 1`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.active = 0`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.pending = 0`)

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Pending', 'Active', 'Complete'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Backorder } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(backorder: Backorder): string {
    if (backorder.pending) {
        return 'Pending'
    } else if (backorder.complete) {
        return 'Complete'
    }

    return 'Active'
}
````

````typescript
import { MultiPropertyDataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class BranchInvoiceAddress extends MultiPropertyDataOption<Branch> {
    protected fullAddressStringAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(Branch, 'Branch invoice address')
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof Branch)[] {
        return []
    }

    public getValue(entity: Branch | null, raw: any): string[] {
        return raw[this.fullAddressStringAlias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Branch | null, raw: any, container: Component<any, any, any>): Component<any, any, any> {
        const address = this.getValue(entity, raw) ? this.getValue(entity, raw).toString() : ''

        return new Typography(address)
````

````typescript
/* eslint-disable max-classes-per-file */
import { Address, Branch } from '../../../models'
import { Component, FragmentContainer, Input, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Filter, SinglePropertyDataOption, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

const FIELD = 'postal_code'
const ADDRESS_TYPE = 'delivery'

export interface ContainsFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

// Note that adding these to a list can make the list slow to respond

export function applyWhereForSegmentOfPrimaryAddressOfBranch(
    query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>,
    parentAlias: string,
    configurationValue: string,
    alias: string,
    addressFieldName: string,
    invoiceOrDelivery: 'invoice' | 'delivery',
    filterType: 'contains' | 'equals' | 'notEqual' | 'isNull' | 'notNull'
): void {
    switch (filterType) {
        case 'contains':
            query.andWhere(`EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM postal_address addr
                WHERE addr.branch_id = ${parentAlias}.id
                AND addr.primary_${invoiceOrDelivery} = 1
                AND LOWER(addr.${addressFieldName}) LIKE :${alias}
            )`, { [alias]: `%${configurationValue.toLowerCase()}%` })

            break
        case 'equals':
            query.andWhere(`EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM postal_address addr
                WHERE addr.branch_id = ${parentAlias}.id
                AND addr.primary_${invoiceOrDelivery} = 1
                AND LOWER(addr.${addressFieldName}) = :${alias}
            )`, { [alias]: configurationValue })
            break
        case 'notEqual':
            query.andWhere(`NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM postal_address addr
                WHERE addr.branch_id = ${parentAlias}.id
                AND addr.primary_${invoiceOrDelivery} = 1
                AND LOWER(addr.${addressFieldName}) = :${alias}
            )`, { [alias]: configurationValue })
            break
        case 'isNull':
            query.andWhere(`NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM postal_address addr
                WHERE addr.branch_id = ${parentAlias}.id
                AND addr.primary_${invoiceOrDelivery} = 1
                AND addr.${addressFieldName} IS NOT NULL
                AND addr.${addressFieldName} <> '')`)
            break
        case 'notNull':
            query.andWhere(`EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM postal_address addr
                WHERE addr.branch_id = ${parentAlias}.id
                AND addr.primary_${invoiceOrDelivery} = 1
                AND addr.${addressFieldName} IS NOT NULL
                AND addr.${addressFieldName} <> '')`)
    }
}
````

````typescript
            this.preferredAlias
        )
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { CallLog } from '../../../models'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<CallLog>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Open') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.open = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Closed') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.open = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render() {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Open', 'Closed'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Company, CompanyCustomerSupplierProspect, Customer, Prospect, Supplier } from '../../../models'
import { CompanyDropdownPanel } from '../../../component'
import { DropdownData } from '../../../reports'
import { FlexContainer, Theme, Tooltip } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'
import { getIcon, getTheme } from '../../../configuration'
import { _ } from '../../../functions/dictionary'

export class CompanyDropdownData extends DropdownData<Company> {
    protected customerAlias: string
    protected supplierAlias: string
    protected prospectAlias: string
    protected customerId: string
    protected supplierId: string
    protected prospectId: string

    public constructor() {
        super(Company, 'Name dropdown', 'name')

        this.customerAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.supplierAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.prospectAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.customerId = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.supplierId = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.prospectId = this.getRandomAlias()

        this.setRenderDropdown((entity, raw) => {
            const container = new FlexContainer(true, false).setDirection('column')
            const iconsAndNames: Theme[] = []

            if (raw[this.customerAlias]) {
                const to = `/sales/customers/${raw[this.customerId]}`

                iconsAndNames.push(
                    new Theme(getTheme(Customer), getTheme(Customer)).addChild(
                        new CompanyDropdownPanel(getIcon(Customer).getIcon(), raw[this.customerAlias], `${_('customer')}`, to)
                    )
                )
            }

            if (raw[this.supplierAlias]) {
                const to = `/purchasing/suppliers/${raw[this.supplierId]}`

                iconsAndNames.push(
                    new Theme(getTheme(Supplier), getTheme(Supplier)).addChild(
                        new CompanyDropdownPanel(getIcon(Supplier).getIcon(), raw[this.supplierAlias], `${_('supplier')}`, to)
                    )
                )
            }

            if (raw[this.prospectAlias]) {
                const to = `/sales/prospects/${raw[this.prospectId]}`

                iconsAndNames.push(
                    new Theme(getTheme(Prospect), getTheme(Prospect)).addChild(
                        new CompanyDropdownPanel(getIcon(Prospect).getIcon(), raw[this.prospectAlias], 'prospect', to)
                    )
                )
            }

            if (iconsAndNames.length <= 1) {
                return null
            }

            return container.addChild(...iconsAndNames)
        })

        this.setRenderLink((entity, raw) => {
            if (raw[this.customerId] && (raw[this.supplierId] || raw[this.prospectId]) || (raw[this.supplierId] && raw[this.prospectId])) {
                return null
            }

            if (raw[this.customerId]) {
                return `/sales/customers/${raw[this.customerId]}`
            }

            if (raw[this.supplierId]) {
                return `/purchasing/suppliers/${raw[this.supplierId]}`
            }

            if (raw[this.prospectId]) {
                return `/sales/prospects/${raw[this.prospectId]}`
            }

            return null
        })

        this.setRenderIcon((entity, raw) => {
            if (raw[this.customerId] && (raw[this.supplierId] || raw[this.prospectId]) || (raw[this.supplierId] && raw[this.prospectId])) {
                return null
            }

            if (raw[this.customerId]) {
                return new Theme(getTheme(Customer), getTheme(Customer)).addChild(
                    new Tooltip('This is a customer').addChild(
                        getIcon(Customer).setThemeColor('primary')
                    )
                )
            }

            if (raw[this.supplierId]) {
                return new Theme(getTheme(Supplier), getTheme(Supplier)).addChild(
                    new Tooltip('This is a supplier').addChild(
                        getIcon(Supplier).setThemeColor('primary')
                    )
                )
            }

            if (raw[this.prospectId]) {
                return new Theme(getTheme(Prospect), getTheme(Prospect)).addChild(
                    new Tooltip('This is a prospect').addChild(
                        getIcon(Prospect).setThemeColor('primary')
                    )
                )
            }

            return null
        })
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`)
        }

        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            return subQuery
                .from(CompanyCustomerSupplierProspect, 'ccsp')
                .where(`ccsp.company_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .leftJoin('customer', 'cu', 'ccsp.customer_id = cu.id')
                .select('cu.id', this.customerId)
        }, this.customerId)

        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            return subQuery
                .from(CompanyCustomerSupplierProspect, 'ccsp')
                .where(`ccsp.company_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .leftJoin('supplier', 'su', 'ccsp.supplier_id = su.id')
                .select('su.id', this.supplierId)
        }, this.supplierId)

        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            return subQuery
                .from(CompanyCustomerSupplierProspect, 'ccsp')
                .where(`ccsp.company_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .leftJoin('prospect', 'pr', 'ccsp.prospect_id = pr.id')
                .select('pr.id', this.prospectId)
        }, this.prospectId)

        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            return subQuery
                .from(CompanyCustomerSupplierProspect, 'ccsp')
                .where(`ccsp.company_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .leftJoin('customer', 'cu', 'ccsp.customer_id = cu.id')
                .leftJoin('company', 'cuco', 'cu.company_id = cuco.id')
                .select('cuco.name', this.customerAlias)
        }, this.customerAlias)

        query.addSelect(subQuery => {

                .leftJoin('supplier', 'su', 'ccsp.supplier_id = su.id')
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { Component, FlexContainer, Link, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Dropdown } from '../../../component'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

export class DropdownData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)
    protected renderDropdown: ((entity: T, raw: any) => Component)
    protected renderIcon: ((entity: T, raw: any) => Component)

    public constructor(entity: { new(): T }, label: string, protected property: keyof T) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.renderDropdown = () => null
        this.renderLabel = result => `${result[property]}`
    }

    public setRenderLink(renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)): this {
        this.renderLink = renderLink

        return this
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public setRenderDropdown(renderDropdown: ((entity: T, raw: any) => Component)): this {
        this.renderDropdown = renderDropdown

        return this
    }

    public setRenderIcon(renderIcon: ((entity: T, raw: any) => Component)): this {
        this.renderIcon = renderIcon

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`)
        }
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, direction)
    }

    public getValue(entity: T, raw: any): string {
        if (entity) {
            return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
        }

        return ''
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any): Component {
        const contentContainer = new FlexContainer(true, false).setAlignItems('center').setSpacing(8)

        let value: Link | Typography = new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw))
        if (this.renderLink) {
            let renderedLink = this.renderLink(entity, raw)
            if (renderedLink) {
                if (typeof renderedLink === 'string') {
                    renderedLink = new Link(this.renderLink(entity, raw) as string)
                }

                value = renderedLink.addChild(new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw)))
            }
        }

        const dropdownContent = this.renderDropdown(entity, raw)
        const dropdown = new Dropdown().addChild(dropdownContent)

        if (this.renderIcon) {
            contentContainer.addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(this.renderIcon(entity, raw))
            )
        }

        contentContainer.addChild(value)

        if (dropdownContent) {
            contentContainer.addChild(dropdown)
        }

        return contentContainer
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Contact } from '../../../models'
import { ContactNameLinkData } from '../reports/contactNameLinkData'
import { Filter } from '../../../reports/filter'
import { Input } from '../../../component'

interface ContactNameFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class ContactNameFilter extends Filter<ContactNameFilterConfiguration, ContactNameLinkData> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<Contact>): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                const personAlias = this.getOption().getPersonAlias()
                const aliasForename = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()
                const aliasSurname = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

                query.orWhere(`LOWER(${personAlias}.forename) LIKE :${aliasForename}`, {
                    [aliasForename]: `%${this.configuration.value.toLowerCase()}%`
                })

                query.orWhere(`LOWER(${personAlias}.surname) LIKE :${aliasSurname}`, {
                    [aliasSurname]: `%${this.configuration.value.toLowerCase()}%`
                })
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): Input {
        const input = new Input()

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Button, Chip } from '../../../component'
import { Component, Dialog, FlexContainer, FragmentContainer, Icon, IconButton, Tooltip } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Contact, MarketingTag } from '../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { TagFilter } from './filters/tagFilters'

export class TagData extends SinglePropertyDataOption<Contact> {
    protected preferredAlias: string

    public constructor() {
        super(Contact, 'Tags')

        this.preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.clearFilterTypes()
        this.addFilterType('in', TagFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('in')
    }

    public getValue(entity: Contact | null, raw: any): any[] {
        const data = []

        if (raw[this.preferredAlias]) {
            for (const [id, tag] of JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])) {
                data.push(tag)
            }
        }

        return data
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Contact | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
        const content: { tag: string }[] = []
        const contentContainer = new FragmentContainer()
        const showMoreButton = new IconButton(new Icon('MoreHoriz')).setSize('small')

        let stop = false

        if (raw[this.preferredAlias]) {
            for (const [id, tag] of JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])) {
                content.push({ tag })

                if (!stop) {
                    const tagChip = new Chip().setLabel(tag)
                    contentContainer.addChild(tagChip)

                    if (contentContainer.getChildren().length > 5) {
                        stop = true
                        contentContainer.removeChild(tagChip)
                        contentContainer.addChild(
                            new Tooltip('Show all tags').addChild(showMoreButton)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        showMoreButton.on('click', () => {
            const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Marketing tags')
            const dialogContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)
            const close = new Button().setLabel('Close').on('click', () => application.getContainer().removeChild(dialog))
            dialog.addAction(close).setCancelButton(false)

            for (const data of content) {
                dialogContainer.addChild(
                    new Chip()
                        .setLabel(data.tag)
                        .setSize('medium')
                )
            }

            dialog.addChild(dialogContainer)
            application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)
        })

        return contentContainer
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( '[', \`${alias}\`.id, ',"', REGEXP_REPLACE(ptn.tag, '"', '\\\\\\\\"'), '"]' ) ), ']')`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(MarketingTag, alias)
                .leftJoin(`marketing_tag_name`, 'ptn', `\`${alias}\`.marketing_tag_name_id = ptn.id`)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.contact_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .groupBy(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Contact, MarketingTag, MarketingTagName } from '../../../../models'
import { Filter } from '../../../../reports/filter'
import { MultipleSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SelectQueryBuilder, getManager, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { TagData } from '../tagData'

interface TagFilterConfiguration {
    values: MarketingTagName[]
}

export class TagFilter extends Filter<TagFilterConfiguration, TagData> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.values.length > 0) {
            const names = this.configuration.values.map(tag => tag.tag)
            const subQuery = query.subQuery()
                .select('p.id')
                .from(Contact, 'p')
                .innerJoin('p.marketingTags', 't')
                .innerJoin('t.marketingTagName', 'n')
                .andWhere('n.tag IN (:names)', { names })
                .groupBy('p.id')
                .andHaving('COUNT(t.id) = :tagCount', { tagCount: this.configuration.values.length })

            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${subQuery.getQuery()}`)

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): MultipleSelect<MarketingTagName> {
        const select = new MultipleSelect<MarketingTagName>()
        select.getOptionPrimary = marketingTagName => marketingTagName.tag
        let allTags: MarketingTagName[]

        getRepository(MarketingTagName).find().then(values => {
            allTags = values
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            select.setValues(this.configuration.values)
        }

        select.on('close', () => {
            const values = select.getValues()

            this.configuration = values === null ? undefined : { values }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        select.on('clear', () => {
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        select.on('toggle', async () => {
            const selected = select.getValues()

            if (selected.length) {
                const subtags = await this.getSubtags(selected)
                select.setOptions([...selected, ...subtags])
            } else {
                select.setOptions(allTags)
            }
        })

        return select
    }

    protected async getSubtags(selected: MarketingTagName[]): Promise<MarketingTagName[]> {
        const tagIds = selected.map(marketingTagName => Number(marketingTagName.id))
        const subTags: MarketingTagName[] = []

        if (tagIds.length === 0) {
            const marketingTagNames = await getRepository(MarketingTagName).find()
            subTags.push(...marketingTagNames)
        } else {
            const query = getManager()
                .createQueryBuilder()
                .addSelect('ptn.id')
                .addSelect('ptn.tag')
                .from(subQuery => {
                    subQuery
                        .addSelect('pt.contact_id')
                        .addSelect('CONCAT(",", GROUP_CONCAT(pt.marketing_tag_name_id), ",")', 'ptnid')
                        .from(MarketingTag, 'pt')
                        .groupBy('pt.contact_id')

                    return subQuery
                }, 'pt1')
                .leftJoin('marketing_tag', 'pt2', 'pt1.contact_id = pt2.contact_id')
                .leftJoin('pt2.marketingTagName', 'ptn', 'pt2.marketing_tag_name_id = ptn.id')
                .groupBy('ptn.id')
                .having('ptn.id NOT IN(:ids)', { ids: tagIds })

            /**
            * When appending multiple wheres to this query, the parameter being passed
            * into the where clause needed to increment its key to prevent typeorm overwriting it
            */
            for (let i = 0; i < tagIds.length; i++) {
                query.andWhere(`pt1.ptnid LIKE "%,:id${i},%"`, { [`id${i}`]: Number(tagIds[i]) })
            }

            const results = await query.getRawMany()
            const tagNames: MarketingTagName[] = results.map(result => ({ id: result.ptn_id, tag: result.ptn_tag }))

            subTags.push(...tagNames)
        }

        return subTags
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { LinkData } from '..'
import { Filter } from '../../..'

interface IdArrayFilterConfiguration {
    ids: string[]
}

export class ArrayFilterIncludingNulls extends Filter<IdArrayFilterConfiguration, LinkData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.ids.length > 0) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()
                    const field = `LOWER(${parentAlias}.${String(property)})`

                    query.orWhere(`(${field} IS NULL OR ${field} IN (:${alias}))`, { [alias]: this.configuration.ids })
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FragmentContainer {
        return new FragmentContainer()
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { ContainsFilter } from './filters/contains'
import { Link, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

export class UniqueNumberData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected numberAlias: string = this.getRandomAlias()
    protected renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)

    public constructor(protected entity: new () => T, protected label: string, protected property: keyof T) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.renderLink = () => ''
        this.renderLabel = (result) => `${(result[this.property] as any).uniqueNumber}`

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)
        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
    }

    public getNumberAlias(): string {
        return this.numberAlias
    }

    public setRenderLink(renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)): this {
        this.renderLink = renderLink

        return this
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.leftJoin(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, this.numberAlias)
        query.addSelect(`${this.numberAlias}.uniqueNumber`)
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, direction)
    }

    public getProperty() {
        return this.property
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        if (entity && entity[this.property]) {
            return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
        } else {
            return 'Not assigned'
        }
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        if (entity) {
            let renderedLink = this.renderLink(entity, raw)

            if (!(renderedLink instanceof Link)) {
                renderedLink = new Link(renderedLink)
            }

            return renderedLink.addChild(new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw)))
        } else {
            return new Typography('')
        }
    }

    // UniqueNumbers are freely available
    public getCanView(application: Application): boolean {
        return true
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { Company } from '../../../models'
import { ContainsFilter } from './filters/contains'
import { Dot } from '../../../component'
import { Component, FlexContainer, Link, Theme, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { MultiPropertyDataOption, RelationOption } from '../../option'
import { PaletteColorOptions } from '@mui/material/styles/createPalette'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

export class ListStatus<T extends Base> extends MultiPropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)
    protected color: ((entity: T, raw: any) => PaletteColorOptions)
    protected title: string
    protected relatedFieldToFilterOrSort: string

    public constructor(entity: { new(): T }, label: string, protected properties: (keyof T)[]) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.renderLink = () => ''
        this.renderLabel = result => this.properties.map(property => result[property]).join(', ')

        this.addFilterType('contains', ContainsFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('contains')
    }

    public setRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort(propertyName: string): this {
        this.relatedFieldToFilterOrSort = propertyName

        return this
    }

    public getRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort(): string {
        return this.relatedFieldToFilterOrSort
    }

    public setRenderLink(renderLink: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string | Link)): this {
        this.renderLink = renderLink

        return this
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public setColor(color: ((entity: T, raw: any) => PaletteColorOptions)): this {
        this.color = color

        return this
    }

    public setTooltip(title: string): this {
        this.title = title

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        for (const property of this.properties) {
            const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(property))

            if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
                query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${property}`)
            }
        }
    }

    public applyGroup(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addGroupBy(
            `CONCAT(${this.properties.map(property => `${parentAlias}.${property}`).join(', ')})`
        )
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {
        if (this.getRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort()) {
            const alias = this.getDependentOptions().filter(option => option.getLabel() === 'Company').shift() as RelationOption<Company>

            if (alias) {
                const companyalias = alias.getAlias()
                const companyField = this.getRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort() || 'alias'

                query.addOrderBy(`${companyalias}.${companyField}`, direction)

                return
            }

            console.error('setRelatedFieldToFilter() used on non company table in applySort method of listStatus. Normal sort applied.')
        }

        for (const property of this.properties) {
            query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${property}`, direction)
        }
    }

    public getProperties(): (keyof T)[] {
        return this.properties
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any): string {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        }

        return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any): Component {
        if (entity === null) {
            return new Typography('')
        }

        let renderedLink = this.renderLink(entity, raw)

        if (!(renderedLink instanceof Link)) {
            renderedLink = new Link(renderedLink)
        }

        return renderedLink.addChild(
            new FlexContainer(true, false).addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(
                    new Theme(this.color(entity, raw), this.color(entity, raw)).addChild(
                        new Dot().setColour('primary').setTooltipTitle(this.title)
                    )
                ),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw)))
            ).setSpacing(8).setDirection('row')
        )
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseInputFilter } from '../../../filter'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Company } from '../../../../models'
import { ListStatus } from '../../listStatus'
import { RelationOption } from '../../../../reports/option'

interface ContainsFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class ContainsFilter extends BaseInputFilter<ContainsFilterConfiguration, ListStatus<any>> {
    protected companyalias: string
    protected companyField: string = 'alias'

    public constructor(option: ListStatus<any>, configuration?: ContainsFilterConfiguration) {
        super(option, configuration)

        const alias = option.getDependentOptions().filter(option => option.getLabel() === 'Company').shift() as RelationOption<Company>
        this.companyalias = alias.getAlias()
        this.companyField = option.getRelatedFieldToFilterOrSort() || 'alias'
    }

    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

                    query.orWhere(`LOWER(${this.companyalias}.${this.companyField}) LIKE :${alias}`, {
                        [alias]: `%${this.configuration.value.toLowerCase()}%`
                    })
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../../models/base'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { DataOption, Filter } from '../../..'
import { FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { TypographyData } from '..'

interface IdArrayFilterConfiguration {
    ids: string[]
}

export class ArrayFilter extends Filter<IdArrayFilterConfiguration, DataOption<Base>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<unknown>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.ids.length > 0) {
            const option = this.getOption() as TypographyData<Base>

            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of option.getProperties()) {
                    const alias = option.getRandomAlias()

                    query.orWhere(`LOWER(${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) IN (:${alias})`, {
                        [alias]: this.configuration.ids
                    })
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FragmentContainer {
        return new FragmentContainer()
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { CreditNote } from '../../../models'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<CreditNote>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Draft') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Assigned') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.assigned = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Posted') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.posted = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Draft', 'Assigned', 'Posted'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { Invoice } from '../../../models'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class PaymentStatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<Invoice>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        const today = new Date()
        
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Due') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.paid = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.payment_required_by > :today`, { today })
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Overdue') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.paid = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.payment_required_by < :today`, { today })
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Paid') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.assigned = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.paid = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.posted = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Paid', 'Due', 'Overdue'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../models/base'
import { AggregateData } from '../data'
import { GroupOption } from '../option'

export class AggregateGroup<T extends Base> extends GroupOption<T> {
    protected typeLabel = {
        avg: 'Average value',
        count: 'Count',
        max: 'Maximum value',
        min: 'Minimum value',
        stddev_pop: 'Standard deviation (population)',
        stddev_samp: 'Standard deviation (sample)',
        sum: 'Total value',
        var_pop: 'Variance (population)',
        var_samp: 'Variance (sample)'
    }

    public constructor(
        entity: { new(): T },
        label: string,
        property: keyof T,
        types: (AggregateData<T>['type'])[] = [
            'avg', 'max', 'min', 'stddev_pop', 'stddev_samp', 'sum', 'var_pop', 'var_samp'
        ]
    ) {
        super(entity, label)

        for (const type of types) {
            this.addChild(
                new AggregateData(entity, this.typeLabel[type], property, type).setPrecision(2)
            )
        }
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Customer } from '../../../models'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<Customer>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Active') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.approved = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Awaiting approval') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.approved = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Closed') {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 1`)

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'On hold') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render() {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Active', 'Awaiting approval', 'Closed', 'On hold'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
                    [aliasSurname]: `%${this.configuration.value.toLowerCase()}%`
                })

            return true

            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
````

````typescript
import { Base } from '../../../models/base'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../option'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName } from '../../../functions'

export class FormattedNumberData<T extends Base> extends SinglePropertyDataOption<T> {
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)
    protected precision = 2

    public constructor(entity: { new(): T }, label: string, protected property: keyof T) {
        super(entity, label)

        this.setGroupable(true)
        this.setSortable(true)

        this.renderLabel = result => `${result[property]}`
    }

    public getFormattedValueBase(value: any): string {
        return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: this.precision, maximumFractionDigits: this.precision }).format(value)
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: T, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public setPrecision(precision: number): this {
        this.precision = precision

        return this
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

        if (!query.getSql().includes(`${parentAlias}_${databaseName}`)) {
            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`)
        }
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC') {
        query.addOrderBy(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`, direction)
    }

    public getProperty(): keyof T {
        return this.property
    }

    public getValue(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        } else {
            return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
        }
    }

    public renderContent(entity: T | null, raw: any) {
        return new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw))
    }
}

````

````typescript
        const databaseName = convertPropertyNameToDatabaseName(this.entity.name, String(this.property))

            query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.${this.property}`)
        }
    }

    public applySort(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string, direction: 'ASC' | 'DESC'): void {

    }
````

````typescript
import { Filter, LinkData } from '../../../reports'
import { FragmentContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Job } from '../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'

interface IdArrayFilterConfiguration {
    ids: string[]
}

export class IdArrayFilter extends Filter<IdArrayFilterConfiguration, LinkData<Job>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.ids.length > 0) {
            const subQuery = query.subQuery()
                .select('j.id')
                .from(Job, 'j')
                .andWhere('j.id IN (:ids)', { ids: this.configuration.ids })
                .groupBy('j.id')

            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${subQuery.getQuery()}`)

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): FragmentContainer {
        return new FragmentContainer()
    }
}
````

````typescript
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
````

````typescript
import { Job } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(job: Job): string {
    if (job.complete === true) {
        return 'Complete'
    } else if (job.cancelled === true) {
        return 'Cancelled'
    } else if (job.hold === true) {
        return 'On hold'
    } else if (job.draft === true) {
        return 'Draft'
    } else if (job.escalated) {
        return 'Escalated'
    } else if (job.dateStarted) {
        return 'In progress'
    }

    return 'Active'
}
````
