````typescript
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Button, Chip } from '../../../component'
import { Component, Dialog, FlexContainer, FragmentContainer, Icon, IconButton, Tooltip } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Operation, OperationResourceTag } from '../../../models'
import { OperationResourceTagFilter } from './filter/operationResourceTag'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../../reports'

export class OperationTagData extends SinglePropertyDataOption<Operation> {
    protected preferredAlias: string

    public constructor() {
        super(Operation, 'Resource tag and quantity')

        this.preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.clearFilterTypes()
        this.addFilterType('in', OperationResourceTagFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('in')
    }

    public getValue(entity: Operation | null, raw: any): any[] {
        const data = []

        if (raw[this.preferredAlias]) {
            for (const [id, tag] of JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])) {
                data.push(tag)
            }
        }

        return data
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Operation | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
        const content: { tag: string }[] = []
        const contentContainer = new FragmentContainer()
        const showMoreButton = new IconButton(new Icon('MoreHoriz')).setSize('small')
        let stop = false

        if (raw[this.preferredAlias]) {
            for (const [id, tag] of JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])) {
                content.push({ tag })

                if (!stop) {
                    const tagChip = new Chip().setLabel(tag)
                    contentContainer.addChild(tagChip)

                    if (contentContainer.getChildren().length > 5) {
                        stop = true
                        contentContainer.removeChild(tagChip)
                        contentContainer.addChild(
                            new Tooltip('Show all tags').addChild(showMoreButton)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        showMoreButton.on('click', () => {
            const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle('Resource tags')
            const dialogContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)
            const close = new Button().setLabel('Close').on('click', () => application.getContainer().removeChild(dialog))
            dialog.addAction(close).setCancelButton(false)

            for (const data of content) {
                dialogContainer.addChild(
                    new Chip()
                        .setLabel(data.tag)
                        .setSize('medium')
                )
            }

            dialog.addChild(dialogContainer)
            application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)
        })

        return contentContainer
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( '[', \`${alias}\`.id, ',"', CONCAT(\`${alias}\`.resource_tag_quantity, 'x', REGEXP_REPLACE(ptn.name, '"', '\\\\\\\\"')), '"]' ) ), ']')`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(OperationResourceTag, alias)
                .leftJoin(`resource_tag_name`, 'ptn', `\`${alias}\`.resource_tag_name_id = ptn.id`)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.operation_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .groupBy(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Filter } from '../../../../reports/filter'
import { MultipleSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Operation, OperationResourceTag, ResourceTagName } from '../../../../models'
import { OperationTagData } from '../operationTags'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { getManager, getRepository } from 'typeorm'

interface OperationResourceTagFilterConfiguration {
    values: ResourceTagName[]
}

export class OperationResourceTagFilter extends Filter<OperationResourceTagFilterConfiguration, OperationTagData> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.values.length > 0) {
            const names = this.configuration.values.map(tag => tag.name)
            const subQuery = query.subQuery()
                .select('o.id')
                .from(Operation, 'o')
                .innerJoin('o.operationResources', 'or')
                .innerJoin('or.resourceTagName', 'rtn')
                .andWhere('rtn.name IN (:names)', { names })
                .groupBy('o.id')
                .andHaving('COUNT(or.id) = :tagCount', { tagCount: this.configuration.values.length })

            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${subQuery.getQuery()}`)

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): MultipleSelect<ResourceTagName> {
        const select = new MultipleSelect<ResourceTagName>()
        select.getOptionPrimary = resourceTagName => resourceTagName.name
        let allTags: ResourceTagName[]

        getRepository(ResourceTagName).find().then(values => {
            allTags = values
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            select.setValues(this.configuration.values)
        }

        select.on('close', () => {
            const values = select.getValues()

            this.configuration = values === null ? undefined : { values }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        select.on('clear', () => {
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        select.on('toggle', async () => {
            const selected = select.getValues()

            if (selected.length) {
                const subtags = await this.getSubtags(selected)
                select.setOptions([...selected, ...subtags])
            } else {
                select.setOptions(allTags)
            }
        })

        return select
    }

    protected async getSubtags(selected: ResourceTagName[]): Promise<ResourceTagName[]> {
        const tagIds = selected.map(resourceTagName => Number(resourceTagName.id))
        const subTags: ResourceTagName[] = []

        if (tagIds.length === 0) {
            const resourceTagNames = await getRepository(ResourceTagName).find()
            subTags.push(...resourceTagNames)
        } else {
            const query = getManager()
                .createQueryBuilder()
                .addSelect('rtn.id')
                .addSelect('rtn.tag_name')
                .addSelect('ort2.resource_tag_quantity')
                .from(subQuery => {
                    subQuery
                        .addSelect('ort.operation_id')
                        .addSelect('CONCAT(",", GROUP_CONCAT(ort.resource_tag_name_id), ",")', 'rtnid')
                        .from(OperationResourceTag, 'ort')
                        .groupBy('ort.operation_id')

                    return subQuery
                }, 'ort1')
                .leftJoin('operation_resource_tag', 'ort2', 'ort1.operation_id = ort2.operation_id')
                .leftJoin('resource_tag_name', 'rtn', 'ort2.resource_tag_name_id = rtn.id')
                .groupBy('rtn.id')
                .having('rtn.id NOT IN(:ids)', { ids: tagIds })

            /**
            * When appending multiple wheres to this query, the parameter being passed
            * into the where clause needed to increment its key to prevent typeorm overwriting it
            */
            for (let i = 0; i < tagIds.length; i++) {
                query.andWhere(`ort1.rtnid LIKE "%,:id${i},%"`, { [`id${i}`]: Number(tagIds[i]) })
            }

            const results = await query.getRawMany()
            const tagNames: ResourceTagName[] = results.map(result => ({ id: result.rtn_id, name: result.tag_name }))
            subTags.push(...tagNames)
        }

        return subTags
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Opportunity } from '../../../models'

interface OpportunityFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<OpportunityFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<Opportunity>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Open') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.won = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Won') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.won = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Lost') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.won = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render() {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Won', 'Lost', 'Open'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Opportunity } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(opportunity: Opportunity) {
    if (opportunity.closed === true) {
        if (opportunity.won === true) {
            return 'Won'
        } else {
            return 'Lost'
        }
    } else {
        return 'Open'
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Application } from '../../../application'
import { Checkbox, Component, FlexContainer } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { DataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { Product } from '../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder, getRepository } from 'typeorm'

export class CheckboxData extends DataOption<Product> {
    protected preferredAlias: string

    public constructor() {
        super(Product, 'Available for shipping')

        this.preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
    }

    public getValue(entity: Product | null, raw: any): boolean {
        return raw[this.preferredAlias]
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Product | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
        const contentContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setAlignItems('center')
        const check = JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])

        const checkbox = new Checkbox().on('change', async event => {
            const product = await getRepository(Product).findOne({
                where: { id: entity.id }
            })

            if (event.checked) {
                product.availableForShipping = true
            } else {
                product.availableForShipping = false
            }

            await getRepository(Product).save(product)
            application.createAuditEvent(entity, 'update', 'Available for shipping was updated')
        })

        checkbox.setChecked(check)
        contentContainer.addChild(checkbox)

        return contentContainer
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${alias}\`.available_shipping`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(Product, alias)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Component, FlexContainer, Link, Theme, Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Dot, Skeleton } from '../../../component'
import { PaletteColorOptions } from '@mui/material/styles/createPalette'
import { Product, StockValues } from '../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { StatusFilter } from './filters/status'
import { colors } from '@mui/material'
import { _ } from '../../../functions/dictionary'

interface RowClickSelectionContainer {
    rowClick?: boolean
    preserveLinksOnRowClick?: boolean
    rowClickPreservedLinkLabels?: string[]
    rowClickHandler?: (entity: Product) => void | Promise<void>
}

export class StockValueProperty extends SinglePropertyDataOption<Product> {
    protected renderLink: ((entity: Product, raw: any) => string | Link)
    protected renderLabel: ((entity: Product, raw: any) => string)
    protected color: ((entity: Product, raw: any) => PaletteColorOptions)
    protected title: string
    protected preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(Product, 'Stock level status dot')

        this.renderLink = () => ''
        this.renderLabel = () => 'Stock level status dot'

        this.addFilterType('equals', StatusFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('equals')
    }

    public setValue(status: string): this {
        this.setRenderLabel(entity => status)

        return this
    }

    public setTooltip(title: string): this {
        this.title = title

        return this
    }

    public setRenderLabel(renderLabel: ((entity: Product, raw: any) => string)): this {
        this.renderLabel = renderLabel

        return this
    }

    public setRenderLink(renderLink: ((entity: Product, raw: any) => string | Link)): this {
        this.renderLink = renderLink

        return this
    }

    public setColor(color: ((entity: Product, raw: any) => PaletteColorOptions)): this {
        this.color = color

        return this
    }

    public getValue(entity: Product | null, raw: any): string {
        if (entity === null) {
            return ''
        }

        return this.renderLabel(entity, raw)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Product | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const contentContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setAlignItems('center').addChild(
            new FlexContainer(false, true).setPadding(0, 8).addChild(new Skeleton('circle')),
            new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(
                new Skeleton().setWidth(60).setHeight(16),
                new Skeleton().setWidth(60).setHeight(16)
            )
        )

        const getPendingStockStatus = async (): Promise<Typography | Link | FlexContainer> => {
            if (entity === null || entity && !entity.managed) {
                return new Typography('')
            }

            const reorderLevel = entity.reorderLevel ? Number(entity.reorderLevel) : 0
            const reorderWarningPercentage = entity.reorderLevelWarningPercentage ? 1 + Number(entity.reorderLevelWarningPercentage)/100 : 1
            const productStockValues = await getRepository(StockValues).findOne({ where: { id: entity.id } })
            const pendingStockValue = productStockValues ? productStockValues.pendingStock : 0

            if (pendingStockValue <= 0) {
                this.setValue(`No ${_('inventory')}`)
                this.setTooltip(`Pending stock level (${pendingStockValue}) has dropped below 0. Replenish stock immediately.`)
                this.setColor(entity => colors.grey)
            } else if (pendingStockValue < reorderLevel) {
                this.setValue('Reorder')
                this.setTooltip(`Pending stock level (${pendingStockValue}) has dropped below reorder level. Replenish stock.`)
                this.setColor(entity => colors.red)
            } else if (pendingStockValue < reorderLevel * reorderWarningPercentage) {
                this.setValue('Close to limit')
                this.setTooltip(`Pending stock level (${pendingStockValue}) close to reorder limit. Consider restocking.`)
                this.setColor(entity => colors.amber)
            } else {
                this.setValue('No action')
                this.setTooltip(`Sufficient stock levels (${pendingStockValue}).`)
                this.setColor(entity => colors.green)
            }

            const statusContent = new FlexContainer(true, false).addChild(
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(
                    new Theme(this.color(entity, raw), this.color(entity, raw)).addChild(
                        new Dot().setColour('primary').setTooltipTitle(this.title)
                    )
                ),
                new FlexContainer(false, true).addChild(new Typography(this.getValue(entity, raw)))
            ).setSpacing(8).setDirection('row')

            if (this.shouldSuppressLink(container)) {
                return statusContent
            }

            let renderedLink = this.renderLink(entity, raw)

            if (!(renderedLink instanceof Link)) {
                renderedLink = new Link(renderedLink)
            }

            return renderedLink.addChild(
                statusContent
            )
        }

        (async () => {
            const result = await getPendingStockStatus()
            contentContainer.clearChildren().addChild(result)
        })()

        return contentContainer
    }

    protected shouldSuppressLink(container: Component): boolean {
        const configurableListView = container as unknown as RowClickSelectionContainer
        const isRowClickSelectionMode = Boolean(configurableListView && configurableListView.rowClick && configurableListView.rowClickHandler)

        if (!isRowClickSelectionMode) {
            return false
        }

        const preserveLinksOnRowClick = Boolean(configurableListView.preserveLinksOnRowClick)
        const preservedLabels = Array.isArray(configurableListView.rowClickPreservedLinkLabels)
            ? configurableListView.rowClickPreservedLinkLabels
            : []

        if (!preserveLinksOnRowClick) {
            return true
        }

        if (preservedLabels.length === 0) {
            return false
        }

        return !preservedLabels.includes(this.getLabel())
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subQuery
                .select(`\`${alias}\`.id`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(Product, alias)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter } from '../../../../reports/filter'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Product } from '../../../../models'
import { RelationOption } from '../../../../reports/option'
import { StockValueProperty } from '../stockValueProperty'
import { _ } from '../../../../functions/dictionary'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, StockValueProperty> {
    protected stockValueAlias: string

    public constructor(option: StockValueProperty, configuration?: StatusFilterConfiguration) {
        super(option, configuration)

        const alias = option.getDependentOptions().filter(option => option.getLabel() === 'Stock values').shift() as RelationOption<Product>
        this.stockValueAlias = alias.getAlias()
    }

    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        if (this.configuration) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'No stock') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.\`managed\` = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${this.stockValueAlias}\`.\`pending_stock\` <= 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Reorder') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.\`managed\` = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${this.stockValueAlias}\`.\`pending_stock\` < \`${parentAlias}\`.\`reorder_level\``)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${this.stockValueAlias}\`.\`pending_stock\` > 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Close to limit') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.\`managed\` = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${this.stockValueAlias}\`.\`pending_stock\` < \`${parentAlias}\`.\`reorder_level\` * (1 + \`${parentAlias}\`.\`reorder_level_warning_percentage\` / 100)`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${this.stockValueAlias}\`.\`pending_stock\` >= \`${parentAlias}\`.\`reorder_level\``)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'No action') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.\`managed\` = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${this.stockValueAlias}\`.\`pending_stock\` >= \`${parentAlias}\`.\`reorder_level\` * (1 + \`${parentAlias}\`.\`reorder_level_warning_percentage\` / 100)`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render() {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['No stock', 'Reorder', 'Close to limit', 'No action'])

        if (this.configuration) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Filter } from '../../../../reports/filter'
import { MultipleSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Product, ProductTag, ProductTagName } from '../../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder, getManager, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { TagData } from '../tagData'

interface TagFilterConfiguration {
    values: ProductTagName[]
}

export class TagFilter extends Filter<TagFilterConfiguration, TagData> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.values.length > 0) {
            const names = this.configuration.values.map(tag => tag.tag)
            const subQuery = query.subQuery()
                .select('p.id')
                .from(Product, 'p')
                .innerJoin('p.tags', 't')
                .innerJoin('t.productTagName', 'n')
                .andWhere('n.tag IN (:names)', { names })
                .groupBy('p.id')
                .andHaving('COUNT(t.id) = :tagCount', { tagCount: this.configuration.values.length })

            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${subQuery.getQuery()}`)

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): MultipleSelect<ProductTagName> {
        const select = new MultipleSelect<ProductTagName>()
        select.getOptionPrimary = productTagName => productTagName.tag
        let allTags: ProductTagName[]

        getRepository(ProductTagName).find().then(values => {
            allTags = values
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            select.setValues(this.configuration.values)
        }

        select.on('close', () => {
            const values = select.getValues()

            this.configuration = values === null ? undefined : { values }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        select.on('clear', () => {
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        select.on('toggle', async () => {
            const selected = select.getValues()

            if (selected.length) {
                const subtags = await this.getSubtags(selected)
                select.setOptions([...selected, ...subtags])
            } else {
                select.setOptions(allTags)
            }
        })

        return select
    }

    protected async getSubtags(selected: ProductTagName[]): Promise<ProductTagName[]> {
        const tagIds = selected.map(productTagName => Number(productTagName.id))
        const subTags: ProductTagName[] = []

        if (tagIds.length === 0) {
            const productTagNames = await getRepository(ProductTagName).find()
            subTags.push(...productTagNames)
        } else {
            const query = getManager()
                .createQueryBuilder()
                .addSelect('ptn.id')
                .addSelect('ptn.tag')
                .from(subQuery => {
                    subQuery
                        .addSelect('pt.product_id')
                        .addSelect('CONCAT(",", GROUP_CONCAT(pt.product_tag_name_id), ",")', 'ptnid')
                        .from(ProductTag, 'pt')
                        .groupBy('pt.product_id')

                    return subQuery
                }, 'pt1')
                .leftJoin('product_tag', 'pt2', 'pt1.product_id = pt2.product_id')
                .leftJoin('pt2.productTagName', 'ptn', 'pt2.product_tag_name_id = ptn.id')
                .groupBy('ptn.id')
                .having('ptn.id NOT IN(:ids)', { ids: tagIds })

            /**
            * When appending multiple wheres to this query, the parameter being passed
            * into the where clause needed to increment its key to prevent typeorm overwriting it
            */
            for (let i = 0; i < tagIds.length; i++) {
                query.andWhere(`pt1.ptnid LIKE "%,:id${i},%"`, { [`id${i}`]: Number(tagIds[i]) })
            }

            const results = await query.getRawMany()
            const tagNames: ProductTagName[] = results.map(result => ({ id: result.ptn_id, tag: result.ptn_tag }))

            subTags.push(...tagNames)
        }

        return subTags
    }
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * A more accurate rounding function.
 */
export const round = (value: number, decimalPlaces: number): string => {
    const [mantissa, exponent = '0'] = value.toString().split('e')
    const adjustedExp = Number(exponent) + decimalPlaces

    const rounded = Math.round(Number(`${mantissa}e${adjustedExp}`))

    const [roundedMantissa, roundedExp = '0'] = rounded.toString().split('e')
    const finalExp = Number(roundedExp) - decimalPlaces

    return Number(`${roundedMantissa}e${finalExp}`).toFixed(decimalPlaces)
}

/**
 * The original more accurate rounding function. Replaced by above function.
 * Note that it can result in the first part of the number being in e notation and therefore the "number" can have 2 "e"s resulting in "NaN"
 * being returned. Mainly happens if decimal places > 17 but can happen with other very small numbers that result in javascript
 * automatically converting to scientific notation.
 */
export const roundOld = (value: number, decimalPlaces: number) => {
    if (decimalPlaces > 17) {
        decimalPlaces = 17 // This ony partially prevents the function returning NaN
    }

    return Number(Math.round((value + 'e' + decimalPlaces) as any) + 'e-' + decimalPlaces).toFixed(decimalPlaces)
}

````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Product } from '../../../models'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<Product>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Draft') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.active = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Active') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.active = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Draft', 'Active'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}

````

````typescript
import { DataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { Product, ProductQuantityDiscount } from '../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'

export class DiscountPricePerUnitData extends DataOption<ProductQuantityDiscount> {
    protected alias: string = this.getRandomAlias()

    public constructor() {
        super(ProductQuantityDiscount, 'Price per unit')
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const productAlias = this.getRandomAlias()

        query.addSelect(subQuery => {
            return subQuery.select(`\`${productAlias}\`.normal_sell_price_display - (\`${productAlias}\`.normal_sell_price_display * (\`${parentAlias}\`.discount_percentage / 100))`)
                .from(Product, productAlias)
                .where(`${productAlias}.id = \`${parentAlias}\`.product_id`)
        }, this.alias)
    }

    public getValue(entity: ProductQuantityDiscount | null, raw: any) {
        return Number(raw[this.alias]).toFixed(2)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: ProductQuantityDiscount | null, raw: any) {
        return new Typography(`${this.getValue(entity, raw)}`)
    }
}

````

````typescript
            this.emit('change')

        return input
    }
````

````typescript
import { PurchaseOrder } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(purchaseOrder: PurchaseOrder): string {
    if (purchaseOrder.closed) {
        return 'Cancelled'
    } else if (purchaseOrder.hold) {
        return 'On hold'
    } else if (purchaseOrder.draft) {
        return 'Draft'
    } else if (purchaseOrder.awaitingApproval) {
        return 'Awaiting approval'
    } else if (purchaseOrder.complete) {
        return 'Complete'
    }

    return 'In progress'
}
````

````typescript
import { Component, Dialog, FlexContainer, FragmentContainer, Icon, IconButton, Tooltip } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Resource, ResourceTag } from '../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { SinglePropertyDataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { TagFilter } from './filters/tag'
import { _ } from '../../../functions/dictionary'

export class TagData extends SinglePropertyDataOption<Resource> {
    protected preferredAlias: string

    public constructor() {
        super(Resource, 'Tags')

        this.preferredAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        this.clearFilterTypes()
        this.addFilterType('in', TagFilter)
        this.setQuickFilter('in')
    }

    public getValue(entity: Resource | null, raw: any): any[] {
        const data = []

        if (raw[this.preferredAlias]) {
            for (const [id, tag] of JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])) {
                data.push(tag)
            }
        }

        return data
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Resource | null, raw: any, container: Component): Component {
        const application = container.getRootComponent() as Application
        const content: { tag: string }[] = []
        const contentContainer = new FragmentContainer()
        const showMoreButton = new IconButton(new Icon('MoreHoriz')).setSize('small')
        let stop = false

        if (raw[this.preferredAlias]) {
            for (const [id, tag] of JSON.parse(raw[this.preferredAlias])) {
                content.push({ tag })
                if (!stop) {
                    const tagChip = new Chip().setLabel(tag)
                    contentContainer.addChild(tagChip)

                    if (contentContainer.getChildren().length > 5) {
                        stop = true
                        contentContainer.removeChild(tagChip)
                        contentContainer.addChild(
                            new Tooltip(`Show all ${_('resource tags')}`).addChild(showMoreButton)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        showMoreButton.on('click', () => {
            const dialog = new Dialog().setTitle(_('Resource tags'))
            const dialogContainer = new FlexContainer(true, true).setBreakpoint('xs', 12)
            const close = new Button().setLabel('Close').on('click', () => application.getContainer().removeChild(dialog))

            dialog.addAction(close).setCancelButton(false)

            for (const data of content) {
                dialogContainer.addChild(
                    new Chip()
                        .setLabel(data.tag)
                        .setSize('medium')
                )
            }

            dialog.addChild(dialogContainer)
            application.getContainer().addChild(dialog)
        })

        return contentContainer
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        query.addSelect(subquery => {
            const alias = this.getRandomAlias()

            return subquery
                .select(`CONCAT('[', GROUP_CONCAT( CONCAT( '[', \`${alias}\`.id, ',"', REGEXP_REPLACE(rtn.name, '"', '\\\\\\\\"'), '"]' ) ), ']')`, this.preferredAlias)
                .from(ResourceTag, alias)
                .leftJoin(`resource_tag_name`, 'rtn', `\`${alias}\`.resource_tag_name_id = rtn.id`)
                .where(`\`${alias}\`.resource_id = \`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
                .groupBy(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id`)
        }, this.preferredAlias)
    }
}

````

````typescript
import { Filter } from '../../../../reports/filter'
import { MultipleSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Resource, ResourceTag, ResourceTagName } from '../../../../models'
import { SelectQueryBuilder, getManager, getRepository } from 'typeorm'
import { TagData } from '../tagData'

interface TagFilterConfiguration {
    values: ResourceTagName[]
}

export class TagFilter extends Filter<TagFilterConfiguration, TagData> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined && this.configuration.values.length > 0) {
            const names = this.configuration.values.map(tag => tag.name)
            const subQuery = query.subQuery()
                .select('r.id')
                .from(Resource, 'r')
                .innerJoin('r.tags', 't')
                .innerJoin('t.tagName', 'n')
                .andWhere('n.name IN (:names)', { names })
                .groupBy('r.id')
                .andHaving('COUNT(t.id) = :tagCount', { tagCount: this.configuration.values.length })

            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${subQuery.getQuery()}`)

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): MultipleSelect<ResourceTagName> {
        const select = new MultipleSelect<ResourceTagName>()
        let allTags: ResourceTagName[]

        select.getOptionPrimary = resourceTagName => resourceTagName.name

        getRepository(ResourceTagName).find().then(values => {
            allTags = values
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            select.setValues(this.configuration.values)
        }

        select.on('close', () => {
            const values = select.getValues()

            this.configuration = values === null ? undefined : { values }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        select.on('clear', () => {
            select.setOptions(allTags)
        })

        select.on('toggle', async () => {
            const selected = select.getValues()

            if (selected.length) {
                const subtags = await this.getSubtags(selected)

                select.setOptions([...selected, ...subtags])
            } else {
                select.setOptions(allTags)
            }
        })

        return select
    }

    protected async getSubtags(selected: ResourceTagName[]): Promise<ResourceTagName[]> {
        const tagIds = selected.map(resourceTagName => Number(resourceTagName.id))
        const subTags: ResourceTagName[] = []

        if (tagIds.length === 0) {
            const resourceTagNames = await getRepository(ResourceTagName).find()

            subTags.push(...resourceTagNames)
        } else {
            const query = getManager()
                .createQueryBuilder()
                .addSelect('rtn.id')
                .addSelect('rtn.name')
                .from(subQuery => {
                    subQuery
                        .addSelect('rt.resource_id')
                        .addSelect('CONCAT(",", GROUP_CONCAT(rt.resource_tag_name_id), ",")', 'rtnid')
                        .from(ResourceTag, 'rt')
                        .groupBy('rt.resource_id')

                    return subQuery
                }, 'rt1')
                .leftJoin('resource_tag', 'rt2', 'rt1.resource_id = rt2.resource_id')
                .leftJoin('rt2.tagName', 'rtn', 'rt2.resource_tag_name_id = rtn.id')
                .groupBy('rtn.id')
                .having('rtn.id NOT IN(:ids)', { ids: tagIds })

            for (let i = 0; i < tagIds.length; i++) {
                query.andWhere(`rt1.rtnid LIKE "%,:id${i},%"`, { [`id${i}`]: Number(tagIds[i]) })
            }
            const results = await query.getRawMany()
            const tagNames: ResourceTagName[] = results.map(result => ({ id: result.rtn_id, name: result.rtn_tag_name }))

            subTags.push(...tagNames)
        }

        return subTags
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { ReturnsAuthorisation } from '../../../models'

interface ReturnsAuthorisationFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<ReturnsAuthorisationFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<ReturnsAuthorisation>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string) {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Draft') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Active') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Complete') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 1`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render() {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Draft', 'Active', 'Complete'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}

````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Component, Select } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { Supplier } from '../../../models'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class NotEqualStatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<Supplier>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Draft') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Active') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 1`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Complete') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.complete = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): Component {
        const input = new Select<string>()
            .setOptions(['Active', 'Draft', 'Complete'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { RunList } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(runList: RunList): string {
    if (runList.complete === true) {
        return 'Complete'
    } else if (runList.draft === true) {
        return 'Draft'
    }

    return 'Active'
}
````

````typescript
}
````

````typescript
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            const alias = this.option.getRandomAlias()
            query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.invoice_status = :${alias}`, { [alias]: this.configuration.value })
            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<InvoiceStatus> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<InvoiceStatus>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions([InvoiceStatus.NONE, InvoiceStatus.PART, InvoiceStatus.FULL])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value as InvoiceStatus)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, TypographyData } from '../../../reports'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { SalesOrder } from '../../../models'

interface StatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<SalesOrder>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Draft') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'In progress') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.completed != 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Cancelled') {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 1`)

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'On hold') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Complete') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.completed = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Awaiting approval') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.awaiting_approval = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Awaiting approval', 'Draft', 'In progress', 'On hold', 'Cancelled', 'Complete'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}

````

````typescript
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Filter, FullStatusOption } from '../../../reports'
import { Invoice, Job, SalesOrder } from '../../../models'
import { NullableSelect } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { _ } from '../../../functions/dictionary'

interface FullStatusFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class FullStatusFilter extends Filter<FullStatusFilterConfiguration, FullStatusOption<SalesOrder>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.closed = 0`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.hold = 0`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.draft = 0`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.completed != 1`)
            }))

            const jobsSubQuery = query
                .subQuery()
                .from(Job, 'job')
                .innerJoin('job.salesOrder', 'salesOrder')
                .select('salesOrder.id')
                .where('job.complete = 0')
                .andWhere('job.cancelled = 0')
                .getQuery()

            const invoiceSubQuery = query
                .subQuery()
                .from(Invoice, 'invoice')
                .innerJoin('invoice.salesOrder', 'salesOrder')
                .leftJoin('salesOrder.customer', 'customer')
                .select('salesOrder.id')

            if (this.configuration.value === `${_('Jobs')} outstanding`) {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${jobsSubQuery}`)

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Requires invoice') {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id NOT IN ${jobsSubQuery}`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id NOT IN ${invoiceSubQuery.getQuery()}`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.requires_invoice = 1`)

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Processing') {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id NOT IN ${jobsSubQuery}`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${invoiceSubQuery.where('invoice.paid = 1').andWhere('customer.credit = 0').getQuery()}`)

                return true
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Awaiting payment') {
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id NOT IN ${jobsSubQuery}`)
                query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.id IN ${invoiceSubQuery.where('invoice.paid = 0').andWhere('customer.credit = 0').getQuery()}`)

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Requires invoice', `${_('Jobs')} outstanding`, 'Processing', 'Awaiting payment'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { ServiceContract } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(contract: ServiceContract): string {
    if (new Date(contract.expiryDate) < new Date()) {
        return 'Expired'
    } else if (contract.closed === true) {
        return 'Cancelled'
    } else if (contract.hold === true) {
        return 'On hold'
    }
    return 'In progress'
}
````

````typescript
import { Address, Shipment } from '../../../models'
import { DataOption } from '../../../reports'
import { SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { Typography } from '@computech-it/milkman'
import { getShortAddress } from '../../../functions'

export class ShortAddressData extends DataOption<Address | Shipment> {
    public constructor() {
        super(Address || Shipment, 'Short template')
    }

    public applySelect(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): void {
        const formatAlias = this.getRandomAlias()
        query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.streetAddress1`)
        query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.streetAddress2`)
        query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.streetAddress3`)
        query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.city`)
        query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.administrativeArea`)
        query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.postalCode`)
        query.addSelect(`${parentAlias}.country`)

        query.leftJoinAndSelect(`${parentAlias}.format`, formatAlias)
        query.addSelect(`${formatAlias}.shortTemplate`)
    }

    public getValue(entity: Address | Shipment | null): string {
        return entity === null ? '' : getShortAddress(entity)
    }

    public renderContent(entity: Address | Shipment | null): Typography<{}> {
        return new Typography(this.getValue(entity))
    }
}
````

````typescript
import dot from 'dot'

/**
 * Get short representation of an address
 * @param entity A model that contains all address fields and format relation
 */
export function getShortAddress(entity: any): string {
    const template = '{{? it.streetAddress1}}{{= it.streetAddress1}}<br />{{?}}{{? it.streetAddress2}}{{= it.streetAddress2}}<br />{{?}}{{? it.streetAddress3}}{{= it.streetAddress3}}<br />{{?}}{{? it.city}}{{= it.city}}<br />{{?}}{{? it.administrativeArea}}{{= it.administrativeArea}}<br />{{?}}{{? it.postalCode}}{{= it.postalCode}}<br />{{?}}{{? it.country}}{{= it.country}}{{?}}'

    if (entity.format === undefined || entity.format.shortTemplate === undefined) {
        throw new Error('Template not available')
    }

    return dot.compile(entity.format === undefined || entity.format.shortTemplate === undefined ? template : entity.format.shortTemplate)({
        streetAddress1: entity.format.streetAddress1Enabled && entity.streetAddress1,
        streetAddress2: entity.format.streetAddress2Enabled && entity.streetAddress2,
        streetAddress3: entity.format.streetAddress3Enabled && entity.streetAddress3,
        city: entity.format.cityEnabled && entity.city,
        administrativeArea: entity.format.administrativeAreaEnabled && entity.administrativeArea,
        postalCode: entity.format.postalCodeEnabled && entity.postalCode,
        country: entity.country
    }).replace(/<br\s*\/?>/g, ', ')
}
````

````typescript
import { BaseInputFilter } from '../../../reports/filter'
import { Brackets, SelectQueryBuilder } from 'typeorm'
import { StockCategoryPath } from '../../../models'
import { TypographyData } from '../../../reports'

interface StockCategoryContainsFilterConfiguration {
    value: string
}

export class StockCategoryContainsFilter extends BaseInputFilter<StockCategoryContainsFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<StockCategoryPath>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                for (const property of this.getOption().getProperties()) {
                    const alias = this.getOption().getRandomAlias()

                    query.orWhere(`FIND_IN_SET(:${alias}, ${parentAlias}.${String(property)}) > 0`, {
                        [alias]: this.configuration.value.toLowerCase()
                    })
                }
            }))

            return true
        }

        return false
    }
}
````

````typescript
import { Supplier } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(supplier: Supplier) {
    if (supplier.closed === false) {
        if (supplier.hold === true) {
            return 'On hold'
        } else if (supplier.approved === false) {
            return 'Awaiting approval'
        } else {
            return 'Active'
        }
    } else {
        return 'Closed'
    }
}
````

````typescript
export class NotEqualStatusFilter extends Filter<StatusFilterConfiguration, TypographyData<SupplierInvoice>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Paid') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.paid = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            }

            if (this.configuration.value === 'Posted and approved') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.approved = 0`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.posted = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            }

            if (this.configuration.value === 'Posted, awaiting approval') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.awaiting_approval = 0`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.approved = 1`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.posted = 0`)
                }))

                return true
            }

            if (this.configuration.value === 'Unposted. Approved.') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.awaiting_approval = 1`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.approved = 0`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.posted = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }

            if (this.configuration.value === 'Unposted, awaiting approval') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.awaiting_approval = 1`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.approved = 1`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.posted = 1`)
                }))

                return true
            }
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): Select<string> {
        const input = new Select<string>()
            .setOptions(['Paid', 'Unposted, awaiting approval', 'Unposted. Approved.', 'Posted, awaiting approval', 'Posted and approved'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````

### Capsule server/configuration/supplierInvoice/getStatus.ts

````typescript
import { SupplierInvoice } from '../../models'

export function getStatus(supplierInvoice: SupplierInvoice): string {
    if (supplierInvoice.paid) {
        return 'Paid'
    }

    if (!supplierInvoice.paid && Number(supplierInvoice.totalAmountPaid) > 0) {
        return 'Part paid'
    }

    if (supplierInvoice.posted) {
        if (supplierInvoice.approved) {
            return 'Posted and approved'
        }

        return 'Posted, awaiting approval'
    }

    if (supplierInvoice.approved) {
        return 'Unposted. Approved.'
    }

    return 'Unposted, awaiting approval'
}
````

````typescript
interface UserFilterConfiguration {

}

export class UserStatusFilterdDetailed extends Filter<UserFilterConfiguration, UserData<any>> {
    public applyWhere(query: SelectQueryBuilder<any>, parentAlias: string): boolean {
        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            if (this.configuration.value === 'Disabled') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.password_expiry_date <= :date`, { date: new Date() })
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.password_is_hard_expiry_date`)
                }))
            } else if (this.configuration.value === 'Active') {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.password_expiry_date IS NULL`)
                    query.orWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.password_expiry_date > :date`, { date: new Date() })
                }))
            } else {
                query.andWhere(new Brackets(query => {
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.password_expiry_date <= :date`, { date: new Date() })
                    query.andWhere(`\`${parentAlias}\`.password_is_hard_expiry_date = 0`)
                }))
            }

            return true
        }

        return false
    }

    public render(): NullableSelect<string> {
        const input = new NullableSelect<string>()
            .setNullPrimary('All')
            .setOptions(['Active', 'Disabled', 'Password soft expired'])

        if (this.configuration !== undefined) {
            input.setValue(this.configuration.value)
        }

        input.on('change', () => {
            const value = input.getValue()

            this.configuration = value === null ? undefined : { value }
            this.emit('change')
        })

        return input
    }
}
````
